english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
kriol: Bambai na sambala men bin kaman langa det taun gulum Entiyak brom det kantri gulum Judiya, en deibin dalimbat ola bilibamob, “If yumob nomo sekamsais jis laik im tok langa det lowa weya Mosis bin gibit wi, wal God kaan seibum yumob.”

english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
kriol: Brom deya wan olmen brom detlot olmen bin tok langa mi, “Yu nomo kraikrai. Yu luk dijan iya? Im det Boswan brom det Juda klen. Im jis laiga laiyan. En im grengrensan blanga King Deibid. Wal imbin win, en im na gin deigimat detlot sebenbala bush gam en opinimap det rolapwan peipa.”

english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
kriol: En yumob gin baiyim detlot biginini brom detlot pipul brom najalot kantri hubin jidanbat garram yumob. Detlot biginini hubin bon langa yumob kantri gin jidan wekinmen blanga yumob.

english: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
kriol: “Yumob kaan baudan en weship eni drimin, dumaji mi na YAWEI, en ai nomo larram eni drimin deigim main pleis.

english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
kriol: Wal bambai na King Deibid en im soljamob bin go en fait langa detlot Filastain pipul igin, en deibin bidim olabat. En deibin teikoba det taun gulum Geth en ol detlot lilwan taun gulijap.

english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,
kriol: Longtaim wen deibin kaman brom Ijip, deibin go thru langa det deset kantri raidap langa det solwoda gulum Redsi, en afta deibin go langa det pleis gulum Keidish,

english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
kriol: Det silibala san meigim trabul blanga im dedi. Det waif hu oldei graulimbat im hasbin, im jis laik woda weya liklikbat olataim.

english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
kriol: “Isikiyel, yu irrim dijan stori blanga dubala sista.

english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
kriol: En najalot bin lukaftumbat ol detlot speshalwan ebrijing weya deibin yusumbat, en deibin lukaftumbat det flauwa, wain, oliboil, en ola gudsmelwan medisin du.

english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
kriol: Wal yu si? Det olwan lowa im binij na, dumaji det lowa bin wikwan en nogud,

english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
kriol: Bat ol detlot sid daga weya dei nomo bin gugumbat, nomeda deibin miksimap garram det oliboil o gibit draiwan, im blanga detlot serramonimen brom Eran femili en dei garra sherimat gija.”

english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.
kriol: Imbin majurrumap ola Libaimen hubin wek blanga YAWEI en hubin titjimbat ola pipul blanga im lowa, en imbin dalim olabat, “Yumob kaan garrimap det Seikridwan Boks brom wan pleis langa najawan pleis enimo. Im garra stap langa det Serramoni Pleis weya King Salaman det san blanga King Deibid bin bildimap. En deya na yumob garra wek blanga YAWEI en im Isreil pipul olabat.

english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok na, “Mi stil wail langa yumob, en ai garra yusum det king blanga Asiriya. Im garra jidan wulijim bigwan wadi blanga yumob,

english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.
kriol: Olabat reken detlot drim weya dei oldei dalimbat main pipul olabat meigim olabat fogedabat mi, jis laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin fogedabat mi en olabat bin bulurrum det drimin sheip gulum Beil.

english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
kriol: Bat Jisas bin tok, “Sambodi bin tatjim mi. Ai sabi, dumaji aibin filim det pawa bin gowei brom mi.”

english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.
kriol: Bat dumaji wi grenfatha olabat bin meigim det God deya langa hebin wail, imbin larram Nebakanesa det king blanga Bebalon kaman en teikoba olabat kantri en imbin binijimap det Serramoni Pleis en imbin deigidawei ola pipul prisana langa najawan kantri. Nebakanesa na bin brom det femili lain gulum Keldiyan hu jidan langa det kantri gulum Mesapoteimiya.

english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
kriol: Wal mi gibit theingks langa God, dumaji ai nomo bin beptaisim yumob. Oni Krispas en Gaiyas aibin beptaisim.

english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
kriol: “Bat King Sedakaiya brom Juda en detlot wekinmen blanga im, en det najalot pipul langa Jerusalem hubin stap langa dijan kantri, o hubin mub langa Ijip, mi na YAWEI garra tridim olabat wulijim det nogudwan fig daga weya olabat kaan dagat.

english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
kriol: Wal detlot wekinmen bin tok, “Wi nomo garram naf daga. Oni 5 damba en dubala fish wi garram.”

english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
kriol: Langa ebri kantri ola pipul en ola enimul bin binij. Nomo enijing bin jidan laibala. Najing na. Holot bin ded. Oni Nowa en detlot langa det bout bin jidan laibala.

english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.
kriol: Ola pipul bin jidan brabli gudbinjiwei na dumaji Ethalaiya bin dai deya langa det bigwan haus.

english: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,
kriol: Aibin pikimat yu blanga gibitbat feyago langa ebribodi, en mi oldei jidan garram yu. Aibin meigim yu, en ai jandim yu blanga gibit lait langa ola pipul langa ebri kantri en blanga gibit main pramis blanga lukaftumbat olabat.

english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
kriol: Strongbala king, yu pudumon yu bigwan naif. Haibalawan, yu luk gudwan.

english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
kriol: Wal mi en ola Kristjan braja en sista hu jidan garram mi iya, melabat ol tok gudei langa yumob deya langa ola tjetj langa det kantri gulum Galeisha.

english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
kriol: en deibin jingat, “Yumob luk! Iya na det men hubin oldei go ebriweya en tok nogudbalawei blanga ola Juwish pipul en blanga det lowa blanga Mosis en blanga dijan Serramoni Pleis. Tudei na imbin deigim sambala Jintail pipul rait insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis weya dei nomo lau go, en imbin meigim det Serramoni Pleis nogud na.”

english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
kriol: Wal Jeikob bin tok, “Im nomo taim yet blanga meigim ola ship leidan. Im oni dinataim. Yumob gibit woda langa ola ship en deigimbek olabat blanga fidabat.”

english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.
kriol: Wal wen Ebsalom bin gowei brom Jerusalem blanga go langa Hebran, imbin abum 200 men garram im, dumaji imbin askim olabat blanga kaman garram im. Bat dei nomo bin sabi det plen blanga im. Deibin jis go eniwei garram im gudbinjiwei.

english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
kriol: Imbin go gulijap langa det haus wen imbin naitaim na.

english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
kriol: Afta na wen detlot pipul bin stil jinggabat wanim Jisas bin dumbat, imbin tok langa im wekinmen olabat, “Yumob jinggabat dijan wed na. Mi na det Speshalwan Men, en dei garra gibit mi langa detlot men hu garra kilim mi ded.”

english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
kriol: Wal ola bilibamob langa det dubala taun gulum Listra en Aikoniyam bin tok gudbalawei blanga Timathi,

english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
kriol: Wal ai gibit theingks langa YAWEI det trubala God, dumaji im garra jidan garram Shem, en im garra meigim ola klen blanga Keinan jidan jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga ola klen blanga Shem.

english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
kriol: Dumaji langa det dei wen Kosbi bin gitkil wen det brabli strongbala siknis bin goranbat deya langa det hil gulum Piyowa en deya na deibin dum nogudbala ting langa yumob, dumaji deibin trikim yumob blanga go en weship det drimin sheip gulum Beil.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
kriol: Dijan tri garra buldan langa graun en ai garra jandim im langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei jidan. En ola pipul langa ebri kantri garra sheiksheik nomo lilbit. english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

Det wei blanga dijan Kristjan laif im blanga dumbat wanim God wandim wi blanga dum en blanga jidan gudbalawei garram ebribodi en blanga jidan gudbinji garram det Holi Spirit.

english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
kriol: en det pleis garra jidan seikridwan, dumaji ai garra shain detmatj deya.

english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
kriol: Det taim na God garra seibum ola Juwish pipul. Wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman God bin tok, “Tharran hu garra seibum main pipul olabat garra kaman brom det speshalwan taun gulum Saiyan, en im garra deigidawei ola nogudbalawei brom ola grengrensan blanga Jeikob,

english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
kriol: Deibin meigim golwan buligi sheip deya langa Sainai, en deibin weshipbat det laiyawan drimin sheip.

english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.
kriol: Im garra luk im igin. If det sowa im waitwan, wal im klinbala blanga serramoni, en det serramonimen garra tok im klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
kriol: En mi oldei prei langa God blanga yumob, dumaji ai nomo wandim yumob blanga dum eni nogudbala ting. Bat ai nomo prei blanga yumob blanga meigim pipul tok mi gudbala mishanri. Nomo. Mi prei blanga yumob blanga meigim yumob kipgon dumbat gudbala ting. Nomeda pipul tok mi nomo gudbala mishanri, bat stil mi oldei prei blanga yumob wulijim yumob garra jidan strongbala.

english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
kriol: Ilaishama, Eliyada, en Elifalet.

english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
kriol: en yumob bin go langa det nyubala laif, en God bin meigim yumob nyuwan, en ebridei im meigim yumob mowa en mowa laik im wulijim yumob garra sabi im brabliwei.

english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
kriol: Yu kaan dalimbat eni laiyawan stori. Wen dei deigim nogudwan men langa kot, yu kaan dalim laiya blanga album im.

english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
kriol: YAWEI, oni yu na main strongwan ston. Yu irrim mi kraikraibat. Mi askimbat yu blanga albumbat mi. If yu kaan irrim mi wal ai garra dai en go langa greib.

english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
kriol: Yubin deigidawei im speshalwan stik weya im oldei holdim, en yubin nokamdan im speshalwan tjeya langa graun.

english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
kriol: Ai lukap langa ola hil. Hu garra kaman blanga album mi wen mi abum trabul?

english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
kriol: Wal main gudfren olabat, yumob wandim det dei garra kaman, en blanga tharran na yumob garra adwek wulijim God garra luk yumob jidan gudbalawei nomo garram enijing rong, en yumob garra jidan streitwei langa im.

english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
kriol: If yu ensa siliwan kwestjan, wal yu silibala jis laik tharran hubin askim det siliwan kwestjan.

english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.
kriol: Wen det boks bin oldei jidan fulwan garram ola mani, det wekinmen blanga det king hubin oldei raidimdan ebrijing weya det king bin oldei dalim im, en det haibala serramonimen bin oldei kaundimap ola ofring mani en pudum insaid langa beig en taiyimap.

english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house;
kriol: Wal Ethalaiya det kwin bin irrim ola nois wen ola solja en pipul bin jingatbat en imbin go kwikbala langa det Serramoni Pleis weya ola pipul bin majurrumap.

english: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
kriol: En streidawei YAWEI bin jandim faiya, en bin barnimap det 250 wekinmen blanga Kora hubin bringimap det gudsmelwan medisin langa im.

english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
kriol: Wanim meigim yu jinggabat blanga melabat?

english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
kriol: en wen imbin shoum ola klebabala ting imbin dum langa Sowan deya langa det kantri Ijip.

english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin tok langa ol detlot pipul deya langa det Serramoni Pleis, en detlot serramonimen gulum Ferasi bin deya du. Wal Jisas bin tok, “Mi na det lait blanga ebribodi, en wen enibodi bulurrum mi, im kaan jidan langa dakbala na, dumaji im garram det lait weya gibit im laif.”

english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
kriol: En deibin tok olkain nogudbalawei langa im.

english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
kriol: im lafta go langa det teibul blanga det barnapwan ofring en meigim det teibul blanga ofring klinbala blanga serramoni. Im garra go langa det teibul blanga ofring blanga mi en im garra deigim sambala buligi blad en sambala boiwan nenigout blad en pudum ontop langa det shapwan pat langa det fobala kona langa det teibul.

english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
kriol: Bifo Jisas bin gowei brom det pleis, bigmob pipul bin kaman langa im deya langa det bush kantri, en afta thrideistaim dei nomo bin abum eni daga blanga dagat. Wal Jisas bin jingat langa im wekinmen olabat,

english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
kriol: Wal det men bin gowei na, en imbin dalimbat det nyus blanga Jisas langa det tenbala taun langa det kantri gulum Dikapalas, en wen ol detlot pipul bin irrim det nyus, deibin ol hatjamp.

english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
kriol: Ai sabi wotkain mesinja yumob wandim. Yumob wandim detkain laiyinbalawan weya oldei dalim yumob olkain wed blanga meigim yumob gudbinji. Yumob wandim im blanga tok lagijat, God garra gibit yumob blendibala wain en grog.

english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
kriol: Nomeda dei weship langa God, bat stil dei nomo teiknodis langa im. Olabat reken dei bulurrum God lowa. Bat najing. Olabat bulurrum olabat ron lowa.’ Lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok.

english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
kriol: en detlot siksbala am garra abum thribala sheip jis laik det purdiflawa blanga det tri gulum amantri.

english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”
kriol: “Wal yu garra go langa detlot solja blanga yu, en yu garra gudbinji langa olabat, en yu garra shoum olabat yu jinggabat olabat. Trubala mi dalimbat yu. If yu nomo go en tok langa detlot solja blanga yu, wal ailibala yu kaan faindim eni solja iya, dumaji dei garra ol ranawei en gibit bekboun langa yu. Wal ai sabi loda nogudbala ting bin hepin langa yu. Bat if detlot solja blanga yu ranawei brom yu, wal tharran garra jidan mowes blanga yu.” Lagijat na Jowab bin tok.

english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’
kriol: Wen olabat garra askim yu weya olabat garra go, yu dalim olabat wanim aibin dalim langa yu, ‘Sambala garra dai brom nogudwan siknis. Najalot garra dai brom faitfaitbat langa wo. Sambala garra dai brom jidanbat hanggribala en najalot garra gowei prisana. Lagijat na ai garra panishim olabat.’

english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
kriol: Yumob garra libum ola gel en biginini biyain, en oni ola men garra go en weship langa YAWEI det God blanga yumob. If yumob wandi abum det serramoni blanga yumob God, wal oni ola men garra go.” Lagijat na det king bin tok, en afta imbin andimwei Mosis en Eran.

english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
kriol: Eibrahem bin dedi blanga Aisik, en Aisik bin dedi blanga Jeikob, en Jeikob bin dedi blanga Juda,

english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
kriol: King Hairam brom det kantri gulum Taya bin album im en bin gibit im ola sidatri en paintri en ola gol weya imbin wandim blanga dijan wek. Afta wen imbin binij, King Salaman bin gibit King Hairam 20 taun deya langa Gelali.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin kipgon tok langa Mosis,

english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
kriol: En wen im faindim det ship, im garra gudbinji brabliwei. Im gudbinji blanga detlot 99 ship hu nomo bin los. Bat im brabli gudbinji blanga det wanbala ship weya imbin faindim im.

english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
kriol: Wal detlot Emanait solja bin kamat brom olabat taun, en deibin meigim miselp redi blanga fait. En ola king en ola najalot solja weya bin kaman blanga album olabat bin meigim miselp redi blanga fait langa det plein kantri lilbit longwei brom det taun.

english: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
kriol: Wal oni YAWEI det trubala God na hendulum det main blanga det king jis laik im hendulum det woda langa riba en meigim im randan langa raitwan pleis.

english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
kriol: “Wal yumob nomo wandi dum lagijat wen yumob go langa eni padi. Mobeda yumob go en pikimat nogudwan pleis blanga jidan basdam wulijim det boswan garra kaman en dalim yumob blanga go en jidan langa gudbala pleis. En wen im dum lagijat langa yumob, im meigim yumob haibala men langa ola najalot pipul deya.

english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
kriol: Sairas, yu nomo sabi mi, bat mi na bin gulum yu neim en aibin meigim yu haibala, dumaji ai wandim yu garra album main Isreil pipul.

english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.
kriol: Afta na YAWEI bin jandim im spirit langa Jeftha, en Jeftha bin go ebriweya langa det kantri blanga ola Isreil pipul sanraiswei brom det Jodan Riba, en imbin majurrumap ola Isreil men redibala blanga fait, en afta imbin gobek langa det taun gulum Mispa, en brom deya deibin ol go blanga fait langa detlot Emanait solja.

english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.
kriol: Wal Hushai bin dalim im laiyawei, “Ai kaan go garram King Deibid, dumaji mi wekinmen blanga det king weya YAWEI bin pikimat. Mi wekinmen blanga det men weya ol dislot pipul iya en ola najalot Isreil pipul bin pikimat blanga jidan king blanga olabat. Yu sabi? Ai garra jidan iya garram yu, dumaji yu na det king.

english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
kriol: Yumob garra abum seimkain filing blanga ebribodi. En yumob kaan reken miselp haibala en nomo wandi dumbat odinri wek. Yumob garra gudbinji blanga dumbat enikain wek. En yumob kaan reken miselp sabibala wen yumob nomo sabi brabliwei.

english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
kriol: Malai bin abum dubala san neim Eliyeisa en Kish. Wal Eliyeisa nomo bin abum eni san na, bat Kish bin abum wanbala san neim Jeramiyel.

english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
kriol: Wal ol dislot klen na Mosis en Eliyeisa bin raidimdan en kaundimap ola Isreil pipul langa det plein kantri blanga Moweb najasaid langa det Jodan Riba brom Jeriko.

english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
kriol: Maitbi det men nomo garram eni rileishan blanga album im baiyimbek det kantri. Wal wen im abumbat naf mani im gin baiyimbek det kantri miselp.

english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
kriol: En Kenan bin det dedi blanga Mahalalel, en Mahalalel bin det dedi blanga Jered.

english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
kriol: en deibin taiyimap det dubala tjein langa det dubala golwan ring,

english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
kriol: Yunbala bin lukaftumbat mi. Yunbala bin seibum main laif weya yunbala bin bringimat mi iya atsaid brom det taun. Bat det hil kantri im longwei. Maitbi ai kaan gajimap det kantri bifo yunbala binijimap det taun, en ai garra binijap du.

english: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
kriol: en if enibodi yang o ol pipul, gel o boi nomo duwit langa YAWEI, wal dei garra kilim im ded.

english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
kriol: Im kaman brom God, hu jidan det boswan blanga jadjimbat pipul. Im panishim sambala en najalot im larramgo fri.

english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Wal det taim im kaminap na wen wanbala biginini blanga Deibid garra jidan sain blanga ola pipul brom ebri kantri blanga kaman mijamet. Olabat garra oldei bulurrumbat wanim im oldei tok, en im ronwan kantri garra jidan brabli haibala.

english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”
kriol: Olabat granggibala en nomo jinggabat en tok miselp, “Aibin meigim faiya garram lilbit wud blanga gugum main damba en bif, en aibin meigim det drimin sheip garram det najapat blanga det wud. Wotfo ai weshipbat det wud? Im najing!”

english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
kriol: “En ol yumob Juda pipul deya langa det taun gulum Shafiya, yumob garra sheim, dumaji dei garra deigidawei yumob brom yumob taun neigidbala. “En ol yumob Juda pipul deya langa det taun gulum Seinan, yumob kaan kamat brom det taun blanga yumob, dumaji yumob garra bradin detmatj. “En ol yumob Juda pipul deya langa det taun gulum Bethesel, yumob garra kraikrai, dumaji det taun kaan seibum yumob.

english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
kriol: en det king bin bos blanga det Jodan Riba kantri du brom det bigwan woda gulum Leik Gelali raidap langa det taun gulum Bethjeshimoth sanraisaid brom det solwoda gulum Dedsi raidap langa det hil gulum Pisga.

english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
kriol: Wal wanmo ai dalim yumob. Ai nomo wandim enibodi garra irrim mi tok praudbalawei en reken mi granggibala. Bat if enibodi reken mi granggibala, wal im rait, dumaji ai garra meigim miselp granggibala en tok praudbalawei.

english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
kriol: Main God, yubin win, en ebribodi bin luk yubin go lida langa yu brabli seikridwan pleis.

english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
kriol: En deibin jidan langa najalot lilwan taun gulum Itam, Eiyin, Riman, Token en Eshan,

english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
kriol: Langa ebrijing im dum im trubala, en im oldei gibit feyago langa pipul. Yu gin trastim ol im lowa brabliwei.

english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
kriol: Nomo. Wi kaan dumbat detkain nogudbala ting lagijat, dumaji wi garra bulurrum det wei blanga Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi, en wi garra stap jinggabat ol detlot nogudbala ting weya det nogudbala filing blanga wi oldei wandim.

english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
kriol: Bat det olibtri bin tok, ‘Ai kaan jidan king, dumaji ai wandi kipgon meigimbat det seikridwan oil weya dei oldei yusum langa serramoni blanga ola men en ola drimin.’

english: “You shall not commit adultery.
kriol: “‘Yumob nomo lau blanga silipsilip garram enibodi, oni yu waif o yu hasbin.

english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
kriol: Wal wen Neiyomi bin luk Ruth bin wandim go garram im brabli, im nomo bin tok igin. Dubala bin jis kipgon.

english: Their Redeemer is strong. Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
kriol: Bat det wanbala hu garra larramgo olabat, im brabli strongbala. Im neim YAWEI det boswan God. Im na garra seibum en lukaftumbat olabat, en olabat garra jidan gudbinjiwei, nomo garram eni trabul, bat im garra jandim trabul langa Bebalon.

english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
kriol: Aibin luk wanbala men hubin jidan brabli nogudwan, en imbin oldei dumbat krulbala ting langa najalot pipul. Imbin jidan strongwan laiga bigwan tri langa gudwan graun.

english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
kriol: “Wal YAWEI garra dum nogudbala ting langa ola taun en fam blanga yumob.

english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
kriol: Brom deya King Sol bin go miselp na blanga grebum Deibid deya langa det taun gulum Rema, en wen imbin kamat langa det bigwan wel deya langa det pleis gulum Seku, imbin faindim sambala pipul deya, en imbin askim olabat weya Semyul en Deibid, en deibin tok, “Dubala deya langa det pleis gulum Naiyoth.”

english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
kriol: Wen imbin ailibala det neksdei na, YAWEI bin tok langa mi igin,

english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
kriol: YAWEI oldei dum wanim rait blanga detlot pipul wen enibodi dum nogudbala ting langa olabat. Im gibit daga langa detlot pipul hu jidan hanggriwan. Im album detlot pipul hu garram enikain trabul, jis laik sambodi larramgo olabat fri brom jidanbat prisana.

english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”
kriol: En det femili blanga yu garra kipgon jidanbat olagija. En God garra meigim sambodi brom yu femili oldei jidan king, dumaji det femili lain blanga yu garra kipgon jidanbat king olagija.’ Lagijat na yu garra dalim King Deibid.” Lagijat na God bin tok langa det speshalwan mesinja blanga im neim Neithan.

english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “King Hesakaiya bin jidan king blanga Juda fo 14 yiya wen det king neim Senakerib brom Asiriya bin go en fait en teikoba detlot strongwan taun langa Juda,

english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
kriol: Imbin tok, ‘Ai kaan album yumob. Ai garra luk wanim garra hepin langa yumob. Yumob brabli adbala pipul hu jidan nomo trubala langa mi.

english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
kriol: Brom deya Jisas bin goran langa ola taun langa det kantri, en imbin meigim olkain sikbala pipul gudbala, en imbin tok langa ola pipul langa ola Juwish Miting Pleis langa det kantri, en imbin dalimbat olabat det gudnyus blanga God weya imbin meigim wei blanga olabat blanga kaman langa im.

english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
kriol: Wal Eibrahem bin abum sekan waif neim Ketura en imbin abum siksbala san. Detlot san bin neim Simran, Jokshan, Midan, Midiyan, Ishbak en Shuwa. En Jokshan bin abum dubala san neim Shiba en Dedan.

english: “‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.
kriol: Afta na det speshalwan kotkeis langa top garra stat en God garra deigidawei det pawa brom im en binijimap im olagija.

english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
kriol: Sambala pipul hu stil jidan laibala langa det kantri blanga detlot enami blanga yumob garra jidan brabli soribala en nogudbinji brom yumob nogudbalawei, en blanga yumob grengrenfathamob nogudbalawei.

english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
kriol: Wal Pida bin tok na, “Titja, gudwei yubin bringimap melabat iya. Wal melabat garra meigim thribala hampi. Wanbala blanga yu en wanbala blanga Mosis en wanbala blanga Ilaija.”

english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
kriol: Yumob sabi? Yumob wandim pruf blanga shoum yumob Jisas Krais bin pikimat mi blanga dalimbat yumob blanga im. En wen mi kaman langa yumob, ai garra streitinimap yumob. En tharran na garra shoum yumob trubala Jisas Krais bin pikimat mi blanga dalimbat yumob blanga im, dumaji im na garra streitinimap yumob. En im nomo wikwan. Nomo. Im shoum yumob det pawa blanga im.

english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
kriol: Wal Jesi bin abum sebenbala san, en deibin neim Eliyab, Abinadeb, Shama, Nethanel, Reidai, Osem en Deibid. En imbin abum dubala doda du gulum Seruwaiya en Ebigeil. Seruwaiya bin abum thribala san, en deibin neim Ebishai, Jowab en Esahel. En Ebigeil bin merrit langa Jetha hubin brom det femili lain blanga Ishmeil, en dubala bin abum wanbala san neim Amasa.

english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
kriol: En yu garra faindim det dubala serramonimen neim Seidok en Abaiyatha deya, en yu garra dalim dubala ebrijing weya yu irrim langa det king haus, dumaji dubala garram dubala san deya neim Ahimas en Jonathan,

english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
kriol: Wal Jon bin tok langa Jisas na, “Bos, melabat bin luk wan men bin andimwei dibuldibul, en imbin yusumbat yu neim. En melabat bin dalim im blanga stap, dumaji im nomo wekinmen blanga yu laik melabat.”

english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,
kriol: Wal wen King Deibid bin gulijap dai, imbin jingat langa im san Salaman blanga dalim im wanim im garra dum.

english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
kriol: Wal afta na Endru bin deigim im braja langa Jisas, en wen Jisas bin luk im, imbin dalim im, “Yu neim Saiman det san blanga wan olmen neim Jon. Bat brom tudei ai garra gulum yu neim Sifas.” Wal Jisas bin gulum im Sifas garram det langgus blanga dubala. Bat garram det Grik langgus im Pida. En det dubala neim min rok.

english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
kriol: If sambala men fait, en dei hitim gel hu jidan femiliwei, en im lujim det beibi, bat dei nomo bin ardim det gel, wal det men hubin hitim im en meigim det beibi dai garra peiyim det gel hasbin wanim im wandim wen dubala go langa kot.

english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
kriol: En langa det dei na, nobodi nomo lau blanga wek, bat yumob garra majurrumap miselp oni blanga weship. Wal blanga yumob bigininimob, olabat garra dum lagijat en bulurrum det lowa olataim nomeda weya dei jidanbat.

english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
kriol: En det gol bin detmatj, imbin 200 kilogrem.

english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”
kriol: Oni det boswan blanga ola Isreil pipul lau kaman thru langa det geit en jidan wansaid blanga dagadagat det sekrifais daga weya deibin gibit langa mi, en afta kamat langa det seimwei geit.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.
kriol: Brom deya Joshuwa en detlot Isreil solja bin go langa det taun gulum Leikish, en deibin fait langa ola pipul deya,

english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
kriol: Dei garra jadimap olabat irriwol brom det trubalawan wed, dumaji dei oldei wandi irrim ola laiyawan wed brom najalot pipul.

english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
kriol: Salaman gin kipum holot 1,000 silba mani, en ol detlot fama gin kipum 200 silba mani, bat ai garram main ronwan greiptri fam.

english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”
kriol: Brom deya Jeihu bin gobek langa ola boswan wekinmen en deibin askim im, “Ebrijing rait? Wotfo det granggibala men bin wandim yu?” En Jeihu bin tok, “Yumob sabi wotfo imbin wandim mi?”

english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
kriol: En wanim bin hepin langa yumob? Detlot nogudbala ting bin album yumob? Najing. Detlot nogudbala ting bina meigim yumob dai. Wal tudei yumob sheim blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin oldei dumbat,

english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.
kriol: Yumob pipul brom Ijip meigim miselp redi, dumaji yumob garra gowei na en jidan prisana. Det bigwan taun gulum Mimfas im garra jidan wulijim deset na. Brabli rabishwan im garra jidan, en nomo enibodi kaan jidan deya.

english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
kriol: en Pailat bin askim olabat, “Yumob wandim mi larramgo dijan king blanga ola Juwish pipul?”

english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not meet you in any other field.”
kriol: Wal Neiyomi bin tok, “Gudwan tharran, main gel. Mobeda yu kipgon wek garram detlot wekingel langa det fam blanga Bowes. Yu kaan go langa najawan fam, dumaji if yu go langa najawan fam, maitbi ola wekinmen mait hambag langa yu.”

english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
kriol: Den, Neftali, Ged en Esha.

english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
kriol: Wal yumob gel brom Jerusalem, yumob garra pramis mi brabli strongbalawei. Yumob garra pramis nomo blanga kadimat minbala wen minbala laigim gija detmatj.

english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
kriol: En ai nomo dalim God blanga jandim nogudbala ting blanga meigim olabat dai.

english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.
kriol: Det dubala woda lili sheip bin ontop langa det dubala pos. Lagijat na deibin binijim det dubala pos.

english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
kriol: “Blanga yu bigiswan sista im Sameriya en im jidan langa nowathsaid gulijap langa ol im lilwan taun. Blanga yu yangwan sista im Sadam en im jidan langa sauthsaid gulijap langa ol im lilwan taun.

english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
kriol: “Wal yu sabi detlot bilibong gras oldei gro brabli gudwei langa bilibong.

english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
kriol: Ol yumob Isreil pipul bin kamat brom Jeikob, en yumob garra bilib langa YAWEI, en yumob garra kambek langa im na. Yumob garra jidan trubalawei langa im en bulurrum det lowa blanga im, en yumob garra weit blanga im blanga album yumob.” Lagijat na Hoseiya bin tok.

english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
kriol: “Wal wan nait minbala bin abum drim garram difrin wed blanga minbala,

english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
kriol: Wal wen detlot najalot tenbala wekinmen bin irrim wanim det dubala wekinmen bin askim Jisas, olabat bin brabli wail langa dubala.

english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
kriol: Wal ola Kristjan pipul jidan jis laiga seikridwan haus blanga God, en det flopat im det wed weya God bin gibit langa detlot speshalwan mishanri en speshalwan mesinja blanga im, en ebri Kristjan im jis laiga ston joinap langa det haus,

english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
kriol: “En nomo dagadagat eni bif garram blad, en nomo dumbat eni doktabala ting.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin dalim Mosis blanga dalim ola Isreil pipul dislot wed na. Imbin tok,

english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.
kriol: Ai nomo bin abumbat eni gudbala taim garram najalot pipul hu oldei laflafbat gudbinjiwei. Aibin dum wanim yubin dalim mi blanga dum. Aibin jidan miselp en aibin brabli wail langa olabat.

english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
kriol: God im det bos blanga det kothaus langa hebin. Im dalim ola drimin blanga dum wanim im wandim olabat blanga dum.

english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
kriol: Bat wi Kristjan pipul sabi God garra meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im, en im garra meigim wi jidan raitwei langa im dumaji wi bilib langa Jisas Krais, en det Holi Spirit album wi weidabat blanga det rait taim weya God garra meigim wi jidan brabliwei lagijat na.

english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
kriol: “Yunbala gobek langa yunbala ron kantri na. Yunbala garra jidan deya langa yunbala mami. Yunbala kaan kaman langa mi. “Wal yunbala bin brabli gud langa mi en langa main hasbin en san dubala wen deibin laibala. En seimwei lagijat gin YAWEI garra lukaftumbat yunbala,

english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
kriol: Mi gudbala, dumaji mi nomo dagat daga dubala dei ebri wik, en mi oldei gibit yu haf ola mani main.’ Lagijat na det serramonimen bin tok.

english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
kriol: Orait, wan men bin abum dubala waif. Det men bin neim Elkana, en imbin brom det Ifreiyim klen, en imbin oldei jidan langa det taun gulum Rema deya langa det hil kantri gulum Ifreiyim. Im dedi bin neim Jeroham, en Jeroham dedi bin neim Ilaihu, en Ilaihu dedi bin neim Tohu, en Tohu dedi bin neim Suf.

english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
kriol: Bat wen deibin kamat langa det jeil, dei nomo bin faindim olabat deya, en deibin gobek langa detlot serramonimen, en deibin dalim olabat,

english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
kriol: bat aibin gitwail brabliwei langa ol detlot kantri, en langa ol detlot Idam pipul du hubin jidan mowa brabli nogudbala, dumaji deibin laflafbat brabli adbala en deibin teikoba detlot fam blanga yumob.

english: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.
kriol: Bambai na Potafa bin luk Josef bin oldei dum ebrijing brabli gudwei dumaji YAWEI bin oldei album im.

english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
kriol: en God bin dalim im lagijat, “Yu garra dum wanim detlot pipul wandim, dumaji dei nomo tjakidaweibat yu. Dei tjakidaweibat mi, dumaji mi na bin jidan king blanga olabat. Bat dei wandim men garra deigim main pleis.

english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
kriol: Bat det brajawan en mamiwan blanga Rabeka bin tok, “Yu larram det gel stap iya garram melabat lilbit longtaim yet. Tendeistaim yumob gin deigim im.”

english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
kriol: Olabat bin libum mi miselp, jis laik aibin gitkil en leidanbat langa greib garram ola dedbala pipul. Im jis laik yu God, bin fogedabat mi en kaan dum enijing blanga album mi.

english: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
kriol: Bat if YAWEI meigim samting hepin weya yumob nomo bin irrim bifo, en det graun garra opinap en julurumap olabat garram ola ebrijing blanga olabat, wulijim olabat garra ol godan laibala langa det pleis blanga ola dedbala pipul, wal yumob garra sabi dislot men bin gibit bekboun langa YAWEI.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.
kriol: Dubala bin weshipbat detlot drimin sheip en dubala bin gibit bekboun langa mi, en dubala bin medrimbat detlot biginini weya dubala bin abum blanga main en dubala bin gibit langa detlot drimin sheip jis laik daga.

english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
kriol: Det widogel hu nomo garram eni femili blanga lukaftumbat im, wal im oldei jinggabat God, en im oldei askimbat God blanga albumbat im ebridei, dumaji im sabi nobodi kaan lukaftumbat im.

english: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
kriol: En langa det dei yumob garra dalimbat miselp, ‘Main braja olabat, yumob blanga God.’ En ‘Main sista olabat, God im laigim yumob.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
kriol: Wal yumob garra jinggabat God en bulurrum det wei blanga im, en im na garra gibit yumob ol detlot ting weya yumob wandim.

english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
kriol: “Yu si? Deibid bin speshalwan mesinja, en imbin sabi wanim God bin pramis langa im. God bin dalim im wanbala king garra kamat brom im femili lain,

english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
kriol: En wen yumob kamat langa eni taun, en dei nomo welkam yumob en dei nomo lisin langa yumob, wal yumob garra gowei brom det taun. Bat bifo yumob gowei, yumob garra sheikim det das brom yumob fut blanga gibit woning langa olabat, dumaji God garra panishim olabat.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: “This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.
kriol: En dijan na wanim im min. Namba im min God im sabi haulong yu garra jidan bos, en det taim im binij na.

english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
kriol: Blanga main ronwan frenmob, en detlot pipul weya ai laigim brabliwei, olabat nomo laigim mi enimo na. Olabat bin ol gibit bekboun langa mi.

english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
kriol: Wal Isaka bin abum fobala san neim Tola, Puwa, Jeishab en Shimran.

english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
kriol: En det dubala hu dalimbat en titjimbat det gudnyus, wal dubala seim, en God garra peiyim dubala blanga det wek weya dubala dumbat.

english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
kriol: Ola komyuniti bin sabi Eran bin dai, en deibin ol kraikraibat blanga 30 dei.

english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
kriol: Aibin jinggabat blanga kipgon bulurrumbat detlot lowa blanga yu raidap mi dai.

english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
kriol: Yumob nomo bin garrimap det Seikridwan Boks basdam en YAWEI bin panishim wi, dumaji wi nomo bin duwit langa im gudwei.” Lagijat na King Deibid bin tok.

english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.
kriol: Wal aibin jinggabat main selp, “Wanim garra hepin langa det granggibala men garra hepin langa mi du. Wal wanim ai garra gajim dumaji mi jidan brabli klebabala?” Ai nomo sabi. En ai nomo sabi wotfo im lagijat.

english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
kriol: Mi oldei wori en abumbat detmatj pein oloba langa main bodi.

english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
kriol: en imbin dalim det yangboi, “Yu gobek silip. En if im jingat langa yu igin, wal yu garra tok, ‘Ai sabi yu na, Bos. Wal yu tok na, dumaji mi wekinboi blanga yu, en mi irrim yu na.’” Lagijat na det olmen bin dalim det yangboi, en det yangboi bin gobek silip.

english: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
kriol: Yumob ensim dijan! Hu dijan brabli haibala king? Im YAWEI, strongwan garram pawa. Im YAWEI weya fait garram pawa, en bidim im enami olabat.

english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
kriol: Im nogud blanga yu if yu nomo teiknodis langa yu dedi en mami, bat im gud if yu dum wanim dubala dalim yu.

english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”
kriol: Wal Rubin bin tok na, “Dedi, ai garra lukaftum Benjamin. En if ai nomo bringimbek im langa yu, wal yu gin peiyimbek mi. Yu gin binijimap det dubala lilboi main. Yu nomo wori blanga Benjamin. Ai garra bringimbek im langa yu.”

english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
kriol: Brom deya Ruth bin go langa wan fam, en imbin gajimbat detlot gras garram sid weya ola wekinmen bin oldei libumbat biyain. Det fam bin blanga Bowes. Bat Ruth nomo bin sabi det fam bin blanga im.

english: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
kriol: Yu garra jinggabat wanim plen yu garra meigim, bat YAWEI meigim det plen hepin.

english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.
kriol: Afta aibin dalim detlot serramonimen, “Yumob seikridwan blanga YAWEI det trubala God, det God blanga yumob grengrenfatha olabat, en ola silba en gol en ebrijing weya wibin gibit langa im gudbinjiwei blanga ofring jidan seikridwan blanga im du.

english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”
kriol: Bat if yumob nomo bin tridim Gidiyan en im femili olabat gudbalawei, wal Abimalek garra meigim trabul blanga yumob garram faiya, en im garra barnimap ol yumob men brom Shekam en Bethmailo jis laik det faiya garra barnimap ola tri. En yumob garra meigim trabul blanga Abimalek du en barnimap im.”

english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
kriol: Betheraba, Semaraiyim, Bethel,

english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
kriol: Wal detlot pipul hu jidan langa dakbala, olabat garra luk det brabliwan lait brom God. Detlot pipul hu nomo garram lait, olabat garra dai. Bat God garra shoum olabat det lait brom hebin.” Lagijat na Aisaiya bin tok.

english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
kriol: Yuwai, ai garra luk langa im miselp, en ai kaan weit blanga det taim.

english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.
kriol: If enibodi tok, ‘Ai garram wed brom YAWEI’, nomeda im jidan mesinja, o serramonimen o im jis odinri men, ai garra panishim im en im femilimob.

english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”
kriol: “Ol yumob pipul langa Juda, yumob bin bringimap dijan trabul langa yumob ronselp, dumaji yumob bin oldei jidanbat rongwei. Detlot nogudbalawei weya yumob bin oldei dumbat bin bringimap dijan trabul langa yumob. Im garra kilim yumob ded, jis laik wen sambodi jalk yumob.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin dalim mi blanga tok.

english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
kriol: Imbin go langa det pleis weya Arauna en im fobala san bin oldei deigimatbat ola rabishwan gras brom ola sid daga, en wen detlot fobala san bin luk det einjul deibin ranawei en haidim miselp.

english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
kriol: det serramonimen garra luk det sowa. En if det sowa im gro dipwan rait insaid, en if det heya insaid langa det sowa bin go yelowan en lilwan, wal im na wan brabli nogudwan skin siknis, en det serramonimen garra dalim im, ‘Yu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni’.

english: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
kriol: YAWEI, seibum melabat. Seibum melabat en meigim melabat win.

english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
kriol: Detlot tri langa det bush kantri garra jingat brabli gudbinjiwei wen YAWEI garra kaman en jidan bos blanga dijan wel.

english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
kriol: Ai nomo bradin wen mi langa deinja, en wen ola enami jidan raidaran langa mi.

english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
kriol: en imbin stap deya gin langa det kantri Gelali.

english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
kriol: Wal sambala pipul bin trai en lukabat daga langa det Sebathdei. Bat dei nomo bin faindim eni daga.

english: “‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”
kriol: “Aibin oldei wandim majurrumap main pipul olabat, jis laik det fama weya im oldei majurrumap detlot daga, bat yumob jidan jis laik det greiptri weya nomo garram eni greip daga, en jis laik det figtri weya nomo garram eni fig daga. En detlot bushis bin draiyap du. Wal blanga tharran na, aibin larram detlot streinja pipul teikoba det kantri.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
kriol: Sambala pipul dumbat silibala ting en meigim olabat ronwan laif brabli nogud, en dei pudum det bleim langa YAWEI det trubala God.

english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
kriol: Wal ol detlot fren blanga det olmen bin gida shok wen deibin irrim wanim bin hepin, en det nyus bin spredat ebriweya langa det hil kantri weya deibin jidan,

english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
kriol: Trubala ai dalim yumob. Ai kaan dringgim dijan wain garram yumob enimo. Bat wen main Dedi jandimbek mi, en ai jidan Boswan brabliwei, det taim na ai garra dringgim det wain Nyubalawei.”

english: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”
kriol: en imbin jingat langa ol detlot solja blanga King Sol na, en imbin jingat langa det boswan solja neim Ebna du, “Ebna! Yu gin irrim mi?” Wal Ebna bin tok, “Hu tharran deya jinginatbat en weikimapbat det king?”

english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
kriol: Yumob nomo lisin langa King Hesakaiya. Yumob teiknodis langa main king. Yumob majurrumap miselp langa im. En blanga lilwail im garra larram yumob kipum yumob ronwan greip fam, en ola figtri, en ol detlot wel.

english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Gidap ol yumob pipul langa Jerusalem! Jandap en larram det lait blanga yumob shain. Dumaji det lait brom YAWEI det trubala God im shain brabliwei langa yumob.

english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
kriol: Wal det yangboi bin tok, “Detlot Juwish bosmen bin ol tok blanga askim yu blanga deigim Pol langa detlot bosmob tumorro, en dei garra tok laiyawei dei wandi faindat mowa blanga im.

english: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
kriol: Wal Deibid bin libum ola daga garram det men hubin oldei maindimbat ola enijing blanga ola solja, en imbin ran langa im braja olabat weya deibin jandap redi blanga fait, en imbin askim olabat hau olabat.

english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
kriol: en ai garra meigim detlot pipul gibit yumob enijing yumob wandim wen yumob garra gowei brom det kantri. Yumob kaan gowei nomo garram enijing.

english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
kriol: Aibin oldei bidim olabat brabliwei, en aibin oldei meigim olabat lus, en dei kaan gidap en fait langa mi igin.

english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
kriol: en God garra meigim yumob jidan gudbalawei. Wi nomo sabi brabliwei hau im meigim wi jidan gudbalawei. Bat im kaan larram enijing ardim wi insaid langa wi hat en main, dumaji wibin joinap garram Jisas Krais.

english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
kriol: Afta na det klaud bin gaburrumap det Seikridwan Tent, en det brabli shainiwan lait blanga YAWEI bin jidan insaid langa det Tent.

english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin majurrumap ola pipul brom Isreil en brom oloba langa det kantri, brom det boda blanga Ijip en langa sauthwei raidap langa det jampap gulum Heimath en langa nowathwei, blanga bringimap det Seikridwan Boks brom Kiriyajerim langa Jerusalem.

english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.
kriol: Wandei detlot speshalwan mesinja weya Ilaisha bin maindimbat bin grambulbat langa im. Deibin tok, “Det rum langa melabat kemp im lilwan!

english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
kriol: en im oldei lendim mani blanga meigimbat mowa mani en im dumbat olkain nogudbala ting weya im dedi nomo bin dum bifo. Wal wanim yumob reken? Yumob reken im garra jidan laibala? Nomo. Im kaan jidan laibala, dumaji imbin dum ol diskain nogudbala ting. Wal im garra lafta dai, en det bleim garra go langa imselp. Im garra dai blanga wanim imbin dumbat.

english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
kriol: Yumob sabi ebrijing weya bin hepin langa det kantri blanga ola Isreil pipul. Yumob sabi wanim bin hepin brom det taim weya Jon Beptis bin dalimbat ebribodi blanga beptais deya langa Gelali.

english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? Det lowa nomo jidan bos blanga wi na, dumaji det taim bin kaman weya wi garra bilib langa Jisas Krais.

english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin dalim im, “Yu bilib langa mi dumaji yubin luk mi. Bat detlot pipul hu garra bilib langa mi nomeda dei nomo luk mi garra gudbinji brabliwei.”

english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
kriol: Bat det filing blanga yu im go difrinwei, en im meigim yu luk brabli wailwan.

english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin gajim detlot femili lain blanga Eran, en imbin pudum olabat langa grup na blanga olabat wek. Seidok brom det femili lain blanga Eliyeisa en Ahimalek brom det femili lain blanga Ithama bin album im.

english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
kriol: En seimtaim wibin teikoba en binijimap ebri taun, en wibin kilim olabat ded holot, ola men, ola wuman, en ola biginini langa ebri taun.

english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;
kriol: Wal neksdei God bin jandim det nogudbala spirit langa King Sol, en imbin teikoba langa im, en Sol bin jinginat nomo lilbit insaid langa im haus jis laiga granggibala men. Wal Deibid bin deya du garram King Sol, en imbin pleiplei det gita gulum hap jis laik imbin oldei dumbat, en King Sol bin holdimbat spiya langa im bingga.

english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.
kriol: yu garra go garram yu amimob brom yu kantri langa nowathsaid,

english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
kriol: Yu garra meigim detlot purdiflawa en det pol garram wanbala gudwan gol,

english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;
kriol: “Wal if enibodi garram wan brabli nogudwan skin siknis wal dei garra kaman langa det serramonimen,

english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
kriol: YAWEI, melabat ol sabi hau detlot boswan king blanga Asiriya bin binijimap ebrijing langa loda kantri en detlot kantri jidan nomo garram enijing na.

english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
kriol: “Isikiyel, yu garra raidimdan det namba blanga tudei, dumaji det king brom Bebalon bin stat faitabat langa Jerusalem tudei na.

english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
kriol: en imbin luk wan men deya garram wan kripulwan bingga. Wal sambala serramonimen deya bin wandi faindim folt langa Jisas, en deibin askim im, “Wanim yu reken det lowa blanga wi tok? Wen im Sebathdei enibodi lau dum detkain wek weya im meigim sikbala pipul gudbala?”

english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
kriol: En if yumob owim det gabman eni teks mani, wal yumob garra peiyim det mani. Nomeda wotkain teks mani yumob owim det gabman, bat stil yumob garra peiyim olabat blanga ebrijing. En yumob garra shoum rispek brabliwei langa ol detlot pipul hu jidan gabman bos, dumaji yumob owim olabat det rispek.

english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
kriol: God bin kipum det pramis weya imbin meigim langa wi grengrenfatha Eibrahem, en imbin albumbat ol detlot pipul langa dijan kantri Isreil hubin bulurrum im.

english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
kriol: Yu si? If aibin dum det wek dumaji aibin wandi dum, wal ai bina meigim yumob gibit mi enijing blanga dumbat det wek. Bat ai kaan askimbat yumob blanga enijing, dumaji God na bin gibit mi det wek blanga dum, en ai garra duwit langa im.

english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
kriol: Olabat gin tok blanga det filing blanga laigim pipul olataim en blanga yu trubalawei? Najing.

english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
kriol: Yu si? Dijan bodi weya wi garram iya langa dijan wel im jis laiga tent weya wi jidan insaid. En wi sabi wen God garra pulumdan dijan tent, im garra gibit wi nyubala bodi deya langa hebin jis laiga haus blanga jidan insaid. Nobodi bin meigim det haus blanga wi. Oni God bin meigim. En det haus garra jidan olagijawan.

english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you; for now Yahweh would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.
kriol: Wal Semyul bin tok, “Yu granggibala! Yu nomo bin bulurrum det lowa weya YAWEI bin gibit yu. If yu bina bulurrum det lowa, wal God bina meigim yu en yu femili olabat jidan king olagijawan blanga ola Isreil pipul.

english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;
kriol: Longtaim yubin oldei dumbat klebabala ting langa Ijip, en yubin kipgon dumbat lagijat raidap tudei na langa Isreil en langa ola najalot kantri. Wal ebribodi sabi hu yu na.

english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
kriol: “En if enibodi gibit im haus langa mi, det serramonimen garra dalim im haumatj mani blanga det haus, en det serramonimen garra luk langa ola gudwan en ola nogudwan ting blanga det haus en det serramonimen garra dalim im haumatj im garra pei en im kaan tjeinjim.

english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
kriol: Brom deya imbin binijimap detlot sebenbala traib langa det kantri gulum Keinan, en imbin gibit det kantri langa detlot Isreil pipul.

english: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
kriol: en mowa igin brom detlot pipul hubin baiyim en selim enijing langa im kantri. Detlot king brom det kantri gulum Areibiya en detlot lidamob brom Isreil bin gibit King Salaman detmatj silba en gol du.

english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
kriol: En wen ola pipul bin luk langa mi deibin askim mi, “Wotfo yu nomo kraikraibat blanga yu waif?”

english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
kriol: Dei nomo bin bradin langa God. Deibin kaman kwikbala langa yumob brom biyain en fait langa yumob wen yumob bin nokap. En deibin kilim ded ol detlot pipul hubin kaman slobala.

english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
kriol: Hubin dalim detlot wailwan dongki blanga go eniweya dei wandim go?

english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
kriol: en 20 blanga jandap langa det nowathsaid en siksbala blanga jandap langa sangodansaid en dubala freimpat blanga jandap langa dubala kona en det dubala freimpat garra joinap brom bodam raidap langa top. Yu garra meigim 96 silbawan pleit blanga holdimap ola pol blanga detlot freimpat.

english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
kriol: Lagijat na Jisas bin tok. Wal detlot wekinmen blanga Jisas bin toktok miselp na, “Im dalimbat wi blanga raising, dumaji wi nomo garram naf daga.” Lagijat na deibin tok, dumaji deibin reken Jisas bin dalimbat olabat blanga det raising weya yu pudum langa flauwa. Bat nomo. Imbin dalim olabat blanga wotjim miselp blanga det nogudbalawei weya detlot serramonimen en det king bin oldei dumbat.

english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.
kriol: Wal streidawei detlot Filastainmob bin grebum Semsan, en deibin deigimat im dubala ai, en deibin deigim im langa det taun gulum Gasa, en deya na deibin taiyimap im garram dubala strongwan tjein, en deibin meigim im wek deya langa det jeil, en imbin oldei grandimbat ola sid daga blanga meigim flauwa.

english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
kriol: Wal wen King Deibid bin irrim nyus weya det olgamen bin jidan deya garram detlot bodi, imbin jinggabat detlot boun blanga Sol en Jonathan. Longtaim wen detlot Filastain solja bin kilim dubala ded langa det hil gulum Gilbowa, deibin deigim dubala bodi, en deibin heingimap det dubala bodi langa midul langa det taun gulum Bethshiyan, en afta detlot pipul brom det taun gulum Jeibesh deya langa det kantri gulum Giliyad bin go snikinwei langa det taun, en deibin gajim det dubala bodi blanga Sol en Jonathan, en deibin deigim det dubala bodi langa olabat taun, en deya na deibin berrim dubala. Wal King Deibid bin go langa det taun weya Sol en Jonathan bin berrap, en imbin gajim detlot boun blanga dubala,

english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? If yumob sabi det gudbalawei, en yumob nomo bulurrum det gudbalawei, wal im nogud, dumaji yumob dum nogudbala ting.

english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;
kriol: “Wen ola pipul blanga yu dum nogudbala ting, en nobodi deya hu nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting, en yu gitwail langa olabat en yu larram ola enami blanga olabat bidim olabat en dei deigim olabat prisana langa najawan kantri, nomeda det kantri im longwei,

english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.
kriol: Olabat bin ol gibit mi bekboun, nomeda aibin kipgon titjimbat olabat. Deibin jadimap olabat irriwol en nomo bin teiknodis langa mi.

english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
kriol: Wal ol dislot na bin ola grengrenfatha boswan blanga ol detlot femili hubin jidan langa Jerusalem.

english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.
kriol: Aibin deigim det nogudbala gabigabi sheip weya yumob bin meigim, en aibin tjakam insaid langa det faiya. En aibin breigimap det drimin sheip en bitsimap raidap imbin jidan wulijim det das. Aibin gajim det das en aibin tjakam im langa det lilwan riba weya bin randan brom det hil.

english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
kriol: Bambai na wen ola pipul langa det dubala kantri bin binijimap olabat mani, ola Ijip pipul bin kaman en tok langa Josef, “Kaman na. Yu gibit melabat daga bambai melabat dai, dumaji melabat nomo garram mani blanga baiyim daga na.”

english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.
kriol: En aibin trai ranawei brom im.” Wal wen detlot boutmen bin irrim det wed, deibin ol bradin, en deibin askim Jona, “Wotfo yubin ranawei lagijat?”

english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
kriol: If yu bilib brabliwei langa God, wen yu prei en askim im blanga enijing, im garra gibit yu.”

english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
kriol: Bat yubin gibit woning langa detlot hu weship langa yu blanga sabi, wulijim olabat gin kamat brom det deinja.

english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.
kriol: Yubin luk imbin oldei bulurrum yu brabliwei, en yubin meigim brabli strongbala pramis langa im. Yubin pramis blanga gibit im det kantri blanga detlot traib gulum Keinanait, Hitait, Emarait, Perasait, Jebusait en Gegashait. En det kantri garra jidan blanga im biginini olabat. Yubin kipum yu pramis dumaji yu na jidan trubalawan.

english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
kriol: “Isikiyel yu garra sing dijan fyunral song blanga Taya, det bigwan taun deibin bildimap wansaid langa solwoda. En deibin oldei selimbat enijing langa najalot kantri wansaid langa solwoda. Yu dalim detlot pipul langa Taya dijan wed brom mi na YAWEI det boswan God. “‘Taya, yubin oldei tok brabli praudbalawei. Yu reken yu brabli purdiwan.

english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
kriol: en oni wanbala deya gin meigim God en ola pipul jidan mijamet, en det men na im neim Jisas Krais.

english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
kriol: en lodataim imbin kamat langa detlot pipul hubin bulurrum im brom Gelali raidap langa Jerusalem, en detlot pipul na oldei dalimbat det gudnyus langa ola Juwish pipul.

english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
kriol: Wal det bigiswan san blanga Keilab det braja blanga Jeramiyel bin neim Misha. Misha bin det dedi blanga Sif hubin det dedi blanga Maresha, hubin det dedi blanga Hebran.

english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
kriol: If melabat bina stap weshipbat melabat God, en stat preipreibat langa najawan drimin,
