english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
kriol: Ola men brom Ifreiyim klen bin go langa det plein kantri blanga fait, en ola men brom Benjamin klen bin go biyain langa olabat, en ola boswan solja brom Manesa klen bin go du, en ola boswan solja brom Sebyulan klen bin deya du,

english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
kriol: Nobodi nomo lau yusum det oil, en nobodi nomo lau meigim det seimkain oil du, dumaji im brabli seikridwan. En ebribodi garra teiknodis langa dis lowa.

english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
kriol: Wal streidawei wen Semyul bin tok lagijat, imbin tenaran blanga gowei, en King Sol bin grebum Semyul klos, en imbin breigim det klos,

english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
kriol: Melabat bin dum brabli gudwan ting garram melabat ronwan pawa.’ Bat ai kaan teiknodis langa olabat nogudbalawei, en detlot nogudbala plen dei garram.

english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,
kriol: wen wan wekinmen bin ran langa Job en imbin tok, “Wen ol wi wekinmen blanga yu bin wekwekbat en grajimbat det graun garram detlot buligi, en detlot dongki bin deya du wansaid dagadagatbat gras,

english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
kriol: Wen det dongki bin luk det einjul jandap lida en imbin holdimbat bigwan naif, det dongki bin libum det roud en bin go langa det fam kantri. Beilam bin beldim det dongki en bringimbek im langa det roudwei igin.

english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
kriol: Sekaraiya bin det boswan blanga det femili lain blanga Ishaiya en Yusiyel. Sekaraiya bin braja blanga Maika.

english: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.
kriol: Longtaim YAWEI bin meigim pramis langa ola grengrenfatha blanga detlot Isreil pipul. Imbin pramis blanga meigim olabat jidan langa det kantri gudbalawei. En imbin kipum det pramis, en imbin meigim olabat win langa ola enami blanga olabat. Nomo enibodi langa eni kantri bin bidim olabat.

english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
kriol: Nomo eni kantri langa dijan wel jidan mowa haibala langa YAWEI. Detlot kantri jidan jis laik det bilibong weya im garram lilwan woda. Detlot kantri nomo enijing. If YAWEI holdim ola ailin langa im bingga, im nomo hebiwan. Im jis laik im garram lilbit sengraun langa im bingga.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
kriol: Wal ola ebrijing King Jerabowam namba 2 bin dum en hau imbin jidan brabli strongbala blanga fait en hau imbin gedimbek det dubala taun gulum Dameskas en Heimath blanga Isreil, deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum Ola stori blanga ola king brom Isreil.

english: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
kriol: YAWEI det trubala God langa hebin, en im na det king blanga ola boswan ebriweya langa dijan wel.

english: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
kriol: Bambai na YAWEI det trubala God bin gitwail langa ol detlot Isreil pipul, en imbin yusum King Deibid blanga meigim trabul blanga olabat blanga panishim olabat. God bin dalim King Deibid lagijat, “Yu garra go en kaundimap ola pipul brom det Juda klen en brom ola najalot Isreil klen du.”

english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
kriol: Detlot gabman bos jidan jis laik det wailwan dog weya oldei go en bitsimap ola enimul afta deibin kilim. Olabat oldei go en medrimbat enibodi blanga meigim miselp ritjwan.

english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
kriol: Wal ol detlot Isreil pipul bin dum nogudbala ting langa YAWEI. Deibin tenawei brom im, en deibin bulurrum detlot drimin gulum Beil en Eshara.

english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
kriol: “En yumob jinggabat du det taim wen det speshalwan mesinja neim Ilaisha bin jidan iya langa dijan kantri Isreil. Loda pipul iya langa dijan kantri bin abum det brabli nogudwan skin siknis langa olabat bodi. Bat God nomo bin dalim det speshalwan mesinja blanga meigim olabat gudbala. Imbin dalim im blanga meigim gudbala det men neim Neiman brom det longweiwan kantri gulum Siriya.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Brom deya YAWEI bin dalim Mosis,

english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
kriol: Bat blanga wi ol pipul garra titjimbat yu garram brabli klebabala main ebrijing deibin sabi brom olabat grenfathamob en grengrenfathamob.

english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
kriol: Bambai na im mami bin faindim waif blanga im brom im ronwan kantri gulum Ijip.

english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
kriol: Wal wen God bin joinimap ol yumob Jintail pipul langa Jisas Krais, imbin joinimap yumob garram detlot Juwish pipul, en im meigimbat yumob jidan jis laiga seikridwan pleis weya im garra jidan garram im Holi Spirit.

english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.
kriol: Basdam King Hairam bin gibit King Salaman detmatj gol.

english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat det gita en det wisul na. If enibodi nomo pleiyim det gita gudbalawei, wal hau wi garra sabi det tyun?

english: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
kriol: Yumob kaan dum enijing, dumaji YAWEI garra fait blanga yumob.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
kriol: Wal Pida bin tufeis wen imbin kadimat miselp brom detlot Jintail Kristjan pipul lagijat, en tharran rong ting imbin dum. En ol detlot najalot Juwish Kristjan pipul bin bulurrum det wei blanga im, en deibin meigim Banabas kadimat miselp seimwei laik olabat du.

english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
kriol: Wal wandei Ishboseth det san blanga Sol bin reken Ebna bin silipsilip garram det widogel blanga Sol neim Rispa hubin det doda blanga Aiya.

english: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
kriol: YAWEI im oldei jidan garram mi. Ai kaan bradin langa enibodi blanga ardimbat mi.

english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
kriol: Wal wandei wen Jisas bin lukinatbat detlot bigmob pipul hubin hipimapbat miselp raidaran langa im, imbin dalim im wekinmen olabat blanga go najasaid langa Leik Gelali.

english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)
kriol: Detlot pipul gulum Horait bin jidan langa det kantri gulum Idam, bat ola biginini blanga Isau bin andimwei olabat en deibin jidan deya, jis laik detlot Isreil pipul bin dum bambai wen deibin andimwei olabat enami en deibin jidan langa detlot kantri weya YAWEI bin gibit olabat.

english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.
kriol: If olabat nomo laigim blanga deigim det kap brom yu bingga en dringgim brom det kap, wal yu garra dalim olabat mi na YAWEI det brabli boswan God bin tok olabat garra lafta dringgim brom det kap.

english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
kriol: Wal wen enibodi dum nogudbala ting langa yumob, yumob kaan peiyimbek im nogudbalawei. Yumob garra oldei trai en dumbat wanim ola pipul reken gudbala ting.

english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.
kriol: Afta na Mosis bin jandim sambala yangmen blanga abum det sekrifais serramoni blanga YAWEI, en deibin kilim sambala yangwan buligi blanga det ofring gulum feloship ofring du,

english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
kriol: Im garra gibit sain langa detlot kantri en im garra bringimbek ol detlot pipul weya olabat enamimob bin andimwei brom Juda en Isreil, en hubin spredat oloba langa dijan wel.

english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
kriol: Wal Ilaisha bin tok langa im, “Yu go gudbinjiwei na.” En Neiman bin gowei. Bat imbin oni lilbit longwei,

english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin dalim det shotwan men, “Tudei na God bin seibum yu en ola femili blanga yu, dumaji yu rileishan blanga Eibrahem,

english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
kriol: Deibin ranimap langa mi en deibin gulijap binijimap mi, bat YAWEI bin album mi.

english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
kriol: Yubin askim melabat if melabat abum dedi en yangwan braja,

english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
kriol: Yubin seibum mi brom ol main trabul, en aibin luk ol main enami olabat nomo bin win.

english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.
kriol: Pipul blanga Jerusalem sing gudbinjiwei, dumaji YAWEI bin tok im garra kaman blanga jidan garram yumob.

english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
kriol: Yubin tok tumatj na. Maitbi yu meigim najalot pipul gibit bekboun langa God na, en meigim olabat wanwanbat en nomo prei langa im.

english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
kriol: Im oldei meigim ola pipul brom najalot kantri jidan strongbala, en afta im deigidawei det pawa brom olabat.

english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.
kriol: Bambai na wen det lilboi nomo bin dringgimbat milk, im mami bin gajim wanbala 3 yiya ol boiwan buligi en 10 kilogrem flauwa en wanbala skinbeig garram wain, en imbin deigim ol detlot enijing garram det lilboi langa det taun gulum Shailo blanga gibit ofring langa God blanga det lilboi. Nomeda det lilboi bin lilwan, bat stil im mami bin deigim im langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI.

english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
kriol: Wal det serramonimen garra tjakam det blad olaran langa det teibul blanga ofring langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent en barnim det fet blanga meigim gudsmelwan wulijim ai garra jidan gudbinji.

english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
kriol: Yumob garra faindat wotkain det kantri, en haumeni pipul jidan deya, en hau strong olabat.

english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
kriol: “Wotfo yu wekinmen olabat nomo bulurrum det lowa weya bin kamat longtaim brom wi grengrenfatha olabat? Det lowa im tok dei garra washimbat olabat bingga brabliwei bifo olabat dagadagat daga. Wal wotfo yu wekinmen olabat nomo bulurrum det lowa?”

english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
kriol: Wen olabat abum gudbala taim olabat gin stil irrim det nogudwan ting jinginatbat insaid langa olabat irriwol.

english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
kriol: en melabat garra kipgon abumbat preya en dalimbat det gudnyus.”

english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
kriol: En langa detlot kantri weya YAWEI garra jandimwei yumob, ola pipul langa detlot kantri garra gida shok wanim bin kaman langa yumob, en olabat garra meigimbat fan langa yumob en mokimbat yumob.

english: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.
kriol: En langa roud deibin lafta gugum daga nomo garram raising dumaji deibin gowei brom Ijip kwikbalawei, en dei nomo bin abum taim blanga meigim ola daga redi.

english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
kriol: King Jehowesh bin grebum King Amasaiya en meigim im jidan prisana en imbin kipgon langa Jerusalem. Deya na deibin breigimap det wol blanga det taun brom Ifreiyim Geit raidap langa det Kona Geit. Deibin breigimap 200 mita blanga det wol.

english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
kriol: Wal yumob sabi wanim mi toktok? Wi garram det brabli Boswan haibala serramonimen hu oldei jidan langa raidensaid langa det speshalwan tjeya blanga det Brabli Haibalawan God deya langa hebin,

english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
kriol: Ailibala na det king bin stat jinggabat, en imbin jandim wed langa ola doktabala en langa ola klebabalamen ebriweya langa det kantri, en deibin ol kaman langa im, en imbin dalim olabat det dubala drim. Bat dei nomo bin sabi wanim det dubala drim bin tok blanga im.

english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
kriol: If dislot Juwish men iya bin faindim enijing rong langa mi wen deibin kotim mi deya langa Jerusalem, wal larram olabat dalim yu wanim aibin dum.

english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
kriol: wen aibin silip, bat main drim bin bradin mi.

english: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
kriol: Wal Hoseiya bin tok, “YAWEI det trubala God bin tok yumob Juda pipul bin breigim det lowa blanga im, en imbin tok im garra panishim ol yumob Isreil pipul blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin oldei dumbat. Im garra peiyimbek yumob blanga ebrijing weya yumob bin dumbat.

english: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
kriol: “En ol yumob pipul hu jidan langa Saiyan det speshalwan hil blanga God, yumob garra hepi en gudbinji du, dumaji YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob bin dum brabli gudbala ting blanga yumob. Imbin jandim det rein langa yumob brabliwan. Rait taim imbin jandim blendibala rein langa yumob.

english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, detlot pipul bin dalim im, “Trubala melabat sabi na yu garram nogudbala spirit insaid langa yu, dumaji melabat grengrenfatha Eibrahem bin dai, en ol detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga God bin dai du. Bat yu reken wen enibodi bulurrum det wed blanga yu, im kaan neba dai. Wal maitbi yu reken yu mowa haibala langa Eibrahem en langa detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga God.”

english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.
kriol: Wal Edanaija bin brabli bradin blanga Salaman, en imbin go langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI, en imbin holdim detlot kona blanga det teibul blanga ofring.

english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Wal ai garra meigim det nyubala hebin en det nyubala graun. Nomo enibodi garra jinggabat det olbalawei igin.

english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
kriol: “Wal aibin det kaunsala du. Aibin go en joinap garram det najalot kaunsala en yangwan lidamob en garram detlot olmen deya langa det taun, en deibin oldei rispek langa mi en deibin ol jandap wen aibin kaman,

english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin kipgon tok langa detlot pipul, “Trubala ai dalim yumob. Sambala pipul brom yumob kaan bilib langa mi. En blanga tharran na aibin dalim yumob nobodi kaan kaman langa mi. Oni detlot pipul weya main Dedi bin gibit olabat det pawa garra kaman langa mi.”

english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
kriol: Wal afta na Neithan bin go langa King Deibid, en imbin dalim im ebrijing weya God bin dalim im.

english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok igin, “Ola pipul garra tok blanga yu Jerusalem, ‘Det dodawan imbin jidan jis laik im mami.’

english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
kriol: En wen aibin binij det serramoni blanga meigim miselp fri, dislot Juwish men bin luk mi deya langa det Serramoni Pleis. En ai nomo bin abum enibodi deya garram mi, en nomo eni trabul du.

english: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
kriol: Mi oldei wandim yu blanga seibum mi brabliwei, YAWEI. Detlot lowa blanga yu meigim mi jidan gudbinjiwei.

english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
kriol: Wal streidawei Mosis bin baudan langa graun, en imbin weship YAWEI,

english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
kriol: Wal wen Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin wokwok langa roud, wan men bin tok langa Jisas, “Ai garra bulurrum yu ebriweya yu go.”

english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
kriol: Langa det Sanrais Geit, siksbala wekinmen bin oldei wotjimbat ebridei. Fobala bin wotjimbat langa Nowath Geit, en fobala bin wotjimbat langa Sauth Geit. En fobala bin oldei wotjimbat det dubala stowa rum, dubala blanga wanbala stowa rum en dubala blanga najawan stowa rum.

english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
kriol: En Ilaihu det san blanga Barakel, brom det femili gulum Rem brom det taun gulum Bus bin deya du, en imbin brabli nogudbinji langa Job, dumaji Job bin pudum bleim langa God en im nomo bin pudum bleim langa im ronselp. Najing.

english: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
kriol: Aibin oldei bidim olabat brabliwei, en aibin oldei meigim olabat lus, en dei kaan gidap en fait langa mi igin.

english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
kriol: Dumaji YAWEI na garra gibit yumob ol detlot ebrijing blanga meigim yumob jidan ritjwan. Im garra dum lagijat dumaji im kipum det brabli strongwan pramis weya imbin gibit langa wi grengrenfathamob.

english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,
kriol: Wal King Salaman bin gibit oda langa im wekinmen olabat blanga meigim ol dislot golwan ebrijing blanga det Serramoni Pleis, det teibul blanga ofring en detlot najalot teibul blanga det damba ofring blanga gibit langa God,

english: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
kriol: en deibin askim YAWEI, “Wujei det men?” Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Im deya. Im blandim miselp biyain langa ola enijing.”

english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
kriol: Jeihas, Kedemoth, Mefath,

english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
kriol: Brom deya det boda bin go nowathwei langa det taun gulum Riman hafwei langa det taun gulum Niya,

english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
kriol: En yu oldei meigim detlot pipul hu meigim miselp haibala jidan lobala. Bat yu oldei seibum detlot pipul hu nomo meigim miselp haibala.

english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
kriol: Bat Jisas bin tenaran, en imbin luk langa im wekinmen olabat, en imbin dalimof Pida, dumaji imbin sabi det Seitin bin deya du toktok langa Pida. Jisas bin tok, “Seitin, yu gowei na.” En langa Pida imbin tok, “Pida, yu nomo sabi wanim yu toktok, dumaji yu nomo jinggabat Godwei. Yu oni jinggabat det wei blanga men.”

english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
kriol: “Yumob nomo ardim det kantri en solwoda en tri olabat. Wi garra pudum mak langa ola wekinmen blanga God basdam. Wi garra brendimbat olabat langa olabat forid, dumaji olabat blanga det God blanga wi.”

english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.
kriol: Imbin stat dumbat ol diskain ting wen imbin jidan langa Ijip, en imbin oldei redi blanga silipsilipbat garram eni men.

english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
kriol: Wotfo mi kipgon jidanbat laibala wen God bin jadimap det roud blanga mi? Im nomo dalim mi wanim garra hepin langa mi. En ai kaan ranawei brom im.

english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
kriol: Brom deya Jisas bin go langa Nesareth weya imbin growap, en wen imbin Sebathdei, imbin go langa det Miting Pleis blanga ola Juwish pipul, en wen imbin taim blanga ridim det oltestaman, imbin jandap,

english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,
kriol: Bat bifo det mesinja bin go langa King Deibid, Jowab bin dalim im, “Wen yu kamat langa King Deibid, yu garra dalim im wanim bin hepin langa det fait,

english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
kriol: Beilak bin tok langa im, “Wotfo yu nomo bin kaman wen aibin jandim nyus basdam? Maitbi yubin jinggabat ai kaan peiyim yu detmatj?” Lagijat na Beilak bin tok.

english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
kriol: En wen dubala pipul agamin gija, dubala garra kaman langa mi blanga stapam det agamin, en ai garra dalim dubala hu rait en hu rong, en ai garra dalim dubala detlot lowa weya God bin gibit.”

english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
kriol: Wal blanga tharran na, yumob garra gibit miselp langa im, en yumob garra jandap strongbalawei langa Seitin blanga meigim im gowei brom yumob.

english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
kriol: Dumaji yu nomo sabi wotaim yu garra dai, jis laik bard weya yu gajim langa trep kwikbala, en jis laik det fish weya yu gajim garram fishnet kwikbala, lagijat na pipul garra dai langa det taim weya dei nomo sabi.

english: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
kriol: Wal aibin tok na, “Yumob kambek langa YAWEI. Yumob gin stil faindim im. Yumob jingat langa God. Im nomo longwei, im gulijap.

english: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
kriol: En 250 men bin jidan bos blanga ol detlot hu deibin fosim blanga wek langa ola difrinwan wek.

english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
kriol: En blanga tharran na olabat kemp oni hol langa graun, o langa keib o langa rokiwan pleis,

english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”
kriol: Wal wen detlot Isreil solja hubin ranawei bin luk det smok bin kamat brom det taun, deibin sabi imbin taim blanga olabat blanga tenaran blanga fait langa ola Benjamin solja. Bat detlot Benjamin solja nomo bin sabi wanim garra hepin, dumaji deibin olredi kilim 30 Isreil solja ded, en deibin dalim miselp, “Trubala wibin bidim olabat seimwei laik bifo.”

english: So they glorified God in me.
kriol: En wen detlot pipul bin irrim det wed, deibin preisimbat God, dumaji mi dalimbat det gudnyus na.

english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
kriol: Bat detlot pipul langa Jerusalem nomo bin dum wanim aibin dalim olabat. Olabat bin brabli wikitwan, mowes langa najalot pipul brom najalot kantri weya jidan raidaran langa olabat. Detlot pipul blanga Jerusalem, olabat bin gibit mi bekboun en olabat nomo bin teiknodis langa main wed en olabat nomo bin bulurrum main lowa.

english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
kriol: Wal im gudbala wen yu prei lagijat, en im meigim God brabli gudbinji. Im na bin seibum wi,

english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
kriol: Bat yumob jidan trubalawei, dumaji Jisas Krais bin gibit yumob det Holi Spirit, en im na meigim yumob sabi det trubala wed.

english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.
kriol: Yu na bin tok langa mi, en aibin lisin langa yu. Mi blanga yu na, YAWEI det Boswan God, wulijim yu wed na meigim mi jidan brabli gudbinji en hepiwan.

english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
kriol: Wal wan wekinmen blanga det boswan haibala serramonimen bin deya langa det faiyapleis du. Imbin femili blanga det men weya Pida bin kadimof im irriwol, en imbin askim Pida, “Aibin luk yu garram det men neim Jisas deya langa det gadin, indit?”

english: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
kriol: Dislot thribala men bin go langa Hilkaiya det boswan serramonimen, en deibin gibit im det mani weya detlot Libai blijiman bin oldei gajimbat brom detlot pipul langa Manesa en Ifreiyim en ebriweya langa det nowathwan kantri gulum Isreil, en brom detlot hubin jidan langa Juda en Benjamin en Jerusalem.

english: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’
kriol: Imbin tok, “Yu garra dalim det nyus langa ebri kantri. Yu gibit det sain en dalim det nyus. Yu nomo kipum sigridwan. Detlot enami garra teikoba Bebalon. En blanga im drimin neim Maduk, im garra sheim en brabli bradin, En detlot enami garra bitsimap detlot brabli nogudbala drimin sheip.

english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
kriol: “Wal mi na YAWEI det trubala God, en det taim im gulijap na weya ai garra jadjim ebri kantri, en ai garra dum langa ol yumob pipul deya langa Idam seimwei laik yumob bin dum langa main pipul olabat langa Juda. Det seim ting garra hepin langa yumob seimwei jis laik weya yumob bin dum langa olabat.

english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
kriol: Afta na sambala serramonimen gulum Ferasi en sambala lowamen bin dalim Jisas. Deibin tok, “Titja, yu dum speshalwan klebabala ting blanga shoum melabat yu garram det pawa brom God.”

english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin kipgon tok langa olabat, “Yumob jinggabat brabliwei ol dislot ting weya mi dalimbat yumob. God garra tridim yumob seimwei jis laik yumob tridim det wed blanga im. Bat mowa strongbalawei im garra lagijat langa yumob.

english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
kriol: Wal ai kaan lisin langa yunbala weya yunbala tok, en ai kaan miksap garram yunbala weya yunbala abum miting, dumaji yunbala temperap olataim, en yunbala binijimof pipul, en blanga fan yunbala oldei kripulumap ola boiwan buligi.

english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
kriol: wal ai garra gibit yu en det riba bekboun na. Ai garra meigim yu kantri jidan jis laik deset kantri nomo garram enijing, olawei brom det taun gulum Migdal langa nowathwei raidap langa det taun gulum Eswan deya langa sauthwei en raidap langa det boda langa Ithiyopiya.

english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
kriol: Yu garra abum gudwan silip en jidan seifwan en yu kaan bradin en wori blanga enijing enimo.

english: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
kriol: en det brabliwan lait blanga im bin shain brom insaid langa det klaud, en ola laitining bin flesh jis laiga faiya weya im go ebriweya.

english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
kriol: En mi oldei prei blanga olabat du, dumaji ai sabi dei wandim bulurrum God brabliwei, en dei oldei trai en dumbat olkain gudbala ting blanga im. Bat dei nomo sabi det trubalawei blanga God.

english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”
kriol: Im nomo bin jinggabat im ron laif wen imbin kilim Galaiyath ded, en YAWEI det trubala God bin yusum im blanga win det fait blanga ol wi Isreil pipul, en wen yubin luk imbin win, yubin gudbinji. Wal wotfo yu wandi dum dis nogudbala ting langa det gudbala men? Wotfo yu wandi kilim im ded? Yu nomo garram eni risan blanga kilim im.” Lagijat na Jonathan bin tok.

english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
kriol: Ai garra go en meigim det pleis redi blanga yumob, en afta ai garra kambek en gajim yumob miselp en deigim yumob blanga jidan weya ai garra jidan.

english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
kriol: Wal lagijat na aibin dalim ol detlot Isreil pipul en detlot brom najalot kantri hu jidan mijamet, dei kaan dagat enikain bif garram blad.

english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
kriol: Deibin meigim faibala pol brom det wadultri, en deibin meigim ola kep blanga detlot pol garram gol, en detlot reil du, en deibin pudum sambala golwan huk langa detlot reil blanga heingimap det ketin, en deibin meigim faibala kopawan pleit blanga holdimap detlot pol.

english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
kriol: en deibin go en tok sori langa dubala, en afta deibin deigimat dubala brom det jeil, en deibin askim dubala blanga gowei brom det taun.

english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
kriol: Wal det king bin tok, “Yuwai, ai sabi yubin oldei jidan gudwei langa mi jis laiga einjul brom God. Bat detlot najalot king bin tok yu kaan kaman garram melabat langa det fait.

english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
kriol: Wal King Eiheb bin dalim im waif Jesabel ebrijing wanim Ilaija bin dum, en hau imbin kilim ded ol detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga Beil.

english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
kriol: Olabat nomo tok trubalawei. Olabat reken dei tok trubalawei, bat najing. Olabat oldei dalimbat laiya.

english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
kriol: If ai abum tumatj daga ai mait fogedabat yu. If ai nomo abum naf daga ai mait go stilimbat en bringim sheim langa yu neim.”

english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
kriol: Wen detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei langa yu streitinimap mi, en panishim mi garram det raitwei blanga yu, ai garra larram olabat. Mi oldei prei blanga stapam ola nogudwan ting weya ola nogudbala pipul oldei dumbat.

english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
kriol: Wal God nomo bin fogedabat Reitjul. Imbin lisin langa im du wen Reitjul bin prei langa im blanga det trabul weya im kaan abum beibi.

english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
kriol: Wal Mosis bin jandim sambala mesinja brom Keidish langa det king blanga Idam. Olabat bin tok, “Dijan wed brom yu kantrimen, det traib blanga ola Isreil pipul. Yu sabi ola adtaim melabat bin abumbat,

english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.
kriol: Deibin kaundim en weiyimbat ebrijing en seimtaim deibin raidimdan ebrijing langa rolapwan peipa.

english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.
kriol: Longtaim detlot Isreil pipul bin meigim hampi lagijat na blanga det serramoni wen Joshuwa det san blanga Nan bin jidan bos, bat detlot Isreil pipul nomo bin kipgon abumbat det serramoni. Bat ol detlot pipul hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana bin bildimap hampi blanga abum det serramoni. En deibin gudbinji.

english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:
kriol: Bat oni God na hu jidan langa hebin gin shoum wi sigridwan ting. Im na bin gibit yu det drim blanga dalim yu wanim garra hepin bambai. Wal tudei na ai garra dalim yu det drim yubin abum wen yubin silip.

english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
kriol: Wal King Hesakaiya bin gibit detlot pipul 1,000 boiwan buligi, en 7,000 boiwan ship blanga kilim en dagat, en detlot boswan wekinmen olabat bin gibit langa detlot pipul 1,000 buligi en 10,000 boiwan ship. Wal detmatj serramonimen bin go thru langa det serramoni blanga meigim miselp klinbala blanga det serramoni.

english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
kriol: Mi na det Feswan, en mi na det Laswan du. Dei gulum mi Olagijawan, dumaji mi det Basdamwan en det Binijimapwan du.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
kriol: en deya du deibin gedim sambala men blanga tok laiyawei blanga Stibin. Detlot men bin tok, “Dijan men im oldei toktok nogudbalawei blanga dijan seikridwan Serramoni Pleis blanga wi en blanga ol detlot lowa weya Mosis bin gibit langa wi.

english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
kriol: Det gel bin neim Kosbi. Im fatha bin neim Suya en imbin det boswan blanga sambala Midiyan traib.

english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
kriol: Mi gitwail brabliwei laiga faiya weya im barn, dumaji main bedfren olabat nomo teiknodis langa ol yu lowa.

english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
kriol: Wal langa det namba 12 yiya wen Eihes bin jidan king blanga Juda, Hosheiya det san blanga Ela, bin jidan det nyuwan king blanga Isreil. Imbin jidan king langa Sameriya 9 yiya.

english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
kriol: “Wal det wekinmen bin gobek, en imbin dalim det boswan wanim detlot pipul bin ol tok, en det boswan bin gitwail, en imbin dalim det wekinmen, ‘Yu go ebriweya langa taun, en yu go kwikbala en bringimbek ola powan en kripulwan en blainwan en leimwan pipul.’

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
kriol: King Sedakaiya bin tenawei brom YAWEI en kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting en im nomo bin teiknodis langa YAWEI, jis laik King Jehoiyakim bin dumbat basdam.

english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.
kriol: Bambai na detlot men brom det taun bin wandi meigim trep blanga Abimalek, en deibin blandim miselp langa ola hil, en deibin stat stilimbat ola enijing brom ola pipul hubin wandi go thru langa det hil kantri, en afta det wed bin gobek langa Abimalek.

english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
kriol: Nomo. Yu garra gobek raitbek langa main ronwan kantri, en brom main ronwan kantrimen yu garra gajim waif blanga main san.” Lagijat na Eibrahem bin tok.

english: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?
kriol: Dijan na wanim YAWEI det trubala God bin tok blanga det kantri gulum Eman. Imbin tok, “Weya ol detlot men brom Isreil? Enibodi iya lukaftum blanga olabat kantri? Wotfo olabat bin larram detlot pipul hu oldei weshipbat Molek teikoba en jidan langa det kantri blanga Ged klen?

english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
kriol: Afta na deibin tok langa olabat selp garram olabat ron langgus. Deibin tok, “Dijan trabul bin kaman langa wi dumaji wibin dum det nogudbala ting langa wi braja bifo. Wen imbin apset en imbin kipgon askimbat wi blanga larramgo im, wi nomo bin lisin langa im. En wi garram dijan bedlak na dumaji wibin dum lagijat langa im.”

english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
kriol: en sambala pipul bin tok, “Im brabli medwan, dumaji im garram dibuldibul insaid langa im. Wal wotfo yumob kipgon irrimbat im?”

english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
kriol: Im nomo bin laiyinbala, en im nomo bin kilimbat enibodi, bat deibin berrim im laik ola brabli nogudbala pipul en deibin pudum im langa det greibyad blanga wan ritjwan men.” Lagijat na aibin tok.

english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Nobodi bin dum nogudbala ting blanga meigim im jidan blainwan. Nomo. God bin meigim im jidan blainwan, dumaji im wandim ebribodi garra luk im pawa wek langa det blain men.

english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
kriol: Im garra deigim detlot bushis gulum hisap en pudum insaid langa det woda en spilim langa det tent en langa ebrijing insaid langa det tent, en detlot pipul hubin deya langa det tent. En seimwei blanga enibodi hubin tatjim dedbala boun, o dedbala bodi, o greib. Enibodi hu jidan klinbala blanga serramoni garra spilim det woda garram eshis langa im.

english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
kriol: Deya na deibin oldei grambulbat en aibin gitwail langa olabat. Dei nomo bin jinggabat wanim aibin oldei dumbat blanga olabat.

english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
kriol: “Wen det fama plentimbat ola sid, afta na ebrinait im oldei silip, en deitaim im oldei go en wek langa im fam, en wen im wek lagijat, detlot sid kamat na, en dei gro. Bat det fama nomo sabi hau dei gro.

english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
kriol: Afta na King Deibid bin gibitbat daga langa ebri men en ebri gel brom ol detlot Isreil pipul hubin deya langa det serramoni. Imbin gibit olabat wanbala damba en wanbala kukwan bif en sambala daga gulum reisan. En afta ebribodi bin gobek langa olabat ron kemp.

english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
kriol: Detlot wekinmen garra luk im feis, en dei garra abum im neim langa olabat forid,

english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.
kriol: En deya na yumob garra jidan longtaim langa det gudbala kantri weya garram gudwan graun en growimapbat ola gudwan daga weya YAWEI bin pramisim blanga gibit wi grengrenfathamob en ola bigininimob.

english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.
kriol: en imbin kilim ded ola pipul hu nomo bin dum eni rong ting. En YAWEI nomo bin larramgo Manesa fri brom det nogudbala ting weya imbin dum.

english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
kriol: Langa det namba 6 dei ola pipul bin gajim naf daga blanga dubala dei, en deibin bilimap dubala dish blanga ebriwan, en afta ola boswan blanga detlot pipul bin go langa Mosis, en deibin dalim im olabat bin duwit.

english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
kriol: Im kaan dalimbat laiya im klebabala, dumaji detkainwei nomo kaman brom hebin. Detkainwei kamat brom dijan kantri. Im meigimapbat im ronwan stori, en im brom det dibuldibul na.

english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
kriol: en yu nomo bin larram main enami olabat grebum mi, en yu nomo bin larram mi buldan du.

english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
kriol: En im garram pawa nomo lilbit, en im shainiwan jis laik det san. Wal God bin shain detmatj, en garram smok imbin bilimap det serramoni pleis. Nobodi bin gowin langa det pleis na raidap detlot 7 einjul bin spilim ola trabul brom detlot 7 dish en detlot trabul bin binij.

english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,
kriol: “Wen sambodi reken enibodi bin dum nogudbala ting en dei bringimap im langa det teibul blanga ofring langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga meigim strongbala pramis en tok, ‘Ai nomo bin dum det ting’,

english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;
kriol: en detlot Juwish bosmob bin jandap, en deibin dalimbat mi olkain stori. Bat dei nomo bin dalim mi wanim aibin reken olabat garra tok.

english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’
kriol: “Wal bos, aibin kaman blanga tok langa yu, dumaji detlot pipul bin tok nogudbalawei langa mi, en aibin jinggabat wen mi askim yu blanga album mi, wal maitbi yu garra duwit langa mi.

english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.
kriol: Yu meigim det men jidan nogudbinji hubin meigimbat main dedi jidanbat hepiwan wen imbin bringimap det nyus, ‘Yu garram san.’

english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
kriol: Wal yumob irrim mi na. Det taim im gulijap na weya God garra kaman blanga jadjim ebribodi, en im garra jadjim ol im pipul olabat basdam. En if im dum lagijat langa ola Kristjan pipul, wal im garra jadjim ol detlot pipul hu nomo bin bulurrum det gudnyus blanga im, en im garra panishim olabat brabliwei.

english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
kriol: Wal yu dalim mi na, main olmen. Wujei yu garra deigim detlot ship blanga fidimbat? Wujei yu garra abum spel brom det hotwan san? Ai nomo wandim lukabat yu ebriweya. Ai wandim kaman streit langa yu. Ai nomo wandim gaburrumap main feis garram heinggitjif, dumaji det najalot stakmen mait luk langa mi.

english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
kriol: “Wal yumob irrim mi na. Wotfo yumob gulum mi Bos wen yumob nomo duwit langa mi?

english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.
kriol: Bat wi nomo bin go gulijap langa det kantri blanga detlot Emanait pipul, o gulijap langa detlot hubin jidan langa det Jeibak Riba, o langa detlot taun wansaid langa det hil kantri, o langa eni pleis weya YAWEI bin dalim wi nomo blanga go.”

english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
kriol: Aibin gibit det najalot kantri blanga Giliyad, en holot det kantri Beishan weya King Og bin jidan bos langa det haf klen blanga Manesa. Dei gulum det pleis Egob na. “Bifo deibin gulum Beishan det kantri blanga ola Refait pipul.

english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
kriol: Yu garra meiksho yu rait bifo yu deigim sambodi langa kothaus, o bambai yu kaan win en yu mait sheim miselp.

english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
kriol: Wal laitining en thanda en olkainaba nois bin kamat brom det speshal boswan tjeya langa midul, en 7 lait bin barn lida langa det wanbala speshalwan tjeya. Detlot 7 lait bin detlot 7 spirit blanga God.

english: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”
kriol: Wal Gidiyan bin deigim ol detlot solja langa det springwoda. En wen deibin kamat langa det spring, YAWEI bin dalim Gidiyan, “Yu garra kadimat detlot men hu go en nildan rait langa det woda en dringgim laiga dog brom detlot men hu dringgim woda brom olabat bingga.”

english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
kriol: En im lagijat du langa detlot pipul hu wek langa olabat gadin. Dei kaan gobek langa olabat haus en gajim enijing.

english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”
kriol: bat wi garra askim YAWEI det trubala God wanim wi garra dum basdam.”

english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
kriol: En lagijat na Jeihu bin binijimap ola pipul hubin weshipbat det drimin gulum Beil deya langa Isreil.

english: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
kriol: “Det Spirit blanga YAWEI bin tok thru langa mi. Imbin pudum det wed blanga im langa main ronwan mawus blanga tok.

english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
kriol: Yumob sabi? Ai wandim yumob garra redi blanga gibitbat det mani jis laik weya aibin tok, dumaji sambala braja blanga wi brom Mesadoniya maitbi garra kaman garram mi wen ai garra go deya langa yumob, en if dei luk yumob nomo redi blanga gibitbat det mani, wal im garra meigim mi sheim, dumaji aibin reken trubala yumob bin redi blanga gibitbat det mani. En if yumob kaan gibitbat det mani, im garra meigim yumob sheim du.

english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
kriol: Sambala langa yumob nomo sabi enijing, bat dislot brabli gudwan wed na garra album yumob blanga sabi mowa hau blanga jidan gudbalawei en album ola yang pipul blanga teiknodis en lenimbat ola gudbala ting.

english: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
kriol: Yu garra shoum rispek langa YAWEI en im garra titjim yu blanga sabi mowa blanga ola klebawan ting. If yu wandim pipul blanga preisimbat yu, wal yu garra jidan lobala en nomo laigim miselp.

english: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
kriol: “Bat mi na det God hu jidan ebriweya! Ai nomo jidan oni langa wanbala pleis! Detlot mesinja reken ai kaan luk wanim olabat dumbat!

english: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.
kriol: Weiyimbat im jis laik sambodi bin weiyimbat samting langa det skeil, en im nomo hebiwan bat brabli laitwan. Wal seimwei God im sabi yu nomo gudwan blanga jidan king enimo.

english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
kriol: Yu si? If yumob wandi bulurrum det lowa blanga meigim miselp jidan raitwei langa God, wal yumob bin kadimat miselp brom Jisas Krais, en God kaan kain langa yumob na.

english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
kriol: Wal dislot na ola serramonimen en ola Libaimen hubin kambek garram Serababal det san blanga Shiyaltiyel en Joshuwa det haibala serramonimen brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana. Ola serramonimen bin Seraiya, Jeramaiya, Esra, Amaraiya, Melak, Hetash, Shekanaiya, Reiyam, Meremoth, Ido, Ginathoi, Abaija, Mijamin, Meidaiya, Bilga, Shemaiya, Joiyarib, Jedaiya, Salu, Emak, Hilkaiya en Jedaiya. Dislot men bin jidan bos blanga ola serramonimen langa det taim wen Joshuwa bin jidan det haibala serramonimen.

english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
kriol: langa detlot draiwan pleis weya nobodi jidan?

english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Nomo trastim langa mani en ola ebrijing. Detlot Bebalon solja jidan gridibala en olabat neba sedisfaid. Dei oldei wandim mowa. En blanga tharran na dei oldei teikoba najalot kantri.

english: They cried to Yahweh, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahweh and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’
kriol: “Afta na yumob grengrenfatha olabat bin jingat langa YAWEI blanga album olabat, en deibin tok, ‘Melabat bin dum brabli nogudbala ting, dumaji melabat bin tenawei brom yu, en melabat bin bulurrumbat detlot najalot drimin gulum Beil en Estatei. Wal yu seibum melabat brom melabat enami olabat, en melabat garra libum ol detlot drimin en bulurrum yu.’

english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.
kriol: En Paltiyel bin brabli nogudbinji, en imbin bulurrum det gel raidap langa det taun gulum Bahurim, en imbin kraikrai olawei, en wen deibin kamat langa det taun, Ebna bin dalim im blanga gobek, en streidawei imbin tenaran, en imbin gobek.

english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
kriol: Olabat kaan neba gowei brom det dakbala pleis. Olabat jis laik det tri wen det faiya bin barnimap en det win bin blowimwei detlot purdiflawa.

english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
kriol: en Kenan bin san blanga Inash, en Inash bin san blanga Seth, en Seth bin san blanga Edam, en Edam bin san blanga God.

english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”
kriol: Yumob garra go langa det boswan serramonimen langa det taim en dalim im, ‘Ai wandim dalim YAWEI aibin kaman langa dijan kantri en mi na jidan langa dijan kantri weya imbin pramisim langa wi grengrenfathamob blanga gibit wi.’

english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
kriol: Wal det najawan wekinmen hubin kamat langa det keib basdam bin gowin insaid na, en imbin luk detlot bendij en detlot matiriyal, en imbin bilib trubala Jisas bin gidap laibala brom dedbala.

english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
kriol: Wal bambai na aibin irrim God bin jinginat brabli adbala, “Ol yumob men, yumob hu garra panishim det taun, yumob garra kaman iya. Yumob bringimap ebrijing blanga fait.”

english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
kriol: En if enibodi dum eni wek langa det dei, wal ai garra binijimap im.

english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
kriol: “En yumob garra lafta tjeinjim yumob laif, en yumob garra stap dumbat detlot nogudbala ting. Yumob garra gibit feyago langa ola kantrimen blanga yumob du.

english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
kriol: Imbin jis laik imbin gajim det peipa weya imbin bukumdan ol detlot nogudbala ting blanga wi, en imbin rabumof ol detlot nogudbala ting, en imbin gajim det najawan peipa garram detlot lowa weya bina meigim wi dai, en imbin deigim det dubala peipa, en imbin neilimap dubala ontop langa det kros, en deya na imbin binijimap ebrijing. Imbin jis laik imbin dum lagijat na.

english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
kriol: Wen pipul bon, trabul garra kaman langa olabat. Im jis laik det spak weya kamat brom det bush faiya en gowap langa skai.

english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.
kriol: Wal afta wen King Beisha bin dai, deibin berrim im bodi deya langa det meinwan taun gulum Taisa, en im san Ela bin jidan det nyuwan king.

english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
kriol: Wal Job bin jidan laibala blanga naja 140 yiya, en imbin luk im bigininimob en im grenkidmob bin abumbat ronwan biginini du.

english: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
kriol: Wal ebritaim wen detlot Isreil pipul bin oldei abum adtaim brom olabat enami, deibin oldei kraikrai en sori miselp, en YAWEI bin oldei sori langa olabat, en imbin oldei gibit olabat nyubala lida, en imbin oldei album det lida seibum olabat brom detlot enami.

english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Wen Labaiyathan im snis, im oldei meigim faiya kamat, en im ai dubala oldei shain wulijim det san.

english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
kriol: Bambai na wen Edam bin olmen 130 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Seth, en det lilboi bin jis laik im dedi.

english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
kriol: Wal Jeikob bin gitredi blanga gobek langa im dedi Aisik deya langa det kantri gulum Keinan. Bat im nomo bin dalim Leiban im garra gowei. Bambai na wen Leiban bin wei shirimbat ola ship, Reitjul bin go, en imbin stilim ola drimin sheip weya Leiban bin abum langa im haus, en afta Jeikob bin pekimap sambala kemul garram ola ebrijing weya imbin gedim langa det kantri, en imbin pudum im biginini olabat en im waif olabat langa sambala kemul du, en imbin jandim ola najalot enimul blanga im lida langa im femili olabat.

english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok langa det kantri gulum Bebalon. Imbin tok, “Ola pipul brom najalot kantri bin oldei preisimbat Bebalon, bat im jidan prisana na. Wen ola pipul brom najalot kantri garra luk wanim bin hepin langa Bebalon olabat garra bradin nomo lilbit.

english: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
kriol: Ai garra bildimap brabli gudwan serramoni pleis, dumaji melabat God mowa haibala brom eni najalot drimin.

english: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
kriol: Det feswan bin neim Eliyab, en det sekanwan bin neim Abinadeb, en det namba thriwan bin neim Shama,

english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
kriol: Wal det san blanga Salaman bin neim Reiyabowam en imbin 41 yiya ol wen imbin jidan king blanga Juda. Blanga im mami bin neim Neima brom det pleis gulum Eman. Reiyabowam bin jidan bos 17 yiya langa Jerusalem, det taun weya YAWEI bin pikimat brom ola kantri langa Isreil blanga meigim det pleis weya pipul garra weshipbat oni langa im.

english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
kriol: Yumob reken yumob gin larramgo fri detlot prisana hu abum strongbala en krulbala bos?

english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
kriol: “Det taun gulum Saidan weya oldei jidan langa solwoda, yu brabli strongbala taun indit? Bat yu garra sheim miselp na jis laik det gel hubin merrit basdam en nomo bin abum eni biginini.

english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
kriol: en mi shoum olabat wulijim dei garra jidan laibala olagijawan. Longtaim God bin pramisim wi blanga jidan laibala olagijawan. En God im nomo laiya.

english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
kriol: If yumob dum lagijat, wal melabat gin merrit langa yumob doda, en yumob gin merrit langa melabat doda, en wi gin jidan wan pipul.

english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
kriol: YAWEI nomo larram wi fogedabat blanga ola gudwan ting weya im oldei dumbat. Im brabli kainbalawan en im garram soribalawan filing blanga pipul.

english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
kriol: en deibin ol tok, “Melabat nomo sabi wanim yu tok. Melabat nomo bin dum lagijat.

english: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation—
kriol: En detlot lif blanga det tri bin brabli purdiwan, en det tri bin abum detmatj frut daga blanga fidim ola pipul brom ebri kantri. Wailwan enimul bin silip andanith langa det tri, en bard bin meigim nes langa det tri.

english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”
kriol: En wen imbin tok lagijat, aibin go langa im, en aibin kilim im ded, dumaji aibin sabi streidawei wen im garra buldan langa graun, im garra dai. “Wal afta wen aibin kilim im ded, aibin deigimat det speshalwan het brom im hed en det speshalwan ring weya imbin oldei werrimon langa im am, en aibin bringimap det dubala ting langa yu na, bos.” Lagijat na det men bin tok langa Deibid laiyawei. Bat Deibid nomo bin sabi imbin laiya langa im.

english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.
kriol: Wal ol detlot pipul bin jandap mijamet, en deibin tok wanwei, “Nomeda hu wi iya, bat stil wi kaan gobek langa wi ronwan kemp raidap wi garra streitinimap dijan trabul gudwei.

english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
kriol: Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Yumob reken aibin askim yumob blanga gibit mi presen o bigismob mani?

english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
kriol: Detlot krulbala pipul kaminap gulijap na, ol detlot pipul na hu nomo bulurrum yu lowa.

english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
kriol: en yu sabi ola trabul aibin oldei abumbat en hau pipul bin oldei gibit mi adtaim. Wal yu jinggabat na wanim bin hepin langa mi deya langa detlot taun gulum Entiyak, Aikoniyam en Listra. Detlot pipul deya bin gibit mi brabli adtaim. Bat ai nomo bin gibap wen aibin abum detlot trabul, en Jisas Krais det Bos blanga yunmi bin seibum mi brom detlot trabul.

english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
kriol: Main gudfren bin grajim det graun en deigimat ola ston blanga plentim detlot brabli gudwan greiptri. Imbin bildimap brabli haiwan haus blanga wotjimbat detlot greiptri. Imbin meigim pleis blanga gajim jus brom detlot greip daga. Imbin reken detlot greiptri garra gro brabli switwan daga, bat imbin teist brabli bitawan.

english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
kriol: Brom deya Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin go langa det taun gulum Kapeniyam, en wen imbin Sebathdei, Jisas bin go langa det miting pleis blanga ola Juwish pipul, en imbin toktok langa olabat,

english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
kriol: Yumob kaan deigimat yumob raunwan het en yumob but du. Yumob kaan kraikraibat en graulgraulbat. Yumob garra go ebriweya en ardimbat detmatj dumaji yumob bin dum brabli nogudbala ting.

english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”
kriol: “Ai garra gibit langa yu en yu sanmob en langa yu dodamob blanga ol det taim weya garra kaman, ola speshalwan ofring. Wen detlot Isreil pipul garra gibit langa mi, dijan garra jidan fogud. Aibin meigim dijan brabli strongwan pramis fogud blanga yu en yu bigininimob.

english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
kriol: Nomo larram mi go langa det rongwei. Dumaji yu kainbalawan YAWEI, lenim mi blanga yu lowa.

english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”
kriol: Wal Ebsalom bin kipgon askimbat im dedi, “Wal wotabat yu larram main braja Emnon kaman langa det padi?” Wal im dedi nomo bin wandim Emnon blanga go deya, en imbin tok, “Wotfo im garra go deya?”

english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
kriol: “Wal ai garra spredimat main net en gajim olabat, en ai garra panishim olabat blanga ola nogudbala ting weya deibin dumbat.

english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
kriol: Wal detlot pipul hu dumbat nogudbala ting garra bradin langa detlot pipul hu jidan bos. Bat detlot pipul hu dumbat gudbala ting kaan bradin langa detlot pipul hu jidan bos. Wal yumob dalim mi na. Yumob wandi bradin langa detlot pipul hu jidan bos o yumob wandi jidan fri brom detkain ting? If yumob wandi jidan fri, wal yumob garra dumbat gudbala ting,

english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
kriol: En langa det namba 8 dei det gel im garra deigim dubala dab o dubala pijin langa det serramonimen deya langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent weya mi oldei jidan.

english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
kriol: Wal Jisas bin sabi im Dedi God bin meigim im jidan Bos blanga ebrijing, en imbin sabi imbin kaman brom God en im garra gobek langa God.

english: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
kriol: Det dei blanga YAWEI garra jidan brabli dakbala nomo garram eni lait.” Lagijat na aibin tok.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
kriol: Wal ebrijing weya King Hesakaiya bin dum wen imbin jidan king, en hau imbin brabli trubalawan langa YAWEI, im deya langa det dubala buk gulum Ola wed blanga Aisaiya det speshalwan mesinja en det san blanga Eimas, en Ola stori blanga ola king brom Juda en Isreil.

english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
kriol: Im na bin meigim ebrijing!’ Lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok. “Yu si? YAWEI kaan jidan langa haus weya men bin bildimap.

english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
kriol: Wal loda pipul bin gibit bigmob mani blanga dijan ofring, en melabat garra hendulum det mani brabli gudbalawei, dumaji melabat nomo wandim enibodi garra agamin blanga det mani,

english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
kriol: En deibin hitimbat im garram longwan stik langa im hed, en deibin spit langa im, en deibin nildan langa im blanga tisimbat im.

english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.
kriol: Wal blanga tharran na ai garra jandim faiya blanga barnimap det haus weya det king gulum Heiseiyel bin bildimap en ai garra barnimap ol detlot strongwan haus blanga det king gulum Benaded.

english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
kriol: “Wal ol yumob pipul deya langa Jerusalem, det taim garra kaman weya yumob garra bildimap det taun blanga yumob igin, en det taim na yumob garra meigim det kantri blanga yumob bigwan,

english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’
kriol: If detlot wekinmen blanga main irrim aibin toktokbat garram yu, wal olabat garra kaman en olabat garra askim yu wanim wibin toktokbat. Olabat garra pramis dei kaan kilim yu if yu dalimbat olabat enijing.

english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh.
kriol: “Deya na det serramonimen garra bringimap det waif en meigim im jandap lida langa det teibul blanga ofring.

english: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
kriol: Ai garra preisimbat det neim blanga YAWEI. Im pipul olabat garra tok im brabli haibala.

english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob sabi na God bin brabli kain langa yumob, en blanga tharran na ai dalim yumob blanga gibit miselp langa im jis laiga laibalawan sekrifais ofring. Yumob garra oldei jidan oni blanga im, en yumob garra oldei meigim im gudbinji, dumaji wen yumob dum lagijat na, yumob weship im brabliwei en trubalawei.

english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
kriol: Imbin reken im kantrimen olabat bin sabi God garra yusum im blanga larramgo olabat fri brom det kantri. Bat dei nomo bin sabi.

english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;
kriol: Afta na aibin wandim irrim mowa blanga det namba 4 enimul, dumaji imbin luk difrin brom detlot najalot enimul. Imbin meigim ebribodi bradin langa im brabliwei, en wen imbin kilimbat enibodi imbin oldei dagadagat olabat garram im aiyanwan tuth en imbin yusum im kopawan fut blanga pudumbut langa enijing.

english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
kriol: Det wed brom Esta bin agri langa det wed weya Modakai bin raidimdan bifo blanga det dubala dei gulum Purim. En deibin raidimdan ebrijing blanga det dubala dei gulum Purim langa det buk.

english: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
kriol: Haulong detlot nogudbala pipul garra jidanabat gudbinjiwei? Haulong mowa YAWEI?

english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
kriol: Wen ola gudwan pipul dum enijing brabli gudwei, en wen nogudbala pipul dai, detlot pipul langa det taun jidan hepiwan en jinginatbat gudbinjiwei.

english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
kriol: Ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei garra jidan gudbinji wen dei luk ola nogudbala pipul git panish. Olabat garra luk detmatj blad buldan blanga detlot nogudbala pipul.

english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
kriol: Bat ai nomo bin dum enijing langa olabat dumaji ai nomo bin wandim main neim garra jidan sheimwan langa ola pipul langa najalot kantri hubin sabi aibin deigimwei ol detlot Isreil pipul brom Ijip.

english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
kriol: yu garra dalim olabat mi na YAWEI det boswan God garra joinimap det dubala wadi mijamet blanga det kantri gulum Isreil en blanga det kantri gulum Juda. Ai garra holdim dubala langa main bingga en dei garra jidan wanbala.

english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
kriol: Brom deya Jeikob en im femili olabat bin kipgon raidap najasaid langa wan pleis gulum Migdalida, en deya na deibin meigim olabat kemp.

english: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
kriol: YAWEI, larram yu filing blanga laigimbat olagijawan jidan garram melabat. Melabat trastimbat yu blanga ebrijing.

english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
kriol: Ola ebrijing wandim det taim garra kaman, dumaji God bin meigim ebrijing jidan difrinwei brom hau imbin meigim ebrijing gudbala basdam. Ola ebrijing nomo bin wandim jidan difrinwei.

english: “Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’
kriol: “Ola pipul langa ebri kantri, yumob irrim mi na. Yumob garra toktokbat main wed langa longweiwan solwoda kantri. Aibin spredimat main pipul olabat oloba, bat ai garra majurrumap olabat mijamet, en ai garra lukaftum olabat, jis laik det stakmen hu oldei lukaftumbat im shipmob.

english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.
kriol: en im oldei lukaftumbat detlot pipul hu bilib langa im brabliwei, en im garra binijimap ola nogudbala pipul en meigim olabat jidan langa dakbala pleis olagija. Nobodi kaan meigim miselp strongbala blanga go thru langa dis laif garram im ronwan pawa, dumaji ola enami blanga YAWEI garra binij.

english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
kriol: Trubala ai dalim yumob. Ebriweya langa dijan kantri weya dei garra dalimbat dijan gudnyus blanga mi, dei garra dalim dijan stori blanga dijan gel du blanga jinggabat im.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
kriol: Wal det blad im na det laif blanga ol detlot enimul en ebri laibwan ting. Blanga tharran na aibin dalim ol detlot Isreil pipul dei nomo lau dagat bif garram blad, en if enibodi dum lagijat, wal im kaan jidan blanga main pipul olabat.

english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
kriol: Dei garra jidan brabli krulbala en dei kaan kain langa enibodi, langa yangwan pipul o ol pipul.

english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
kriol: Wal God bin seibum yumob wen yumob bin bilib langa Jisas Krais dumaji imbin abum det brabli kainbala filing blanga yumob. Im nomo bin seibum yumob dumaji yumob bin gudbala, en im nomo bin seibum yumob dumaji yumob bin dum gudbala ting. Imbin seibum yumob dumaji imbin wandi seibum yumob imselp, en dumaji imbin seibum yumob lagijat, wal nobodi kaan reken miselp na.

english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.
kriol: Wal Jeihu bin jingat langa ola pipul langa Sameriya, en imbin majurrumap olabat deya en imbin tok, “King Eiheb bin wek blanga det drimin gulum Beil oni lilbit, bat ai garra wek blanga im mowa adbalawei.

english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
kriol: en det einjul bin dalim im, “Yu werrimon yu belt en yu but.” En Pida bin werrimon, en afta det einjul bin tok, “Yu werrimon yu kout du, en yu kaman en bulurrum mi.”

english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
kriol: Ai garra dalim yumob wanim mi reken na,

english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
