kriol: en Eibram bin dalim Lot, “Yunmi rileishan gija. Ola stakmen blanga yunmi nomo wandi fait.

english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
kriol: en God bin meigim im gidap laibala brom dedbala, en imbin meigim im jidan garram det brabli shainiwan lait, en thru im na yumob bilib langa God. Yumob bilib langa Jisas Krais, en blanga tharran na yumob bilib langa God du, en yumob trastim im blanga seibum yumob.

english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says Yahweh, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.
kriol: Langa Juda bigmob pipul garra dai, en oni lilbit garra stil jidan laibala.

english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.
kriol: Imbin tok, ‘Yumob garra bildimap haus en jidan deya. Yumob garra growimap gadin en dagat daga brom det gadin weya yumob bin growimap.

english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;
kriol: Ai meigim pramis garram yu. If ai nomo bringimbek det boi, wal ai garra jidan bleim blanga im, en afta yu gin kilim mi ded.

english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.
kriol: Wal YAWEI im brabli wail na, jis laik det rein weya kaman garram bigiswan win, en im kaman blanga panishim detlot nogudbala pipul. Im garra kipgon panishimbat olabat raidap im binij dum ebrijing im wandim dum. Bambai im pipul olabat garra sabi dijan brabliwei.

english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
kriol: Brom deya YAWEI bin tok langa Joshuwa, “Tudei na ai garra stat meigim yu haibala langa ola Isreil pipul, en dei garra sabi mi jidan garram yu jis laik weya aibin oldei jidan garram Mosis.

english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
kriol: Bat ai gibit yumob nyuwan lowa blanga bulurrum. En iya na det lowa. Yumob garra laigim gija. “Yumob sabi? Aibin laigim yumob, en yumob garra laigim gija seimwei du jis laik aibin laigim yumob.

english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
kriol: “Wal main biginini, yu jinggabat wanim aibin dalimbat yu, en yu nomo fogedabat wanim aibin dalimbat yu blanga dum.

english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
kriol: Yumob sabi wanim mi tok blanga det kros? Detlot pipul hu garra go langa det helfaiya oldei toktok garram detkain bigwan wed, dumaji dei reken det trubalawan wed im siliwan. Bat blanga ol detlot pipul weya God garra seibum olabat, det trubalawan wed im det pawa blanga God.

english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
kriol: Afta na detlot wekinmen blanga Jisas bin kaman langa im, en deibin askim im, “Wen yu kambek en jidan bos, wujan garra jidan mowa haibala langa melabat?”

english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”
kriol: “Wal yumob irrim mi na. Ai kaan dagat dijan sapa garram yumob enimo raidap main Dedi jandimbek mi en ai jidan boswan brabliwei.”

english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu dumbat adwek garra jidan garram pawa, bat detlot pipul hu jidanbat leisibala garra oldei dumbat rabishwan wek.

english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
kriol: “Wal detlot serramonimen en speshalwan mesinja tok langa mi na, ‘Yu kaan titjimbat melabat. Najing. Detlot wed weya yu toktokbat jis laik beibi tok. Yu toktok jis laik ola beibi oldei toktokbat en yu oldei dalimbat melabat ebrijing oba en oba igin.’

english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.
kriol: “Melabat kaan lisin langa yu Jeramaiya wanim yubin oldei dalimbat melabat garram YAWEI neim.

english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
kriol: Main pipul langa Jerusalem, aibin raidimdan yumob neim langa main bingga. Ai oldei jinggabat yumob.

english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
kriol: Wal wen God bin tok lagijat langa Jisas, imbin meigim im Bos blanga det nyubalawei, en det nyubalawei im mobedawan langa det olbalawei.

english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.
kriol: “Esra, yu garra wek hau God wandim dumaji imbin meigim yu sabi det lowa. Yu garra pikimat ola men hu jidan boswan en ola men hu kotimbat pipul en meigim lowa blanga lukaftumbat ola Isreil pipul sangodansaid brom det Yufreitis Riba blanga bulurrum det lowa blanga yu God. En yu garra titjimbat det lowa langa detlot hu nomo sabi.

english: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
kriol: Wal aibin tok, “Ol yumob Isreil pipul, YAWEI det trubala God garram strongbala wed blanga yumob, en yumob garra irrim det wed. “Wal God, yu dalim detlot pipul na, en yu tok wulijim ol detlot hil en ol detlot ston garra lisin langa det wed weya yu dalim olabat du.

english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
kriol: Wal olabat bin kipgon langa det wei brom Refadim raidap langa det hil gulum Hora en deibin kemp langa ol dislot pleis na. Deibin kemp deya langa det deset gulum Sainai, Kibrathataba, Heiseroth, Rithma, Rimanperes, Libna, Risa, Kehelatha, hil gulum Shefa, Herada, Makeloth, Teihath, Tera, Mithka, Hashmana, Mosarath, Benajakan, Horagidged, Jotbatha, Ebrona, Esiyangeba, Keidish, deya langa det deset gulum Sin, en bambai deibin kamat langa det hil gulum Hora, gulijap langa det kantri gulum Idam.

english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
kriol: en wen deibin kamat langa det riba, deibin faindim det riba bin rait ful dumaji imbin fladwodataim. Wal nomeda det riba bin ful, bat stil detlot serramonimen bin pudum olabat fut insaid langa det woda,

english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
kriol: Olabat bin gajulum im en deigim im blanga dai, dumaji nobodi bin gibit im feyago. Nobodi bin jinggabat wanim garra hepin langa im. Nobodi bin sabi imbin gibit im laif blanga det brabli nogudbalawei blanga melabat.

english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
kriol: Bat wen imbin meigim Jisas jidan serramonimen, imbin meigim det strongwan pramis langa im. Wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, “Det Bos bin meigim strongwan pramis langa im, en im kaan breigim det pramis, en imbin tok, ‘Yu garra jidan serramonimen olagijawan.’”

english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
kriol: Preisim det haibalawan neim blanga YAWEI. Nildan lida langa YAWEI, det brabli holiwan God.

english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
kriol: en imbin jidan garram dubala, en imbin wek garram dubala du, dumaji imbin faindat dubala bin oldei meigimbat tent blanga meigimap mani seimwei laik imbin oldei dumbat.

english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? God oldei pikimat enibodi weya im wandim kain langa im. En im oldei pikimat enibodi weya im wandim meigim im jidan admen du.

english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
kriol: Wen mi jinggabat main God, mi wori, en mi fil brabli nogudbinji.

english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
kriol: en im na oldei klinim olabat brom olabat nogudbalawei, en im en ol detlot pipul weya imbin meigim gudbala, olabat abum seimwan Dedi. En blanga tharran na im nomo sheim blanga gulum wi im femili olabat.

english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
kriol: Wal afta wen Kein bin kilim Eibul ded, Edam en Ib bin silipsilip igin, en dubala bin abum najawan lilboi, en Ib bin tok, “God bin gibit dijan lilboi langa mi blanga deigim pleis blanga Eibul, dumaji Kein bin kilim im ded.” En blanga tharran na imbin gulum det lilboi neim Seth.

english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
kriol: Wal ol detlot pipul langa det taun gulum Jeriko bin bradin blanga detlot Isreil pipul, en deibin jadimap det geit langa det taun brabliwei, en nobodi bin lau gowin langa det taun en kamat brom det taun.

english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
kriol: dumaji detlot solja garra deigimbek det drimin sheip langa olabat ronwan kantri, en deya na dei garra gibit det drimin sheip langa det haibala king blanga olabat, dumaji im garra bidim detlot Isreil pipul, en im garra meigim olabat peiyim im garram det drimin sheip na, en ola Isreil pipul garra sheim miselp, dumaji deibin bulurrum nogudbala wed.

english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
kriol: En detlot frog garra galimap langa pipul du. Dei garra galimap langa yu en langa detlot boswan wekinmen blanga yu en langa ol yu pipul olabat.’ Lagijat na yunbala garra tok langa det king.”

english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
kriol: Wal klebabala pipul jinggabat blanga dai, bat detlot granggibala oni jinggabat blanga abumbat brabli gudwan taim.

english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,
kriol: Wal King Edanisadek bin jandim wed langa detlot najalot fobala king blanga detlot Emarait pipul. Imbin jandim det wed langa King Hoham langa det taun gulum Hebran en langa King Pairam langa det taun gulum Jamath en langa King Jeifiya langa det taun gulum Leikish en langa King Debiya langa det taun gulum Iglan.

english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.
kriol: Wal det taim garra kaman na wen dei kaan gulum dijan pleis Tofeth o Hinam Beli enimo. Dei garra gulum dijan pleis Beli blanga Kilimbat Pipul.

english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
kriol: Bambai na Ebsalom bin gajim hos en bagi blanga raidabat, en imbin gajim 50 men blanga lukaftumbat im wen imbin oldei wandi go eniweya.

english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.
kriol: Wal Gidiyan bin kadimat detlot 300 Isreil solja, en imbin meigim thribala grup, en imbin gibit ebri solja wanbala hon en wanbala jag, en deibin blandim faiyastik insaid langa detlot jag,

english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
kriol: Ol detlot nogudbala ting weya deibin oldei dumbat longtaim, wal ai garra larramgo olabat fri en dei gin jidan laibala dumaji olabat bin dum wanim im rait.’

english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
kriol: Ai garra tok strongbalawei langa im, en ai garra jidan brabli nogudbinji langa im, en ebribodi garra teiknodis langa mi. En ai garra tjakidawei im brom main pipul olabat wulijim yumob garra sabi mi na YAWEI det trubala God.

english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
kriol: Wal bifo Joshuwa bin dai, detlot Juda solja bin bidim ola Keinanait pipul hubin jidanbat langa det taun gulum Hebran. Basdam det taun bin neim Aba, en deya na deibin bidim det thribala Keinanait femili gulum Sheshai, Ahiman en Telmai.

english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin jinggabat, “Det Serramoni Pleis weya mi wandim main ronwan san Salaman blanga bildimap garra jidan bigiswan en brabli purdiwan. Bat main san im oni yangboi en im nomo sabi. Wal ai garra gajim ebrijing redibala na bifo mi garra dai.” Lagijat na imbin jinggabat.

english: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
kriol: YAWEI, yu det God hu oldei panishim ol detlot jigiwan bos. Yu gitwail en panishim olabat na.

english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.
kriol: Imbin tok, “Wal deigim dijan buk garram God lowa en pudum wansaid langa det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI, wulijim dijan buk garra jidan witnis blanga yumob weya yumob dumbat ola nogudbala ting.

english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
kriol: Yumob blanga God pipul, en if wailwan enimul kilim eni enimul, wal yumob nomo lau dagat det bif. Yumob garra gibit det bif langa ola dog blanga dagat.

english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
kriol: Wen sambodi meigim im ronwan plen wal det plen kaan hepin, najing, bat if bigmob pipul album im meigim plen tharran garra hepin.

english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
kriol: Yumob bin kilim ded det Boswan blanga laif. Bat God bin meigim im gidap laibala brom det greibyad, en minbala bin ol luk dijan ting bin hepin.

english: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
kriol: Wal wen detlot Isreil pipul bin tok lagijat, deibin libum ol detlot drimin, en deibin tjakidawei ola sheip blanga detlot drimin weya deibin abum, en deibin weship langa YAWEI det trubala God, en afta wen deibin dum lagijat, imbin sori langa olabat.

english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
kriol: Bat jis laik det stakmen oldei faindim brabli gudbala pleis blanga im ship, wal ai garra maindimbat ola po pipul en olabat garra jidan gudbalawei. Bat ai garra meigim sambala pipul jidan hanggriwan, en najalot pipul garra gitkil.

english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
kriol: Wal detlot pipul bin dalim Jisas, “Det lowa blanga wi tok det Boswan gulum Masaiya garra jidan laibala olagijawan. Wal wotfo yubin tok dei garra lidimap det Speshalwan Men? Hu im?”

english: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.
kriol: Ola pipul blanga Isreil bin jandap deya. En det king bin tenim miselp feis langa olabat, en imbin askim YAWEI blanga jidan gudwei langa olabat.

english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
kriol: Aibin reken ai garra jidan longtaim bat main laif im go kwikbala na, jis laik sambodi tjakam spiya kwikbala.”

english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
kriol: Ai garra meigim detlot Isreil pipul gobek langa olabat kantri. Olabat garra oldei dagadagatbat detlot daga weya gro langa det hil kantri gulum Kamul en langa det kantri gulum Beshan en langa det hil kantri blanga Ifreiyim en Giliyad.

english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
kriol: En mi na YAWEI det boswan God garra kaman kwikbala en seibum yu, en det graun garra sheiksheik, en yu garra irrim det thanda garra jingat adbala en det faiya en win garra kaman.

english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.
kriol: Im dubala ai brabli purdiwan laik detlot waitwan dab, wen dei oldei washim miselp langa lilwan riba.

english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
kriol: en ai garra meigim im brabli gudbinji, dumaji im garra abum im ronwan san blanga yu. Im garra jidan mamiwan blanga bigismob traib, en sambala king garra kamat brom im du.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.
kriol: Blanga yu tuth, im brabli waitwan laik det ship wen dei kadimbat blanga im wul en washim im. Holot jis rait, en yu nomo bin lujim eni tuth.

english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
kriol: Wal det boswan haibala serramonimen bin jandap, en imbin askim Jisas, “Wanim yu ensa blanga dijan stori weya dijan dubala men toktok blanga yu?”

english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
kriol: En yu garra dringgim oni dubala kap blanga woda ebridei.

english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”
kriol: Wal dubala bin jidan en dagadagat daga en dringgimbat oldei, en afta det gel dedi bin dalim dubala, “Yunbala garra silip iya tunait en abum gudtaim bifo yunbala garra gowei.”

english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, imbin tok blanga det Holi Spirit weya God oldei gibit langa ola pipul hu bilib langa Jisas. Bat det taim na wen Jisas bin toktok, God nomo bin jandim det Holi Spirit yet langa detlot pipul hubin bilib langa Jisas, dumaji im nomo bin deigimbek Jisas langa top blanga jidan deya haibala garram det brabli shainiwan lait.

english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”
kriol: En nomeda mi meigim miselp lobala jis laiga brabli granggibala men, bat stil ai garra kipgon densdensbat blanga preisimbat God. En nomeda yu jinggabat nogudbalawei blanga mi, bat stil detlot wekingel garra jinggabat mi gudbalawei, en dei garra kipgon rispek langa mi.” Lagijat na Deibid bin tok.

english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
kriol: ‘Brom yu femili lain na king garra oldei jidan. Ai garra meigim yu femili jidan lagijat olagijawan.’”

english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.
kriol: Wal Amasa bin gowei blanga majurrumap ola Juda solja. Bat im nomo bin kambek tudeistaim.

english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
kriol: Esaraiya, det san blanga Neithan bin det haibala bos blanga ol detlot gabman bos. Seibad det serramonimen bin det san blanga Neithan, en imbin oldei albumbat King Salaman jinggabat ola ebrijing weya im garra oldei dumbat.

english: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
kriol: YAWEI, yubin meigim loda ting. Garram yu ron sabibalawei yubin meigim olabat brabli gudwei. Dijan wel jidan garram detmatj enimul blanga yu.

english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
kriol: Bat afta wen ai garra gidap laibala brom det greib, ai garra go lida langa yumob langa Gelali.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
kriol: Sambala pipul bin luk detlot ting hepin brom stat, en deibin spredimat det gudnyus, en afta bigmob pipul bin irrim detlot stori, en deibin raidimdan.

english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
kriol: En melabat oldei dalimbat ola najalot Kristjan pipul blanga yumob du. Loda pipul oldei gibit yumob adtaim, en yumob oldei abum loda trabul. Bat yumob nomo slekbek. Yumob oldei kipgon trastimbat Jisas Krais olawei. En blanga tharran na melabat oldei dalimbat ola najalot Kristjan pipul.

english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
kriol: Wal King Eihes bin dum ola brabli nogudbala ting, imbin gibit ola sekrifais ofring en barnim ola gudsmelwan medisin langa ola nogudwan weship pleis blanga ola drimin ontop langa ola hil kantri en andanith langa ola sheidiwan tri.

english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”
kriol: “Yumob jinggabat det men neim Ekan. Imbin breigim det lowa blanga YAWEI, en imbin kipum detlot ting weya im nomo bin lau blanga abum, en afta YAWEI bin panishim wi holot. Det men bin dai dumaji imbin dum det nogudbala ting, en najalot pipul bin dai du.” Lagijat na Finiyas en detlot najalot men bin tok langa det thribala klen.

english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
kriol: Pethrasait, Keslahait en Krit pipul. En detlot Filastain pipul bin kaman brom detlot Krit pipul na.

english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,
kriol: det wed weya sambala nogudbala kantrimen langa yumob bin deigimwei detlot pipul langa olabat taun blanga weship detlot drimin sheip weya yumob nomo bin weship basdam.

english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
kriol: Imbin meigim ola gudwan graun jidan garram solt, dumaji ol detlot hubin jidan langa det kantri bin dumbat ola brabli nogudwan ting.

english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
kriol: Wal det king bin abum 900 hosis en aiyanwan bagi, en imbin jidan brabli krulbala langa detlot Isreil pipul fo 20 yiya. Afta na detlot Isreil pipul bin jinggabat YAWEI, en deibin jingat langa im blanga album olabat.

english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
kriol: En afta imbin shoum olabat im bingga en det said weya deibin jalk im garram spiya. Wal detlot wekinmen bin brabli gudbinji wen deibin luk det Bos blanga olabat,

english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
kriol: en wen detlot king blanga ola traib gulum Hitait, Emarait, Keinanait, Perasait, Hibait en Jebusait bin irrim det nyus, deibin ol majurrumap miselp, en deibin ol joinap blanga fait langa Joshuwa en ola Isreil pipul.

english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
kriol: En detlot san blanga Isau bin neim Elifas, Ruwel, Jeyus, Jeilam en Kora.

english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”
kriol: Afta aibin go luk Shemaiya, det san blanga Dalaiya, en grensan blanga Mehetabel. Im nomo bin lau gowei brom im kemp det taim. Imbin dalim mi dijan wed, “Yu en mi garra midap langa det Serramoni Pleis. Wi garra blandim miselp insaid langa det Seikridwan Pleis en lokimap det dowa. Blanga yu enamimob garra kaman blanga kilim yu ded. Dei garra kaman blanga kilim yu eni naitaim na.”

english: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.
kriol: Wal tumorro laik distaim na God garra jandim brabli nogudwan heilstom weya yumob nomo bin abum langa dijan kantri bifo.

english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin dalim detlot Isreil pipul najawan wed brom YAWEI, “Wanim det Manesa klen bin tok, olabat rait.

english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
kriol: “Wal wanim yunbala reken? Yunbala agri langa det wed weya aibin dalim yunbala? Yunbala garra tridim main bos gudwei en meigim im gudbinji?” Lagijat na det wekinmen blanga Eibrahem bin tok.

english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
kriol: Deibin jidanbat brabli klinbala bifo. Dei nomo bin oldei merrit langa eni gel, najing. Oni deibin bulurrumbat det yangwan ship ebriweya imbin go, dumaji det yangwan ship bin baiyim olabat. Deibin speshalwan pipul blanga God, en olabat jis laiga feswan ofring blanga det yangwan ship.

english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
kriol: “Yunbala jandap longwei brom dislot pipul dumaji ai garra binijimap olabat streidawei na.”

english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
kriol: “En God garra panishim detlot pipul hu nomo bilib langa det gudnyus, en im garra seibum detlot pipul hu bilib langa det gudnyus en beptais.

english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
kriol: Wal afta wen ol detlot Isreil pipul bin teikoba ola kantri sangodansaid brom det Jodan Riba, deibin ol majurrumap miselp langa det taun gulum Shailo, en deya na deibin ringimap det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI det trubala God.

english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
kriol: Bat ai nomo bin yusum det rait blanga gedimbat enijing brom enibodi. En wen mi tok lagijat, ai sabi mi tok praudbalawei. En ai nomo raidimbat dijan leda langa yumob blanga meigim yumob gibit mi enijing. Mobeda mi dai basdam bifo mi askimbat yumob blanga enijing, dumaji if ai meigim yumob gibit mi enijing, wal mi nomo trubala langa det wed weya aibin jis tok. En if yumob peiyim mi blanga det wek, wal ai kaan tok praudbalawei enimo na.

english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
kriol: Ai sabi im meigim yumob sheim wen yumob tokabat detkain nogudbala ting weya pipul oldei dumbat snikinwei.

english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
kriol: Wal ol detlot pipul bin gowei brom detlot tent blanga Kora, Deithan en Ebiram. En Deithan en Ebiram bin kamat en jandap langa det dowawei langa dubala tent garram dubala waif en biginini olabat.

english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
kriol: Nomeda if ai washim miselp garram det strongbala sop,

english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”
kriol: en imbin jingat langa im wekinmen, en imbin dalim det wekinmen, “Yu andimwei dis gel atsaid, dumaji ai nomo wandi luk im. Yu tjakam im atsaid en lokimap det dowa.”

english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, detlot pipul bin wandi grebum im. Bat nobodi bin pudum bingga langa im, dumaji det rait taim blanga im nomo bin kaman yet.

english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
kriol: En yumob garra barnbarn wulijim det draiwan gras weya det faiya oldei barnimap.

english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
kriol: en aibin oldei meigim trabul blanga ola Juwish pipul hubin bulurrum Jisas Krais, dumaji aibin laigim det Juwish lowa brabli, en aibin brabli gudbala men langa det lowa, dumaji ai nomo bin abum eni folt.

english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”
kriol: Wal Teima bin oldei jidan langa det haus blanga im dedi King Deibid, en King Deibid bin jandim wed langa im deya, “Yu garra go langa det haus blanga Emnon, en yu garra gugum daga blanga im.”

english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
kriol: Wal King Salaman bin fosim pipul blanga bildimap det Serramoni Pleis en detlot bigwan haus blanga im, en blanga filimap det graun sanraisaid langa det taun, en blanga bildimap det wol raidaran langa det taun. En imbin yusum olabat du blanga bildimbek det najalot taun gulum Heisowa, Magido en Gisa.

english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
kriol: Eibrahem imselp bin tok, ‘Det wuman im main sista’, en det wuman bin tok seimwei, ‘Eibrahem im main braja.’ Dubala bin trikim mi. Ai nomo bin dum enijing rong. En ai nomo fil giltiwan.” Lagijat na det king bin tok.

english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
kriol: Bat detlot san blanga Kora nomo bin gitkil.

english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
kriol: Yumob Isreil pipul jidan brabli gudbinji na. Nomo eni pipul jidan laik yumob. YAWEI bin seibum yumob. YAWEI na oldei jidan jis laik det shild en shapwan naif. Im na oldei lukaftumbat yumob en bidim yumob enamimob. Detlot enami garra askim yumob blanga kainbala langa olabat, bat yumob Isreil pipul garra bidim olabat.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
kriol: Yumob lisin gudwei na wanim ai garra dalim yumob. Ai garra dalimbat yumob gudwan wed weya ai sabi.

english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.
kriol: Wal King Sol bin dalim ola pipul blanga bringimap ola sekrifais ofring en ola feloship ofring langa im, en afta wen deibin bringimap detlot ofring langa im, King Sol bin dum miselp det serramoni blanga det sekrifais ofring,

english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
kriol: Ai garra gibit yumob taim na blanga jinggabat wanim yumob garra dum. Yumob garra jidan laibala o dedbala, gudbalawei o nogudbalawei? Ai garra jingat langa skai en langa graun. Dubala garra jidan witnis blanga yumob wanim yumob jinggabat blanga dumbat. Wal yumob garra jinggabat blanga jidan laibala.

english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
kriol: Bambai na sambala men bin jandap, en deibin tok laiyawan wed blanga Jisas,

english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
kriol: en wen Sol en im wekinmen bin kamat langa det taun gulum Gibiya, detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga God bin midim dubala, en streidawei det spirit blanga God bin teikoba langa Sol, en Sol bin joinin langa detlot men, en imbin densdens en jingatbat garram olabat.

english: Then Job answered,
kriol: Wal Job bin tok langa Bilded,

english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
kriol: Yumob nomo rait wen yumob bin tok, ‘Melabat sabi det wei blanga God. Larram God panishim im.’

english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
kriol: “Yu go langa det taun gulum Serafath deya gulijap langa det taun gulum Saidan, en deya na yu garra jidan dumaji aibin dalim wanbala widogel blanga fidimbat yu.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
kriol: Ilaija bin go langa detlot pipul en imbin tok, “Haulong im garra deigim yumob blanga meigimap yumob main? If YAWEI im det trubalawan God, wal yumob garra weship oni langa im, bat if Beil im det trubalawan god, wal yumob garra weship langa im!” Bat ola pipul nomo bin tok enijing.

english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.
kriol: Detlot king blanga ola Isreil pipul bin oldei bildimap olabat ronwan haus deya gulijap langa main Serramoni Pleis, en oni det wol na bin kadimat olabat brom mi. En detlot king nomo bin shoum rispek langa mi en deibin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, en aibin brabli wail en bin binijimap olabat.

english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
kriol: Yu oldei taiyimap det raiding dongki blanga yu langa det gadin weya dei oldei growimap ola gudwan greip daga blanga meigimbat wain, dumaji yu brabli ritjwan. En yu oldei washimbat yu klos langa det gudwan wain, dumaji yu garram detmatj, en im gowin blanga weist.

english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
kriol: Main pipul, yumob irrim main wed en teiknodis wen mi tok.

english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
kriol: Wal det king en Heiman bin go en dagat daga garram Esta,

english: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
kriol: Bambai na YAWEI bin dalim mi blanga gobek langa det Yufreitis Riba blanga gajim det shot trasis.

english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
kriol: En ebridei det wekinmen blanga det king bin oldei peiyim Jehoiyakin mani blanga baiyim enijing blanga lukaftum miselp. Binij na.

english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
kriol: “Dijan na det wed weya aibin jandim langa detlot pipul longtaim bifo yumob bin abum ola trabul. Yumob garra oldei dumbat rait ting langa yumob selp en tridim gija gudwei, en yumob garra albumbat gija en jidan kainbala.

english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
kriol: Deya na ola plent oldei gro gudwei. Det gadin growimap detlot pamagrenit tri, en olkain gudwan frut daga. Det gadin growimap olkain plent blanga gudsmelwan medisin, en blanga meigim det daga teist gudwei.

english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
kriol: Ebrijing yubin tok im rabishwan wed.”

english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
kriol: Bat ol detlot pipul hu trastim yu blanga kipum olabat seif garra oldei sing langa yu gudbinjiwei. Yu blandim olabat brom olabat enamimob, en olabat garra oldei preisimbat yu.

english: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.
kriol: Detlot roud weya olabat oldei bulurrumbat dei jidan brabli slipriwan en dakbala. Ai garra meigim olabat buldanbat, en ai garra bringimap nogudbala ting langa olabat. En det taim blanga olabat panishmen im kaminap na.

english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
kriol: Wal dubala bin askim Jisas, “Wujei minbala garra meigim det sapa redi?”

english: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
kriol: Wen aibin abum trabul, en ai nomo bin sabi wanim mowa blanga dum, aibin jingat langa YAWEI. Imbin irrim mi, en imbin seibum mi brom ol detlot trabul.

english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
kriol: Wal wotfo yu kwestjanimbat mi? Yu garra kwestjanimbat ola pipul hubin oldei irrim mi toktok. Yu go en askim olabat wanim aibin oldei dalimbat olabat. Olabat sabi.”

english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
kriol: Aibin reken yu na det men brom Ijip hubin stadim det fait longtaim en deigim 4,000 medra langa det deset kantri.”

english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’
kriol: Yumob pipul langa Jerusalem, ai garra pikimat sambala men blanga jidan bos langa det kothaus, en sambala men garra albumbat yumob wulijim yumob garra jidan raitwei jis laik detlot pipul hubin jidan basdam. Jerusalem garra abum nyuwan neim gulum Trubalawan en Feyagowan Taun.

english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
kriol: Bambai ai garra kambek en jidan langa Jerusalem. Langa det taim na main pipul garra dum wandim ai wandim trubalawei en dei garra gulum det pleis ‘Trubala Taun’ en dei garra gulum det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan det seikridwan hil blanga YAWEI.

english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.
kriol: “‘En wen det king brom Ijip garra luk dislot greibyad, im en im soljamob garra gudbinji, dumaji detlot najamob bin gitkil du.

english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in Yahweh’s assembly.
kriol: “En bambai wen ol detlot pipul blanga YAWEI garra gedimbek olabat len, wal yumob kaan gedimbek yumob len.

english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.
kriol: “If enibodi meigim pramis en nomo jinggabat gudwei wanim imbin pramis, wal im gilti wen im sabi wanim imbin dumbat.

english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
kriol: Det lowa im lagijat du if det buligi kilim lilboi o lilgel ded.

english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
kriol: Wal detlot olmen bin go langa Jisas, en deibin askimbat im soribalawei, “Yu garra album det men, dumaji imbin dum loda gudbala ting,

english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
kriol: Yubin meigim trabul kaman langa mi en aibin ardim, bat yu garra meigim mi strongbala igin. Yu kaan larram mi go langa greibyad.

english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
kriol: en faibala blanga nowathsaid en faibala blanga sangodansaid.

english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
kriol: Wal Mosis bin tok, “Wal ai garra askim im blanga yu. Bat yu garra dalim mi wotaim ai garra askim im blanga deigidawei ola frog brom yu en brom ola boswan wekinmen blanga yu en brom ol yu pipul olabat. En wen ai askim im, det taim na im garra deigidawei ola frog. Oni langa riba sambala frog garra stil jidan.”

english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
kriol: en ai garra binijimap ol detlot klebabala ting weya yumob bin oldei yusumbat, en ai garra binijimap ola doktabala blanga yumob du.

english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
kriol: Bat mi wori blanga yumob, dumaji wen ai kaman deya, maitbi ai garra faindim yumob jidan difrinwei brom hau ai wandim yumob garra jidan. En if ai faindim yumob jidan difrinwei, wal maitbi yumob garra faindim mi jidan difrinwei brom hau yumob bin wandim mi blanga jidan du. Yumob sabi? Mi wori blanga yumob, dumaji maitbi ai garra faindim yumob agamin gija en jelasbat en gulajambap en gitwail en toktok nogudbalawei en spredimatbat yan en reken miselp en nomo teiknodis langa enibodi.

english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.
kriol: “Ai sabi yumob oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, en ai sabi yumob oldei stilimbat enijing brom pipul en ardimbat pipul brabli nogudwei langa fait. Yumob oldei meigim ola gudbala pipul brabli nogudbinji. En yumob oldei gajimbat mani brom enibodi blanga dum enijing yumob wandim blanga dum, en yumob nomo oldei gibit ola po pipul feyago langa kot.

english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
kriol: Wal wen deibin kamat atsaid brom det kothaus, sambala pipul bin grebum wan men neim Sosanis hubin bos blanga det Juwish Miting Pleis, en deya gin lida langa det kothaus deibin beldim im, en det gabman bos nomo bin dum enijing.

english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;
kriol: Blanga detlot pipul langa det taun gulum Taya YAWEI bin tok, “Detlot pipul langa det taun gulum Taya oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en blanga tharran na ai garra panishim olabat. Deibin deigidawei ola pipul prisana, en deibin selim olabat langa detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum Idam, en wen deibin dum lagijat dei nomo bin kipum det pramis weya deibin dalim miselp longtaim blanga jidan braja gija.

english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.
kriol: YAWEI bin meigim det king jidan admen, en det king bin ranimap detlot Isreil pipul, en deibin gajimap olabat deya weya deibin kemp wansaid langa det Redsi gulijap langa det dubala pleis gulum Paiyahairoth en Beilsefan. Wal wen detlot Isreil pipul bin gowei brom Ijip, deibin oldei kipgon jinginatbat gudbinjiwei.

english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
kriol: Imbin abum loda bout blanga trebul langa woda garram ola bout blanga King Hairam. Ebri 3 yiya im bout bin oldei kambek garram gol, silba, det shainiwan boun blanga elafen gulum aibri, en ola eip en ola mangki.

english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
kriol: En det boswan king wed im brabli strongbala. Nobodi kaan tok langa im, “Wotfo yu dum lagijat?” Najing!

english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
kriol: En if yu abum mowa san biyain langa Manesa en Ifreiyim, wal olabat nomo main san, en ai kaan hendimoba kantri langa olabat, najing. Olabat lafta gajim kantri brom Manesa en Ifreiyim det dubala braja blanga olabat.

english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
kriol: Blanga yu pipul olabat nomo bin fait garram olabat spiya blanga teikoba det kantri. Dei nomo bin win garram olabat ronwan pawa, bat garram yu strongbala pawa yubin album olabat. Dumaji yubin deya garram olabat, yubin shoum olabat haumatj yubin laigim olabat.

english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
kriol: Bat if yumob kaan dum lagijat, wal melabat garra gajim det gel en deigidawei im longwei brom yumob kantri.” Lagijat na detlot san blanga Jeikob bin tok.

english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
kriol: Wal det najawan men brom yumob neim Apefras im iya garram mi, en im tok gudei langa yumob du. Im wekinmen blanga Jisas Krais, en im oldei prei blanga yumob brabliwei, en im oldei askimbat God blanga meigim yumob jandap brabli strongbala en jinggabat wanwei en sabi en dum ebrijing God wandim.

english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
kriol: en imbin askim Jeikob, “Yu brabli olmen. Wal haumeni yiya yubin gajimap?”

english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
kriol: Wal dubala pipul mobeda langa wanbala. Dubala gin wek mijamet en albumbat gija.

english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
kriol: Wal Modakai bin gowei en imbin dum ebrijing wanim Esta bin dalim im.

english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
kriol: Yumob kaan jidan giltiwan wen yumob dagat det daga, dumaji yumob bin gibit det brabli gudwan ofring langa YAWEI. Bat yumob garra dum dijan raitwei en nomo meigim det seikridwan ofring nogud blanga detlot Isreil pipul en dagadagat daga bifo yumob gibit det gudwan ting langa YAWEI. If yumob dum det nogudbala ting, wal yumob garra dai.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Wotfo ai garra larramgo fri main pipul olabat? Olabat bin libum mi en gibit bekboun langa mi. Olabat bin oldei weshipbat ola drimin weya nomo trubala. Aibin oldei fidimbat main pipul raidap olabat bin bulap binji, bat olabat tufeis en oldei silipsilipbat garram naja men waif. En olabat oldei abumbat gudwan taim silipsilipbat garram gel blanga mani.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”
kriol: YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis, “Yu pudumbek det wokinstik blanga Eran insaid lida langa det Seikridwan Boks. Det wokinstik garra jidan woning blanga ol detlot Isreil pipul wulijim olabat garra dai if olabat nomo stap grambulbat.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
kriol: “En yumob garra lukaftum det Libai klen weya dei jidan deya langa ola taun blanga yumob, dumaji dei nomo garram eni kantri.

english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
kriol: If yu nomo dalim ol detlot pipul, wal wen ai garra jidan widogel, streidawei ol detlot pipul garra tridim mi en main san Salaman brabli nogudbalawei.” Lagijat na Bethshiba bin tok.

english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
kriol: Bat aibin gulijap nomo bilib na, jis laik aibin gulijap buldan,

english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.
kriol: Wal det serramonimen garra luk im igin, en if im luk det sowa bin breik opin, im garra dalim im, ‘Yu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni’. Wal det opinwan sowa im wan brabli nogudwan skin siknis, en im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
kriol: Wen det sangodan im garra jidan klinbala blanga serramoni, en im gin dagat det seikridwan ofring.

english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
kriol: If yumob nomo andimwei olabat, wal ai lafta binijimap yumob seimwei laik wen aibin jinggabat blanga binijimap detlot najalot pipul.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.
kriol: Pipul garra irrim bigiswan nois wen Bebalon garra binij, en ola graun ebriweya garra sheik. Ola Bebalon pipul garra jingat bradinbalawei, en pipul garra irrim olabat brom ola najalot kantri.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
kriol: Afta na detlot draiwan daga bin dagat ol detlot bigwan daga. Brom deya det king bin gidap brom silip, en imbin sabi det dubala drim bin dalimbat samting langa im.

english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
kriol: En yumob garra oldei prei blanga mi en main wekinmen olabat du. Yumob garra askimbat God blanga gibit melabat tjens blanga dalimbat det wed blanga Jisas Krais. Nobodi bin sabi det wed bifo Jisas Krais bin kaman en shoum wi. En tudei mi iya langa dijan jeil dumaji mi oldei dalimbat det wed blanga im.

english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.
kriol: “Wal brom tudei na yumob garra jinggabat, dumaji tudei na yumob bin binij bildimbat det flopat blanga det Serramoni Pleis main, en yumob garra luk wanim garra hepin langa yumob brom tudei na.

english: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
kriol: Olataim King Yusaiya bin jidan laibala imbin abum det brabli nogudwan skin siknis en im nomo bin klinbala blanga serramoni. Imbin jidan langa im ronwan haus en im nomo bin lau blanga go langa det Serramoni Pleis igin. Im nomo bin lau blanga dum eni wek en im san Jotham bin jidan boswan blanga det kantri.

english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.
kriol: Wal ola Filastain solja ebriweya langa det kantri bin brabli bradin na, en det graun bin sheik, en ol detlot solja nomo bin sabi wanim blanga dum.

english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
kriol: Bat melabat bin dalim im melabat kaan kambek miselp langa yu nomo garram det laswan san. If melabat bringimap im, orait. Melabat gin kambek langa yu, dumaji yubin tok lagijat na langa melabat.

english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”
kriol: Yu weit iya basdam. Ai garra go en gajim sambala daga blanga gibit yu ofring.” Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Wal gowan. Ai garra weit blanga yu.”

english: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
kriol: Sing preis song langa YAWEI. Plei myusik garram ola gita.

english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
kriol: Wal Shafan bin dalim Hilkaiya wanim King Josaiya bin tok, en Hilkaiya bin dalim Shafan imbin faindim det buk garram ola lowa langa det Serramoni Pleis. Wal Hilkiaya bin gibit det buk langa Shafan en imbin ridimbat.

english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
kriol: Bat dumaji yu laigim mi detmatj, ai gin kaman langa yu Serramoni Pleis. Dumaji mi bradin en rispek langa yu, mi tenim miselp langa yu Seikridwan Pleis en weship yu.

english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok,

english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
kriol: Det bandri blanga det kantri blanga yumob garra stat brom det deset kantri, en brom deya im garra go sangodanwei langa det solwoda gulum Medatareiniyan, en brom deya im garra go raidap langa det hil kantri gulum Lebanan, en brom deya im garra go sanraiswei langa det Yufreitis Riba raidaran langa det kantri blanga detlot pipul gulum Hitait pipul.

english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
kriol: En yu jinggabat hau det sanraisaid jidan brabli longwei brom det sangodansaid. Wal lagijat du im garra deigidawei ola nogudbalawei longwei brom wi.

english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
kriol: Blanga wi taim langa dijan wel yubin meigim, en melabat kaan tjeinjim.

english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
kriol: En streidawei wanbala wekinmen blanga Jisas bin deigimat im bigwan naif, en imbin kadimof det raidensaid irriwol blanga wanbala wekinmen blanga det haibala serramonimen.

english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
kriol: Afta na wan bosmen bin askim Jisas, “Gudbala titja, wanim ai garra dum blanga abum det olagijawan laif?”

english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
kriol: Wal langa det seimtaim igin, det king brom Asiriya bin gajim det nyus na, hau det king neim Tairaka brom Ithiyopiya bin kaminap blanga fait langa im. Wal det king brom Asiriya bin jandim sambala mesinja garram leda langa King Hesakaiya.

english: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and no one can stop his hand, or ask him, “What are you doing?”
kriol: Im oldei lukinat ola pipul langa dijan wel. Olabat najing. Im jidan bos langa ola einjul langa top en langa ola pipul langa dijan wel. Nobodi kaan go oba langa im, en nobodi kaan tok, ‘Wotfo yu dum lagijat?’

english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
kriol: Ola Isreil pipul bin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en nomo bin laigim dum wanim YAWEI bin oldei wandim olabat blanga dum, en nomo bin bulurrum im wed. Wal blanga tharran na YAWEI bin larram najalot pipul stilimbat ola ebrijing blanga olabat.

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”
kriol: Wal Mosis bin tok langa Eran, “Wi garra spilim wanbala dish ful garram mena insaid langa dram, en wi garra pudum det dram weya YAWEI wandim wi garra kipum det mena daga blanga ola Isreil pipul hu garra bulurrum wi biyain.”

english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
kriol: Wal detlot solja brom Sebyulan klen nomo bin andimwei detlot Keinanait pipul brom det dubala taun gulum Kitran en Neihalal, en detlot Keinanait pipul bin kipgon jidanbat deya langa det taun. Bat detlot Isreil pipul bin meigim olabat jidan laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga olabat.

english: The chief priests accused him of many things.
kriol: En wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, detlot serramonimen bin tok olkain blanga im.

english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
kriol: en imbin dalim King Deibid, “Yu na main bos en main king. En ai garra dum ebrijing weya yu wandim mi blanga dum.” Wal afta na det wekinmen en im femili olabat bin jidan wekinmen blanga Mefibosheth. En Mefibosheth bin go en jidan langa Jerusalem weya King Deibid bin jidan, en nomeda imbin kripulwan langa im fut dubala, bat stil imbin oldei dagat daga deya gin langa det kemp blanga King Deibid, en imbin oldei jidan jis laiga san blanga King Deibid. En Mefibosheth bin abum ronwan san du neim Mika.

english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
kriol: Main gudfren olabat, yumob kaan bilib langa enibodi wen im reken im garram det Holi Spirit. Yumob garra testim im basdam blanga faindat if det spirit weya im garram bin kaman brom God, dumaji loda laiyinwan titja bin go ebriweya langa dijan wel.

english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for Yahweh has sent you away.
kriol: Bat if ai dalim det wekinboi main ola erro bin buldan det said, wal yu garra gowei, dumaji YAWEI wandim yu garra gowei brom iya,

english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
kriol: Bat wen gel abum longwan heya, det heya meigim im purdibala, dumaji God bin gibit im det longwan heya blanga gaburrumap im hed jis laiga het.

english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
kriol: Detlot Ibaha pipul bin meigim det dubala drimin sheip gulum Nibas en Tatak blanga olabat, en ola Sefabaim pipul bin oldei gibit olabat biginini blanga barnimapwan ofring langa det dubala drimin sheip gulum Edramelek en Einamelek.

english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
kriol: Ola gudbala pipul oldei jinggabat basdam bifo dei ensim sambodi, bat detlot nogudbala pipul ensimbek streidawei en dei meigim trabul.

english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
kriol: Wen yu kilim sambodi blanga stilimbat im enijing, wal det nogudbalawei na garra binijimap yu laif.”

english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
kriol: Wal blanga tharran na God bin lidimap im en meigim im jidan brabli haibala langa hebin, en imbin gibit im neim, en det neim im mowa haibala langa enibodi neim.

english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
kriol: En Ruwel bin jidan dedi blanga Neihath, Sera, Shama en Misa.

english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
kriol: Wal det najawan wekinmen bin buldan lida langa im, en imbin askim im, ‘Yu gibit mi taim, en ai garra peiyimbek det mani!’

english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
kriol: Ebritaim det klaud bin oldei gidap, detlot Isreil pipul bin libum det kemp, en wen det klaud bin oldei stap, wal deibin sabi olabat garra stap deya igin.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai garra duwit langa yu, dumaji ai sabi yu brabli, en yu meigim mi gudbinji.”

english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.
kriol: Yumob nomo bulurrum King Hesakaiya. Im kaan seibum yumob.

english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
kriol: Deya na Jeikob bin pailimap ston, en imbin gulum neim blanga det pleis Elbethel, dumaji deya na God bin kamat langa im basdam wen imbin ranawei brom im braja en go langa det kantri gulum Mesapoteimiya.

english: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”
kriol: Afta det einjul blanga YAWEI bin tok, “YAWEI yu na det boswan God, en blanga 70 yiya na yubin brabli wail langa Jerusalem en Juda. Wal haulong dei garra weit langa yu blanga kain langa olabat?”

english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
kriol: Wal Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi garra jidan garram yu en meigim yu strongbala insaid, en God garra kain langa ol yumob Kristjan pipul deya. Binij na.

english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
kriol: Imbin pikimat sambodi brom det king femili, en imbin meigim im raidimdan det pramis garram im, en imbin meigim det pramis brabli strongwan. Im garra jidan trubala langa im en imbin meigim im jidan king. Imbin deigimwei ola haibala pipul langa najawan kantri wulijim detlot najalot pipul hu stil jidan deya langa Juda garra duwit wanim im dalim olabat, en dei kaan neba breigim det pramis.

english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
kriol: Detlot gudbala en sabibala lidamob garra jidan jis laik det san shain langa skai brabli braitwan, dumaji deibin oldei dumbat ola gudbala ting. En detlot pipul hubin titjimbat najalot pipul blanga dum ola rait ting blanga God garra jidan olagijawan jis laik detlot sta weya shain brabli braitwan langa skai.

english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu jidan deya najasaid langa det solwoda, olabat oldei weidabat blanga mi blanga seibum olabat. Mi brabli strongbalawan en mi jidan redibala. Det taim im gulijap na weya ai garra kaman blanga seibum olabat, en ai garra jidan bos langa ebri kantri.

english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.
kriol: Wal wen Semsan dedi bin gowin langa det haus blanga det gel, Semsan bin abum det weding padi jis laik ola yangmen bin oldei abum wen deibin merrit,

english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
kriol: Brom deya sekanwan einjul bin kamat, en imbin tok, “Binij na! Binij na! Det taun gulum Bebalon im binij na! Det taun bin meigimbat ola pipul dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. Bat det taun im binij na!”

english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
kriol: Afta na King Deibid bin gibitbat daga langa ebri men en ebri gel brom ol detlot Isreil pipul hubin jidan deya langa det serramoni. Imbin gibit olabat wanbala damba en wanbala kukwan bif en sambala daga gulum reisan.

english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
kriol: Detlot praudbala pipul hu nomo teiknodis langa yu lowa bin grajim dipwan hol blanga trepam mi.

english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;
kriol: Bambai na detlot Filastain pipul bin stat fait langa detlot Isreil pipul igin, en King Deibid en im solja olabat bin go blanga fait langa olabat, en wen deibin faitfait, King Deibid bin nokap,

english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
kriol: Ai trastim im en ai kaan bradin. Wotfo ai garra bradin? Pipul kaan ardim mi!

english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
kriol: “Brom deya det king blanga det kantri gulum Moweb bin fait langa yumob. Det king bin neim Beilak, en imbin san blanga det olmen neim Sipowa, en imbin jandim wed langa det klebabalamen neim Beilam, hubin san blanga det olmen neim Biyowa, en det king bin askim Beilam blanga singim yumob.

english: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
kriol: “Detlot Juda pipul bin oldei jidan prisana en detmob bin tridimbat olabat adbalawei, Olabat enamimob bin deigim olabat langa najawan pleis blanga wekwekbat. Deibin oldei jidan langa najawan kantri, dumaji olabat nomo bin abum ronwan kantri. Bigismob enami bin deya en dei nomo bin larram olabat ranawei.

english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
kriol: Wal Pailat bin lafta kamat atsaid langa olabat, en wen imbin kamat atsaid, imbin askim olabat, “Wanim nogudbala ting dijan men bin dum blanga meigim yumob bringimap im iya langa mi?”

english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.
kriol: en imbin kilim ded ola pipul langa ol detlot taun du. Oni langa wanbala taun im nomo bin kilim olabat. Imbin meigim pramis langa ola Hibait pipul langa det taun gulum Gibiyan, en imbin larram olabat kipgon jidan laibala.

english: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin panishimbat detlot Filastain pipul deya langa det taun en langa ola lilwan taun deya du. Imbin bradinim olabat brabliwei, en imbin gibit olabat brabli nogudwan boil weya meigim pipul dai,

english: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.
kriol: Langa det taim wen King Jehosafet bin jidan king blanga Juda imbin agri blanga wek gija garram King Eihesaiya det king blanga Isreil, bat King Eihesaiya bin dum loda brabli nogudbala ting.

english: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;
kriol: Aibin tok, “Ai nomo detkain weya spredimatbat nyus en dalimbat wed blanga gedimbat mani. Mi brabli stakmen dijan iya en mi oldei lukaftumbat ola tri gulum figtri.

english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
kriol: Gedowa, Ahiyo, Sekaraiya en

english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
kriol: Im garra gibit yumob det prais, dumaji wen aibin hanggribala, yumob bin gibit mi daga, en wen aibin thestibala, yumob bin gibit mi woda, en wen aibin jidan streinja langa yumob kantri, yumob bin jingat langa mi,

english: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.
kriol: Wal det king bin brabli bradin na. Detlot haibala pipul blanga im nomo bin sabi wanim blanga dum.

english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
kriol: Wal Leimek bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 182 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi,

english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
kriol: Wotfo deibin kipgon jidanbat garram ola enimul blanga olabat? Deibin jidan garram ola enimul dumaji deibin agamin, en dei nomo bin meigimap olabat main gudwei blanga go.

english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
kriol: “Yubin brabli trubala men brom det taim na wen yubin bon, bat bambai na yubin stat dumbat nogudbala ting.

english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
kriol: “‘Ai garra jandim detlot Midiya pipul blanga fait langa det kantri gulum Bebalon. En wen detlot Bebalon pipul garra trai blanga gibit olabat silba o gol blanga album, dei kaan gajim.

english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
kriol: Wal ola serramonimen, en detlot Libai pipul, en sambala najalot pipul bin jidan langa Jerusalem en gulijap langa det taun. Ola singamob en ola blijiman en ola wekinmen blanga det Serramoni Pleis bin jidan langa ola gulijapwan taun, en ola najalot Isreil pipul bin jidan langa detlot taun weya olabat grenfatha olabat bin jidan.

english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
kriol: Bambai na det taim bin kaman blanga det gel blanga abum det beibi, en imbin abum dubala lilboi.

english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
kriol: “Wal detlot wekinmen bin go ebriweya langa det taun, en deibin faindim loda gudwan pipul en nogudwan pipul, en deibin majurrumap olabat holot langa det haus blanga abum det padi, en deibin jadimap det haus.

english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
kriol: Lagijat na Jisas bin shoum miselp thritaim langa im wekinmen olabat afta imbin gidap laibala brom dedbala.

english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
kriol: Main braja en sista olabat, yumob sabi na? Wen ai kaman deya langa yumob, if ai toktok langa yumob garram difrinkain langgus, yumob reken ai garra album yumob? Nomo. Ai kaan album yumob lagijat. Im rait if ai gibit yumob speshalwan wed brom God o dalim yumob blanga det wed weya imbin gibit langa mi, en im rait du if ai meigim yumob sabi mowa blanga im o titjimbat yumob det wei blanga im, dumaji ol detlot ting na gin album yumob.

english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin kipgon tok, “Ai dalim yumob. Seimwei lagijat na ola einjul blanga God olabat brabli gudbinji wen eni nogudbala pipul tenim miselp brom det nogudbalawei blanga im.”

english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
kriol: Aibin lukinat langa top en aibin luk wanbala einjul hubin werrimon waitwan kout, en imbin werrimon goldinwan belt.

english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
kriol: Wen Serababal en mi na, Niyamaiya bin laibala, ebridei ola Isreil pipul bin oldei gibit ola daga en enijing blanga detlot singamob en blanga detlot blijiman blanga det Serramoni Pleis. En deibin oldei pudum sambala daga en enijing wansaid blanga ola Libaimen, en detlot Libaimen bin oldei pudum sambala daga en enijing wansaid blanga detlot najalot serramonimen, jis laik det lowa bin tok.

english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
kriol: bat detlot pipul garra stil abum blendibala milk blanga dringgim. Ebribodi hu stil jidan langa det kantri garra dringgim milk en dagadagatbat shugabeig.

english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
kriol: Wal ola san en ola grensan blanga Ishmeil bin oldei kemp langa ol detlot kantri brom det deset kantri gulum Shuya sanraisaid brom det kantri gulum Ijip raidap langa det kantri gulum Habila hafwei langa det plein kantri gulum Asiriya, en deibin kadimat miselp brom detlot najalot grensan blanga Eibrahem, en deibin oldei jidan miselp.

english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
kriol: Yumob reken yumob gin bidim det greib en det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei jidanbat, bat im nomo trubala tharran. Ai garra jandim bigismob enami blanga kaman langa yumob jis laik bigiswan fladwoda weya garra gaburrumap yumob.

english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
kriol: Wal wibin tok wi bilib langa det gudnyus, en wi garra kipgon bilib langa det gudnyus, dumaji wi garram brabli haibala boswan serramonimen, en imbin go en jidan deya wansaid langa God. Wal det serramonimen blanga wi im neim Jisas, en im na det San blanga God,

english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
kriol: Wal langa det taim wen Jehoram bin jidan king, detlot Idam pipul bin gibit bekboun langa im. Dei nomo bin wandi bulurrum detlot Juda pipul, en deibin jidan bos blanga olabat ron kantri.

english: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.
kriol: Wal YAWEI garra spredimat yumob jis laik detlot draiwan gras weya det win oldei spredimat olabat langa det deset kantri.

english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
kriol: If yu tridim yu wekinmen hu jidan laiga prisana kainbalawei brom wen imbin yangbala biginini, im garra gibit yu trabul bambai.

english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Pida, yu irrim mi na. Ai sabi yu garra tok thritaim yu nomo sabi mi, en afta det jukjuk garra jingat.”

english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.
kriol: “Wal yu luk iya, lambarra. Hu blanga dijan klos? Ai bina kilim yu garram main bigwan naif. Bat aibin kadimof oni klos blanga yu. Wal yu jinggabat na. Ai kaan fait langa yu. Ai nomo wandi kilim yu. Nomeda ai nomo bin dum enijing langa yu, bat stil yu oldei lukabat mi blanga kilim mi ded.

english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;
kriol: Afta aibin meigim ola pipul fri brom ola nogudbala ting weya deibin lenimbat brom ola najalot kantri. En aibin meiksho ola serramonimen en Libai pipul bin sabi ola wek deibin abum blanga dum.

english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
kriol: Bat mi, mi jidan jis laik det olibtri weya grogrobat langa God haus. Mi trastimbat langa God en im filing blanga laigimbat olagijawan.

english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.
kriol: wal dubala lafta deigim det boi langa miting blanga ola boswan langa det taun weya im jidan, en ola boswan garra kotim im.

english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
kriol: Wi jis tjakam im laibala insaid langa det wel deya langa det bush kantri. Wi nomo ardim im.” Lagijat na Rubin bin tok, dumaji imbin reken bambai im garra gobek en larramgo det boi fri wulijim im garra gobek langa im dedi.

english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
kriol: Oni God na bin meigim ebrijing langa skai, en wok ontop langa det rafwan solwoda.

english: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
kriol: Det Serramoni Pleis weya King Salaman bin bildimap bin 27 mita longwei en 9 mita kroswei.

english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
kriol: Wal ol yumob biginini main, mi raidimbat dijan leda langa yumob, dumaji God bin larramgo yumob fri brom ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin dumbat. En imbin larramgo yumob fri dumaji Jisas Krais bin dai blanga yumob.

english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”
kriol: Ai garra yusum detlot najalot pipul blanga testim detlot Isreil pipul en faindat if dei garra bulurrum mi seimwei laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin dumbat.”
