english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
kriol: Tudei na ai gibit yu det pawa blanga dalim olabat hau ai garra binijap sambala pipul en bitsimap olabat taun en jandimwei sambala pipul langa difrinwan kantri, en bambai ai garra lidimap en album pipul blanga gobek langa olabat ronwan kantri en blanga growimap daga igin en bildimap ebrijing igin langa olabat kantri.”

english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
kriol: Bat Pailat bin wandi larramgo Jisas fri, en imbin tok langa detlot pipul igin.

english: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute Yahweh’s offerings and the most holy things.
kriol: Wal Korei det san blanga Imna, imbin Libaimen en imbin bos blanga maindimbat det Sanrais Geit brom det Serramoni Pleis en imbin det boswan blanga detlot presen ofring weya ola pipul bin oldei gibit langa YAWEI en imbin gibit detlot presen langa detlot serramonimen en detlot Libaimen.

english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’
kriol: Yumob neba jinggabat blanga weshipbat langa mi na, nomeda aibin jandim gudbala rein, en aibin gibit yumob gudwan gadin en sid daga ebriyiya.

english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
kriol: “Yumob garra jidan brabli sheimwan na, dumaji yumob bin oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip andanith langa detlot ouktri langa detlot speshalwan gadin.

english: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.
kriol: Win brom nowathwei, yu gidap na! Win brom sauthwei, yu gidap du! Blo langa dijan gadin, en meigim ola ebrijing langa dijan gadin smel gudwan. Main olmen, yu garra kaman iya langa main gadin, en dagat ola gudwan frut weya yu wandim dagat.

english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
kriol: Wen eni men meigim pramis langa YAWEI det trubala God, maitbi im wandi gibit samting langa YAWEI, o maitbi im wandim stap dumbat samting, wal im kaan breigim det pramis, bat im garra dum ebrijing weya imbin pramis. Im garra dum ebrijing imbin tok im garra dum.

english: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
kriol: en det dei garra jidan brabli nogud, en im garra go brabli dakbala, en im garra meigim ebribodi nogudbinji. “Wal ol detlot grashopa garra kaman langa wi jis laik detmatj solja, en dei garra jadimap det skai jis laik wen im naitaim, en det dakbala garra jadimap detlot bigwan hil. Diskain ting nomo bin hepin lagijat bifo, en im kaan hepin lagijat enimo igin.

english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
kriol: en imbin binijimap ola mani blanga im. “Afta na det kantri nomo bin abum rein, en deibin stat ranat blanga daga, en det lilwan san nomo bin abum enijing na,

english: Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
kriol: “Wal blanga tharran na, YAWEI hubin album Eibrahem wen imbin abum trabul, bin tok langa Jeikob bigininimob, ol detlot Isreil pipul. Imbin tok, ‘Main pipul olabat, yumob kaan nogudbinji en sheim miselp enimo.

english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
kriol: En yumob bigininimob weya neba bin irrim detlot lowa blanga YAWEI, dei garra irrim, wulijim olabat garra len blanga rispek langa im olataim olabat jidan langa det kantri weya yumob garra jidan najasaid langa det Jodan Riba.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
kriol: En if im bina meigim wi garram oni wanbala pat, wal wi nomo bina abum bodi.

english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob jinggabat wen aibin kaman deya langa Korinth basdam blanga dalim yumob blanga God. Ai nomo bin strongbala. Aibin brabli bradin, en aibin sheiksheik nomo lilbit, en ai nomo bin tok brabliwei garram olkain bigwan wed, dumaji ai nomo bin wandi jinggabat enijing. Aibin wandi jinggabat oni blanga Jisas Krais en det kros weya imbin dai.

english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
kriol: Imbin werrimon longwan kout garram blad ebriweya langa im, en deibin gulum im neim “Wed Blanga God.”

english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok,

english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
kriol: Wal blanga tharran na bigis trabul garra kaman langa det pleis. Det seim dei siknis garra kaman langa Bebalon, en bednyus garra kamat langa det taun, en ola daga garra ranat du. Afta na dei garra barnimap det pleis garram faiya. Lagijat na im garra hepin langa Bebalon, dumaji God im panishimbat det pleis na. Oni God na im Boswan, en im brabli strongwan du.” Lagijat na det sambodi bin tok.

english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
kriol: Afta na detlot wekinmen bin meigim naja dubala kaliko, wanbala garram det ship skin weya deibin meigim redwan en det najawan garram skin brom det nenigout. Det ship skin kaliko bin jidan raidoba ontopwei langa det Tent, en det nenigout skin kaliko bin jidan ontop langa det ship skin kaliko.

english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”
kriol: Det king bin dalim Esta, “Detlot Juwish pipul bin binijimap 500 men, en det tenbala san blanga Heiman bin dai du langa dijan taun gulum Susa. Wanim deibin dum langa ola najalot kantri blanga main? Wal wanim yu wandim mi blanga dum na? Ai garra dum wanim yu askim mi.” Lagijat na det king bin tok.

english: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.
kriol: En imbin abum ola men deya redibala garram ola bigwan naif en deibin jandap olaran lida langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga maindimbat det king.

english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
kriol: “Wal yumob jigibala pipul jis laiga sneik, en yumob jidan jis laik det nogudwan tri. Yumob kaan tok gudwei, dumaji yumob nogudwan insaid, en ola wed weya yumob oldei tok, dei kamat brom insaid langa yumob. Ol detlot ting weya yumob jinggabat langa yumob hat, detlot ting na yumob oldei meigim olabat kamat brom yumob mawus.

english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Trubala tharran yumob tok. Bat ai dalim yumob. Nomo eni ston garra jidan ontop gija iya. Dei garra tjakidawei ebriwan.”

english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
kriol: Imbin meigim ola riba blanga olabat jidan blad en kilim ded ola fish.

english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
kriol: En lagijat na yumob garra weit en jandap strongbala, dumaji im gulijap taim blanga Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi garra kambek.

english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin jingat adbala igin, en imbin dai.

english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
kriol: Mi duwit langa ol yu lowa, en mi laigim olabat insaid langa main hat.

english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”
kriol: Heiseiyel bin askim im, “Bos, wotfo yu kraikrai?” En Ilaisha bin tok, “Dumaji ai sabi yu garra dumbat brabli nogudwan ting langa ola Isreil pipul. Yu garra barnimap ola strongwan wol langa detlot taun garram faiya, en yu garra kilimbat detmob brabli strongwan yangboi, en yu garra beldimbat ola biginini raidap olabat dai, en yu garra kadim opin ola wuman hu garra abum beibi.”

english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
kriol: Wal ol detlot boswan serramonimen nomo bin wandi bilib wanim bin hepin langa det men. Deibin reken im nomo bin blainwan, en deibin jingat langa im mami en dedi, en wen dubala bin kaman, deibin askim dubala,

english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.
kriol: Wal Jowab en im men olabat bin gajim det bodi blanga Esahel, en deibin berrim det bodi blanga im langa im femili greibyad deya langa Bethlahem. En afta deibin wok olnait raidap ailibala, en deibin kamat langa det taun gulum Hebran weya deibin oldei jidanbat.

english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
kriol: Im garra gibit yumob brabli gudwan ting, mowa langa ola najalot pipul. Ol yumob garra kipgon abumbat mowa biginini, en ol yumob enimul du garra kipgon abumbat lilwan du.

english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
kriol: “Yumob Isreil pipul, ai garra panishim yumob en binijimap yumob kantri.

english: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God oldei lukinatbat ebribodi wanim olabat oldei dumbat. Im oldei luk detlot gudbala en nogudbala ting weya wi oldei dumbat.

english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
kriol: en aibin luk bigismob tri bin gro langa det dubala beingk blanga det riba.

english: For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
kriol: “Blanga yumob sowa kaan neba gowei, en weya yumob bin oldei ardimbat langa yu boun en bodi im kaan jidan gudwan.

english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu nomo dumbat ola rait ting garra git panish, bat detlot pipul hu nomo wandim enibodi blanga streitinimap olabat garra dai.

english: But now your kingdom will not continue. Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and Yahweh has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which Yahweh commanded you.”
kriol: Bat najing na. Yu kaan jidan king olagijawan, dumaji YAWEI garra faindim men hu garra duwit langa ebrijing weya im wandim im blanga dum, en im garra meigim im jidan king blanga ola pipul, dumaji yu nomo bin duwit langa im.”

english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
kriol: en ai garra dum ebrijing weya yumob askim langa main neim wulijim ai garra shoum ola pipul God im brabli haibala.

english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.
kriol: Wal det king neim Horam brom det taun gulum Gisa bin kaman garram ola solja blanga im blanga album detlot pipul langa Leikish. Bat ola Isreil solja bin bidim olabat du, en det king en ola solja blanga im bin ol dai deya gin garram detlot Leikish pipul.

english: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
kriol: Wal King Eihesaiya bin album King Joram brom Isreil blanga fait langa King Heiseiyel brom Siriya. Ol detlot ami bin fait langa det taun gulum Remoth deya langa det kantri gulum Giliyad, en deya na King Joram bin gulijap gitkil langa det fait.

english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
kriol: Det einjul bin askim im, “Wotfo yubin beldimbat yu dongki lagijat thritaim? Aibin kaman blanga stapam yu, wulijim yu kaan go langa det taun.

english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
kriol: Melabat bin jidan jis laiga prisana, bat yu nomo bin libum melabat langa det pleis weya melabat bin jidan jis laiga prisana. Yubin meigim ola king blanga det kantri gulum Pesha album melabat en deibin larram melabat jidan laibala en wek langa dis Serramoni Pleis blanga yu, weya bin jidan laik rabish, en melabat jidan seif iya langa dijan kantri Juda en dijan taun Jerusalem.

english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
kriol: Bambai na deibin lisin nois bin kamdan brom det skai. Det nois bin jis laiga brabli strongwan win, en det win bin gowin langa det haus weya deibin majurrap.

english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
kriol: Wal loda pipul deya langa det Serramoni Pleis bin bilib langa Jisas, en deibin tok, “Im na det Boswan gulum Masaiya, dumaji nobodi kaan dum klebabala ting seimwei laik im dumbat.”

english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
kriol: Im na bin pudum det skai deya langa top, en im na bin pudumdan dijan graun iya langa dijan emtiwan pleis.

english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
kriol: En deibin tok, “Blanga det brabli haibala gabman bos neim Sisa.” Wal Jisas bin tok, “Wal yumob garra gibitbek langa Sisa detlot enijing blanga im, en yumob garra gibitbek langa God detlot enijing blanga im du.”

english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
kriol: Yumob garra gibit im gudbinjiwei enijing weya det God blanga hebin wandim blanga im Serramoni Pleis, blanga meiksho im kaan gitwail langa mi o langa detlot hu jidan king afta mi.

english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
kriol: Wal im nomo bin raidimdan neim blanga det Libai klen, dumaji YAWEI bin dalim Mosis tharran na.

english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.
kriol: Det teibul blanga ofring im jidan langa flopat, en im garram thribala pat. Det bodampat im 8 mita langa ebri said en im 1 mita apendan. Det midulpat im 7 mita ebri said en im 2 mita apendan en imbin abum najawan lilwan krik garram 0.25 mita wol raidaran langa det atsaidpat blanga det krik. Det top pat im 6 mita ebri said en 2 mita apendan. Tharran bin det pleis weya dei oldei barnimbat detlot sekrifais, en det fobala kona langa det top pat, im luk jis laik det dubala hon blanga det buligi. En langa sanraiswei det teibul blanga ofring garram step.

english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.
kriol: en Obed bin dedi blanga Jesi, en Jesi bin dedi blanga King Deibid. Binij na.

english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
kriol: en aibin luk fobala enimul bin kamat brom midul. Olabat bin luk jis laiga men, bat olabat bin abum fobala feis en fobala wing.

english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
kriol: Ol main enami jidan brabli krulbala. Seibum mi brom olabat. Olabat jis laik detlot wailwan bul en laiyan.

english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
kriol: Wal detlot bos en olabat ofsaida bin go, en deibin dalim detlot Isreil pipul, “Det king bin tok im kaan gibit yumob detlot gras blanga meigimbat brik.

english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.
kriol: Wal wen detlot Benjamin men bin gedimbat detlot gel, ol detlot najalot Isreil pipul bin gobek langa olabat ronwan kantri du, en ebribodi bin jidanbat langa im ronwan kemp.

english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
kriol: Bat yumob gin meigim sambodi brom najawan kantri peiyimbek mowa den yumob bin lendim im, bat nomo langa yumob kantrimen. Yumob garra teiknodis langa dijan lowa. God garra peiyimbek yumob gudbalawei blanga ebrijing yumob dum langa det kantri weya yumob garra teikoba.

english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.
kriol: En ai garra pudum tharran langa main klos en langa main hed weya ebribodi gin luk.

english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
kriol: Det 1,000 yiya im laik wanbala dei langa yu. Olabat jis laik yestadei weya im gon olredi, en jis laik lilbit taim naitaim.

english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
kriol: Afta na wen ola Isreil pipul bin kamat najasaid langa det riba, YAWEI bin dalim Joshuwa,

english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now
kriol: “Brom King Ataseksis, mi raidimdan dijan leda langa Esra det serramonimen hubin len en sabi blanga det lowa brabliwei blanga det God langa hebin.

english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
kriol: If enibodi irrim det saun blanga det longwan wisul en if dei nomo teiknodis, wal dei garra ol gitkil langa det wo. Bat tharran olabat ronwan folt, dumaji if olabat bin irrim det wisul en teiknodis olabat bina ranawei.

english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
kriol: Bat if yumob kaan hendulum miselp, wal yumob lafta merrit, dumaji yumob nomo wandim det filing blanga yumob blanga meigim yumob jinggabat olataim. Im mobeda yumob merrit.

english: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
kriol: Wal langa det taim na ai garra pulumat det peig weya jidan brabli strongbala. Im garra kamat en buldan langa graun en ebrijing weya joinap mijamet garram det peig garra ol binijap.’” Wal lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
kriol: En yumob bin meigim mi brabli gudbinji, dumaji yumob bin shoum ebribodi yumob rispek mi brabliwei. Wal basdam wen aibin jandim Taidas langa yumob, aibin tok brabli gudbinjiwei blanga yumob, en aibin dalim im yumob garra album im. En yumob nomo bin meigim mi sheim, dumaji yumob bin album im gudbalawei. En wen imbin kambek langa mi, aibin luk imbin gudbinji. En imbin meigim mi gudbinji, dumaji yumob bin meigim im gudbinji. Yu si? Aibin oldei tok trubalawei langa yumob, en seimwei det wed weya aibin tok langa Taidas blanga yumob bin trubala.

english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
kriol: Bambai na detlot serramonimen bin askim det men hubin oldei jidan blainwan, “Yubin tok det men bin meigim yu luk gudwei. Wal hu yu reken im?” Wal det men hubin oldei jidan blainwan bin tok, “Im speshalwan mesinja blanga God.”

english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
kriol: Brom deya wen imbin taim blanga gajimbat ola sid daga brom ola wit pedik, Rubin bin go langa det pedik, en imbin faindim sambala bush medisin, en imbin deigimbek det bush medisin langa im mami Liya. Wal Reitjul bin askim Liya blanga gibit im det bush medisin weya det boi bin faindim.

english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
kriol: Wal hau det klebabala jidan? Hu gin sabi ebrijing? Wen yu luk langa klebabala feis, im difrin. Det klebabalawei tjeinjim im en meigim im luk gudwei.

english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
kriol: Yu reken yu gin taiyimap im garram roup langa im leig wulijim im gin jidan fren blanga ola lilgel?

english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
kriol: Yumob sabi? If enibodi garram loda enijing, en im luk im braja o sista nomo garram enijing, en im nomo jinggabat langa im, wal im nomo laigim God brabli.

english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
kriol: Brom deya God bin gibit woning langa detlot klebabalamen langa drim. Imbin tok, “Yumob nomo gobek langa King Herod.” En deibin lisin langa God, en deibin gobek langa olabat ron kantri najawei.

english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
kriol: En if det tjetj nomo jandim enibodi blanga dalimbat det gudnyus, wal hu garra dalimbat det gudnyus langa olabat? Yu si? Langa oltestaman im tok, “Im brabli gudbala ting wen pipul kaman garram det gudnyus.”

english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
kriol: Wal ai sabi yu bilib brabliwei, en blanga tharran na ai dalim yu na. Yu garra jinggabat en meiksho yu yusum det speshalwan pawa weya God bin gibit langa yu. Imbin gibit yu det pawa wen mi en detlot tjetj lidamob bin pudum bingga en prei blanga yu.

english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
kriol: “Wal wen det nogudwan wekinmen bin dum lagijat, det bos blanga im bin tok gudwei langa im, dumaji imbin reken imbin hendulum det mani klebabalawei. En loda pipul iya langa dijan kantri olabat klebabala langa manisaid. Bat loda pipul hu bulurrum God nomo klebabala langa manisaid.”

english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.
kriol: Wal wen im san bin gibitbek det 1,100 silbawan mani langa im mami, im mami bin deigim 200 mani, en imbin gibit det mani langa wanbala men hubin oldei meigimbat ola drimin sheip, en imbin meigim det drimin sheip garram wud, en afta imbin meltimap det silbawan mani, en imbin gaburrumap det sheip garram det silba, en wen imbin gibit det sheip langa det mamiwan, det mamiwan bin pudum det sheip langa im san haus.

english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
kriol: En yumob garra oldei jinggabat brabliwei hau yumob oldei tridimbat detlot pipul hu nomo bilib. Yumob nomo wandi weistimbat taim, dumaji yumob garra tok gudbalawei langa detkain pipul blanga meigim olabat jinggabat Jisas Krais, en yumob garra sabi hau blanga gibit olabat det raitwan ensa wen dei askimbat yumob kwestjan.

english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
kriol: Wal wan men hu jidan klin blanga serramoni garra gajim detlot eshis blanga det gelwan buligi en pudum det eshis atsaid langa det kemp langa det pleis weya im jidan klinwan blanga det serramoni. Deya na olabat garra oldei kipum blanga detlot Isreil pipul blanga yusumbat wen olabat meigimbat redi det woda blanga washimbat enibodi hu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni. Dijan garra deigidawei ola nogudbala ting weya ola pipul oldei dumbat.

english: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
kriol: God bin kipgon tok, “Aibin binijim na. Wal dei gulum mi Olagijawan, dumaji mi det Basdamwan en det Binijimapwan du. If enibodi thestibala, wal ai garra gibit im friwan woda brom det spring weya meigim yu laibliwan.

english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
kriol: Aibin jinginatbat langa yu detmatj mi nokap. Dumaji aibin kraikraibat detmatj imbin jis laiga fladwoda, en main sweig im wetwan na.

english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
kriol: Deibin gibit ebrijing weya deibin wandim blanga det wek, en holot bin 500 kilogrem gol, 2,150 kilogrem silba, en 100 longwan kout blanga ola serramonimen.

english: Everyone went to his own house,
kriol: Wal afta wen det serramoni weya deibin abum gulum Hampi bin binij, ebribodi bin gobek langa olabat ron kemp.

english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
kriol: Deibin go langa det hil kantri raidap langa det pleis gulum Eshkol Beli en deya na deibin lukaran snikinbalawei wotkain det kantri.

english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
kriol: If enibodi askim yunbala wotfo yunbala deigimat det roup brom det dubala dongki, wal yunbala garra dalim im det boswan wandi yusum dubala, en im garra jandimbek dubala bambai.”

english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
kriol: Wal wen im kaman langa yumob, yumob garra welkam im gudbinjiwei, en yumob garra gibit theingks langa Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi,

english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
kriol: Wal yumob dalim mi na. Jisas Krais bin kadimat miselp en meigim miselp blendibala? Nomo! Im oni wanbala. En wotabat mi? Aibin dai langa det kros blanga yumob? Nomo! Ai nomo bin dai blanga yumob. En yumob nomo bin beptais garram main neim du. Yumob bin beptais garram det neim blanga Jisas Krais.

english: Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”
kriol: ‘Dijan men im garra abum panishmen en lujim im bigininimob, en im kaan neba jidan gudwei. Im kaan abum eni biginini hu garra jidan king langa Juda.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.”

english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”
kriol: Bat if yu deigimwei ola ebrijing brom im, wal im garra tok nogudbalawei rait langa yu feis.” Lagijat na det nogudwan einjul bin tok.

english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
kriol: en wen det boswan bin teistim, imbin teistim wain, dumaji Jisas bin meigim det woda meigim miselp wain, en det wain bin brabli gudwan wain du. Wal detlot wekinmen hubin bilimap det woda bin sabi brom weya det wain bin kaman. Bat det boswan blanga det padi nomo bin sabi. Imbin reken det men hu garra merrit bin baiyim det wain, en imbin jingat langa det men,

english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
kriol: Wal detlot bosmen bin lafta dalim Jisas lagijat. Deibin tok, “Melabat nomo sabi hubin gibit Jon Beptis det rait blanga beptaisimbat pipul.”

english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
kriol: En wen wailwan dog o enijing bin kilim ship blanga yu weya aibin maindimbat olabat, ai nomo bin dalim yu en pudum bleim langa det dog. Aibin oldei gajim main ronwan ship en pudumbek blanga deigim pleis blanga det dedwan. Olawei aibin oldei dum lagijat, dumaji yubin dalim mi, if ai lujim enijing blanga yu naitaim o deitaim, wal ai garra peiyimbek yu.

english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.
kriol: Aibin sainim main neim langa det dubala peipa weya shoum aibin baiyim det fam en aibin jadimap wanbala peipa garram bush gam, en aibin pudum main ronwan mak langa det gam, en aibin abum sambala witnis pudum olabat mak deya du en aibin weiyimbat det mani langa skeil blanga peiyim im det rait mani.

english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
kriol: En im jis laik imbin taiyimap ol detlot nogudbala ting weya aibin dumbat langa main nek en aibin go brabli wikwan na, nomo garram eni munda. En main bos bin hendimoba mi langa main strongwan enamimob hubin bidim mi.

english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
kriol: Ai garra larramgo im fri brom ol im nogudbalawei en im garra jidan laibala dumaji imbin dum wanim im rait.

english: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
kriol: En det shainiwan lait blanga YAWEI det trubala God bin go thru det sanrais geit, en imbin go insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis.

english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to Yahweh’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.
kriol: Wen detlot lidamob blanga Juda bin irrim wanim bin hepin langa mi, olabat bin go kwikbala brom det haus blanga det king langa det Serramoni Pleis, en brom deya na olabat bin jidan langa det Nyuwan Geit.

english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
kriol: Olabat kaan jidan wulijim olabat grengrenfathamob hubin jidan brabli nogudbala en nomo garram irriwol. Olabat nomo bin trastim God strongbalawei, en dei nomo bin jidan trubalawei langa im.

english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
kriol: dumaji yumob bin jadimap yumob hat, en yumob nomo garram irriwol, en yumob nomo garram ai du. If yumob nomo bina jidan lagijat, wal yumob bina luk garram yumob ai, en yumob bina irrim garram yumob irriwol, en yumob bina sabi, en afta yumob bina tenim miselp langa God, en im bina meigim yumob gudbala.’ Lagijat na det Holi Spirit bin dalim Aisaiya blanga dalim yumob grengrenfatha olabat, en det wed im blanga yumob du.” Lagijat na Pol bin tok langa olabat,

english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
kriol: Bat det speshalwan haibala serramonimen blanga wi bin abum det speshalwan sekrifais serramoni blanga deigidawei ola nogudbala ting blanga ola pipul olagija, en afta imbin go en jidan langa det raidensaid langa God,

english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
kriol: Brom deya langa main drim aibin luk najawan najakain enimul bin kamat brom insaid langa graun. Imbin abum 2 hon jis laiga nenigout, en imbin tok jis laiga dregan.

english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.
kriol: En im garra pudum im bingga langa det blad en spilim det blad lidawei langa det seikridwan ketin sebentaim.

english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat na. If wi tjakidawei det lowa en trai en meigim miselp jidan raitwei langa God thru Jisas Krais, en afta wi faindim miselp stil dumbat nogudbala ting, wal wanim yumob reken? Jisas Krais bin meigim wi dum det nogudbala ting? Najing. Im nomo meigim wi dum nogudbala ting.

english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”
kriol: En tharran na det ofring blanga peiyimbek weya imbin dumbat ola nogudbala ting langa mi.”

english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
kriol: Dei jis laiga hanggriwan laiyan weya hanting blanga daga. Dei jis laiga strongwan laiyan weya blandim miselp en lukinat mi.

english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
kriol: Wal blanga detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Moweb YAWEI det trubala God bin tok, “Detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Moweb oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en blanga tharran na ai garra panishim olabat. Wen olabat bin barnimap detlot boun blanga det king brom det kantri gulum Idam dei nomo bin shoum rispek langa im.

english: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
kriol: en dubala bin tok, “Nomo! Minbala wandi kaman garram yu langa yu kantrimen olabat.”

english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
kriol: Wal wen Deibid bin jidan king det men Eisaf bin jidan bos blanga ola singamob. Deibin oldei abum boswan blanga ola singamob blanga det Serramoni Pleis, en wi lagijat tudei du.

english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
kriol: Wal mi sabi detlot Juwish pipul garra kambek langa God, dumaji olabat grengrenfatha olabat bin jidan blanga im. Olabat bin jis laik det feswan daga. En wen enibodi gibit det feswan daga jis laiga ofring langa God, holbit detlot najalot daga blanga God du. En detlot grengrenfatha olabat bin jis laik det bodampat blanga tri. En wen enibodi gibit det bodampat blanga det tri jis laiga ofring langa God, holbit det tri blanga God du.

english: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.
kriol: Wal Shafan bin deigim det buk langa King Josaiya en imbin tok, “Yu wekinmenmob bin dumbat ebrijing weya yubin wandim.

english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “YAWEI det boswan God bin shoum mi drim en langa det drim aibin luk God bin meigim bigismob grashopa. Det taim na imbin jis afta ola pipul bin gedimbat ola feswan sid daga weya det king garra abum, en imbin det taim wen ola pipul bin weidabat blanga olabat sid daga blanga gro igin.

english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
kriol: Det einjul bin tjakam im langa det dipwan hol, en deya na imbin lokimap im, en imbin meigim det dowa brabli taitbala garram mad. Imbin lokimap im lagijat weya im kaan trikimbat ola pipul. En det dregan garra jidan deya longtaim, 1,000 yiya, en afta dei garra larramgo im fri lilbit taim.

english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
kriol: Detlot taun blanga yu, olabat jidan deset kantri na, en Jerusalem im jidan moweswan.

english: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
kriol: “Wal mi na YAWEI en mi meigim pramis wulijim det ting kaan hepin.

english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
kriol: Imbin jis laik imbin gaburrumap miselp garram det dakbala klaud, en det reinklaud ful garram woda bin raidaran langa im,

english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
kriol: en Jeikob bin tok langa detlot stakmen hubin jidanbat deya, “Gudei! Brom weya yumob bin kaman?” En deibin tok, “Melabat brom det pleis gulum Heran.”

english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
kriol: Afta na Jeikob bin tok langa Josef, “Mi gulijap dai na. Bat God kaan libum yu. Im garra deigimbek yu raitbek langa det kantri blanga yunmi grenfatha olabat.

english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
kriol: Wal im beibi olabat abum bigismob daga, weya det dedwan enimul jidan.”

english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
kriol: en im garra meigim loda pipul iya langa dijan kantri Isreil kambek langa God. Det san blanga yu garra meigim olabat kambek langa det Boswan blanga olabat,

english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
kriol: Wal yumob garra lisin langa yumob Kristjan braja o sista olabat, dumaji yumob rispek langa Jisas Krais.

english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
kriol: YAWEI bin dalim olabat blanga kilim ded detlot pipul hu nomo bin bilib langa im, bat olabat nomo bin duwit.

english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
kriol: Neksdei na melabat bin kipgon langa det najawan taun gulum Sesariya, en melabat bin jidan deya garram det men neim Filip. Longtaim deibin pikimat det men garram detlot najalot 6 men deya langa det tjetj langa Jerusalem blanga lukaftumbat ola mani, en Filip bin oldei dalimbat det gudnyus blanga Jisas langa enibodi.

english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.
kriol: Yu dalim detlot Isreil pipul blanga gitredi na en meigim miselp fri brom olabat nogudbalawei. Yu garra dalim olabat dijan na. ‘Tumorro, yumob garra abum bif blanga dagat. YAWEI bin irrim yumob bin toktokbat blanga abum sambala bif, en hau yumob bin jidan gudwei langa Ijip. YAWEI garra gibit yumob bif, en yumob garra lafta dagat.

english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
kriol: Ola ritjwan pipul bin tjidimbat pipul en deibin stilimbat olabat ebrijing. Deibin oldei tridimbat ola po pipul nogudbalawei en deibin trikimbat ola pipul brom najawan kantri hu jidan langa olabat, en nomo enibodi bin album ol detlot pipul.

english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
kriol: Wen Jesabel bin irrim det wed, imbin dalim King Eiheb, “Yu sabi Neiboth hu nomo bin gibit yu det greip fam? Imbin dai na. Wal yu gin go en teikoba det greip fam weya im nomo bin wandi gibit yu.”

english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
kriol: Wal det bos blanga det Juwish Miting Pleis bin neim Krispas, en im en im femili olabat bin bilib langa Jisas det Boswan, en loda pipul langa det taun bin bilib langa im du wen deibin irrim det gudnyus, en deibin ol beptais.

english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
kriol: Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI garram sekrifais ofring, en garram ola hepiwan song blanga dalimbat pipul blanga ebrijing imbin dumbat.

english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.
kriol: “Yumob nomo fogedabat weya yumob bin meigim YAWEI gitwail langa yumob langa det deset kantri. Yumob nomo bin teiknodis en duwit langa YAWEI brom det taim wen yumob bin libum Ijip raidap yumob bin kamat iya.

english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
kriol: Yu nomo bin bringimap melabat langa dijan gudwan kantri, o gibit melabat det kantri blanga growimap greip o sid daga fam, najing. Yu nomo trai trikimbat melabat. Minbala kaan kaman!” Lagijat na det dubala bin tok.

english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
kriol: “Brom deya wanbala serif bin flai langa mi garram det hotwan tjakol langa im bingga, weya imbin gajim brom det teibul blanga ofring garram det silbawan ting.

english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
kriol: en dei nomo sheim blanga dum enijing du. Dei dum ebrijing wanim olabat ron bodi wandim, en dei oldei dumbat olkain nogudbala ting garram olabat bodi, en dei oldei gridi blanga kipgon dumbat detkain nogudbala ting.

english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
kriol: “Wal yu nomo fogedabat wanim mi oldei dalimbat yu du.

english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
kriol: Wen det san gidap olabat gobek en leidan langa olabat kemp.

english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
kriol: “Bat if olabat nomo teiknodis en bulurrum ol detlot lowa blanga main,

english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
kriol: Yumob garra barnim detlot wudwan en stonwan drimin sheip. Nomo wandimbat detlot silba en gol weya im jidan langa detlot drimin sheip, en nomo deigim blanga yumob ronselp. If yumob dum lagijat tharran garra meigim bigwan trabul kaman langa yumob, dumaji YAWEI nomo laigim lagijat, det wei na weya pipul weshipbat olkainaba ting.

english: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
kriol: En bambai afta yu, det najawan king garra jidan, bat im kaan jidan haibala laik yu. Bambai na det namba 3 king garra jidan jis laik det kopawan binjipat. Im garra jidan bos langa ola kantri.

english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
kriol: Det brabli haibala God na bin album yu blanga bidim detlot enami blanga yu. En ola pipul garra gudbinji en sei theingkyu langa im.” Wal Eibram bin gibit Melkisadek haf enijing weya imbin pulumat brom detlot enami wen imbin bidim olabat. Imbin gibit im wanbala ting blanga ebri tenbala ting imbin deigim brom detlot enami.

english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
kriol: Bat mi trastimbat yu dumaji yu laigim mi olagijawan. Ai garra jidan gudbinji igin, dumaji yu garra seibum mi.

english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
kriol: King Josaiya bin bringimap langa Jerusalem ola serramoni men brom ola taun langa Juda hubin oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip. Imbin bitsimap detlot teibul blanga ofring langa ol det kantri weya deibin oldei gibit ola nogudwan sekrifais ofring wulijim dei kaan weshipbat deya enimo. King Josaiya bin bitsimap detlot teibul blanga ofring weya deibin oldei gibit sekrifais langa det dibuldibulwan nenigout. Detlot teibul blanga ofring bin gulijap langa det geit weya Joshuwa det boswan gabmanmen bin bildimap lefthensaid brom det meinwan geit.

english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
kriol: Yumob garra brabli gudbinji, en yumob garra meigim mi gudbinji du.

english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,
kriol: Wal wen aibin stil lukinatbat, det hon bin stat faitfaitbat langa detlot pipul blanga God na, en imbin bidimbat olabat.

english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
kriol: Wal yu jinggabat ola solja weya dei go blanga fait. Dei nomo jinggabat enijing. Oni blanga fait gudwei blanga meigim olabat bos gudbinji. Yu sabi? Yu jidan jis laiga solja weya yu wek blanga Jisas Krais, en yu garra kipgon dumbat det wek en nomo gibap wen yu abum trabul.

english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
kriol: Bat det dubala kantri gulum Geshuwa en Eram bin fait en bidim 60 taun deya, en deibin gajim detlot lilwan taun brom Jaiyiya en brom Kenath en detlot lilwan taun gulijap. Ol detlot pipul hubin jidan deya langa Giliyad bin femili lain blanga Mekiya.

english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
kriol: Brom deya ai garra go langa yu teibul blanga ofring, God. Yu na meigim mi brabli gudbinji. Ai garra plei main gita en sing song blanga preisim yu, main God.

english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
kriol: En aibin bradin langa yu, en aibin go, en aibin blandim det mani blanga yu langa graun. En iya luk! Aibin bringimbek det mani weya aibin blandim blanga yu.’

english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
kriol: Im det trubalawan bos oba langa ola kantri. Im jadjim pipul langa ola kantri en gibit olabat feyago.

english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
kriol: Bambai na Pol bin dalim Banabas, “Yunmi garra gobek langa ol detlot taun weya yunmi bin dalimbat det gudnyus blanga det Boswan, dumaji yunmi garra go en luk en faindat hau yunmi braja olabat.”

english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for Yahweh is with you.”
kriol: Wal Neithan bin dalim King Deibid, “Wal gowan. Yu dum wanim yu jinggabat blanga dum, dumaji YAWEI im oldei jidan garram yu.”

english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
kriol: Wal main gudfren olabat, yumob sabi olredi ol dislot ting weya mi dalimbat yumob. Bat ai dalim yumob. Yumob garra oldei wotjimbat miselp, dumaji yumob nomo wandim detlot laiyawan wed blanga detlot nogudbala pipul blanga deigidawei yumob en meigim yumob gowei brom det trubalawei weya yumob bulurrum.

english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
kriol: Wal ebrijing weya det lowa tok, wi sabi im tok langa detlot pipul hu bulurrum det lowa, en det lowa im deya blanga meigim detlot pipul sabi weya dei rong en dei kaan tok enijing,

english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
kriol: Wal ai garra pikimat wanbala men en det men wokinstik na garra abum lif. Lagijat na ai garra stapam detlot Isreil pipul brom grambulbat langa yu.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
kriol: “Wal God bin meigim im san gidap laibala, en im kaan dai igin, dumaji God bin tok langa oltestaman lagijat. ‘Ai garra gibit langa yu ol detlot speshalwan ting weya aibin pramis langa King Deibid.’ Wal God kaan gibit detlot ting langa dedbala. Im garra gibit langa laibala.

english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.” He said to her, “Behold, I haven’t told my father or my mother, so why should I tell you?”
kriol: Wal det gel bin go langa im hasbin, en imbin kraikrai langa im, en imbin tok, “Yu nomo laigim mi. Yu heidim mi, dumaji yubin dalim det stori langa main fren olabat. Bat yu nomo bin dalim mi wanim det stori min.” Wal Semsan bin tok, “Nomo. Ai nomo bin dalim main dedi en mami du. Wal wotfo ai garra dalim yu?”

english: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
kriol: Oni YAWEI na garra meigim yu jidan sabibala, en album yu blanga sabi mowa.

english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
kriol: Imbin tok, “Nomo ardim ol main pipul weya aibin pikimat. Nomo tatjim ol main mesinjamob.”

english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Ebridei det lait im shain oldei, indit? En enibodi hu wokabat deitaim kaan buldan, dumaji im luk det lait.

english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin askim detlot serramonimen en lowamen na, “Wal wen det boswan blanga det fam garra kaman, wanim yumob reken im garra dum langa detlot fama?”

english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
kriol: Wal ol detlot taun bin abum brabli strongwan haibala wol en deibin jadimap det wol garram geit garram ola strongwan ba langa olabat. En deibin abum sambala lilwan taun weya nomo bin abum wol.

english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
kriol: En aibin luk nomo eni pipul bin jidan deya, en nomo eni bard bin deya du, najing.

english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
kriol: en imbin deigim im waif neim Serai, en imbin deigim Lot det san blanga im dedbala braja du, en imbin gajim ola enijing blanga im, en imbin gajim ola wekinmen en wekingel hubin jidan laiga prisana blanga im, en garram ol detlot na Eibram bin go langa det kantri gulum Keinan.

english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.
kriol: en nomo pudumbat eni mak langa yu ron bodi, en nomo kadimbat miselp garram naif. Wal mi na YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob.

english: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
kriol: “Bat YAWEI im weidabat blanga yumob blanga kambek langa im, dumaji im laigim yumob detmatj, en im brabli kainbalawan du en im fil sori blanga yumob. YAWEI na oldei dum ebrijing gudwei, en if yumob trastim im, wal yumob garra jidan brabli gudbinji.”

english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.
kriol: Wen detlot men brom Shekam, Shailo en Sameriya bin gowin langa det taun Ishmeil en im menmob bin kilim ded olabat en tjakam olabat bodi langa det bigwan wel.

english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.
kriol: en yumob garra jidan redi blanga fait, dumaji mi en ola najalot solja garra go raidap langa det taun en shoum miselp langa olabat, en wen detlot solja kamat blanga fait langa melabat, wal melabat garra ranawei jis laik wibin dum basdam,

english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
kriol: en yumob kaan gibit miselp langa olkain nogudbala ting. Nomo. Yumob garra gibit miselp langa God, dumaji imbin meigim yumob gidap laibala brom dedbala. Yumob garra gibit miselp bodi holbit langa im blanga dumbat ola gudbala ting.

english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
kriol: Olabat garra tok blanga hau yu jidan haibalawan bos, en dalimbat blanga yu strongwan pawa,

english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa mi,

english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
kriol: dumaji ola nogudbala pipul kaan silip raidap olabat dum det nogudbala ting en ardim sambodi.

english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
kriol: en deibin neilimap im langa det kros, en afta wen deibin dum ebrijing langa im weya det oltestaman bin tok dei garra dum, deibin deigimat im bodi brom det kros, en deibin pudum im langa det keib.

english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
kriol: Wal dijan na det wed brom God blanga ola pipul deya langa det taun gulum Ninaba. God bin gibit dijan wed langa det speshalwan mesinja blanga im neim Neiham brom det taun gulum Elkosh, en God bin gibit im dijan wed langa im drim.

english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
kriol: Neksdei ebribodi brom det komyuniti bin stat grambulbat langa Mosis en Eran, en deibin tok, “Yunbala bin kilim sambala pipul blanga YAWEI.”

english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
kriol: Wal Ilaihu bin kipgon tok, “God oldei wotjimbat ebrijing wi oldei dumbat.

english: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.
kriol: En King Hesakaiya bin abum loda wekinmen bildimbek ola wol weya bin buldan langa det taun. En deibin bildimap strongwan haus langa det wol blanga lukinatbat, en deibin bildimap atsaid wol blanga maindim det insaid wol. En deya langa sanraiswei langa Jerusalem deibin meigim strongwan det pleis weya deibin pudum bigiswan graun blanga bildimap det len. Imbin gibit oda blanga meigim blendibala shild en spiya du.

english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok langa det gel na, “Yu fri brom ol detlot nogudbalawei blanga yu.”

english: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
kriol: Dumaji im nomo bin dum wanim YAWEI bin tok, en imbin meigimap im ronwan main nomo blanga kipum det lowa blanga YAWEI. Wal im bos blanga im ronwan deth.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
kriol: Bat minbala nomo sabi wotfo im luk gudwei tudei. En minbala nomo sabi hubin meigim im gudwan. Yumob garra askim im miselp, dumaji im big men na, en im gin tok blanga im ronselp.”

english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Yahweh’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Yahweh’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
kriol: Yu nomo bin irrim det stori wen Jesabel bin kilimbat ola speshalwan mesinja blanga YAWEI? Wal aibin haidim 100 mesinja deya langa detlot keib, 50 langa wanbala en naja 50 langa najawan keib en aibin oldei gibit olabat woda blanga dringgim en daga blanga dagat.

english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
kriol: En blanga tharran na olabat jandap deya lida langa det speshalwan tjeya blanga God, en dei oldei wek blanga God langa im serramoni pleis. Deitaim en naitaim dei oldei wek blanga im. En det sambodi weya im jidan langa det speshalwan tjeya garra maindimbat olabat brabliwei, dumaji olabat jidan langa im haus na.

english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
kriol: en mi brabli gudbinji langa im, dumaji im na bin seibum mi.

english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
kriol: “Wal ol yumob Isreil pipul, longtaim wen aibin deigim yumob grengrenfatha olabat thru langa det deset kantri blanga 40 yiya, ai nomo bin wandim olabat blanga barnimbat enimul blanga sekrifais ofring langa mi, en ai nomo bin wandim olabat blanga bringimap daga blanga ofring langa mi, blanga shoum mi olabat bulurrum mi trubalawei.

english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
kriol: Wal yu meigim pramis garram mi tudei, en God garra jidan witnis blanga yunmi. Yu pramisim mi nomo blanga trikim mi en main biginini olabat, dumaji aibin gud langa yu weya yubin jidan streinja langa main kantri, en yu garra tridim mi en main kantrimen olabat gudbalawei du.”

english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
kriol: “Wal det Holi Spirit weya oldei dalim yumob det trubala wed garra kaman brom main Dedi blanga album yumob, dumaji ai garra jandim im langa yumob brom main Dedi, en im garra dalim yumob blanga mi.

english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
kriol: en langa Keriyoth en Bosra. Det panishmen bin olredi kaman langa dislot taun langa Moweb, nomeda olabat bin longwei o gulijap.

english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
kriol: En wen Isau bin faindat im dedi bin tok lagijat langa im braja, wal imbin sabi na im dedi nomo bin laigim ola gel brom Keinan,

english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
kriol: Mosis bin hatjamp wen imbin luk det faiya, en imbin go gulijap langa det bushis blanga luk gudwei, en deya na God bin tok langa im.

english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
kriol: Maindimbat mi brom detlot nogudbala pipul hu wandi trepam mi garram ola nogud ting.

english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
kriol: Yu garra meigim det Libai klen jidan bos blanga lukaftumbat detlot ebrijing insaid langa det Seikridwan Tent, en dei garra garrimapbat det Seikridwan Tent garram detlot ebrijing na. En dei garra oldei pudumap olabat ronwan kemp raidaran det Seikridwan Tent.

english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
kriol: en thritaim detlot Roman pipul bin beldim mi garram wadi, en wantaim sambala pipul bin stonim mi, en thritaim bout bin draun garram mi, en wantaim aibin langa solwoda brom ailibala raidap neksdei.

english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.
kriol: Detlot sekrifais en detlot gudsmelwan medisin im brabli nogudwan weya yumob oldei gibitbat langa mi. Ai nomo laigim detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob oldei dumbat wen yumob abumbat serramoni gulum Nyumanth, o langa det namba 7 dei gulum Sebathdei, o langa det najalot taim wen yumob weshipbat. Detlot brabli nogudwan, dumaji yumob oldei dumbat brabli nogudbala ting.

english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
kriol: Wal wen King Eiheb bin go en dagat daga, seimtaim du Ilaija bin go en galimap ontop langa det hil gulum Kamul en deya na imbin nildan feisdan langa graun en imbin prei langa YAWEI.

english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
kriol: Bambai na Josef bin dalim det hedmen blanga im, “Yu bilimap daga langa ola beig raitful blanga detlot men, en yu pudumbek ola mani blanga olabat insaid langa detlot beig igin.

english: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to Yahweh.
kriol: Dumaji loda pipul nomo bin jidan klinbala blanga det serramoni, wal dei nomo bin lau kilim detlot lilwan boiwan ship blanga det Pasoba Serramoni. Wal detlot Libaimen bin lafta kilim detlot lilwan boiwan ship blanga olabat en deibin gibit langa YAWEI.

english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?
kriol: “Wotfo yunbala nomo bin dagat det ofring blanga nogudbalawei langa det seikridwan pleis gulijap langa det dowawei langa det Seikridwan Tent? Im brabli holiwan, en YAWEI bin gibit langa yunbala blanga deigidawei det nogudbalawei brom ola pipul.

english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
kriol: Ol yumob pipul blanga YAWEI, yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei en seifwan,

english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
kriol: Detlot enami garra kaman brom solwodasaid brom Saipras. Olabat garra bidim Asiriya en Iba, bat bambai detmob brom Saipras garra binijap olagijawan.” Lagijat na Beilam bin tok.

english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”
kriol: Yunbala garra jinggabat brabliwei blanga luk dijan kantri igin, bat yunbala kaan neba kambek iya igin.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
kriol: Yu kaan tridim eni widogel nogudbalawei, en yu kaan tridim eni biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi nogudbalawei du.

english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
kriol: En if eni gel nomo werrimon het wen im toktok langa God o gibit wed brom God langa sebis, wal im rabishim im hasbin hu jidan det bos blanga im, en im jis laik imbin kadimof im heya blanga meigim im hasbin sheim.

english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
kriol: Wal langa det feswan yiya wen Belshesa bin jidan king langa Bebalon, wal mi na Denyul, aibin abum drim naitaim. Aibin raidimdan det drim langa peipa, en dijan na det drim. Aibin luk fobala bigbala win bin bloblobat brom ebriweya, en det win bin sterrimap det bigiswan solwoda.

english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
kriol: en det sebenbala draiwan yiya bin stat. Imbin hepin seimwei laik Josef bin tok im garra hepin, en ebri kantri bin jidan brabli draiwan na. Ola kantri bin jidan brabli nogud. Bat langa det kantri gulum Ijip deibin abum blendibala daga langa ola stowahaus.

english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
kriol: Wal detlot Isreil pipul brom det taun gulum Jeibesh deya langa det kantri gulum Giliyad bin irrim wanim detlot Filastain pipul bin dum langa det bodi blanga King Sol,

english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
kriol: En im lagijat du blanga wi. Wen wibin jidan laiga lilwan beibi weya wi nomo bin sabi enijing, ola difrinkain spirit blanga dijan wel bin jidan bos langa wi.

english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
kriol: en detlot einjul garra majurrumap ola pipul brom ebri kantri langa mi, en ai garra kadimat olabat langa dubala mob jis laik det stakmen kadimat ola ship brom ola nenigout.

english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
kriol: En yumob nomo wandi gowei brom God, dumaji im laigim yumob brabliwei. Yumob garra kipgon bulurrumbat Jisas Krais det Bos blanga yumob, dumaji im gudbinji blanga yumob, en im garra meigim yumob jidan garram im olagija.

english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
kriol: Im nomo gud blanga meigim pramis blanga peiyimbek sambodi wanim yu fren bin boro.

english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
kriol: If eni gel trai silipsilipbat garram enimul wal im en det enimul garra lafta dai mijamet du, dumaji im ronwan folt im lafta dai. Imbin dum nogudbala ting.

english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
kriol: Oldei en ol nait mi krai, en detlot tiyas dei jis laik main daga na. En olataim main enamimob askimbat mi, “Weya yu God?”

english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
kriol: Enibodi hu nomo gitwail kwikbala langa sambodi, wal im jidan sabibala, bat det sambodi hu gitwail streidawei wen enibodi tok langa im, wal im garram siliwan main.

english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
kriol: en wen imbin jidanbat deya, imbin irrim Pol toktok, en wen Pol bin luk langa im brabliwei, Pol bin sabi im garra meigim im wok, dumaji det leimbala men bin bilib langa det wed,

english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
kriol: Lagijat, dumaji deibin bradin wen deibin irrim det wed weya imbin tok, “Nobodi kaan tatjim dijan hil, en dijan lowa im jidan blanga ola enimul du. Yumob garra stonim olabat ded if dei pudumbut dijan hil.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”
kriol: Brom deya King Sol bin dalim ola boswan wekinmen blanga im, “Wen yumob luk Deibid miselp, yumob garra tok langa im, en yumob garra dalim im mi gudbinji langa im, en yumob garra dalim im ola boswan wekinmen main laigim im du, en yumob garra dalim im blanga merrit langa main doda.”

english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
kriol: Bat ol detlot najalot pat blanga wi bodi weya enibodi luk, wi nomo oldei wori blanga olabat. Yu si? God bin joinimap ola difrinwan pat langa wi bodi,

english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
kriol: Wal Eibram bin gowei brom det kantri gulum Ijip garram im waif Serai en garram Lot en garram ola enijing weya imbin abum.

english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
kriol: Wal Geshan bin abum dubala san neim Leidan en Shimiyai.

english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
kriol: Bambai na detlot wekinmen bin go langa Mosis, en deibin dalim im,

english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
kriol: “Wal nomeda im sista Oholiba bin luk wanim bin hepin langa Ohola, bat stil Oholiba bin dum mowa nogudbala ting langa im sista en imbin laigim silipsilipbat garram bigismob men du.

english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”
kriol: Wal yumob garra meigim im jidan king na, dumaji YAWEI bin tok Deibid im wekinmen blanga im, en im garra yusum King Deibid blanga seibum ola Isreil pipul brom detlot Filastain pipul en brom ola najalot enami blanga yumob.” Lagijat na Ebna bin tok langa detlot lidamob, en deibin ol agri langa im.

english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
kriol: Wal iya na det stori blanga Tera. Imbin abum thribala san neim Eibram, Neihowa en Heran.

english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
kriol: Nomeda ai nomo bin gudbala laik ola najalot Kristjan pipul, bat stil God bin pikimat mi, en imbin gibit mi dijan wek blanga dalimbat ola Jintail pipul det gudnyus blanga Jisas Krais en ola gudbala ting weya wi nomo sabi. Wi sabi lilbit. Bat wi kaan sabi ol detlot ting brabliwei.

english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
kriol: If yu selim yu doda langa enibodi blanga meigim im wekingel blanga det sambodi, wal det bos blanga im kaan larramgo im fri seimwei laik im larramgo ola wekinmen.

english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
kriol: God bin oldei album yumob, en im oldei holdim yumob garram im bingga. Imbin oldei andimwei ola enami brom yumob, en imbin oldei dalim yumob blanga binijimap ola enami blanga yumob.

english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
kriol: Imbin jandim mi blanga dalim olabat det taim bin kaman wen YAWEI det trubala God garra seibum im pipul olabat, en im garra panishim olabat enamimob. Imbin jandim mi blanga kain langa detlot pipul hu oldei kraikraibat en jidan soribalawei langa Jerusalem.

english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
kriol: Yubin lisin langa mi weya aibin dalim yu blanga kipgon bulurrum mi, en yu nomo bin slekap. Wal bambai wen ola trabul garra kaman langa dijan kantri blanga testimbat ola pipul, mi na garra lukaftumbat yu.

english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat na. Wen yumob dum enikain nogudbala ting, yumob nomo dum det nogudbala ting langa yumob ronselp. Yumob dum det nogudbala ting langa enibodi. Bat wen yumob dum detkain nogudbala ting weya pipul oldei silipsilip gija, yumob dum det nogudbala ting langa enibodi en langa yumob ronwan bodi du.

english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
kriol: Bambai wen detlot Juwish pipul langa Thesalonaika bin faindat Pol bin dalimbat det wed blanga God langa ola pipul langa Beriya, deibin go deya, en deibin stat sterrimap ola pipul blanga meigim trabul.

english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
kriol: Wal wen King Reiyabowam bin kamat deya langa Jerusalem, imbin jingat en majurrumap 180,000 brabli gudwan solja brom Benjamin en Juda klen. Imbin wandi jidan bos igin blanga detlot pipul brom det nowathsaid kantri langa Isreil en imbin wandi meigim plen blanga go en fait langa olabat.

english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
kriol: Wal Sera bin tok igin, “Ola pipul bin reken ai kaan abum beibi blanga Eibrahem. Bat nomeda imbin olmen, bat stil aibin abum san blanga im.”

english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
kriol: Langa det taim wen im wo taim en wen olabat nomo garram eni daga, God garra kipgon maindimbat yu.

english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
kriol: Wen det waifwan kaan abum biginini, wal YAWEI larram im blanga abum biginini, en det gel jidan brabli gudbinji. Preisim YAWEI det trubalawan God.

english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
kriol: en ol detlot bout weya oldei go langa solwoda garra binij du.

english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”
kriol: “Yu sabi wanim dislot pipul toktokbat? Dei tok aibin gibit bekboun langa ola Isreil en Juda pipul, det dubala femili weya aibin pikimat. En olabat mokimbat main pipul en dei reken olabat nomo wanbala pipul enimo.

english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
kriol: Wal Ruth bin tok, “Yu nomo dalim mi blanga libum yu. Yu garra larram mi go garram yu. Wujei yu go, ai garra kaman garram yu, en eniweya yu garra jidan, ai garra jidan garram yu du. En blanga yu kantrimen, dei garra jidan main kantrimen du. En blanga yu God, im garra jidan main God du.

english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
kriol: Wal det taim na ola Isreil pipul nomo bin abum eni king blanga jidan bos blanga olabat, en ebribodi bin oldei dumbat enijing weya imbin wandi dumbat. Binij na.

english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
kriol: YAWEI nomo garram eni rong langa im, en im laigim ola gud ting weya pipul dum. Detlot hu dum lagijat na garra luk im.

english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
kriol: Wen wibin bon langa dijan wel, wibin abum najing, en wi garra libum dijan wel seimwei. Nomeda wi wek adbala langa dijan wel bat wen wi dai wi kaan deigim enijing garram wi.

english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.
kriol: Afta na detlot boutmen bin taiyimap roup raidaran langa det bigwan bout, dumaji deibin reken det bout garra breikhaf, en deibin pudumdan det seil du, dumaji deibin bradin det bout mait hitim senbeingk wansaid langa det kous said deya langa det kantri gulum Libiya, en deibin larram det win deigidaweibat det bout.

english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin kipgon tok na, “Bethlahem Efratha, nomeda yu det lilwan taun langa ola najalot taun deya langa Juda, bat stil brom yu na ai garra meigim kamat det boswan main jis laiga gel weya im abum beibi, en det beibi weya yu garra abum bin jidan laibala basdam bifo enijing bin jidan, en im garra jidan king blanga ola Isreil pipul.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
kriol: Ai beptaisim yumob garram woda. Bat im garra beptaisim yumob garram det Holi Spirit.” Lagijat na Jon bin tok.

english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
kriol: YAWEI bin stat tok blanga Ijip basdam. Dijan na wanim imbin tok blanga detlot ami blanga King Neiko brom Ijip. King Nebakanesa brom Bebalon bin bidim olabat langa Kakamish gulijap langa det Yufreitis Riba langa det namba 4 yiya wen Jehoiyakim bin jidan king langa Juda.

english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
kriol: Wal Pol en Banabas bin tok mowa strongbalawei langa detlot Juwish pipul. Imbin tok, “Minbala bin lafta dalim det wed blanga God langa yumob basdam. Bat yumob bin tjakidawei det wed. Yumob reken yumob gudbala, en yumob nomo wandim det olagijawan laif weya God bin wandi gibit langa yumob.

english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
