kriol: Im mobeda if yu weidabat en nomo askim blanga enijing den blanga jidan garram pawa. Im mobeda if yu jidan bos blanga yu ron laif den yu teikoba ola taun.

english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
kriol: en wi jidan rili bouniwan en lujim wi bodi.

english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
kriol: Ai dalim yumob. Ai kaan dringgim dijan wain garram yumob enimo. Bat wen main Dedi jandimbek mi, en ai jidan boswan brabliwei, det taim na ai garra dringgim det wain nyubalawei.”

english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
kriol: Wal Lot en im femili olabat bin wokwok wen imbin stil dakbala, en wen imbin ailibala na, deibin kamat langa det lilwan taun,

english: For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
kriol: Mi na, YAWEI tok langa olabat, ‘Yumob garra shoum rispek langa det Sebathdei, en teiknodis en duwit langa mi brabliwei, en kipum det strongbala pramis weya wibin agri gija, wulijim ai garra pudum yumob neim langa main Serramoni Pleis. Dijan na mobedawan den abumbat biginini, en yumob neim garra jidan deya olagija.’

english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
kriol: Det king brom Siriya bin dalim im 32 boswan solja garram olabat bagi blanga fait oni langa det king brom Isreil.

english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
kriol: Bat if yu nomo wandim tok, wal yu jidan kwaitbala en lisin langa mi en ai garra titjimbat yu wulijim yu garra sabi det wei blanga God.”

english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
kriol: en blanga tharran na ola gel garra oldei lisin langa olabat hasbin jis laik ola bilibamob lisin langa Jisas Krais.

english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin tok langa detlot lowamen en serramonimen, “If yumob san o maitbi det buligi blanga yumob buldan insaid langa dipwan wodahol wen im Sebathdei, wal yumob garra go en pulumat im streidawei, indit?”

english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
kriol: Im gin jidan langa eni taun im wandim, en yu kaan tridim im nogudbalawei.

english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
kriol: Bat ola soljamob blanga Bebalon bin tjeisimap olabat raidap langa det plein kantri gulijap langa Jeriko, en deibin grebum King Sedakaiya, bat ol im soljamob bin ranawei.

english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
kriol: en deibin jandim dubala garram leda. Det leda bin tok, “Melabat speshalwan mishanri en tjetj lidamob jandim dijan leda langa ol yumob Jintail braja blanga melabat deya langa det taun gulum Entiyak en langa det dubala kantri gulum Siriya en Salisha.

english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
kriol: Wal detlot kaunsala bin askim im na, “Yu reken yu San blanga God, indit?” En Jisas bin tok, “Wal yumob reken mi San blanga God.”

english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
kriol: en dei garra tok, ‘Melabat nomo bin kilim det sambodi, en melabat nomo sabi hubin dum tharran.

english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
kriol: Olabat holot bin sheibum olabat hed, en ola men bin kadimbat olabat wiska. Olabat bin kadim miselp bingga en ebribodi werrimonbat sekbeigwan klos blanga shoum olabat bin brabli nogudbinji.

english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
kriol: Langa det dei na main pipul olabat kaan sheim langa detlot pipul hubin gibit bekboun langa mi en dumbat ola nogudbala ting. Nomo. Detlot pipul hu dum lagijat kaan jidan deya langa Jerusalem, dei kaan jidan deya langa main seikridwan hil. Ai garra deigidawei detlot praudbala pipul, ol detlot hu tok praudbalawei.

english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
kriol: Wal nomo silipsilipbat garram yu grendoda. Wal tharran im brabli sheim blanga yu if yu dumbat lagijat.

english: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
kriol: Brom det taim wen King Amasaiya bin gibit bekboun langa YAWEI ola enamimob blanga im bin meigim sigridwan plen blanga kilim im. Wal King Amasai bin ranawei langa det taun gulum Leikish, bat im enamimob bin bulurrum im raidap deya en deibin kilim im ded.

english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu nomo sabi God jidan silibala. Dei nomo sabi enijing. Olabat meigimbat drimin sheip, bat olabat garra jidan sheimwan, dumaji detlot drimin sheip nomo laibala, Olabat jidan laiyawan.

english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
kriol: en yubin bildimap yu kemp ontopwei langa ola woda. Ola klaud jidan jis laiga hos en bagi blanga yu, en det win deigimbat yu weya yu wandi go.

english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”
kriol: Aibin irrim sambodi bin jingat brom najasaid langa det riba gulum Yulai. Imbin jingat, “Geibriyal, yu dalim dijan men wanim det drim min.”

english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
kriol: Wal Pailat bin tok, “Wanim rong ting imbin dum?” Bat nobodi bin ensim im. Deibin ol stat jinginatbat adbala, “Kilim im! Neilimap im langa kros en larram im dai deya!”

english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
kriol: “Isikiyel, dislot men bin stat weshipbat detlot drimin sheip en dei sabi det ting garra kipgon lidimbat olabat langa det nogudbalawei. Dei reken ai garra ensim langa olabat, bat najing.

english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
kriol: En yumob garra teiknodis en duwit langa im en kipum detlot lowa weya aibin gibit yumob tudei.

english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
kriol: Ai garra dai en ai kaan neba kambek. Ai garra gowei wulijim det klaud wen det win oldei blowimwei.

english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
kriol: Bat det lilboi bin pulumbek im bingga insaid igin, en det braja blanga im bin kamat feswan. “Gardi!” Det wekingel bin tok, “Lagijat na yubin meigim miselp kamat! Wal blanga tharran na dei garra gulum yu neim Peres.”

english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
kriol: Wal main fren olabat deya langa Korinth, aibin tok streidat langa yumob brom main hat.

english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok, “Orait, det Pasoba Serramoni blanga YAWEI, yumob garra abum langa det namba 14 dei langa det feswan manth ebriyiya.

english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
kriol: Im enami olabat kaan neba win en jidan bos langa im. Ola brabli nogudwan pipul kaan bidim im.

english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Yumob Isreil pipul, yumob nomo garram eni rait blanga gitwail langa mi! Aibin meigim yumob! Yumob jis laik det kleiwan pot weya det men oldei meigimbat. Det kleiwan pot nomo askim im, ‘Wotfo yubin meigim mi lagijat? Hau dei garra holdim mi? Yu nomo bin meigim eni hendul.’

english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.
kriol: en deibin go langa det taun gulum Edramitiyam, en deya na deibin faindim wan bout redi blanga go langa ola taun wansaid langa solwoda deya langa det kantri gulum Eisha. Wal Pol bin gowin langa det bout garram wan men neim Aristakas. Det men bin brom det taun gulum Thesalonaika deya langa det kantri gulum Mesadoniya. En mi na, Luk, aibin gowin langa det bout garram Pol du.

english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
kriol: Wal Josaiya bin 8 yiya ol wen imbin jidan det nyuwan king blanga Juda, en imbin jidan king langa Jerusalem fo 31 yiya.

english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
kriol: Wal Damitriyas bin jingat langa im wekinmen olabat en langa ola najalot men hubin oldei meigimbat enijing garram silba, en imbin dalim olabat, “Yumob sabi wi oldei meigimap loda mani weya wi meigimbat diskain silbawan ting.

english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
kriol: Yu si? Det leda bin meigim yumob nogudbinji. Bat God bin yusum det leda blanga tjeinjim yumob, en imbin meigim yumob jinggabat, en imbin meigim yumob wandi jidan nomo garram enijing rong. Yumob sabi? Det leda bin meigim yumob abum det gudwan filing blanga mi, en yumob wandi luk mi na. Bat yumob nomo wandim mi blanga kaman langa yumob nogudbinjiwei. En det leda bin meigim yumob jinggabat det men hubin dum det nogudbala ting weya bin meigim det trabul kaman langa yumob. En yumob bin gitwail langa det men, en yumob bin streitinimap im. Wal ai sabi na yumob bin album miselp streitinimap det trabul, en yumob nomo garram enijing rong langa yumob na.

english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
kriol: en im en ol detlot Isreil pipul bin jinginatbat gudbinjiwei, en deibin blowimbat wisul olawei raidap deibin gajimap Jerusalem garram det Seikridwan Boks.

english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
kriol: Ai garra shoum olabat ola laiyinbala wed ol detlot laiyinbala speshalwan mesinja tok. En detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dalimbat stori, ai garra meigim olabat jidan siliwan. Ai garra deigimwei detlot klebabalawan ting weya detlot men oldei jinggabat, en meigim olabat jidan rabishwan.

english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.
kriol: Ola klebabala pipul gin luk gudwei weya dei go, bat detlot granggibala pipul kaan luk wujei blanga go.” Bat ai sabi du wi ol garra binijap seimwei. Wi ol garra dai.

english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
kriol: “Yumob jinggabat na. Nobodi kaan gowin eniwei langa det haus blanga strongbala men en pulumat im ola enijing. Yu garra taiyimap det strongbala men basdam, en afta yu gin pulumat im ola enijing. En im lagijat na wen mi andimwei dibuldibul.

english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
kriol: Brom deya Ilaisha bin gidap en imbin wokwok ebriweya langa det rum, en afta imbin gobek langa det lilboi en imbin leidan ontop langa det lilboi seimwei igin. Det lilboi bin kof sebenbala taim en imbin opinim im ai dubala.

english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
kriol: “Wal yumob bin irrim det wed weya im tok, ‘Yumob nomo lau blanga silipsilip garram enibodi, oni yu waif o yu hasbin.’

english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Yumob irrim mi na, ol yumob wuman hu oldei jidanbat brabli leisibala en nomo jinggabat enibodi.

english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
kriol: en dalim olabat wanim mi na YAWEI det boswan God toktokbat, ‘Blanga yumob enamimob bin mokimbat en reken yumob bigwan hil blanga olabat.

english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
kriol: “YAWEI det trubala God, yu irrim dijan preya blanga main. Mi jingat langa yu. Yu album melabat blanga bildimap det Serramoni Pleis blanga yu, weya bin binij longtaim wulijim ebribodi garra sabi yu na God.

english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;
kriol: Yumob garra gibit daga langa detlot pipul hu oldei jidanbat hanggribala, en yu garra lukaftumbat detlot pipul hu nomo garram kemp. Det lait blanga yumob garra shain langa dakbala pleis, en yumob garra jidan braitwan jis laik det san.

english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
kriol: Oldei main enami olabat meigimbat trabul blanga mi. Dei oldei jinggabat olkainwei blanga ardim mi.

english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
kriol: Wal Jonathan bin tok, “Wal wanim yu wandim mi blanga dum? Yu dalim mi, en ai garra duwit langa yu.”

english: This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
kriol: Wal wen im nomo bin rein blanga longtaim, YAWEI det trubala God bin dalim mi wotfo im nomo bin jandim eni rein. Imbin tok,

english: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
kriol: “Wal YAWEI bin irrim mi wen aibin jingat langa im blanga album mi, en imbin jis laik imbin pudumdan im bingga brom top en grebum mi, en imbin pulumat mi brom det trabul weya aibin abum.

english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
kriol: en det einjul bin dalim mi det wed blanga YAWEI det boswan God weya ai garra dalim ola pipul. Imbin tok, “Ai laigim Jerusalem main seikridwan taun detmatj,

english: Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”
kriol: Afta na olabat bin tok langa det king, “Haibala bos, yu sabi Denyul det men brom Juda, indit? Wal im nomo rispek langa yu, bos, en im nomo duwit langa det strongbala oda blanga yu. Imbin preipreibat langa im God 3 taim ebridei.”

english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.
kriol: en wan prisana wekinmen blanga det hedbos blanga det jeil bin jidan deya garram minbala. Det wekinmen bin brom det Hibru traib. En minbala bin dalim im blanga minbala drim, en imbin sabi det dubala drim.

english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,
kriol: En detlot hu nomo bin gitkil imbin deigimwei olabat prisana langa Bebalon weya deibin jidan jis laiga prisana dumbat ola adwek blanga det king en im sanmob raidap Pesha bin jidan brabli strongbala kantri.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
kriol: En ebrijing King Eihesaiya bin dum deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum Ola stori blanga detlot king blanga Isreil.

english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
kriol: en Reitjul bin tok, “God bin lisin langa mi. Imbin gudbinji langa mi wen aibin tok langa im, en imbin gibit mi lilboi.” En Reitjul bin gulum neim blanga det lilboi Den.

english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.
kriol: Yu garra seibum sambala heya, en yu garra pudum insaid langa yu klos.

english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
kriol: Olabat jis laik pamtri weya im jidan wan lain, en laik sambala gadin wansaid langa riba, en laik detlot elos tri weya YAWEI bin growimap olabat, en laik detlot sidatri weya gro wansaid langa riba.

english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
kriol: Wal ai kaan tok enijing langa yu, dumaji yu sabi det filing blanga main olredi, bat stil yu rispek langa mi.

english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok langa Mosis, “Yu garra meigim 48 freimpat garram dubala pol brom det wadultri blanga meigim thribala wol blanga holdimap ola kaliko.

english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
kriol: Wal dubala bin dalim olabat, “Wal yumob garra jinggabat na. Wanim God reken? Maitbi minbala garra lisin langa yumob? O maitbi minbala garra lisin langa God?

english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
kriol: Pol bin askim olabat, “Wen yumob bin bilib, det Holi Spirit bin kaman langa yumob?” Wal detlot bilibamob bin tok, “Melabat nomo sabi enijing blanga det Holi Spirit. Melabat nomo bin irrim eni stori blanga im.”

english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
kriol: en imbin jidanbat deya 40 dei, en Seitin bin oldei temtimbat im. En olkain wailwan enimul bin deya du. Bat sambala einjul bin kaman en lukaftumbat im.

english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”
kriol: Bambai na ola men langa det kantri bin askim Aisik blanga im waif Rabeka, en imbin dalim olabat, “Dijan iya main sista.” Im nomo bin dalim olabat Rabeka bin im waif, dumaji imbin bradin bambai dei mait kilim im ded en pulumat Rabeka brom im, dumaji Rabeka bin brabli purdiwan gel.

english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
kriol: En streidawei Libai bin gidap, en imbin bulurrum im.

english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
kriol: Det lilwan wadi brom det greiptri, yu kaan meigim enijing brom tharran.

english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”
kriol: Wal if mi nomo kilim det men en im wekinmen olabat ded bifo sanrais, wal God garra kilim mi ded.” Lagijat na Deibid bin jinggabat wen imbin kaminap langa det roud.

english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.
kriol: Detlot breibwan boswan blanga detlot ami hubin gitkil langa wo garra welkam yumob langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul jidan.

english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
kriol: Bat yumob nomo bin jinggabat tharran. Yumob bin jinggabat oni wan ting. Ai nomo bin fosim yumob blanga peiyim mi eni mani. En blanga tharran na yumob reken ai nomo bin tridim yumob gudbalawei seimwei laik aibin tridim ola najalot bilibamob. Yumob reken aibin tridim yumob rafwei. Wal mi askim yumob blanga larramgo mi fri brom det nogudbala ting weya yumob reken aibin dum langa yumob.

english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
kriol: Lidimap yumob bingga en prei, en preisim YAWEI.

english: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says Yahweh.
kriol: Olabat oldei redi blanga dalimbat laiya, en olabat laiyinbalawei jidan bos langa dijan kantri.” Lagijat na aibin tok. Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok na, “Main pipul olabat kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting, en olabat nomo sabi mi blanga olabat God.

english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
kriol: Brom deya Jisas bin gowei brom det haus blanga det serramonimen, en brom det taim na ola serramonimen en ola lowamen bin oldei tok adbalawei langa Jisas,

english: Yahweh says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
kriol: Basdam aibin kain langa detlot pipul langa det deset kantri hu nomo bin dai. Wen detlot pipul brom Isreil bin wandim abum gudwan spel,

english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
kriol: Jeikob bin deigim Rubin det eldiswan san blanga im garram im fobala boi neim Henak, Palu, Hesran en Kamai.

english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
kriol: En Leimek bin det dedi blanga Nowa. En Nowa bin abum thribala san en olabat bin neim Shem, Hem en Jeifeth.

english: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, Yahweh, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
kriol: “Wal ol yumob serramonimen hu oldei wek deya langa midul langa det seikridwan teibul en det dowawei blanga det Serramoni Pleis, yumob garra kraikrai en askimbat YAWEI, ‘YAWEI, yu sori blanga yu pipul olabat en nomo binijimap olabat. En yu nomo larram detlot najalot pipul mokimbat yu en yu ronwan pipul olabat. Yu nomo larram olabat tok, “Weya yumob God?” Dei kaan meigimbat fan langa yu pipul olabat.’” Lagijat na Jowal bin dalim detlot serramonimen blanga askimbat God.

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.
kriol: Imbin gibit bekboun langa YAWEI im God en im nomo bin wandim tjeinjim im nogudbalawei nomeda Jeramaiya det speshalwan mesinja blanga YAWEI bin wonimbat im.

english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”
kriol: “Yu garra go en faindim Jeramaiya, en yu garra maindim im brabliwei. Yu kaan ardimbat im, en yu garra dum wanim im wandim.”

english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
kriol: Bat Jeihu bin deigimat im bo en erro en imbin shudum strongbalawei en det erro bin hidim King Joram langa im bekboun raidap langa im hat, en Joram bin buldan ded ontop langa im bagi.

english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
kriol: Wen tharran garra hepin, wi garra dalim ebribodi na, ‘Aibin dum nogudbala ting, bat God bin larramgo mi fri,

english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
kriol: En if enibodi jandap en tok Jisas na det San blanga God, wal im jidan joinap garram God, en God jidan joinap garram im du.

english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
kriol: en imbin tok langa Jerabowam, “Jerabowam, yu deigim tenbala blanga yu ronselp, dumaji YAWEI det trubala God blanga ola Isreil pipul tok langa yu, ‘Ai garra deigimwei detlot kantri brom King Salaman, en ai garra gibit langa yu detlot tenbala klen.

english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
kriol: “Den, yu garra jidan gudwan lida blanga yu pipul olabat, langa det wanbala klen blanga Isreil.

english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
kriol: Bat yumob nomo wandi tridim im jis laik im bedfren blanga yumob. Nomo. Yumob garra tok langa im en gibit im woning gudbalawei jis laik im yumob ronwan braja o sista.

english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
kriol: “Yu garra gajim det wanbala boiwan ship, en yu garra dalim Eran en im san olabat blanga pudum olabat bingga langa det hed blanga det ship,

english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
kriol: Melabat bin jinggabat dijan longtaim en melabat sabi ebrijing garra kaman trubala. Wal yu irrim en len mowa, wulijim yu garra sabi brabliwei.” Lagijat na Elifas bin tok.

english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
kriol: Wal pipul wekwekbat oldei blanga gajimbat daga blanga dagat bat dei kaan neba sedisfaid.

english: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
kriol: “Wal yu luk detlot Eman pipul en Moweb pipul en Idam pipul wandi fait langa melabat. Dislot seimwan hubin fait langa melabat grengrenfathamob wen deibin trebul brom Ijip, en yu nomo bin larram olabat binijimap detlot pipul.

english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
kriol: Dei oldei shoum rispek langa detlot pipul hu teiknodis langa YAWEI. Dei nomo shoum rispek langa detlot pipul hu gibit bekboun langa im. Wen dei meigim pramis langa sambodi dei dum det ting, nomeda det ting weya dei garra dum im adwan.

english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
kriol: Afta na wen King Sol bin gowei, Jonathan bin jingat langa Deibid, en wen Deibid bin kaman langa im, Jonathan bin dalim im ebrijing weya im dedi bin tok, en afta imbin deigim Deibid langa im dedi, en Deibid bin kipgon jidanbat wekinmen blanga King Sol jis laik imbin jidan bifo.

english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
kriol: Wen Meri bin kamat langa det pleis weya Jisas bin jidan, imbin buldan lida langa Jisas, en imbin dalim im, “Bos, if yu bina iya, main braja nomo bina dai.”

english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
kriol: Wal Pailat bin askim Jisas mowa na, “Dislot serramonimen bin tok olkain blanga yu. Yu garra ensimbek olabat, indit?”

english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
kriol: en ol detlot raida garrimap spiya en bigbala naif, en detlot ting meigimbat bigmob nois, en ol detlot ting shain nomo lilbit langa san.

english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
kriol: En wen deibin jidan lagijat, Jisas bin gajim detlot daga en det dubala fish, en imbin lukap langa top, en imbin gibit theingks langa God, en afta imbin breigim detlot daga, en imbin gibit langa im wekinmen blanga gibitat langa detlot pipul. En seimwei igin imbin dum langa det dubala fish.

english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
kriol: 23Detlot pipul hu nomo teiknodis langa wanim detlot nogudbala pipul tok, dei garra jidan gudbinji. Dei nomo bulurrum det wei blanga detlot nogudbala pipul. Dei nomo miksap garram ola nogudbala pipul. Dei nomo jidan garram detlot pipul hu mokimbat God, en nomo wandi sabi im.

english: Behold, they ask me, “Where is Yahweh’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”
kriol: “Detlot pipul oldei askimbat mi, ‘Weya detlot panishmen YAWEI garra gibit wi? Larram im dumbat detlot ting na.’

english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
kriol: Wen pipul gaburrumap det dedbala bodi, det bodi im nogudwan. Bat wen God meigim det bodi gidap brom dedbala, det bodi garra jidan brabli gudwan na. Wen pipul gaburrumap det dedbala bodi, det bodi im brabli wikwan. Bat wen God meigim det bodi gidap brom dedbala, det bodi garra jidan brabli strongwan na.

english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin askim detlot pipul, “Wanim det lowa blanga wi dalim wi blanga dum langa Sebathdei? Im dalim wi blanga album sambodi o blanga ardim im? Im dalim wi blanga seibum sambodi laif o blanga deigidawei im laif?” Bat detlot pipul nomo bin tok enijing langa im. Deibin lafta ol jidan kwaitbala.

english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
kriol: Imbin bringimap yumob thru langa det brabli bigiswan en brabli nogudwan deset kantri weya ola jigiwan sneik en skopiyan jidan. En langa det draiwan kantri YAWEI bin meigim woda kamat brom det bigbala ston blanga yumob.

english: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
kriol: YAWEI, blanga yu wed garra jidan olagijawan. Im olagijawan deya langa hebin.

english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
kriol: Wal ola braja bin hatjamp detmatj, en deibin breigim olabat ron klos dumaji deibin brabli nogudbinji. Brom deya deibin loudimap ola dongki, en deibin gobek langa det taun,

english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
kriol: Afta na imbin gajim det kap ful garram wain, en imbin gibit theingks langa God, en imbin gibit det wain langa im wekinmen olabat,

english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.
kriol: Yu nomo laigim eni gel, oni mi na. Yu nomo holdimbat enibodi langa yu bingga, oni mi. Yunmi laigim gija detmatj. Im brabli strongwan wulijim deth. Det strongbala filing yunmi garram blanga yunmi selp, im jis laik deth. Im kaan gibap. Im barnimap yunmi insaid laik det bigwan faiya. Nobodi kaan deigidawei det strongbala filing blanga yunmi.

english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
kriol: Eltolad, Bethul, Homa,

english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.
kriol: En YAWEI garra jandimwei yumob langa najalot pipul en oni lilbit pipul garra jidan.

english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
kriol: Wal ai kaan gajimbat mani brom yumob seimwei laik detlot laiyawan speshalwan mishanri oldei gajimbat, dumaji ai nomo wandim yumob blanga reken olabat dum det wek seimwei laik mi dum.

english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
kriol: “Wal detlot olmen brom Jerusalem oldei jidanbat langa graun kwaitbalawei, en dei oldei pudumbat graun langa olabat hed en werrimonbat sekbeigwan klos dumaji olabat wori miselp blanga ola dedbala kantrimen. En ola yanggel oldei pudumdanbat olabat hed langa graun dumaji deibin wori miselp du.

english: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
kriol: Semyul bin tok, “Wal yumob irrim mi na, dumaji ai garra dalim yumob hau det king garra tridimbat yumob. Im garra meigim yumob san olabat jidan solja blanga im. Sambala garra jidan bos blanga ola bagi, en sambala garra jidan bos blanga ola hosis, en sambala garra ran lida langa det bagi blanga det king.

english: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
kriol: Ebrijing weya YAWEI bin pramis langa olabat, imbin duwit.

english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
kriol: Ola ritjwan pipul oldei mokimbat melabat, en ola praudbala pipul oldei tok blanga melabat nogudbalawei.

english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
kriol: Wal det boswan bin tok, ‘Yubin dum gud wek! Yu gudwan wekinmen, en yubin dum wanim aibin wandim. Yubin hendulum dijan lilwan ting raitwei, en blanga tharran na ai garra meigim yu bos blanga bigwan ting na. Yu kaman en jidan iya garram mi gudbinjiwei.’

english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Det kantri langa Lebanan garram bigismob tri, bat im garra jidan jis laiga gudwan fam dregli, en bambai det fam im garra abum bigismob tri igin.

english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
kriol: YAWEI, im oldei wotjimbat wi wulijim wi kaan buldan. Im oldei lukaftumbat wi. Im nomo go silip.

english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
kriol: Wal detlot Isreil pipul bin libum det hil gulum Hora langa det roud weya go langa det solwoda gulum Redsi, weya goran langa det kantri gulum Idam. Bat olabat bin gitwail, en deibin tok nogudbalawei langa God en Mosis na. Olabat bin stat grambulbat, “Wotfo yubin bringimat melabat brom Ijip blanga dai langa dijan deset kantri, weya nomo eni daga o woda. Wi kaan dagadagat dijan nogudbala daga enimo!”

english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
kriol: Olabat tok, ‘Main pipul oni garram lilwan sowa,’ bat ai sabi det sowa im brabli nogudwan, en olabat tok, ‘Ebrijing im stil rait,’ bat ai sabi im nomo rait, najing.

english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.
kriol: “Im kaan go gulijap langa dedbala bodi, nomeda im blanga im mami, o dedi, o sista, o braja, o enibodi.

english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
kriol: En ai nomo wori en kotim miselp blanga enijing weya aibin dum if im gudwan o nogudwan du, dumaji nomeda det filing blanga main im gudwan insaid, bat stil det filing kaan meigim mi jidan trubala langa God. Yumob sabi? Nobodi kaan kotim mi en faindat if mi trubala langa God. Oni Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi gin kotim mi, dumaji im na main Bos.

english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
kriol: Wal ai dalim yumob na. Yumob na det feswan hubin wandi gibitbat det mani. En lasyiya yumob bin stat gibitbat det mani bifo ebribodi. Bat yumob bin stap hafwei. En ai reken im mobeda blanga yumob blanga kipgon gibitbat det mani.

english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
kriol: En langa oltestaman im tok, “Enibodi bin gibit enijing langa God wulijim God garra peiyimbek im?” Nomo.

english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
kriol: Wal seimtaim King Deibid bin jandim wed langa Ishboseth, “Yu garra gibitbek langa mi main waif Mikal. Aibin gibit yu dedi det skinpat brom 100 dedwan Filastain solja blanga det gel. En ai wandim det gel na.”

english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.
kriol: Wal sambala step bin deya langa det pleis, en sambala Libaimen bin jandap ontop langa detlot step en dislot neim blanga olabat na, Jeshuwa, Bani, Kedmiyel, Shebanaiya, Bunai, Sherebaiya, Bani en Kenanai. Deibin prei adbala langa YAWEI det trubala God blanga olabat.

english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
kriol: Wal Jethro bin tok, “Yu nomo dum raitwei.

english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”
kriol: Wal wen Gidiyan bin snikap olabat kemp, imbin irrim wanbala solja bin dalimbat im fren blanga wanbala drim weya imbin abum, “Langa main drim aibin luk wanbala damba weya deibin meigim garram det sid daga gulum bali, en det damba bin roldan langa wi kemp, en imbin hitim wanbala tent, en det tent bin buldan.”

english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
kriol: Detlot lowa blanga yu, olabat trubalawan. Ola pipul gibitbat mi adtaim garram ola laiyawan stori. Yu album mi, YAWEI.

english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
kriol: YAWEI, yu sabi wanim mi wandim brabli. Yu lisinbat langa mi wen mi jingat langa yu.

english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
kriol: En yumob garra sabi aibin irrim yumob laflafbat wen main pipul olabat bin abumbat bigiswan trabul, en yumob bin reken yumob gin teikoba det dubala kantri.

english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,
kriol: Wal blanga tharran na detlot pipul oldei gulum det taim Purim brom det neim blanga detlot ston dei gulum Purim. Dumaji Modakai bin raidimdan ol detlot ting langa leda en deibin ol luk en sabi wanim bin hepin langa olabat.

english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
kriol: en deibin gidap en grebum Jisas, en deibin dregim im ontop langa det hil weya det taun bin jidan, en dei bina tjakamdan im.

english: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.
kriol: YAWEI bin tok, “Ai nomo bin jandim dislot mesinja, bat dei reken dei toktok blanga mi. Ai nomo bin gibit olabat wed, bat dei kipgon toktokbat.

english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.
kriol: Wal Menahem, det san blanga Gedi, bin gowei brom det taun gulum Taisa blanga go langa Sameriya en kilim King Shalum ded. Wal wen Menahem bin kamat langa Sameriya imbin kilim King Shalum ded, en Menahem bin jidan det nyuwan king.

english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
kriol: Im sabi wi jidan wikwan, en im sabi imbin meigim wi brom det graun.

english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
kriol: Detlot klebabalawan gel bin deigim blendibala speyawan oil blanga olabat lemp.

english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.
kriol: Wal streidawei det solja hubin wotjimbat det haus blanga King Deibid bin luk bigmob pipul kamindan brom hilsaid wansaid langa det roud weya go langa det taun gulum Horonaiyim, en imbin go langa King Deibid, en imbin dalim im wanim imbin luk.

english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
kriol: Detlot hu trastim langa YAWEI jidan wulijim det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan, weya najing gin sheikim en najing gin mubum im.

english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
kriol: Jisas Krais garra kambek garram brabli hotwan faiya blanga panishim detlot pipul hu nomo sabi God. Im garra panishim detlot pipul hu nomo bin lisin langa det Gudnyus blanga im,

english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
kriol: Imbin pudum detlot kantri ontopwei, en ola woda andanithwei.

english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
kriol: Singim song yumob brom Saiyan, en preisim YAWEI det brabli holiwan God blanga Isreil pipul. God im jidan iya blanga album im pipul olabat.”

english: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
kriol: Dumaji im trubalawan en im oldei laigimbat pipul, wal im shoum detlot pipul hu laigim im det raitwei blanga kipum im strongwan pramis.

english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
kriol: Afta na detlot pipul blanga det fleig blanga Rubin klen garra stat mubat grup afta grup garram det boswan Elisuwa det san blanga Shediyu.

english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
kriol: En sambala pipul dei jis laik detlot sid weya bin buldan langa roud. Dei irrim det wed. Bat streidawei Seitin im kaman en deigidawei det wed brom olabat.

english: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
kriol: Ola graun blanga YAWEI det trubala God, en ebrijing langa dijan graun blanga im du. Ola kantri en ola pipul jidan blanga im na.

english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.
kriol: Wal mi na YAWEI det trubala God bin meigim ebrijing. Detlot pipul weya mi laigim olabat brabliwei, dei oldei jidan lobala en dei oldei jinggabat oni langa mi blanga albumbat olabat, en olabat sheik wen dei irrim mi toktokbat.

english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
kriol: en det seim nait dei garra rostim det bif. Holbit dei garra rostim garram leig en hed en binji du. Dei kaan dagat det bif rauwan, en dei kaan boilim det bif du. Dei garra dagat det bif rostidwan, en dei garra dagat det bif garram det jigiwan daga en garram damba nomo garram raising,

english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
kriol: Bos, yu meigim main enami olabat tok garram difrindifrin langgus, wulijim dei kaan andasten miselp, dumaji mi luk pipul dumbat nogud ting en meigim trabul langa det bigwan taun.

english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
kriol: Imbin tok, ‘Dislot pipul tok gudbalawei blanga God garram olabat mawus. Bat insaid langa olabat hat dei nomo jinggabat God.

english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok langa mi na, “Jeramaiya, yu nomo krai o prei blanga dislot pipul. Yu nomo askim mi blanga olabat, dumaji ai kaan irrim yu na.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, mi askim Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi blanga jidan brabli kainbala langa yumob. Yuwai. Binij na.

english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,
kriol: en ai garra fait langa im streidawei, dumaji ai sabi im nokap en wori miselp, en ai sabi im garra bradin wen ai kamat langa im, en ola solja blanga im garra ranawei. Bat ai kaan kilim ol detlot pipul. Oni King Deibid ai garra kilim,

english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
kriol: en deibin go blanga midim im langa roud, en deibin jinginatbat, “Melabat preisimbat God, en melabat askim im blanga album dijan iya king blanga ola Isreil pipul en blanga meigim im brabli gudbinji, dumaji God na bin jandim im.”

english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
kriol: “‘Langa det seim dei na wen ai garra binijimap yumob, ai garra jandim main mesinja langa detlot Ithiyopiya pipul, en im garra dalim olabat blanga det panishmen weya garra kaman. Olabat reken dei jidanbat seifwan, bat bambai dei garra bradin en sheiksheik nomo lilbit.

english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.
kriol: Wal det buligi en det nenigout deibin yusum blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, weya deibin bringimap detlot blad deya langa det Brabli Seikridwan Rum blanga deigidawei det nogudbalawei, wal olabat garra deigim dubala atsaid brom det kemp en barnim. En ol detlot skin en bif en detlot binji garra barn holot.

english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
kriol: Wal wen minbala oldei prei blanga yumob, Prayer minbala oldei gibit theingks langa God det Dedi blanga Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi, dumaji minbala bin irrim det wed weya yumob bilib langa Jisas Krais brabliwei en weya yumob laigim ola pipul blanga God brabliwei du.

english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
kriol: Brom deya sambala serramonimen gulum Ferasi bin majurrumap miselp, en Jisas bin askim olabat,

english: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in Yahweh our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahweh, and turned their backs.
kriol: Wi grengrenfathamob nomo bin bulurrum YAWEI holbit en deibin dum nogudbala ting langa im. Olabat bin tenim miselp bekboun brom det Serramoni Pleis weya im oldei jidan.

english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”
kriol: Wal yumob garra dalim YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob grengrenfatha olabat blanga detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin dumbat, en yumob garra dum wanim meigim im gudbinji. Yumob garra kadimat miselp brom detlot najalot pipul hu jidan langa dijan kantri blanga wi en yumob garra jandimwei detlot waif weya yumob garram brom naja kantri.”

english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ol yumob pipul, yumob brabli defwan en blainwan, bat yumob garra lisin langa mi, en yumob garra luk langa mi.

english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.
kriol: Hegai bin laigim im en imbin kain langa im. Streidawei imbin gibit im ola oil en gudsmelwan ting blanga meigim im mowa purdiwan. Imbin gibit Esta gudwan daga en sebenbala wekingel blanga albumbat im. En imbin gibit langa Esta en im wekingel olabat det nambawan pleis langa det haus.

english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
kriol: Wal wen Aisaiya bin gedim det mesij brom det king,

english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
kriol: Holot det enimul garram im skin, en bif en blad en binji garra barn lida langa det serramonimen.

english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
kriol: en wen det dyu bin gowap, detmatj brabli lilwan daga bin jidan ebriweya langa graun. Det daga bin difrinkain daga,

english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
kriol: Olabat kaan hanggri blanga daga. En olabat kaan lukabat blanga woda du. En wen olabat wek, det san kaan barnimbat olabat, dumaji det Yangwan Ship deya langa det speshalwan tjeya, im na garra maindimbat olabat imselp.

english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
kriol: En ebrijing weya yumob dum, yumob garra dum brabliwei jis laik yumob wek blanga Jisas Krais,

english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin gidap, en im en ola wekinmen blanga im bin go garram det boswan.

english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
kriol: Preisim YAWEI ola yanggel en ola yangboi, en ola ol pipul en ola biginini du.

english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.
kriol: en dei nomo bin jinggabat det femili blanga Gidiyan blanga ola gudbala ting weya imbin dumbat blanga olabat.

english: This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
kriol: Mi na bin meigim yumob, en mi na bin maindimbat yumob bifo yumob bin bon. Yumob nomo bradin! Ai laigim yumob detmatj, dumaji mi na bin pikimat yumob, en yumob na main ronwan speshalwan wekinmen olabat.

english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.
kriol: En wen yumob go, yumob kaan deigim enijing garram yumob. Yumob kaan garrimap wokinstik o beig o daga o mani o speyawan klos.

english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin sori langa dubala, en imbin pudum im bingga langa dubala ai, en streidawei det dubala blainwan men bin luk, en afta dubala bin bulurrum Jisas.

english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
kriol: Yu garra meigim dubala golwan ring blanga garrimap det teibul, en yu garra pudum det dubala ring tusaid langa det teibul andanith langa det benpat,

english: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
kriol: “Wal bifo det gel bin tok lagijat, im nomo bin jinggabat hubin gibit im ola daga en oil en wain en ola gol en ola silba. Im boifren olabat nomo bin gibit im ol detlot ting. Mi na bin gibit im ol detlot ting. Bat im nomo bin jinggabat mi. En imbin oldei yusum ol detlot gol en silba blanga meigim detlot sheip blanga ola drimin gulum Beil. “Wal mi na aibin gibit det gel ol detlot ting. Bat im nomo bin jinggabat mi, en imbin go im ronwei.

english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
kriol: Wal sambala lowamen bin deya, en wen deibin irrim Jisas tok lagijat, deibin toktok miselp na, “Dis men kaan tok lagijat, dumaji im laiya langa God, en im trai en meigim miselp God.”

english: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahweh, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.
kriol: en imbin tok langa olabat deya na, “Ol yumob Libaimen, yumob garra meigim miselp klinbala blanga serramoni, en meigim det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI klinbala blanga serramoni du. Yumob garra deigimwei ola nogudwan ting brom det Serramoni Pleis.

english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
kriol: ‘Mi na YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob hubin bringimat yumob brom Ijip, weya yumob bin wekinmen en wekingel jis laiga prisana.

english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
kriol: “Wal yumob garra abum bigbala trabul na! Dumaji yumob oldei dalimbat laiya. Im jis laik yumob pulumbat roup biyainwei langa yumob garram detlot nogudbala ting.

english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
kriol: Ebritaim wen det Seikridwan Boks bin stat blanga mub, Mosis bin prei, “Kaman YAWEI en album melabat, en jandimwei ola enami en andimwei detlot hu nomo laigim yu.”

english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
kriol: Dumaji deibin abum loda buligi langa det kantri gulum Giliyad, wal deibin teikoba ola kantri sanraiswei raidap langa det deset weya im go langa Yufreitis Riba.

english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
kriol: Bambai na Eibrahem bin shifdim im kemp brom detlot tri blanga det men neim Memrei, en imbin go langa det kantri gulum Neigib, en deya na imbin ringimap im tent langa midul langa det dubala taun gulum Keidish en Shuya. Bambai na imbin go en imbin jidan langa det kantri gulum Gera,

english: “The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
kriol: “YAWEI det brabli boswan God bin gibit dijan strongwan woning. Imbin tok, ‘Ai nomo laigim det praudbalawei blanga ola Isreil pipul. Ai nomo laigim ola brabli gudwan haus blanga olabat. Ai garra gibit det taun en ebrijing langa det taun langa yumob enami.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.”

english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
kriol: Irrim na ol yumob boswan langa dijan wel. Yumob garra jinggabat ol dislot wed en sabi olabat brabliwei.

english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
kriol: YAWEI bin meigim ola riba draiyap brabliwei, en det kantri bin jidan brabli draiwan.

english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
kriol: Ola gudbala pipul oldei tok gudbalawei, dumaji olabat gudbala insaid. En ola nogudbala pipul oldei tok nogudbalawei, dumaji olabat nogudbala insaid.

english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
kriol: Wal God bin tok langa mi na, “Isikiyel, yu luk langa nowathwei.” En aibin luk deya lida langa det geit det brabli nogudwan drimin sheip bin jidan deya en wan teibul blanga ofring bin jidan deya du. Blanga tharran na God bin brabli wail.

english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
kriol: en if yubin dum enijing blanga meigim im nogudbinji, wal yu garra libum det ofring, en yu garra gobek langa det sambodi en sei sori langa im, en afta yu gin gobek en gibit det ofring langa God.

english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
kriol: Bat if wailwan enimul bin kilim det enimul, wal det men hubin lukaftumbat det enimul garra shoum det bodi blanga det enimul langa det boswan, en im kaan peiyimbek det boswan blanga det enimul.

english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
kriol: Eliyeisa, det san blanga Eran hubin det serramonimen, im na boswan blanga det Seikridwan Tent, en blanga det oil blanga detlot lemp, en blanga det gudsmelwan medisin, en det sid daga ofring, en det speshalwan oil dei oldei pudum langa hed langa det speshalwan serramoni, en ebrijing insaid langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI.

english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
kriol: God, brom yu seikridwan pleis langa Jerusalem weya ola boswan king oldei bringim presen langa yu, shoum yu pawa, det pawa na weya yubin yusum basdam blanga seibum melabat.

english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
kriol: If enibodi wandi peiyim yu blanga tok hau im wandim yu blanga tok langa kot, wal yu kaan tatjim det mani brom im, dumaji det mani garra meigim yu jinggabat najawei, en det men kaan abum feyago langa det kot.

english: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
kriol: YAWEI, lisin langa mi. Mi jinginat langa yu. Yu sori langa mi en ensim mi!

english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.
kriol: Wal yumob garra gobek en meigim ebrijing redi, en yumob garra faindat weya Deibid oldei jidan en hu oldei luk im deya langa det pleis, dumaji aibin gedim wed im brabli trikibala.

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
kriol: Wal Mosis bin tok langa Eran na, “Yu dalim ol detlot pipul blanga kaman en jandap lida langa YAWEI, dumaji YAWEI bin irrim olabat wen deibin agamin langa im.”

english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
kriol: En langa det dei bambai yumob garra jingat langa yumob femilimob blanga kaman en jidan garram yumob langa yumob gudwan kemp. Yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei mijamet andanith langa ola greiptri en figtri blanga yumob.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
kriol: Olabat bin nokap brom dumbat adwek. Deibin oldei buldan en nobodi bin albumbat olabat.

english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
kriol: Yu garra dalim detlot Isreil pipul, if eni men hubin dai en nomo bin abum san, im doda gin abum ola kantri blanga im fatha.

english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;
kriol: “Wal yumob garra jidan strongbala, en yumob garra oldei bulurrum ol detlot lowa weya Mosis bin raidimdan langa det buk, en yumob garra oldei teiknodis langa ola lowa.

english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
kriol: En ai garra meigim dijan strongwan pramis langa ol detlot enimul en bard weya bin kamat brom det bout garram yumob du.

english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
kriol: Olabat jis laik detlot purdiflawa weya sambodi bin jis plentimat, en deibin stat blanga gro. Bat wen God jandim det hotwan win langa olabat, im draiyimap olabat, en det bigiswan win deigimwei olabat.

english: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!
kriol: Wal olabat bin go langa det king na, en olabat bin tok, “King Daraiyas, yu brabli haibala bos. Melabat wandim yu garra jidan olagijawan!

english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
kriol: Enibodi hu oldei preisimbat sambodi laiyinbalawei garra trepam im ronselp.

english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.
kriol: Brom deya det einjul blanga YAWEI bin tok langa Ilaija, “Yu garra go garram im en nomo bradin.” Wal Ilaija bin go garram det boswan solja raidap langa det king.

english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
kriol: Brom deya God bin gowei na,

english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
kriol: YAWEI, im jidan langa hebin en im na det Brabli Haibalawan Bos blanga ebrijing. Im mowa strongbala langa det solwoda weya im jingat, en im mowa strongbala langa ola bigwan weib langa solwoda.

english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
kriol: Hu dijan kaminap brom deset kantri weya dubala holdimbat miselp bingga? Det gel im sing. Andanith langa det epul tri aibin weikimap yu langa det pleis weya yubin bon.

english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
kriol: En yu irrim mi Jeramaiya! Ebribodi langa dijan kantri Juda, garra fait langa yu. Detlot king, detlot boswan, detlot serramonimen, en detlot pipul holot garra gibit yu bekboun. Bat tudei na ai garra meigim yu brabli strongbala en olabat kaan bidim yu. Yu garra jidan brabli strongbala jis laiga strongwan taun, en laik det strongwan aiyanwan pol en kopawan wol. Wal olabat kaan bidim yu, dumaji ai garra jidan garram yu blanga album yu.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
kriol: En wen yumob garra lukabat blanga mi, wal yumob garra faindim mi dumaji yumob garra kambek en weship langa mi en ai garra jidan langa yumob.

english: Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Ol yumob praudbala boswan langa Jerusalem, yumob irrim dijan mesij brom YAWEI na.

english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”
kriol: Wal det nait King Sol bin jandim sambala men blanga wotjimbat det haus blanga Deibid, dumaji ailibala deibin wandi kilim im ded. Bat Mikal det waif blanga Deibid bin gibit im woning, “Yu garra ranawei tunait na. Bambai dei kilim yu ded ailibala.”

english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
kriol: Melabat bin brabli hanggri blanga daga, en melabat bin selim miselp langa Ijip en Asiriya blanga gibit melabat daga.

english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
kriol: en deibin gaburrumap im ai garram reig, en deibin askimbat im jigibalawei, “Yu dalim melabat! Hu tharran bin hitim yu?”

english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
kriol: Langa det dei wen ai garra jingat langa yu, ol main enami olabat garra tenaran en gowei. Ai sabi tharran dumaji God im jidan langa main said.

english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
kriol: en wan kilogrem flauwa garram ebri yangwan ship en garram det wain ofring du.

english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
kriol: Wal Tera bin gowei brom det taun gulum Yura, en imbin deigim im san Eibram garram im waif Serai, en imbin deigim Lot, det san blanga im dedbala san du, en deibin stat blanga go langa det kantri gulum Keinan. Bat hafwei langa roud deibin stap langa wan taun gulum Heran.

english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
kriol: Im garra jandimdan hotwan eshis en smok garram nogudwan smel langa ola nogudwan pipul. Im garra panishim olabat garram brabli hotwan win.

english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
kriol: Afta, wen Jisas bin stat titjimbat ola pipul deya, imbin tok, “God bin tok langa oltestaman dijan Serramoni Pleis im blanga im, en enibodi gin kaman iya oni blanga prei. Bat yumob serramonimen bin tenimran dijan pleis, en yumob yusumbat dijan Serramoni Pleis blanga pulumatbat mani brom ola pipul.”

english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
kriol: Deya gin langa Jerusalem det taun blanga God yumob oldei titjimbat ola pipul blanga bulurrum det nogudbalawei en blanga deigidawei enibodi laif.

english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
kriol: Wal detlot thribala men bin tok, “Det bos blanga melabat neim Koniliyas bin jandim melabat. Im gudbala men, en im bulurrum det wei blanga God du, en ola Juwish pipul rispek im brabliwei. Wal wan einjul brom God bin dalim im blanga askim yu blanga kaman langa im haus, dumaji dei garra irrim det wed weya yu garra tok langa olabat.”

english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”
kriol: Wal det men bin tok, “Ola Isreil solja bin ranawei brom detlot Filastain solja. Deibin bidim melabat brabliwei. En deibin kilim yu san dubala ded, en deibin deigidawei det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI.”

english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok langa mi,

english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”
kriol: en wen det serramonimen bin luk olabat bin gajim detlot seikridwan ting olabat, imbin askim olabat, “Wanim yumob dumbat?”

english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Yumob pipul langa Jerusalem, yumob jis laik det gel hu nomo rili trubala langa im hasbin. Basdam Jerusalem bin abum bigismob gudbala pipul. Bat tudei na yumob taun garram loda krulbala pipul hu wandi kilimbat pipul oldei.

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.
kriol: King Jehoyahas bin tenawei brom YAWEI det trubala God en imbin kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting en lidimbat ola Isreil pipul nogudbalawei jis laik King Jerabowam bin oldei dumbat.

english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
kriol: Wal yumob garra askimbat God blanga jandim bigmob wekinmen blanga dalimbat olabat.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
kriol: “Isikiyel, yu garra tok adbalawei langa detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum Eman.

english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
kriol: YAWEI nomo bin sori langa enibodi wen imbin binijimap ol detlot taun langa Isreil. Deya langa det kantri imbin pulumdan ol detlot strongwan wol en taun weya kipum pipul seif wen eni enami kaman langa olabat. Imbin meigim det kantri Isreil en detlot lidamob sheim miselp nomo lilbit en olabat najing na.

english: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Olkain wain meigim main pipul olabat nomo jinggabat gudwei,

english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
kriol: Wal wen yumob bin joinap garram Jisas Krais, yumob bin sekamsais. Bat nomo det sekamsais weya pipul dum langa olabat bodi. Det sekamsais weya Jisas Krais bin kadimat yumob brom det olbalawei blanga yumob, dumaji wen yumob bin beptais, im jis laik yumob bin dai, en deibin gaburrumap yumob garram im, en yumob bin gidap laibala brom dedbala garram im du, dumaji yumob bin bilib langa det pawa blanga God weya bin meigim im gidap laibala.

english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
kriol: “Trubala im garra brabli nogud blanga ol yumob lowamen. Yumob sabi det wei blanga God. Bat yumob nomo bulurrum det wei. En yumob nomo larram ola najalot pipul bulurrum det wei du.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok langa det lowamen.

english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
kriol: Wal if det wek blanga enibodi nomo barnap, wal God garra gibit im prais.

english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,
kriol: “Wal langa det feswan dei blanga det serramoni, yumob garra midap blanga weship langa YAWEI, en yumob kaan dum eni wek.

english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
kriol: Bat ai dalim yumob. Det haibala bos neim King Salaman bin brabli ritjmen, en imbin abum olkain purdiwan klos. Bat detlot klos nomo bin purdiwan seimwei laik ol detlot purdiflawa, dumaji God oldei gibit det kala langa ola purdiflawa.

english: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
kriol: Detlot blijiman hu oldei lukaftumbat det taun bin luk langa mi, en aibin askim olabat, “Yumob bin faindim main olmen?”

english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”
kriol: Aibin ensimbek det king, “If ai dalim yu detlot trubalawan wed, yu mait kilim mi ded, en if ai dalim yu wanim rait, yu nomo teiknodis.”

english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,
kriol: Shefataiya det san blanga Metan, Gedalaiya det san blanga Pashura, Jehukal det san blanga Shelemaiya, en Pashura det san blanga Melkaiya bin irrim wanim aibin dalimbat detlot pipul.

english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”
kriol: Wal wanim wi garra dum blanga faindim waif blanga detlot men? Wi garra faindim waif blanga olabat, dumaji wi nomo wandim det klen blanga binij. Wal hau wi garra faindim waif blanga olabat, dumaji wibin meigim pramis langa YAWEI nomo blanga gibit wi doda langa olabat, en wi kaan breigim det pramis.” Wal deibin jinggabat na, en deibin askim miselp, “Wen wibin majurrumap miselp basdam deya langa det taun gulum Mispa, eni kantrimen blanga wi nomo bin deya?” Deibin askim miselp lagijat, dumaji wen deibin majurrumap miselp deya langa Mispa, deibin meigim pramis blanga kilim ded enibodi hu nomo bin deya,

english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
kriol: En mi dalim yumob trubala dijan najawan wed du. If enibodi welkam enibodi weya mi jandim, wal im welkam mi du. En if im welkam mi, wal im welkam main Dedi hubin jandim mi.”

english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.
kriol: Main bos nomo bin teiknodis langa ol main brabli strongbala soljamob. Imbin jandim ami blanga binijimap ol main boi. En imbin smeshimap main pipul olabat laik ola greip daga weya dei oldei meigim wain.

english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.
kriol: Wal streidawei Joshuwa bin majurrumap ola gudwan solja blanga im, en imbin majurrumap ola najalot solja blanga im du, en deibin ol go langa det taun,

english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
kriol: “Nomo longtaim na ai garra kambek. Wal yu garra wotjimbat yuselp na. Yu nomo wandi slekap en larram enibodi bidim yu. Yu nomo wandim enibodi pulumat yu det ting weya God garra gibit langa yu.

english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
kriol: Ebri wed langa det baibul bin kaman brom God, en ebri wed im brabli gudbala blanga lenimbat wi wanim trubala, en im gudbala blanga shoum wi weya wi rong, en im gudbala blanga streitinimap wi, en im gudbala blanga meigim wi sabi det raitwei,

english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
kriol: en det taim na ai garra kamdan garram klaud. Mi na det Speshalwan Men, en ai garra shain detmatj garram main pawa.

english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
kriol: Bat im nomo bin sabi det wed blanga Jonathan. Oni Jonathan dubala Deibid bin sabi.

english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
kriol: En wanim yumob reken? Detlot Juwish pipul hu nomo bin bilib langa im brabliwei garra meigim God tjeinjim im main? Dei garra meigim im nomo dum enijing weya imbin dalim olabat im garra dum?

english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
kriol: Afta na Jeikob bin prei langa YAWEI det trubala God, “God blanga Eibrahem! God blanga main dedi Aisik! Yu lisin langa mi na! Yu na bin dalim mi blanga gobek langa main kantri en langa main femili olabat. Yu na bin dalim mi yu garra albumbat mi blanga ebrijing.

english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”
kriol: Im bina jinggabat wanim bin hepin langa Abimalek det san blanga Gidiyan deya langa det taun gulum Thebes. Wen Abimalek bin go gulijap langa det taun, wan olgamen bin tjakamdan det bigwan granding ston brom ontop langa det wol, en det ston bin kilim im ded. Wal wotfo Jowab nomo bin jinggabat wen imbin jandim detlot solja gulijap langa det taun?’ Maitbi lagijat na King Deibid garra tok langa yu. En yu garra dalim King Deibid det solja blanga im neim Yuraiya bin dai langa det fait.” Lagijat na Jowab bin dalim det mesinja.

english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
kriol: en imbin meigim kopawan pleit garram loda gep weya det faiya garra jidan ontop, en imbin pudum det pleit garram ola gep deya hafwei insaid langa det teibul.

english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
kriol: Wal King Henun en detlot Emanait pipul bin sabi na deibin meigim King Deibid jidan enami blanga olabat, en deibin go en pei loda mani blanga gajim loda solja en bagi blanga album olabat fait langa King Deibid. Deibin gedim olabat brom Mesapoteimiya en brom det dubala kantri gulum Meiyaka en Soba deya langa Siriya.

english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
kriol: en aibin spredimat olabat oloba langa najalot kantri. Deibin meigim det panishmen kaman langa olabat ronselp.

english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
kriol: en Iba bin abum dubala san. Wanbala imbin gulum im neim Peleg, dumaji det taim na God bin kadimat ola pipul langa olabat ronwan kantri. En det najawan san imbin gulum im neim Joktan.

english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
kriol: Bifo imbin ranawei brom yu lilwail, bat tudei na yu garra abumbek im olagija.

english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
kriol: Wal Pol en Banabas bin dalimbat det gudnyus langa ola pipul deya langa det taun gulum Debi, en loda pipul bin bilib langa det wed. Afta na dubala bin gobek langa det dubala taun gulum Listra en Aikoniyam en langa det taun gulum Entiyak deya langa det kantri gulum Pasidiya.

english: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
kriol: YAWEI, olabat nomo luk yu bingga wen yu redi blanga panishimbat olabat. Yu shoum olabat yu oldei lukaftumbat yu ronwan pipul olabat, en maitbi olabat garra sheim miselp. Larram yu faiya barnimap ol yu enamimob.

english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
