kriol: Imbin andimwei detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanabat langa det kantri wen im pipulmob bin go thru deya. Imbin kadimat olabat kantri en gibit miselpmiselp langa ola klen blanga Isreil, en imbin gibit ola kemp blanga olabat langa im pipul olabat.

english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
kriol: Joshuwa bin jandap deya en imbin werrimon brabli dardiwan klos.

english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
kriol: Wal King Jehosafet det san blanga Asa bin jidan king en imbin brabli strongbala king en imbin meigim Juda mowa strongbala langa Isreil.

english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
kriol: Afta na deibin gajim dubala mamiwan buligi, en deibin taiyimap dubala langa wegan, en deibin deigimbek det dubala gabigabi langa yad,

english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
kriol: Brom deya Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin go langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga ola Juwish pipul, en deya na Jisas bin luk loda pipul bin baiyimbat en selimbat olkain ting blanga yusum langa det serramoni. Wal Jisas bin gitwail, en imbin andimwei ol detlot pipul atsaid brom det pleis, en imbin tipimoba ola teibul blanga detlot pipul hubin hendulumbat ola mani, en imbin tjakidawei ola tjeya blanga detlot pipul hubin selimbat ola bard,

english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
kriol: Wal wen YAWEI dalim melabat blanga gitredi blanga go en krosoba det Jodan Riba en fait, melabat garra duwit.” Lagijat na deibin tok.

english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
kriol: Wal dubala garra jidan brabli gudwei igin, en yu en detlot lilwan taun blanga yu garra jidan gudwan.

english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.
kriol: Bambai det gel bin gitwail langa im hasbin, en imbin ranawei brom im, en imbin gobek langa im dedi kemp deya langa Bethlahem. Imbin jidan deya fo fobala mants,

english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
kriol: Wal wen Pida bin silip, wan einjul bin kamat langa im, en det lait bin shain ebriweya langa det rum, en det einjul bin holdim Pida langa im sholda, en imbin weikimap im, “Kwikbala yu gidap!” En streidawei det dubala tjein bin kamat brom Pida bingga,

english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.
kriol: King Jerabowam bin dumbat ola nogudbala ting, bat King Eiheb bin dumbat mowa brabli nogudbala ting. Imbin merrit Jesabel det doda blanga det king neim Ithbeil. Ithbeil bin jidan king blanga det taun gulum Saidan. En King Eiheb bin weshipbat det drimin sheip gulum Beil.

english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.
kriol: Aibin luk yumob, en streidawei aibin sabi yumob nomo bin teiknodis wanim YAWEI bin dalim yumob blanga dum, en yumob bin dum brabli nogudbala ting langa im wen yumob bin meigimbat det drimin sheip laiga boiwan gabigabi.

english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
kriol: wal det gel garra dum ebrijing wen imbin pramis. Oni if im hasbin nomo agri wen im irrim det wed, wal det gel kaan dum.

english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
kriol: En wen mi trai blanga jingat langa ol main wekinmenmob, olabat nomo irrim mi en dei kaan teiknodis langa mi du.

english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
kriol: Wal ebribodi gon na. Ola solja gin go en gajim ola gol en silba, dumaji det taun im garram detmatj enijing.

english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
kriol: Detlot men na bin oldei stapambat ola agamin. Deibin oldei sodimat ola lilwan trabul, en Mosis bin oldei sodimat ola bigwan trabul.

english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
kriol: Brom deya Aisik bin deigim Rabeka langa im tent, en dubala bin merrit, en Aisik bin laigim Rabeka brabliwei. Wal bifo wen im mami bin dai, Aisik bin oldei jidanbat nogudbinji. Bat tudei na im jidan brabli gudbinjiwei.

english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
kriol: Det klen blanga Ged bin bildimapbek igin detlot strongwan taun gulum Diban, Etaroth, Eroya,

english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
kriol: Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Sambala pipul nomo laigim det gudbalawei en olabat oldei wandim gogobat rongwei.

english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
kriol: En mi tok gudei langa main Juwish kantrimen Herodiyan. En mi tok gudei langa ola femili blanga Nasisas hu bilib langa Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi.

english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
kriol: Ola bigwan taun garra jidan rabishwan nomo garram enijing, oni breikapwan geit.

english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
kriol: Wal yumob sabi wanim bin hepin afta. Isau bin wandi gedim det laswan wed brom im dedi. Bat im dedi nomo bin gibit im, en nomeda imbin kraikrai en askimbat im dedi, bat stil im nomo bin meigim im dedi duwit langa im.

english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
kriol: Bat Jisas bin dalim olabat, “Wotfo yumob bradin? Mi dijan iya.”

english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
kriol: en deibin dalim det king, “God bin meigim dislot senflai kamat ebriweya.” Bat det king bin go mowa admen, en im nomo bin lisin langa Mosis en Eran jis laik weya YAWEI bin tok basdam.

english: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”
kriol: Wal King Sol bin meigim brabli strongbala pramis langa det gel. Imbin tok, “Trubala ai dalim yu. Nobodi kaan panishim yu blanga dis ting.”

english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
kriol: Yu nomo dum eni nogudbala ting. Yu garra dum ola gudbala ting.”

english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
kriol: Ol dislot femili garra kemp sangodansaid biyain langa det Seikridwan Tent.

english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.
kriol: En if im nomo redi blanga bulurrum mi en dai blanga mi, wal im kaan jidan main wekinmen.

english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
kriol: En detlot pipul garra brabli gudbinji hu jidan trubala langa God raidap langa 1,335 dei garra binij!

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok,

english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
kriol: If yumob buldan yumob kaan stap deya, dumaji YAWEI garra album yumob en holdimap yumob garram im bingga.

english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
kriol: Wi nomo wandim wi klen garra binij, en wi garra dum samting blanga meigim det klen kipgon jidan bigismob.

english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?
kriol: Wal wen Jowab bin irrim det wed, imbin go langa King Deibid, en imbin dalim im, “Ebna bin kaman iya langa yu, en yubin larramgo im fri. Wal wotfo yubin lagijat?

english: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
kriol: Ol detlot pipul hu teiknodis langa wanim YAWEI wandim olabat blanga dum, wal olabat garra len brom im na blanga bulurrum det rait roud.

english: “In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek Yahweh their God.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Wen det taim garra kaman, detlot pipul brom Isreil en Juda garra kaman kraikraibat en lukabat blanga mi, blanga olabat God.

english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
kriol: God shoum olabat wanim nogudbala ting en praudbala ting olabat dumbat, en im gibit woning langa olabat blanga libum olabat nogudbalawei en tenim miselp langa im.

english: “Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “YAWEI bin dalim yumob pipul hu stil jidan iya langa Juda, yu kaan go langa Ijip. Wal ai garra wonim yumob na.

english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
kriol: Wal nobodi brom det taun bin jidan laibala na. Oni det gel en im femili olabat bin jidan laibala. Joshuwa bin larram olabat jidan laibala, dumaji det gel bin lukaftum det dubala men hubin go lukaran det taun basdam. En brom det taim na detlot femili blanga det gel bin oldei jidan garram ola Isreil pipul.

english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
kriol: Faiya bin kamdan langa ol detlot pipul hubin oldei bulurrumbat olabat, en det faiya bin barnimap ol detlot brabli nogudbala pipul.

english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
kriol: en dei garra meigim detlot purdibala klos du weya Eran en im fobala san garra werrim wen dei garra jidan serramonimen,

english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”
kriol: Wal ol detlot sanmob blanga Eran garra oldei dagadagat det sid daga ofring weya najalot pipul bin gibit langa mi. En enibodi mowa hu tatjimbat det sid daga ofring garra jidan brabli seikridwan.

english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
kriol: Brom deya detlot 24 olmen en detlot 4 najakain enimul bin ol baudan en weship langa God deya langa det speshal boswan tjeya. Deibin gibit theingks langa im, en deibin tok, “Yuwai! Aleiluya!”

english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok, “Wal wibin jidan langa dijan taun gulum Keidish brom longtaim na.

english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
kriol: If yu jidan gudbala en pipul abum rispek blanga yu wal tharran im mowa gudwan den yu abum loda silba en gol.

english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
kriol: Wal aibin jinggabat dijan wel igin. Det men hu ran kwikbala, im nomo win det reis olataim. En det strongwan solja, im nomo win det fait olataim. En det klebabala men, im kaan abum loda daga olataim. En det klebawan men, im nomo jidan ritjwan olataim. En det men hu sabi hau blanga dum loda ting, im nomo jidan haibala olataim. Wal diskain ting gin hepin enitaim langa enibodi laif.

english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
kriol: Ai nomo bin trikimbat main wekinmen olabat nogudbalawei en meigim olabat abum pein. If ai bina rabishim main kantri lagijat, wal det kantri bina kraikraibat.

english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
kriol: Maitbi King Hesakaiya wandim det king brom Ijip blanga album im, bat im kaan album im. Det king brom Ijip im jis laik det breikinwan wadi weya garra ardim im.

english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
kriol: En yu garra jingat brom andanith langa dijan graun blanga sambodi blanga kaman en album yu, en nobodi kaan adli irrim yu.

english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
kriol: Afta na Pol en Banabas bin stap deya lilbit longtaim garram ol detlot bilibamob.

english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
kriol: en wen Pailat bin tok, “Wujan prisana yumob wandim mi blanga larramgo fri?” Ola pipul bin jingat, “Barebas!” Wal Pailat bin tok, “Wanim ai garra dum langa Jisas weya dei gulum im Krais?” En ola pipul bin jingat, “Kilim im ded!”

english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin dalim olabat, “Yumob kaan sabi wotaim det ting garra hepin. Oni God im sabi, dumaji im na Bos, en im garra dum wen im wandim dum.

english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
kriol: Yu garra jidan gudbinji blanga ol dislot wed en yu garra kipum langa yu main.

english: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
kriol: Lagijat na deibin weshipbat langa YAWEI, en seimtaim deibin oldei weshipbat olabat ronwan drimin jis laik deibin oldei dumbat langa detlot kantri weya deibin kaman brom.

english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
kriol: Wal aibin luk deya ontop langa det fletwan ruf, en ontop langa detlot einjul gulum tjerabim samting bin deya. Imbin luk jis laik det king speshalwan tjeya, brabli shainiwan, garram purdiwan bluwan ston.

english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
kriol: Wal dumaji imbin dum dislot nogudbala ting, im en ola femili blanga im garra ol binijap.

english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
kriol: “Wal kaman na. Yu deigim dislot presen weya aibin bringimap blanga yu. God bin brabli gudbinji langa mi, en imbin gibit langa mi ebrijing.” Wal Jeikob bin kipgon tok langa Isau olawei raidap imbin deigim detlot presen.

english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’
kriol: Olabat garra kaman langa main teibul en dagat detmatj bif brom detlot hosis en soljamob. Mi na, YAWEI det boswan God bin tok dijan.”

english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
kriol: Blanga yu pipul olabat garra dumbat ola raitwan ting, en olabat garra abum olabat ronwan kantri olagijawan. Olabat jis laik detlot tri aibin plentim en meigim olabat blanga shoum main strongbala pawa langa najalot pipul.

english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
kriol: Wal wen aibin jinggabat ol dislot ting aibin fil brabli wik en bradin, en main mawus bin sheiksheik. Main boun bin gulijap barn en aibin wokwok laiga drangginbala. Bat ai garra jidan kwaitbalawei en weidabat blanga det dei bambai wen YAWEI det trubala God garra panishim melabat enami.

english: Thus all the work that Solomon did for Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.
kriol: Wal wen King Salaman bin binijimap ol dislot wek langa det Serramoni Pleis, imbin pudum ol detlot ting weya im dedi Deibid bin gibit langa YAWEI deya langa detlot stowa rum, ola silba, ola gol en ola najalot ebrijing.

english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
kriol: Bat ai garra spredimat main net en ai garra trepam im. Ai garra deigim im langa Bebalon, en im kaan luk det pleis, en deya na im garra dai.

english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
kriol: en Jisas bin dalim olabat, “Yumob bajimap sambala fish weya yumob bin gajim.”

english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
kriol: Yu garra bulurrum dijan wed brabliwei raidap det dei weya Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi garra kambek.

english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
kriol: Sambala pipul dei jis laik detlot sid weya bin buldan langa det gudwan graun. Dei irrim det wed, en dei bilib langa det wed, en det wed im wek langa olabat laif. Blendibala daga bin kamat brom detlot sid weya bin buldan langa det gudwan graun. En lagijat gin wen det wed im wek langa enibodi laif, im meigim im jidan strongbala mowa en mowa ebridei.”

english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
kriol: Sing song blanga preisim God! Sing song blanga preisim wi king!

english: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.
kriol: Bebalon, yubin jidan jis laik det golwan kap langa main bingga. Det kap bin jidan fulwan garram main einggriwan wed. Yubin meigimbat ola pipul langa dijan wel dringgim brom det kap, en tharran na bin meigim olabat jidan brabli medwan.

english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
kriol: Yu si? Det Bos blanga wi sabi hau blanga album ola gudbala pipul wen dei abum trabul, en im sabi hau blanga kipgon panishimbat ola nogudbala pipul raidap det taim weya im garra jadjim olabat en panishim olabat olagijawan.

english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
kriol: en Leimek bin gulum det lilboi neim Nowa, en imbin tok, “YAWEI det trubala God bin meigim dijan graun adwan. Bat main lilboi garra gibit melabat spel brom dumbat adwek.”

english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
kriol: “Yumob bin tok det boswan dibuldibul neim Belsibul bin gibit mi det pawa blanga andimwei dibuldibul brom enibodi. Wal yumob dalim mi na. Hubin gibit det pawa langa yumob wekinmen blanga andimwei dibuldibul? Yu si? Yumob ron wekinmen oldei andimwei dibuldibul garram det seimwan pawa laik mi, en olabat na shoum yumob weya yumob rong.

english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.
kriol: Wal wan nait dijan gel nomo bin sabi imbin rol ontop langa im beibi en det beibi bin dai.

english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.
kriol: Wen det fobala men bin kamat langa det kemp deibin gowin insaid langa wan tent en deibin dagat en dringgimbat en deibin gajim ola silba, gol en klos en deibin go blandim ol detlot. Brom deya deibin kambek en dum seimwei igin langa najawan tent.

english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
kriol: Bambai na thrideistaim Leiban bin gedim det nyus weya Jeikob bin ranawei,

english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin dalim mi, “Yu nomo preipreibat en askimbat mi blanga album dislot pipul.

english: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”
kriol: Im garram brabli gudbala main, en im sabi brabliwei blanga dalim wanim det mining blanga eni drim en najalot kleba ting du. Yu jingat blanga dijan men. Im neim Denyul yu dedi bin gulum im Beltashesa. Im na garra dalim yu wanim ol dislot wed min.” Lagijat na det mamiwan bin tok.

english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
kriol: Wal wen detlot bilibamob bin irrim det ting garra hepin, deibin jinggabat blanga jandim ola mani weya deibin abum blanga album detlot bilibamob langa Judiya,

english: They will call them “The Holy People, Yahweh’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.
kriol: Afta ai kaman, yumob neim garra jidan “Ronwan Pipul blanga YAWEI” en “Detlot Pipul weya YAWEI bin seibum”. En dei garra gibit Jerusalem nyubala neim, “Det Taun weya God Laigim” en “Det Taun weya Bigmob Pipul Jidan”.’”

english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
kriol: En im jis laik det gudsmelwan purdiflawa weya gro langa springwoda kantri.

english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
kriol: Im san blanga det kapinta, indit? Im det san blanga det wuman neim Meri, indit? En im det braja blanga detlot fobala men neim Jeims en Josef en Judas en Saiman, indit?

english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.
kriol: Olabat jingatbat blanga ola Isreil pipul jis laik detlot laiyan, en olabat bin meigim yumob kantri jidan deset kantri, en ol yumob taun jidan rabishwan na, en nobodi kaan jidan deya enimo.

english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
kriol: If yu dagat tumatj shugabeig im meigim yu git sik.

english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
kriol: En yu garra teikoba det kantri blanga det traib gulum Gebalait. En yu garra teikoba det kantri gulum Lebanan brom det taun gulum Beilged sauthsaid brom det hil gulum Heman raidap langa det jampap langa det hil gulum Heimath.

english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
kriol: Dislot na det femili lain blanga Keilab. Huwa bin det bigiswan san blanga Keilab en im waif bin neim Efrath. Det san blanga Huwa bin neim Shobal en imbin stadimap det taun gulum Kiriyajerim.

english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
kriol: Wal wantaim imbin go langa Gibiyan blanga meigim sekrifais ofring, dumaji deya na det brabliwan teibul blanga ofring bin jidan weya deibin oldei go blanga gibitbat ofring. Imbin gibit bigismob sekrifais ofring deya bifo.

english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
kriol: det King Saihan blanga det Emarait traib, en King Og brom Beishan, en ola king langa det kantri gulum Keinan.

english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
kriol: “If enibodi tatjim o garrimap eni dedwan enimul weya garram fut nomo laiga buligi, en nomo dagat gras, en eni enimul weya garram fobala sofwan fut, wal im garra lafta washim im klos, bat im kaan jidan klinbala blanga serramoni raidap sangodan.

english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
kriol: YAWEI, seibum mi brom ol detlot hu mokimbat mi, dumaji ol yu lowa brabli gudwan.

english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
kriol: Wal Kenas bin abum dubala san neim Othniyel en Seraiya. En Othniyel bin abum dubala san du, neim Hethath en Miyanothai.

english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.
kriol: Wal aibin tok, “Pipul brom Isreil, YAWEI garra bringimap bigismob pipul brom longweiwan kantri hubin jidan deya longtaim, en dei garra fait langa yumob, en olabat brabli strongwan. Det langgus olabat tok, yumob nomo sabi.

english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
kriol: en ai garra bringimbek olabat brom najalot kantri weya olabat bin oldei jidanbat. Ai garra jidan olabat stakmen, en ai garra larram olabat dagadagat daga langa det hil kantri blanga Isreil, en langa det brabli gudwan fam kantri.

english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
kriol: Wal Yuraiya bin dalim King Deibid ebrijing imbin wandi sabi, en afta Deibid bin dalim im, “Wal yu gobek langa yu ron kemp, en yu garra abum spel.” Lagijat na King Deibid bin tok, dumaji imbin wandim Yuraiya garra silip garram im waif wulijim ola pipul garra reken det beibi blanga Yuraiya. Wal Yuraiya bin gowei brom King Deibid, en King Deibid bin jandim presen blanga im biyain langa im kemp.

english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
kriol: Deibin meigim 100 raunwan hol garram bluwan matiriyal en deibin pudum 50 langa det longwan saidpat blanga wanbala bigwan matiriyal en det naja 50 seimwei langa det najawan bigwan matiriyal, en afta deibin joinimap det dubala saidpat garram 50 dabulwan huk garram gol.

english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
kriol: En wi sabi God bin meigim bigmob pramis langa oltestaman taim. En God bin meigim detlot pramis kamat trubala wen Jisas Krais bin kaman. En blanga tharran na wi oldei preisimbat God en tok, “Trubala.”

english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
kriol: Brom deya det tenbala braja blanga Josef bin ol go langa Ijip blanga baiyim daga.

english: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
kriol: En King Nebakanesa bin gibit oda langa im wekinmen olabat blanga gibitbat detlot yangmen det seimkain daga en wain weya det king en im femili olabat bin oldei dagat. Imbin tok detlot yangmen garra lafta dagadagatbat det speshalwan daga blanga thribala yiya, en bambai afta det thribala yiya bin binij, en wen olabat bin sabi, wal olabat garra jidan redibala blanga wek blanga im na.

english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
kriol: Yu si? Det taim na det san hubin bon eniwei bin meigim trabul blanga det san hubin bon wen det Spirit blanga God bin wek. En im lagijat gin tudei.

english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.
kriol: Fobala teibul bin deya langa det atsaidwan yad. Dubala teibul bin jidan langa tusaid deya langa detlot step weya im gowap langa det feswan rum.

english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
kriol: bat bambai na im garra libum yu en meigim yu jidan brabli nogudbinji garram loda pein.

english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
kriol: Det God blanga yu grenfatha Eibrahem en det drimin blanga main dedi Neihowa dubala jidan witnis blanga meiksho yunmi kipum det pramis.” Lagijat na Leiban bin tok. Wal Jeikob bin meigim det pramis garram Leiban, en imbin tok, “Det God blanga main dedi Aisik im sabi aibin tok ai garra kipum dis pramis garram yu.”

english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
kriol: Wal mi nomo tok lagijat blanga meigim yumob gibit mi enijing, dumaji aibin len hau blanga jidan sedisfaid nomeda wanim ai garram.

english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
kriol: Yu garra teikoba det kantri gulum Filastain, en yu garra teikoba detlot faibala taun du weya detlot king blanga detlot Filastain pipul jidan. Detlot faibala taun dei gulum Gasa, Eshdad, Eshkalan, Geth en Ekran. En yu garra teikoba det kantri gulum Geshuwa en det kantri sauthwei blanga det traib gulum Eibait. En yu garra teikoba det kantri weya im go brom det krik gulum Shihowa Krik deya langa det boda blanga det kantri gulum Ijip nowathwei raidap langa det taun gulum Ekran.

english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
kriol: “Wal det serramonimen kaan kadim im heya o sheibum im wiska o kadim miselp eniweya langa im bodi, blanga meigim miselp luk soribala.

english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
kriol: Dumaji blanga melabat nogudbalawei deibin beldim im, en gibit im loda pein langa im bodi. Imbin deigim det panishmen blanga melabat en imbin meigim melabat jidan brabli gudbalawei.

english: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.
kriol: Hubin irrim dislot ting, en hu reken im hepin lagijat? Yumob reken ola pipul langa wanbala kantri gin bon seimdei, o gidap laibala seimtaim? Jerusalem im jis laik det mamiwan hubin stat abumbat pein, en det beibi bin bon streidawei.

english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Ol detlot Moweb pipul bin jandim sambala yangwan ship blanga presen blanga det boswan langa Jerusalem. Olabat bin deigim detlot ship thru langa det deset kantri, brom Sela raidap langa Jerusalem deya langa det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan.

english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
kriol: Wen mi hatjamp en wori, yu lidimap mi en meigim mi gudbinji.

english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;
kriol: Blanga detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Idam YAWEI bin tok, “Detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Idam oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en blanga tharran na ai garra panishim olabat. Yumob ol jidan braja gija bat detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum Idam bin ranimapbat yumob brom yumob kantri garram bigwan naif en deibin tridimbat yumob krulbalawei, dumaji longtaim deibin abum nogud filing langa yumob en dei kipgon lagijat tudei.

english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
kriol: Wal brom insaid langa det fish binji Jona bin jingat langa YAWEI det trubala God.

english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
kriol: Wal bambai wen ai kaman deya, ai garra dalim yu en ol detlot Kristjan pipul deya blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya im oldei dumbat. Im oldei dalimbat laiyawan stori blanga mi en blanga ol detlot Kristjan braja blanga wi hu oldei go en spredimatbat det gudnyus. Bat nomo oni tharran. Im nomo oldei jingat gudbinjiwei en welkam detlot Kristjan braja blanga wi wen dei oldei go deya, en im nomo larram detlot Kristjan pipul deya langa det tjetj welkam olabat du, en im oldei andimwei enibodi brom det tjetj if dei album olabat.

english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
kriol: Jedaiya bin det san blanga Joiyarib en Jeikin.

english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”
kriol: En ai garra bringimbek olabat langa Jerusalem weya dei garra jidan main pipul olabat en ai garra jidan garram olabat. Ai garra jidan trubala langa main pipul en ai garra tridim olabat raitwei. En ai garra jidan God blanga olabat.

english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.
kriol: Wen Jehoiyakim bin jidan king, King Nebakanesa brom Bebalon bin teikoba Juda. Imbin meigim King Jehoiyakim prisana en taiyimap im garram tjein en imbin deigim im langa det meinwan taun blanga Bebalon.

english: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
kriol: “Afta na YAWEI bin jingat brom ontop jis laiga thanda, en ebribodi bin irrim det haibala God weya bin jingat,

english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
kriol: Wal detlot pipul bin tok, “Dijan im det speshalwan mesinja blanga God neim Jisas. Imbin kaman brom Nesareth deya langa Gelali.”

english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
kriol: Wal Beka bin abum nainbala san neim Semira, Jowesh, Eliyeisa, Eliyeinai, Omri, Jeramath, Abaija, Einathoth en Elamath.

english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—
kriol: en wen imbin gibit im ol detlot enijing, King Deibid bin meigim detlot ting seikridwan blanga YAWEI. En King Deibid bin dum lagijat du langa ol detlot gol en silba weya imbin gajimbat brom detlot Idam pipul en detlot Mowebait pipul en detlot Eman pipul en detlot Filastain pipul en detlot Amalek pipul wen imbin bidim olabat. En imbin dum lagijat du langa detlot enijing weya imbin gajim brom King Heidadesa.

english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
kriol: En longtaim langa det oltestaman God bin tok im garra meigim ol detlot Jintail pipul hu bilib jidan raitwei langa im. Det taim na imbin gibit det Gudnyus langa Eibrahem. Imbin tok, “Garram yu na ai garra meigim ola traib langa ebri kantri brabli gudbinji.”

english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
kriol: en yumob sabi bifo melabat bin kaman langa yumob, ol detlot pipul deya langa det najawan taun gulum Filapai bin tridim melabat brabli nogudbalawei, en deibin tok nogudbalawei langa melabat du, en nomeda loda pipul nomo bin laigim melabat, bat stil God bin meigim melabat brabli strongbala blanga dalimbat yumob det gudnyus blanga im.

english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
kriol: Wal God na meigim pipul trastim im blanga det olagijawan laif, en mi askim im blanga meigim yumob brabli gudbinji en jidan gudwei weya yumob bilib langa im wulijim det Holi Spirit garra meigim yumob kipgon trastim im mowa en mowa.

english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.
kriol: en ontop langa detlot bigwan hil deya langa det opinwan kantri. Ai garra meigim detlot enami blanga yumob garra gajim yumob mani en gol en gudwan ting, dumaji ebriweya langa yumob kantri yumob bin dumbat nogudbala ting.

english: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
kriol: “Nomeda YAWEI det trubala God bin brabli wail langa mi bat stil im laigim mi detmatj en im kaan neba stap laigimbat mi, en im oldei kain langa mi.

english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
kriol: “‘Nomo eni drimin jidan laibala. Oni mi na det trubalawan God. Mi na gibit laif, en mi na deigimwei laif. Mi na meigim yumob ardimbat, en mi na meigim yumob gudbala, en nobodi gin tjeinjim wanim ai dum.

english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
kriol: Wal det men hubin oldei jidan blainwan bin tok, “Bos, yu dalim mi hu im wulijim ai garra bilib langa im.”

english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
kriol: If yu haidim ol yu nogudbalawei yu kaan jidan gudwei. Bat if yu onap wanim yubin dum en yu nomo dum detlot ting enimo, God garra jidan kainbala langa yu.

english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
kriol: Wal Josef en im pramis Meri bin go langa Bethlahem blanga gibit dubala neim. Meri bin jidan femiliwei,

english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
kriol: en streidawei dubala bin gajim bleingkit, en dubala bin deigim det bleingkit langa det tent blanga dubala dedi. Dubala nomo bin wandi luk dubala dedi leidan neigidbala, en dubala bin lafta ribesbek garram det bleingkit langa dubala sholda, en dubala bin larramgo det bleingkit, en det bleingkit bin gaburrumap det neigidbala.

english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
kriol: Meidai, Emrem, Yuwel, Benaiya, Bedeiya, Kelahai, Banai, Meremoth, Eliyashib, Metanaiya, Metenai en Jasu brom det femili blanga Bani,

english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.
kriol: Yumob laiga gelwan dongki hu oldei ran kwikbala langa det deset kantri wen im wandim meit. Yumob reken enibodi gin hendulum im? If det boiwan dongki wandim det gelwan dongki blanga jidan im meit, wal im kaan wori, dumaji det gelwan dongki oldei wandim im langa det rait taim blanga abum meit.

english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
kriol: Wal afta detlot 40 dei en 40 nait YAWEI bin gibit langa mi det dubala ston weya imbin raidimdan det brabli strongbala pramis.

english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
kriol: en yu garra pudum det dubala pol langa detlot fobala ring blanga garrimap det boks. Wanbala pol garra jidan disaid en wanbala najasaid,

english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
kriol: Lagijat na imbin tok langa olabat streidat. Wal Pida bin grebum Jisas, en imbin deigim im wansaid, en imbin dalim Jisas nomo blanga toktok im garra dai.

english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.
kriol: Afta na deibin larramgo det dubala buligi garram det wegan, en dubala bin go streit langa det roud weya im go langa det taun gulum Bethshemesh. Nomeda dubala bin jingatjingat olawei, bat stil dubala bin bulurrumbat det seim roud. Wal detlot faibala Filastain king bin bulurrumbat det wegan longwei biyain wotjimbat det wegan raidap det wegan bin krosim det boda blanga det kantri.

english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
kriol: Det lait blanga God im shain brom Saiyan, det brabli purdiwan taun, nomo garram enijing rong.

english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
kriol: en detlot wekinmen bin hatjamp brabliwei, dumaji wen deibin gowei garram det bout, dei nomo bin sabi wotkain men Jisas wen imbin fidim det bigmob pipul garram det faibala daga. Deibin jadimap olabat hat en main.

english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
kriol: Det men na nomo bin jinggabat blanga jidan kainbala. Imbin oldei gibitbat adtaim langa ola powan pipul en langa detlot hu nomo bin abum enijing en langa detlot hubin jidan nogudbinjiwei, raidap sambala bin dai.

english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.
kriol: Imbin teikoba ola kantri brom det hil gulum Heilak sauthwei gulijap langa det kantri gulum Idam raidap langa det taun gulum Beilged deya langa det kantri gulum Lebanan Beli disaid langa det hil gulum Heman.

english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram which had two horns stood before the river. The two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
kriol: En deya na aibin luk boiwan ship bin jandap wansaid langa det riba. Det bigwan ship bin abum dubala longwan hon. Wanbala hon bin brabli longwan en mowa nyuwan langa det najawan hon.

english: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.
kriol: Im garra meigim pramis garram najalot king, bat im garra jidan brabli trikibala langa det najalot king, en im garra jidan brabli strongbala boswan nomeda oni lilbit pipul jidan deya langa im kantri.

english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
kriol: “Yumob sabi wanim mi toktok? Yumob nomo wandi tridim eni biginini o enibodi nogudwei, dumaji det einjul blanga im oldei jidan deya garram main Dedi langa hebin.

english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
kriol: Ebrijing weya King Omri bin dumbat deibin raidimdan langa det buk gulum Ola stori blanga detlot king blanga Isreil.

english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
kriol: Bat detlot Juwish bos nomo bin wandi larramgo mi, en nomeda ai nomo bin wandi kotim olabat, bat stil deibin fosim mi blanga kaman iya en abum det kotkeis langa det haibala Roman kot.

english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin gowei brom det haus, en imbin luk wan men neim Libai bin jidanbat deya langa det haus weya imbin oldei gajimbat mani blanga det gabman, en Jisas bin dalim im, “Yu bulurrum mi.”

english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
kriol: en wen Pol bin kaman deya, detlot Juwish lida bin jandap olaran langa im, en deibin tok imbin dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. Bat dei nomo bin abum pruf.

english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
kriol: En King Jerabowam bin bildimap detlot weship pleis ontop langa ola haiwan hil du, en imbin pikimat ola serramonimen brom detlot Isreil pipul, bat dei nomo bin brom Libai klen.

english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
kriol: Wal nomo eni woda bin deya weya deibin silip. Wal detlot pipul bin majurrumap miselp langa Mosis en Eran.

english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
kriol: “‘Wal YAWEI garra panishim enibodi hu nomo gibit feyago langa detlot pipul brom najawan kantri, o detlot biginini hu nomo garram dedi o mami, o detlot widogel.’ “En ola pipul garra tok, ‘Yuwai! Trubala dijan im tok!’

english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin jandim im mesinja blanga faindat hu det gel, en det mesinja bin faindat det gel bin neim Bethsheba, en im dedi bin neim Eliyam. En imbin faindat det gel bin merrit langa wan Hitait men neim Yuraiya.

english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin dalim Matha, “Yu braja garra gidap laibala.”

english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
kriol: Main pipul olabat, ai kaan jidan wailwan olataim, en ai kaan kipgon faindimbat folt langa yumob. Dumaji mi na bin meigim yumob. Ai nomo wandim yumob garra gibap.

english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
kriol: Wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, “God bin meigim det main blanga olabat go dimwan, en raidap tudei dei kaan irrim det trubala wed en sabi det trubalawei.”

english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.
kriol: Bat ol detlot pipul hubin jidan langa Samariya bin kipgon meigimbat olabat ronwan drimin sheip en deibin pudum olabat langa ola weship pleis en teibul blanga ofring weya ola Isreil pipul bin meigim basdam. Ola difrin pipul brom najalot kantri hubin jidan deya bin meigim olabat ronwan drimin sheip.

english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
kriol: Lagijat na deibin askimbat Jisas blanga trikim im, dumaji deibin wandi faindim folt langa im. Wal Jisas bin jukdan, en imbin raidimdan samting langa graun garram im bingga,

english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
kriol: Salaman bin abum bigbala fam garram loda greiptri langa det pleis Beilaman. Imbin kadimat det fam en gibit langa najalot. En ebri fama bin peiyim im 1,000 silba mani brom selimbat ola frut daga.

english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
kriol: Yu nomo jis toktok langa olabat. Yu garra shoum olabat hau dei garra jidan gudbalawei. En wen yu tok langa olabat, yu garra tok brabli streitbalawei.

english: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
kriol: Aibin luk wanim nogudbala ting detlot mesinjamob bin oldei dumbat langa Sameriya. Olabat bin oldei toktokbat garram det neim blanga Beil. Deibin lidimbat main pipul olabat nogudbalawei.

english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
kriol: Herod bin dum lagijat langa Jon Beptis, dumaji imbin merrit langa im ron braja Filip waif neim Herodiyas, en Jon Beptis bin dalimbat im, “Yu kaan pulumat det gel brom yu braja en merrit langa im. Im nomo rait.”

english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
kriol: Wal nogudbala men mait dum loda nogudbala ting langa im laif en stil jidan laibala longtaim. Bat ai sabi im trubala, “If yu rispek en duwit wanim God wandim, wal ebrijing garra jidan gudwei blanga yu bambai.

english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.
kriol: Wal aibin dalim Sedakaiya wanim YAWEI det brabli boswan God blanga Isreil bin tok, “If yu gibit miselp langa detlot Bebalon ami, yu garra jidan laibala, en dijan taun kaan barnbarn. Yu en yu femilimob garra jidan laibala.

english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.
kriol: Detlot ston weya bin buldan nobodi kaan neba yusumbat igin blanga bildimapbat. Yu garra jidan jis laik det deset olagijawan.

english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.
kriol: Brom deya det boda bin go sangodanwei langa det kantri weya detlot pipul gulum Jeiflatait bin jidan, en brom deya imbin go langa det dubala taun gulum Lowabetharan en Gisa olawei raidap langa det solwoda gulum Medatareiniyan.

english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.
kriol: Yu nomo sabi hau det nyuwan laif bin stat. Wal hau yu garra sabi ebrijing God dum wen imbin meigim ebrijing?

english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
kriol: Yu album melabat fait langa dislot enami. Pipul kaan album melabat. Najing! Olabat nomo strongwan.

english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
kriol: “Afta na ola tri bin dalim det Figtri, ‘Yu kaman en jidan king blanga melabat.’

english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
kriol: Yumob bin abum blendibala milk brom buligi en nenigout. Yumob bin abum gudwan ship en buligi en nenigout. Yumob bin abum loda gudwan sid daga en gudwan wain.

english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.
kriol: “En YAWEI garra jandim brabli nogudwan siknis langa ola enimul langa ola enami kemp du. Ola hosis en mul en kemul en dongki garra abum det siknis.

english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
kriol: En detlot najalot Isreil pipul kaan kaman langa det Seikridwan Tent enimo. If olabat kaman gulijap wal dei garra dai.

english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? Im lagijat gin weya dedbala pipul gidap laibala brom dedbala. Yu si? Wen pipul gaburrumap det dedbala bodi, det bodi im dedwan. Bat wen God meigim det bodi gidap brom dedbala, det bodi garra jidan laibala olagijawan.

english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
kriol: Wotfo yubin larram mi jidan laibala wen aibin bon? Mobeda ai bina dai bifo aibin bon,

english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin tok langa ola wekinmen blanga im, “Sambala pipul garra temtimbat yumob blanga meigim yumob go langa det nogudbalawei. Bat God garra panishim brabliwei ol detlot pipul hu temtimbat enibodi.

english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
kriol: Yumob garra jidan gudbinji langa YAWEI en yumob garra kaman garram yumob biginini en ola wekinmen en wekingel en det Libai klen en detlot pipul nomo blanga yumob kantrimen olabat en detlot biginini nomo garram mami en dedi en detlot widogel weya dei jidan langa yumob kantri. En yumob garra weship YAWEI deya langa det wanbala pleis.

english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
kriol: Wal ol yumob Kristjan Jintail pipul nomo jidan longwei brom God na, en yumob nomo streinja langa ol detlot pramis blanga im, dumaji yumob blanga God pipul na, en yumob blanga God femili.

english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.
kriol: Bat Ishmeil en eitbala men blanga im bin ranawei brom Johanan en deibin go langa det kantri gulum Eman.

english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
kriol: Wal ola Isreil pipul bin askim miselp, “Hu garra jidan lida blanga ola solja blanga wi en lidim olabat blanga fait langa detlot Emanait solja? Wal det men hu garra jidan lida blanga wi solja olabat, afta wen dijan fait binij, im na garra jidan lida blanga ol wi Isreil pipul iya langa dijan kantri.”

english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
kriol: “‘Wen det dei garra kaman, ai sabi yu, Gog garra jinggabat blanga meigim nogudwan plen

english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? Yumob kaan tok enijing blanga detlot wekinmen hu garram olabat ron bos, dumaji olabat ron bos garra kotim olabat if dei dumbat gudbala ting o nogudbala ting. En ai sabi dei garra dum gudbala ting, dumaji Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi garra meigim olabat strongbala blanga dumbat gudbala ting.

english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
kriol: Ola pipul brom najalot kantri garra sabi deibin deigidawei detlot Isreil pipul brom olabat ronwan kantri, dumaji olabat bin dum brabli nogudbala ting langa mi, en aibin gibit bekboun langa main pipul olabat en aibin jandim olabat enami blanga go en fait en kilim olabat.

english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
kriol: Wal streidawei det dubala braja gija bin libum dubala fishnet en ebrijing, en dubala bin bulurrum Jisas.

english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
kriol: Wal yumob bin brabli gudbinji basdam. Trubala ai dalim yumob. Yumob bin dum ebrijing blanga album mi, en if ai bina askim yumob blanga gibit mi yumob ai dubala, blanga album mi blanga luk, wal yumob bina deigimat dubala en gibit langa mi. Wal wanim bin hepin langa yumob na?

english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
kriol: If yu oldei wotjim wanim yu tok, wal yu garra kipawei brom loda trabul.

english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
kriol: Det gudwan wed brom sambodi gin album pipul jis laik det freshwan springwoda weya gibit laif langa ebrijing.

english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
kriol: Yumob jinggabat detlot 40 yiya na weya YAWEI bin deigim wi thru det deset kantri. Imbin jandim detlot trabul blanga meigim yumob jidan lobala en blanga testimbat yumob, wulijim im gin luk wanim yumob garra dum en if yumob garra bulurrumap im trubalawei.

english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
kriol: Yumob Juda en Isreil pipul! Bifo wen detlot pipul brom ola najalot kantri bin wandi tok nogud ting langa enibodi deibin oldei tok, ‘Wi wandim ola nogud ting blanga hepin langa yumob laik deibin hepin langa detlot Juda en Isreil pipul!’ Bat ai garra seibum yumob en afta wen detlot pipul brom ola najalot kantri garra wandi tok gudwei langa enibodi dei garra tok, ‘Wi wandim ola gudbala ting blanga hepin langa yumob laik deibin hepin langa ola Juda en Isreil pipul!’ Wal yumob garra jidan strongbalawei en nomo bradin.”

english: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
kriol: “Ol yumob pipul yumob brabli adwan pipul. Yumob oldei gibit mi bekboun, en yumob nomo jidan seifwan. Wal yumob lisin langa mi na.

english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
kriol: Wal maitbi sambala pipul deya langa yumob bilib hafenhaf. Wal yumob garra tok gudbalawei langa olabat, en yumob garra album olabat bilib brabliwei.

english: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
kriol: Melabat garra dum wanim YAWEI bin dalim melabat blanga dum. Wal melabat garra go kros langa det kantri gulum Keinan en melabat garra fait, wulijim melabat garra abum dijan kantri sanraisaid langa det Jodan Riba.” Lagijat na deibin tok.

english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
kriol: Yumob bin rabishim yumob ronselp wen yumob bin bulurrum ol detlot drimin blanga najalot kantri. Yumob garra nogudbinji dregli langa Ijip, jis laik yumob bin nogudbinji langa Asiriya.

english: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
kriol: Wen YAWEI tok im breigimap detlot strongwan tri, ol detlot strongwan sidatri na langa Lebanan.

english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat na. Maitbi sambala Kristjan pipul tok, “Wi gin dum enijing, dumaji Jisas Krais bin meigim wi jidan fri.” Wal im trubala tharran. En ai gin tok lagijat du. Ai gin tok, “Mi lau dum enijing.” Bat nomo ebrijing gudwan blanga wi, en ai nomo wandim enijing blanga jidan bos blanga mi.

english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
kriol: detlot na garra jidan langa det brabli gudbala kantri ontop langa det brabli haibala hil. Deya na olabat garra abum loda daga en woda.”

english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
kriol: Wal det boswan solja bin deigim det yangboi langa det bos blanga ola solja, en imbin tok, “Det prisana neim Pol bin jingat langa mi, en imbin dalim mi blanga bringimap dijan yangboi iya langa yu, dumaji im garram wed blanga yu.”

english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
kriol: Yu nomo laigim ola nogudbala jadj hu oldei gibit adtaim langa pipul. Dei nomo jadjim pipul raitwei garram ol yu lowa.

english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken.
kriol: Detlot enami garra kaman langa eni taun en binijimap olabat. Ola hil kantri en plein kantri garra jidan rabishwan.

english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
kriol: Bat afta wen aibin deigimwei olabat, ai garra fil sori blanga olabat, en ai garra bringimbek ol detlot pipul langa olabat ronwan kantri na.

english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
kriol: En maitbi det irriwol blanga wi reken im nomo blanga wi bodi, dumaji im nomo det ai. Bat stil im blanga wi bodi.

english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.
kriol: Ol melabat king olabat en melabat boswan olabat en ol melabat serramonimen olabat en melabat grengrenfatha olabat nomo bin duwit langa yu lowa. Yubin dalim olabat langa det lowa, bat dei nomo bin irrim yu.

english: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Yahweh your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”
kriol: Ailibala neksdei ol detlot pipul bin go langa det deset kantri gulijap langa Tekowa, en wen deibin stat blanga gowei King Jehosafet bin tok langa ola pipul brom Juda en Jerusalem, “Yumob garra oldei trastimbat YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob, en yumob garra bilib langa detlot wekinmen blanga im du wen olabat dalimbat yumob stori blanga im, dumaji oni YAWEI na gin album yumob blanga enijing. Yumob garra jinggabat langa im olataim.”

english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
kriol: Imbin wandim yumob blanga jidan gudbinjiwei langa yumob ronwan kantri, bat yumob nomo lisin langa im.

english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
kriol: Wal seimtaim wen Pol bin go langa det dubala kantri, wan Juwish men brom det taun gulum Eliksendriya bin go langa det taun gulum Efasas. Det men bin neim Apalas, en imbin sabi det oltestaman brabliwei, en imbin sabi hau blanga tok du.

english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
kriol: Wal YAWEI nomo laigim wen yu larramgo fri detlot pipul hubin dum nogudbala ting, o wen yu lokimap detlot pipul hu nomo gilti.

english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
kriol: Bat ol detlot pipul hu duwit langa God wed, oni olabat na laigim im brabliwei. Yumob sabi na? If enibodi reken im jidan garram God, wal im garra jidan seimwei laik Jisas Krais bin jidan. Lagijat na wi sabi trubala wi jidan garram God.

english: Today you go out in the month Abib.
kriol: Tudei na langa dijan feswan manth blanga wi gulum Abib wibin gowei brom det kantri,

english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
kriol: Brom deya aibin luk det yangwan ship bin deigimat det namba 6 bush gam brom det rolapwan peipa. Wen imbin deigimat, det graun bin sheik detmatj na, en det san bin go dakbala jis laik blekwan klos, en det mun bin go brabli redwan jis laik blad.

english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
kriol: Ai nomo bin tok enijing. Aibin jidan kwaitwan nomeda aibin jinggabat blanga tok blanga gudbala ting. Bat aibin fil brabli nogudbinji.

english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,
kriol: Wal wen det serramonimen bin ridimat det buk blanga Mosis, detlot pipul bin irrim det wed. En deibin faindat detlot pipul langa det dubala kantri gulum Eman en Moweb kaan joinap garram olabat,

english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
kriol: God, yu jidan brabli haibalawan bos, en pipul sabi yu jidan bos raitwei en yu oldei gibit feyago. Olabat sabi yu filing blanga laigim olabat en det trubalawei blanga yu.

english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
kriol: “Go langa detlot men neim Heldai, Tobija, en Jedaiya hubin kambek brom Bebalon weya deibin jidan prisana. Gajim silba en gol brom olabat en deigim streitawei langa det haus blanga Josaiya, det san blanga Sefanaiya.

english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin askim im na, “Wanim yu reken blanga main wekinmen neim Job? Nomo enibodi langa dijan wel wulijim im. En imbin oldei rispek langa mi brabliwei en imbin jandap brabli strongbala en im nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting. Yubin askim mi blanga larram yu dum ol detlot nogudbala ting langa im blanga najing, bat stil im kipgon weshipbat mi brabliwei, nomeda imbin lujim ebrijing.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
kriol: En King Deibid bin dalim Ebishai det braja blanga Jowab, “Yu sabi? Ebsalom bin gibit wi trabul. Bat Shiba garra gibit wi bigismob trabul. Wal yu garra deigim main solja olabat, en yumob garra aftum Shiba en grebum im bifo im deigim im men olabat langa strongbala taun weya wi kaan bidim olabat.”

english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
kriol: Wal ol detlot grengrenfathamob blanga Jisas, 14 dedi bin bulurrum miselp brom Eibrahem raidap langa Deibid, en 14 dedi bin bulurrum miselp brom Deibid raidap det taim wen olabat bin gowei prisana langa Bebalon, en 14 dedi bin bulurrum miselp brom det prisanataim raidap det taim wen Jisas Krais bin bon.

english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
kriol: en deya na sambala pipul bin bringimap wanbala men langa Jisas. Det men bin def, en im nomo bin oldei tok gudwei, en detlot pipul bin askim Jisas blanga pudum im bingga langa det defwan men.

english: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
kriol: If wanbala dedwan enimul buldan langa detlot sid daga weya dei garra plentimbat, wal det sid garra jidan klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
kriol: en imbin jidan langa det helfaiya. Deya na imbin ardimbat detmatj, en imbin luk langa top, en imbin luk Eibrahem longwei garram Lesaras wansaid langa im.

english: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”
kriol: Wal mi na Aisaiya tok, “Ol yumob Isreil pipul, oni melabat God na gin seibum melabat, bat im adwan blanga melabat blanga sabi.

english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
kriol: en YAWEI bin dalim Hoseiya, “Yu garra gulum det lilboi neim Nomo Main Pipul. Bat garram yu ronwan langgus yu garra gulum im neim Lowami, dumaji ola Isreil pipul nomo main pipul, en mi nomo God blanga olabat.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
kriol: Olabat holot bin abum fobala feis en fobala wing, en deibin abum fobala bingga wulijim men andanith langa olabat wing. Detlot seimwan tjerabim na aibin luk deya langa det Keba Riba basdam en ol detlot tjerabim bin ol mub wanwei. Detlot seimwan tjerabim na aibin luk basdam.

english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
kriol: Wal imbin gibit miselp langa mi, en im kaan meigimbat miselp nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, en im kaan gowin langa haus weya eni dedwan bodi jidan en meigim main Seikridwan Tent nomo klinbala blanga serramoni, nomeda if det dedbala im ronwan mami o dedi.

english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
kriol: en deibin tok, “Titja, melabat sabi yu oldei tok det trubala wed streidat langa enibodi, en yu nomo teiknodis wanim olabat jinggabat. Nomeda hau hai det men im jidan, bat stil yu oldei dalim im streidat blanga wanim God wandim im blanga dum. Wal yu dalim melabat na. Yu reken im rait det haibala gabman bos gin meigim melabat peiyim teks mani langa im? Melabat garra peiyim det mani o najing?”

english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”
kriol: Wal Serai bin dalim Eibram, “Yubin meigim trabul blanga mi na. Aibin gibit yu main wekingel, en wanim bin hepin? Wen imbin faindim det beibi, imbin stat lukdan langa mi na. Wal YAWEI garra faindat hu rait langa yunmi.”

english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
kriol: Brom deya det sekanwan einjul bin blowim im longwan wisul na, en wen det longwan wisul bin jingat, samting jis laiga bigwan hil garram faiya ebriwei bin kamat, en sambodi bin tjakamdan det hil insaid langa solwoda, en haf solwoda bin go blad,

english: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;
kriol: “Wal YAWEI bin tok langa mi, ‘Detlot wuman brom Jerusalem olabat brabli praudbala, en olabat oldei wokwok en winkimbat olabat ai langa enibodi, en olabat nomo sheim blanga dum detkain ting. Olabat oldei werrimonbat purdiwan tjein langa olabat eingkul blanga meigimbat nois blanga meigim ebribodi luk langa olabat wen olabat wokwokbat.

english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
kriol: Wen wikitwan pipul jidan bos, loda brabli nogudbala ting garra hepin, bat detlot pipul hu dumbat rait ting garra luk detlot wikitwan pipul garra binij.

english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
kriol: En wen Mosis bin midap garram olabat, Mosis bin brabli wail langa detlot boswan hubin kambek.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
kriol: Wal ola femili brom Esha klen bin gedim ol detlot taun en ol detlot kantri na.

english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
kriol: en imbin dai wen imbin brabli olmen. Imbin gajimap 950 yiya bifo imbin dai.

english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
kriol: Afta imbin heingimap det ketin langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent,

english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.
kriol: Wal afta wen Gidiyan bin dai, ola Isreil pipul nomo bin bulurrum YAWEI. Deibin gibit im bekboun, en deibin bulurrum det drimin gulum Beil, en deibin meigim drimin sheip, en deibin gulum det sheip Beilberith, en deibin weship im na.

english: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
kriol: en dei nomo askimbat mi blanga enijing na. Dei oldei go en askimbat detlot drimin sheip weya deibin meigim brom wud, en dei oldei gedim olabat ensa brom detlot wud na. “Wal main pipul olabat bin oldei gibit mi bekboun, en dei oldei go langa ol detlot drimin sheip jis laik det gel weya im oldei go en silipsilipbat garram eni men.

english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
kriol: “Wal yubin meigim mi brabli gudbinji wen yu kaman iya, dumaji yu na mami blanga det brabli haibala Bos.

english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
kriol: Ai dalim yumob wotfo. Detlot pipul blanga God irrim det wed blanga God. Bat yumob nomo irrim det wed, dumaji yumob nomo blanga God.”

english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.
kriol: En wen enibodi bin oldei redi blanga baudan lida langa Ebsalom blanga shoum rispek langa im, Ebsalom bin oldei grebum im, en kis langa im blanga meigim im laigim im.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin dalim Mosis, “Det king kaan stil lisin langa yu, dumaji ai garra stil dum loda klebabala ting langa dijan kantri.”

english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
kriol: Wal wen Ishboseth bin irrim Ebna tok lagijat, im nomo bin tok enijing, dumaji imbin brabli bradin langa Ebna.

english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.
kriol: If enibodi go atsaid, im garra dai. Wal tharran im ronwan folt. Im nomo folt blanga melabat. Bat if sambodi kaman en ardim yumob insaid langa dijan haus, wal im folt blanga melabat, en melabat garra pei.

english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
kriol: Sambala pipul oldei trastimbat olabat wegan en hosis weya dei yusumbat langa wo, bat melabat oldei trastimbat det pawa blanga YAWEI det God blanga melabat.

english: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.
kriol: “Wal Denyul, detmatj pipul garra fait langa det king brom Ijip. En sambala nogudbala men brom yu ronwan kantri Isreil garra fait langa detlot Ijip pipul. Dei garra fait langa olabat dumaji wanbala drim deibin luk, bat dei kaan win.

english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
kriol: en afta deibin go langa Jon, en deibin dalim im, “Titja, yu sabi det men neim Jisas hubin deya garram yu najasaid langa det Jodan Riba weya yubin dalimbat melabat blanga im? Wal im beptaisimbat pipul na, en loda pipul oldei go langa im.”

english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
kriol: If yumob pipul blanga Rubin en Ged nomo duwit blanga bulurrum im na, im garra libum ol dislot pipul langa det deset kantri, en yumob garra jidan gilti blanga det strongwan panishmen blanga olabat.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.
kriol: Modakai bin jandimbek im wed. Imbin tok, “Esta yu nomo reken miselp, ‘Ai jidan iya langa dis king haus. Maitbi dei garra kilim ded detlot najalot Juwish pipul, bat dei kaan kilim mi.’

english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says Yahweh.
kriol: Langa detlot taun langa det bigwan en lilwan hil kantri, en langa Juda sauthsaid, en langa det kantri blanga Benjamin en langa detlot lilwan taun raidaran langa Jerusalem, en langa detlot taun blanga Juda, ola stakmen garra kaundimap olabat shipmob igin.

english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
kriol: En wen enibodi bin oldei bringimap enimul blanga abum det sekrifais serramoni, deibin oldei kadimof det fet brom det bifpat, en deibin oldei barnim det fet, en afta deibin oldei boilim det bifpat. Bat det wekinmen blanga det dubala serramonimen bin oldei askim det men hubin oldei gibit det ofring blanga bif. Imbin oldei tok, “Yu gibit mi det bif blanga det dubala serramonimen. Dubala nomo laigim boilwan bif. Dubala wandim rauwan bif brom yu, dumaji dubala wandi rostim det bif.”

english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
kriol: Bat im nomo bin hepin lagijat langa tharran weya God bin meigim im gidap laibala.

english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
kriol: Deya na imbin dum ola klebabala ting blanga panishim det king en ol im brabli haibala wekinmen olabat.

english: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok, “Ol yumob biginini, yumob garra irrim mi na. Ai nomo bin libum yumob mami. Ai nomo bin selim yumob oni blanga gajim mani blanga peiyimbek det mani. Nomo. Yumob bin libum mi, dumaji yumob bin oldei dumbat olkainaba nogudbala ting.

english: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
kriol: “Ola Isreil pipul bin bulurrum detlot laiyawan drimin. En ai garra larram olabat go olabat ronwei na.
