english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
kriol: Enibodi hu dum krulbala ting langa ola powan pipul, im nomo shoum rispek langa God hubin meigim olabat, bat det men hu kain langa enibodi, wal im jis laik im weshipbat God wen im dum lagijat.

english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
kriol: Bambai na Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin dagadagat daga langa det kemp blanga Methyu, en loda nogudbala pipul en detlot men hubin oldei wek garram Methyu bin ol kaman deya, en deibin dagadagat daga garram olabat.

english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
kriol: Afta na wen Abimalek bin dai, wanbala men neim Tola bin kaman blanga seibum ola Isreil pipul brom olabat enami. Im dedi bin neim Puwa, en im grenfatha bin neim Dodo, en imbin brom det Isaka klen, en imbin brom det taun gulum Shamiya deya langa det hil kantri blanga Ifreiyim klen.

english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
kriol: Im garra jidan olagija jis laik det mun, weya im jidan trubalawan witnis blanga mi langa skai.”

english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,
kriol: Wotfo yu nomo dum lagijat langa Jeramaiya brom det kantri gulum Einathoth hubin oldei toktokbat jis laik speshalwan mesinja langa ola pipul?

english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
kriol: Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Ola yangbala men oldei meigimbat fan langa mi na. Main dog bin oldei albumbat mi lukaftumbat ola ship main. Bat detlot dediwan blanga detlot yangmen olabat brabli rabishwan. Ai kaan askim olabat blanga dum main wek.

english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
kriol: Aibin dalim Mosis ebri kantri weya yumob pudum yumob fut, wal det graun na ai garra gibit yumob.

english: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
kriol: Luk tharrei! Main olmen jinginat. Im kaminap oba detlot hil, en im ranran kwikbala langa mi.

english: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
kriol: YAWEI ai garra sing langa yu, dumaji yubin kain langa mi detmatj.

english: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
kriol: Lagijat na Joshuwa bin dum, dumaji longtaim YAWEI bin dalim det wekinmen blanga im neim Mosis blanga dum lagijat na, en bifo imbin dai, Mosis bin dalim Joshuwa blanga dum lagijat, en Joshuwa bin dum wanim YAWEI bin dalim im.

english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
kriol: en mi wail langa olabat na, en ai garra binijimap olabat. En yu kaan trai en stapam mi, dumaji afta ai garra meigim yu en yu biginini olabat jidan brabli bigwan traib blanga deigim pleis blanga detlot Isreil pipul.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
kriol: en ai wandi bulurrum im en libum det olbalawei, dumaji oni lagijat na God garra meigim mi gidap laibala brom dedbala.

english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
kriol: Oni mi na bin album olabat blanga jidan gudwei langa det soltiwan sengraun kantri.

english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
kriol: Yu garra meigim shotwan trasis blanga olabat,

english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
kriol: Yumob garra lukaran blanga detlot brabli krulbala enami, bat yumob kaan faindim olabat, dumaji olabat bin gowei.

english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
kriol: Yu kaninbala. Wotfo yubin ranawei snikinwei? Yu bina dalim mi, en ai bina abum bigwan padi blanga yumob. Wi bina abum bigwan singsong garram det gita gulum hap en garram det lilwan dram gulum tembarin. En ai bina larramgo yu gudbinjiwei.

english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings
kriol: “Wal dijan na ol detlot lowa blanga det barnapwan ofring, en det sid daga ofring, en det ofring blanga nogudbalawei, en det peiyimbek ofring, en det ofring weya deibin gibit wen deibin meigim serramonimen, en det feloship ofring.

english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.
kriol: “En if enibodi nomo bin luk gudwei, en im tatjimbat samting weya im nomo klinwan blanga serramoni, jis laik det dedwan enimul, wal im nomo klinbala. Wal im gilti wen im sabi wanim imbin dumbat.

english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
kriol: Wal det king nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola rong ting, dumaji im garra gibit feyago langa ola pipul en tharran na garra meigim pipul langa im kantri jidan strongbala.

english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
kriol: Bat maitbi sambala pipul deya kaan teiknodis langa yu, dumaji yu yangbala. Wal nomeda olabat kaan teiknodis langa yu, bat stil yu garra lenimbat olabat. Yu kaan jis dalimbat olabat. Yu garra shoumbat olabat. Yu garra shoumbat olabat hau blanga tok, en yu garra shoumbat olabat hau blanga jidan, en yu garra shoum olabat hau blanga laigim pipul, en yu garra shoumbat olabat hau blanga bilib brabliwei, en yu garra shoumbat olabat hau blanga abum det raitwan filing.

english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
kriol: Wal Eliyeisa bin abum oni wanbala san neim Reiyabaiya, bat Reiyabaiya bin abum loda biginini na.

english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
kriol: “Wal bifo detlot ting garra hepin, dei garra grebum yumob en meigim trabul blanga yumob, en dei garra deigim yumob langa kot langa ola Juwish Miting Pleis, en dei garra tjakam yumob langa jeil, en dei garra meigim yumob jandap lida langa gabman bos en ola haibala men. Dei garra dum lagijat langa yumob dumaji yumob bilib langa mi.

english: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”
kriol: Bat yu nomo brabli nogudbala. Yubin kadimat ol detlot seikridwan pol weya dei oldei weshipbat det gelwan drimin gulum Eshara, en yubin trai duwit blanga God.” Lagijat na Jehu bin tok.

english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”
kriol: King Amasaiya blanga Juda bin tok langa ol im boswan men en afta imbin jandim mesij langa King Jehowesh langa Isreil, “Yumob kaman en fait langa mi.”

english: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin dalim Semyul, “Nomeda det men im longwan en purdibala, bat stil yu kaan jinggabat im, dumaji ai nomo wandim im. Yumob pipul oldei luk atsaidwei langa enibodi. Bat nomo mi. Ai luk ebribodi insaidwei langa olabat hat.”

english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
kriol: Wal detlot wekinmen bin askim im, “Wotaim dislot ting garra hepin? Hau melabat garra sabi det rait taim?”

english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
kriol: “Wal yumob garra ol jidan strongbala, dumaji mi trastim God, en ai sabi im garra dum wanim imbin tok.

english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
kriol: Nobodi kaan lisin langa det gita en longwan wisul en bambu en olkain myusik langa det pleis enimo na. Nobodi kaan wek langa det pleis du na. Nobodi kaan meigimbat damba langa det taun enimo.

english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
kriol: Wen yumob irrim wanim bin hepin yumob garra jidan bradinwan en nobodi garra dum diskain nogudbala ting igin.

english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
kriol: Wal sambala boswan wekinmen blanga King Eman nomo bin wandim im en deibin kilim im ded deya langa im ronwan haus.

english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
kriol: Wal det wek bin stat langa det feswan dei langa det feswan manth, en langa det namba 8 dei deibin ol binij det wek langa ebri rum insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis. En afta deibin kipgon wek naja 8 dei, raidap det namba 16 dei langa det manth, en deibin meigim ebrijing redibala langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga weship YAWEI.

english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
kriol: En aibin oldei bastimap olabat jis laiga wekinmen weya im bastimap graun en det win blowimwei det das. Aibin oldei pudumbut langa olabat jis laik weya ola pipul pudumbut langa mad langa roud.

english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
kriol: Wal King Abaija bin kipgon ranimap en fait langa King Jerabowam en im amimob en imbin teikoba detlot Isreil taun gulum Bethel, Jeshana en Ifran en ola lilwan taun gulijap langa detlot thribala taun.

english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
kriol: Wal mi redi blanga gibap. Mi filim miselp brabli nogudbinji.

english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.
kriol: Bambai na Kein bin bringimap sambala daga brom det gadin, en imbin gibit det daga ofring langa YAWEI det trubala God.

english: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
kriol: Wal det widogel bin tok, “Trubala ai dalim yu. Ai nomo garram eni daga. Ai garram oni lilbit flauwa langa dish en lilbit oliboil. Aibin kaman iya blanga gedim faiyawud blanga deigimbek langa kemp blanga meigim lilwan damba blanga mi en main san. Dijan im laswan daga blanga minbala en afta minbala garra jidan nomo garram eni daga raidap minbala dai.”

english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
kriol: Nomo gibit bekboun langa YAWEI, en nomo bradin blanga detlot pipul hu jidan deya. Wi gin bidim olabat isibala. YAWEI im oldei iya garram wi en im garra bidim detlot drimin hubin oldei lukaftumbat detlot pipul langa det kantri. Yumob nomo bradin.” Lagijat na det dubala bin tok.

english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
kriol: Wal Eibrahem bin tok, “Orait. Ai meigim det pramis garram yu. En ai garra kipum det wed.”

english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
kriol: ‘Yumob ola drimin! Yumob holot jidan bigininimob blanga det Brabli Haibala God.’

english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
kriol: Wal Juda bin tok langa Jeikob na, “Yu jandim det boi garram mi, en melabat gobek streidawei langa det kantri blanga gajim daga bambai wi dai.

english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
kriol: Garram yu pawa yubin seibum ol yu pipul olabat, detlot bigininimob blanga Jeikob en Josef.

english: “It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”
kriol: “Langa det taim na, det king en ola wekinmen garra jidan brabli bradinwan, en ola serramonimen garra gida shok, en ola speshalwan mesinja garra hatjamp nomo lilbit du.”

english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
kriol: If eni men silipsilipbat garram enimul, wal im en det enimul garra lafta dai mijamet du.

english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
kriol: en imbin tok im garra jinggabat ola grengrenfatha blanga wi. En im garra kipum det pramis weya imbin meigim garram olabat.

english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
kriol: Wal wen det dubala wekinmen blanga Jisas neim Jeims en Jon bin luk detlot pipul nomo bin wandim Jisas blanga jidan deya, dubala bin askim im, “Bos, yu wandim minbala garra jingat blanga meigim faiya kamdan brom hebin en barnimap dislot pipul?”

english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
kriol: Wal wan boswan solja brom Rom bin jidan deya langa det taun, en wanbala wekinmen blanga im bin brabli sik en imbin gulijap dai. Wal det boswan solja bin laigim det wekinmen blanga im brabliwei,

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: “Wal mi na YAWEI kipgon gibitbat Mosis ol dislot lowa

english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
kriol: en imbin tok gudbinjiwei langa dubala, “Yunbala garra abumbat bigmob biginini, dumaji yunbala garram loda kantri blanga jidanbat. En detlot biginini blanga yunbala garra go ebriweya langa ola kantri en meigim miselp bos blanga detlot kantri, dumaji mi na meigim yumob bos blanga ola fish en ola bard en ola enimul.

english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”
kriol: en imbin dalim ola wekinmen blanga im, “Yumob garra wotjimbat Emnon, en wen yumob luk im dringgimbat detmatj, wal ai garra dalim yumob blanga kilim im ded. Yumob kaan bradin blanga enibodi, dumaji mi na wandim im blanga dai. En yumob garra jandap strongbala en nomo bradin blanga kilim im ded.”

english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
kriol: Oni YAWEI na oldei meigim mi jidan brabli strongbala. Oni im na ebrijing langa mi. Oni im na bin seibum mi.

english: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
kriol: Longtaim wen imbin gowei brom det hil kantri gulum Siyiya, en wen imbin kaman iya basdam brom det kantri gulum Idam, ola graun langa dijan kantri bin sheik, en bigiswan rein bin buldan brom ola klaud ebriweya.

english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
kriol: Brom deya langa Bethel King Josaiya bin lukaran en imbin luk sambala greib ontop langa wanbala hil. Imbin deigimat detlot boun blanga detlot pipul weya deibin berrim en imbin barnimap detlot boun ontop langa det teibul blanga ofring. Imbin bitsimap det teibul blanga ofring, wulijim dei kaan weshipbat deya enimo, dumaji longtaim wan speshalwan mesinja bin tok blanga dis ting garra hepin wen King Jerabowam bin jandapbat langa det teibul blanga ofring wen olabat bin abum det serramoni. King Josaiya bin luk det greib blanga det speshalwan mesinja hubin tok dijan garra hepin.

english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
kriol: “Bat nomo. Ai garra stapam det bigbala naif. Ai garra jadjim yumob langa det pleis weya aibin meigim yumob, langa det kantri weya yumob bin bon.

english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
kriol: If enibodi hu bulurrum main wei en nomo gibit bekboun langa mi wal larram im jidan brabli gudbinji.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
kriol: Bambai na wen Inak bin gro, imbin abum lilboi, en imbin gulum im neim Airad. En wen Airad bin gro, imbin abum lilboi, en imbin gulum im neim Mehujeiyel. En wen Mehujeiyel bin gro, imbin abum lilboi, en imbin gulum im neim Mathusheil. En wen Mathusheil bin gro, imbin abum lilboi, en imbin gulum im neim Leimek.

english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
kriol: Yumob sabi? Jisas Krais en Seitin det brabliwan laiyinbala kaan jidan fren gija. En detlot pipul hu bilib langa Jisas Krais kaan abum seimwan main laik detlot pipul hu nomo bilib langa im.

english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
kriol: Ola solja blanga Asa det king blanga Juda bin oldei faitfait langa detlot solja blanga King Beisha brom Isreil wen dubala bin jidan king.

english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
kriol: En yumob garra midap blanga weship langa YAWEI langa det namba 7 dei, en yumob kaan dum eni wek langa det dei na. Wal lagijat na yumob garra gibit detlot ofring langa YAWEI blanga 7 dei, en det smel blanga detlot ofring garra meigim YAWEI brabli gudbinji. Blanga 7 dei yumob garra gibit detlot ofring mowa den det barnapwan ofring en wain ofring yumob gibit ebridei.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
kriol: “Yumob kaan bradin blanga detlot pipul hu gin kilim yumob ded. Dei gin kilim ded det bodipat blanga yumob, bat dei kaan kilim ded det spiritpat blanga yumob. Yumob garra bradin oni langa God, dumaji im gin kilim yumob bodipat en spiritpat ded en afta im gin tjakam yumob langa det helfaiya. Trubala ai dalim yumob. Oni langa im na yumob garra bradin.

english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
kriol: En detlot pipul brom Gris, Tubal en Mishek bin oldei selimbat ola prisana, en ola ting deibin meigim brom kopa.

english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
kriol: Bat det Libai klen garra oldei kemp raidaran langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga wotjimbat, wulijim nobodi kaan go gulijap langa det Seikridwan Tent en meigim mi brabli einggri langa ola Isreil pipul.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis.

english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
kriol: Wal detlot solja bin duwit langa olabat bos, en det nait deibin deigim Pol raidap langa det taun gulum Entipatras.

english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
kriol: ‘Fren, yu gibit mi thribala daga, dumaji wan fren main bin kaman langa main haus brom longwei, en ai nomo garram eni daga blanga gibit im.’

english: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”
kriol: En dei garra bringimap det bekleig en det briskit langa det rait taim wen det fet garra redi blanga det ofring blanga YAWEI. Ol dislot pat na blanga yumob en yumob biginini olabat olagijawan na, jis laik YAWEI bin tok.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.

english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “If eni Isreil kantrimen jidan gulijap langa yumob brabli powan, en im wandim selim miselp langa yumob blanga meigim miselp wekinmen blanga yumob, wal yumob kaan larram im dum det wek laik im jidan prisana.

english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
kriol: Yu si? Det olbala lowa bin dalim ola pipul blanga pikimat wanbala men blanga jidan det boswan haibala serramonimen. Bat det men bin oldei jidan wikwan, dumaji imbin men jis laik wi. God bin gibit det olbala lowa. Bat longtaim afta imbin gibit det strongwan pramis blanga det nyubalawei, en imbin pikimat im San blanga jidan det Boswan haibala serramonimen blanga det nyubalawei, en imbin meigim im go thru langa det trabul weya imbin dai blanga meigim im sabi det wei. En im jidan lagijat olagijawan.

english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
kriol: ‘Ol yumob Filastain pipul, yumob nomo jidan gudbinji dumaji det wadi bin breik na weya bin oldei panishimbat langa yumob. Det wadi na garra jidan wulijim jigiwan sneik, en afta im garra jidan wulijim det brabli poisinwan sneik.

english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.
kriol: En wen yumob go langa detlot kantri weya wi nomo bin gajim, wal YAWEI garra andimwei detlot najalot pipul brom detlot kantri, en yumob garra teikoba detlot kantri, dumaji YAWEI bin pramisim yumob blanga abum detlot kantri.

english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
kriol: “Wal wen pipul wandim yu blanga album olabat yu garra duwit gudbinjiwei.

english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
kriol: Detlot Amalekait pipul en Keinanait pipul hubin jidan deya, bin fait garram detlot pipul en deibin bidim olabat, en deibin ranimap olabat raidap langa Homa.

english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
kriol: “Wal yumob jinggabat na wanim Deibid bin tok blanga im. ‘Aibin oldei luk det Boswan lida langa mi olataim. Im oldei jidan iya raidensaid langa mi, en im oldei meigim mi jandap strongbala.

english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
kriol: “If enibodi wandi bildimap haus, im garra wekimat haumatj det haus garra kos, en im garra kaundimap ola mani blanga im blanga faindat if im garram naf blanga bildimap det haus.

english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
kriol: Wal yumob garra oldei dum ol detlot ting na, en yumob garra oldei prei langa God du en askim im blanga album yumob. En yumob garra oldei larram det Holi Spirit lidim yumob wen yumob prei. En yumob garra oldei wotjim miselp en nomo slekap. Yumob garra oldei prei blanga ola Kristjan pipul.

english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
kriol: Wal det widogel bin tok langa Ilaija na, “Yu speshalwan mesinja blanga God. Wotfo yubin dum dijan ting langa mi? Yubin kaman iya blanga meigim God jinggabat ola nogudbala ting weya aibin dum, en yubin kaman blanga kilim main san?”

english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
kriol: Wal mi brabli gudbinji blanga weistim ola enijing main blanga album yumob. En mi gudbinji blanga weistim main ron laif blanga yumob du. Yumob sabi? Ai kaan meigim yumob peiyim mi mani, dumaji mi laigim yumob detmatj. En tharran na bin meigim yumob laigim mi lilbit. Bat if ai bina laigim yumob lilbit en meigim yumob peiyim mi mani, wal yumob bina laigim mi detmatj.

english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
kriol: En wen det faiya en smok en yelawan poisin smok bin kamat brom olabat mawus, imbin binijimap bigmob pipul. Langa ebri kantri det faiya en smok bin binijimap wanbala, libum dubala, olawei lagijat na.

english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
kriol: Imbin gibit ola kantri blanga olabat langa ola Isreil pipul, detlot pipul blanga im na.

english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
kriol: Wal ola nogudbala spirit langa dijan wel nomo jidan bos blanga yumob na, dumaji yumob bin dai garram Jisas Krais. Wal wotfo yumob kipgon bulurrumbat ol detlot ting blanga dijan wel?

english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”
kriol: Ai garra jidan gudbinjiwei blanga dumbat ola gudbala ting blanga olabat, en ai garra meigim olabat jidan olagijawan langa dijan kantri.

english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
kriol: en detlot gudbala pipul blanga im garra jidan laibala, dumaji dei bilib langa im brabliwei. Bat if enibodi tenim miselp brom im, wal im kaan gudbinji langa det sambodi.” Lagijat na im tok.

english: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa Mosis igin, “Aibin gibit yu pawa blanga dum olkain klebabala ting. Wal yu garra gobek langa Ijip, en yu garra shoum detlot klebabala ting langa det king. Bat det king kaan larramgo ol detlot Isreil pipul, dumaji ai garra meigim im brabli admen.

english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
kriol: Wen King Eiheb bin gopas langa det roud, det speshalwan mesinja bin jingat en tok langa im, “Haibala bos, wen aibin faitfait blanga yu wanbala solja blanga wi bin bringimbek wan enami solja langa mi. En det solja bin tok langa mi, ‘Yu maindim dijan men en if im ranawei wal yu garra gitkil, o yu garra pei bigismob silbawan mani langa mi.’

english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
kriol: Bambai na wen Pida bin wokwok ontop langa woda, imbin stat jinggabat det strongbala win, en imbin bradin na, en imbin stat godan insaid langa woda, en imbin jingat langa Jisas, “Bos! Yu album mi!”

english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.
kriol: en afta ola Benjamin solja bin sabi deibin lus det fait, dumaji detlot Isreil solja bin meigim det plen basdam. Deibin ranawei brom detlot Benjamin solja dumaji deibin meigim det plen blanga detlot najalot Isreil solja hubin blandim miselp raidaran langa det taun,

english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
kriol: Brom deya Jisas bin tok langa detlot serramonimen en lowamen. Imbin tok, “Wanim det lowa blanga wi dalim wi blanga dum langa det Sebathdei? Im dalim wi blanga album enibodi o blanga ardim olabat? Im dalim wi blanga seibum enibodi laif o blanga deigidawei olabat laif?”

english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
kriol: Im nogud wen silibala pipul weistimbat mani blanga len, dumaji dei nomo garram gudwan main.

english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
kriol: Wen enibodi stilimbat daga, det daga teist brabli switwan, bat afta det daga garra jidan laik sengraun langa im mawus.

english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
kriol: Nomeda melabat bin abum det rait blanga askimbat yumob blanga daga, bat stil melabat nomo bin laigim meigim yumob gibit melabat daga. Melabat bin oldei wek blanga pei blanga melabat daga, dumaji melabat bin wandi shoum yumob det gudbalawei blanga jidan.

english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
kriol: Yumob garra abum thribala serramoni ebriyiya blanga meigim yumob jinggabat God.

english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
kriol: “Bat yumob jinggabat dijan stori. Wan men bin abum dubala san, en imbin go langa det eldiswan san, en imbin tok, ‘San, yu garra go en wek langa det gadin tudei.’

english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
kriol: Imbin libum langa det kantri Juda ola brabli powan pipul hu nomo bin abum enijing, en imbin gibit olabat ola greip fam en detlot pedik weya dei growimap sid daga.

english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
kriol: Wen King Josaiya bin binij ridimbat, imbin jandap langa det pleis weya ola king jandap. Imbin meigim brabli strongbala pramis langa det neim blanga YAWEI blanga duwit trubalawei langa YAWEI en bulurrum im lowa en ola ebrijing weya imbin ridimbat langa det buk.

english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi bin pikimat mi, imbin sori langa mi, en imbin brabli kainbala langa mi nomo lilbit, en imbin meigim mi bilib en laigim im, dumaji wen im joinimap enibodi garram im, wal im meigim im bilib en laigim im.

english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
kriol: en detlot lowamen en serramonimen bin kipgon askimbat im, en afta imbin jandap, en imbin dalim olabat, “If enibodi brom yumob nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting, wal im garra tjakam det feswan ston langa dijan gel.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok,

english: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
kriol: YAWEI im gudbala langa ebribodi. Im kainbala langa ebrijing weya imbin meigim.

english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
kriol: Wal sambala pipul bin dalim mi, wen yumob oldei abumbat miting, yumob oldei agamin gija en kadimat miselp. En ai reken im trubala tharran.

english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
kriol: Wal yumob kaan dum lagijat langa olabat, dumaji wen yumob tok yumob bilib en yumob nomo dum gudbala ting langa pipul blanga shoum olabat yumob bilib, wal yumob jis laiga dedbala.

english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
kriol: Yumob garra wotjim miselp en nomo fogedabat YAWEI hubin bringimat yumob brom Ijip weya yumob bin jidan wekinmen en wekingel laiga prisana.

english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
kriol: “Afta na wen imbin nokoftaim, det fama bin dalim det boswan wekinmen blanga im, ‘Yu jingat langa ol detlot wekinmen en peiyim olabat. Detlot wekinmen hubin kaman iya leitbala, yu garra peiyim olabat basdam, en detlot wekinmen hubin kaman iya ailibala, yu garra peiyim olabat biyain.’

english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
kriol: Dumaji blanga ol yu pramis mi brabli gudbinji, jis laik sambodi hu gudbinji brabliwei wen im faindim samting brabli gudwan.

english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.
kriol: Wal wen detlot pipul bin wek blanga 52 dei deibin binij bildimapbat det wol raidaran langa det taun. Deibin binij langa det 25 dei blanga det manth gulum Elul.

english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.
kriol: Brom deya Joshuwa en detlot Isreil solja bin gobek langa det taun gulum Debiya, en deibin fait langa ola pipul deya,

english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
kriol: Bat langa det kantri gulum Goshin weya ola Isreil pipul bin jidan, nomo eni heilston bin buldan deya.

english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
kriol: “Wal wen det king bin gowin, imbin luk ola pipul deya, en imbin luk wanbala men deya nomo werrimon det raitwan klos blanga det padi, en imbin dalim det men,

english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
kriol: En yumob garra tok, ‘Melabat bin dagat en dringgimbat garram yu. En yubin titjimbat melabat langa melabat ronwan taun!’

english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det boswan God bin tok langa im ship olabat na, ol detlot Isreil pipul, “Ai garra wotjimbat yumob en ai garra luk wujan im strongbala, en wujan im wikwan.

english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
kriol: Wen aibin luk tharran imbin titjimbat mi dijan.

english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”
kriol: King Nebakanesa garra bitsimap detlot seikridwan ston blanga Heliyapalas langa Ijip, en ai garra barnimap detlot serramoni pleis garram detlot drimin sheip blanga detlot Ijip pipul.” Wal lagijat na YAWEI bin dalim mi.

english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
kriol: Wal 64,300 men bin brom det klen blanga Isaka. Olabat bin kamat brom detlot femili grup blanga Tola, Puwa, Jeishab en Shimran.

english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
kriol: En im lagijat gin blanga Seitin. If Seitin en im dibuldibul olabat kadimat miselp en faitfait gija, wal dei garra binijimap miselp gin, en afta Seitin kaan jidan boswan na.

english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”
kriol: Imbin tok, “Tumorro lagijat taim ai garra jandim wan men brom det Benjamin klen langa yu, en yu garra spilim det speshalwan oil ontop langa im hed blanga meigim im jidan bos blanga ola pipul main. Im na garra seibum olabat brom ola Filastain pipul, dumaji aibin luk ola trabul weya main pipul oldei abumbat, en aibin irrim olabat jinginatbat langa mi blanga album olabat.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”
kriol: En yu garra gajim daga du blanga yu en yu femili en blanga ola enimul.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
kriol: Yu dum ebrijing aibin dalim yu en yu garra jidan laibala. Yu teiknodis langa detlot wed weya aibin titjimbat langa yu jis laik yu lukaftumbat yu ai dubala.

english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
kriol: “YAWEI bin meigim yumob Isreil pipul bos langa hil kantri. Yumob bin dagat loda daga brom detlot fam. Imbin gibit yumob shugabeig brom detlot ston. Yumob bin abum gudwan olibtri langa det stoni kantri.

english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
kriol: En faibala men garra bidim 100 men, en 100 men garra bidim 10,000 men.

english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,
kriol: Yumob garra dum dislot ting. Yumob garra tok trubala wed langa yumob selp en wen yumob deigim sambodi langa kot, gibit olabat feyago det raitwei, wulijim afta detlot pipul garra gudbinji gija.

english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
kriol: Nomo eni pipul oldei kaman blanga weshipbat langa yu neim, o jidan brabli trubalawei langa yu. Yubin gibit melabat bekboun, en yubin larram melabat nogudbalawei tenimwei melabat brom yu du.

english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
kriol: Det serramonimen garra deigim wanbala lilwan boiwan ship garram det oliboil blanga peiyimbek ofring. En im garra gibit det speshalwan ofring blanga det serramonimen.

english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
kriol: Bat ai kaan dum, dumaji ola pipul kaan shoum rispek en teiknodis langa eni speshalwan mesinja langa im ron taun.

english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
kriol: Yumob garra oldei welkam pipul brom najalot kantri langa det bigwan hil, en yumob gibit det raitwan sekrifais ofring deya. Yumob garra gajim loda ebrijing langa det solwoda en langa det sengraun.”

english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
kriol: Deibin jidan deya fo thribala dei garram King Deibid, en olabat kantrimen bin meigim redibala loda daga blanga olabat blanga dagat.

english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
kriol: Wal Gidiyan bin meltimap detlot golwan iyaring, en garram det gol imbin meigim detkain speshalwan shet dei gulum ifad weya det haibala serramonimen bin oldei werrim, en imbin meigim jandap det golwan shet insaid langa im haus deya langa im ronwan taun gulum Ofra. Afta na ola Isreil pipul bin gibit bekboun langa YAWEI, en deibin oldei go en weship det golwan shet, en det ting bin meigim Gidiyan en im femili olabat bilib langa det shet du.

english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
kriol: Imbin deigimat olabat brom det dakbala pleis, en imbin breigimap hafenhaf ol detlot tjein blanga olabat.

english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
kriol: En imbin dalim ola pipul blanga jidan langa det grinwan gras deya, en imbin gajim detlot daga en det dubala fish, en imbin lukap langa top, en imbin gibit theingks langa God, en afta imbin breigim detlot daga en fish, en imbin gibit langa im wekinmen olabat, en deibin gibitat det daga en fish langa detlot pipul.

english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
kriol: En im garra kilim det lilwan ship langa det pleis weya dei oldei kilim detlot enimul blanga det ofring blanga nogudbalawei en det barnapwan ofring. En im garra dum lagijat na, dumaji det dubala ofring jidan brabli seikridwan en blanga det serramonimen.

english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
kriol: Basdam Jerusalem bin jidan jis laik det silba, bat tudei na yumob pipul meigim det taun jidan brabli rabishwan. Basdam Jerusalem bin jidan jis laik det gudwan wain, bat tudei na yumob pipul jis laik det wain weya nomo garram eni teist.

english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
kriol: En det serramonimen garra luk langa ola gudwan en ola nogudwan ting blanga det enimul, en det serramonimen garra dalim im haumatj mani im garra pei en im kaan tjeinjim.

english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
kriol: Aibin deya wen imbin dalim det solwoda nomo blanga pasim det mak, en aibin deya wen imbin meigim det draiwan graun.

english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
kriol: en wan lowamen deya bin trai en trikim im.

english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin gibit sambala kantri langa sambala pipul brom Manesa klen.

english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
kriol: Goshin, Holan en Gilo. Deibin gedim ol detlot 11 taun na garram ola lilwan taun du weya jidan raidaran langa detlot taun.

english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
kriol: En afta Aisaiya bin tok streidat langa detlot Isreil pipul wen imbin dalim olabat blanga detlot Jintail pipul. Imbin tok, “Detlot pipul hu nomo bin lukabat God bin faindim im, en God bin shoum miselp langa detlot pipul hu nomo bin askim im blanga shoum miselp langa olabat.”

english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,
kriol: en det dubala kidni en det kidni fet, en det brabli gudwan pat langa det liba du.

english: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
kriol: Wen yu dum enijing gudwei, yu meigim YAWEI brabli gudbinji, en yu enamimob jidan gudfren langa yu.

english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.
kriol: Yu jinggabat det pramis weya yubin meigim langa melabat grengrenfathamob basdam, en nomo tjakidawei melabat. Yu nomo meigim yu speshalwan pleis Jerusalem jidan rabishwan, det pleis weya det brabli gudwan tjeya blanga yu oldei jidan. Yu nomo breigim det strongwan pramis weya yubin meigim garram melabat grengrenfathamob.

english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.
kriol: en ai garra panishim Jerusalem afta yu dai. Ai garra larram yu dai nomo garram trabul.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok. En detlot men bin gobek langa King Josaiya garram det wed na.

english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
kriol: Nomeda haumatj yu drimbat, en haumatj yu nomo sabi blanga dijan laif, en haumatj yu toktokbat, yu stil garra shoum rispek langa God.

english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.
kriol: Bat yu nomo jinggabat detlot solja hu laigim yu. Yu oni jinggabat det san blanga yu hu nomo bin laigim yu. En tudei yubin shoum ola boswan solja en ola najalot solja yu nomo jinggabat olabat. Maitbi imbin mobeda blanga yu solja olabat bina dai en yu san Ebsalom bina jidan laibala.

english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, det boswan haibala serramonimen bin breigim im ronwan klos, dumaji imbin gitwail, en imbin jingat, “Im laiyinbala! Wi nomo wandim enimo witnis na! Yumob bin irrim im mokimbat God imselp, en imbin trai en meigim imselp seim laik God du.

english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
kriol: “Wal det wanbala gel bin kaman langa det men na. Imbin dresap wulijim gel hu oldei silipsilipbat garram eni men blanga mani en imbin meigimbat plen blanga trikim im.

english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
kriol: Wal ol detlot pipul bin tok langa Jisas na, en deibin dalim im blanga gowei brom det kantri blanga olabat,

english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
kriol: Im garra jidan langa yumob gudwei en wek blanga yumob jis laik wekinmen hu yumob peiyim, raidap det namba 50 yiya wen ola kantri garra gobek langa ola fesmob boswan blanga det kantri.

english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
kriol: Wen yubin stap wokwokbat dijan wel bin sheik, en wen yubin luk, pipul langa ebri kantri bin jidan brabli bradinwan. En wen yu wokwokbat langa det roud blanga yu weya bin jidan longtaim, ol detlot bigwan hil en lilwan hil buldan.

english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
kriol: en im garra dum olkain speshalwan ting langa skai en langa graun. Garram blad en faiya en smok im garra dum.

english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
kriol: En Mosis bin bradin du wen imbin luk ebrijing hepin langa det hil, en imbin tok, “Mi sheiksheik, dumaji mi brabli bradin detmatj.”

english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
kriol: Yu garra luk olkain ting en yu kaan luk gudwei en yu main garra trikimbat yu.

english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.
kriol: yumob garra kilim ded detlot pipul langa det taun en blanga olabat enimul du. Yumob garra binijimap ebrijing langa det taun.

english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin rili wail na langa detlot Isreil pipul, en imbin larram ola enami blanga olabat kaman en bidimbat olabat, en deibin oldei deigidawei ola enijing brom olabat, en detlot Isreil pipul bin jidan brabli wikwan na,

english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
kriol: Wal yumob sabi mi jidan fri, en yumob sabi mi jidan speshalwan mishanri, en yumob sabi aibin luk Jisas det Bos blanga wi, en yumob bilib langa im na, dumaji aibin dum det wek weya imbin gibit langa mi blanga dum.

english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
kriol: Wal main gudfren olabat, wi jidan biginini blanga God na. Bat wi nomo sabi hau wi garra jidan bambai. Bat wi sabi wen Jisas Krais garra kambek, wi garra jidan seimwei laik im, dumaji det taim na wi garra luk im brabliwei hau im jidan.

english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
kriol: Detlot klen blanga Ged en Rubin en haf blanga det Manesa klen hubin jidan sanrais said bin gedim olabat kantri en deibin kadimat langa ola femili deya,

english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
kriol: Wen melabat dai, wi kaan neba gidap igin raidap det skai garra binij. Nomo enibodi gin meigim wi gidap brom det greib.

english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
kriol: Wal det wekinmen bin go gulijap langa Jisas, en imbin askim im, “Bos, blanga hu yu toktokbat?”

english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
kriol: Yumob sabi? Det gudbala men bin dai blanga ola nogudbala pipul, en imbin dai blanga meigim wei blanga wi blanga go langa God. Deibin kilim im bodi ded. Bat det spirit blanga im bin jidan laibala,

english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”
kriol: Ai garra meigim det king jidan nogudbinji garram stori blanga wanim bin hepin langa im ronwan kantri. Im garra gobek, en deya na ai garra meigim im dai brabli krulbalawei.’ Tharran na det mesij brom YAWEI.”

english: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
kriol: en imbin tok langa im, “Dumaji yu nomo bin kipum det brabli strongbala pramis weya yubin meigim garram mi, en yu nomo bin duwit langa mi wen aibin dalim yu, wal ai pramis langa yu ai garra deigidawei dijan kantri brom yu weya yu jidan bos, en ai garra gibit langa det wanbala boswan wekinmen blanga yu.

english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
kriol: En wen enibodi yusum det neim blanga det teibul blanga ofring blanga bekimap det wed blanga im, wal im yusum det neim blanga detlot ofring langa det teibul du.

english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
kriol: En wen yumob san askim yumob blanga eig, wanim yumob gibit olabat? Yumob gibit olabat skopiyan o yumob gibit olabat eig?

english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
kriol: Bambai na det taim bin kaman blanga det olgamen Elisabeth blanga abum det beibi, en imbin abum lilboi,

english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”
kriol: Bambai na YAWEI det trubala God bin dalim Semyul, “Wotfo yu oldei sori blanga King Sol? Aibin tenawei brom im, en ai kaan larram im jidan king blanga ola Isreil pipul. Wal yu gajim det botul garram oliboil, en yu go langa det men neim Jesi deya langa det taun gulum Bethlahem, dumaji aibin pikimat wanbala san blanga im blanga jidan king.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
kriol: en wen Jisas bin irrim detlot wekinmen, imbin tok, “Yumob nomo andimwei detlot biginini. Yumob larram olabat kaman langa mi, dumaji ola pipul hu meigim miselp lobala jis laik dislot biginini, wal olabat na garra jidan garram God.”

english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
kriol: Wal ol detlot pipul langa det taun bin ol lisin langa det wed blanga God, en deibin tok, “Wi garra werrimon ola sekbeigwan klos, en wi kaan dagat eni daga du. Wi garra dum lagijat blanga shoum God wi garra libum ola nogudbalawei blanga wi en bulurrum det wei blanga im. Wi holot garra dum lagijat.”

english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
kriol: Bat imbin oldei gobek langa im dedi kemp deya langa Bethlahem blanga maindimbat ola ship blanga im dedi du.

english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.
kriol: En najalot bin tok, “Wibin lafta askimbat blanga mani blanga peiyim teks langa det boswan king blanga ola sid daga en frut tri wibin growimapbat.

english: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
kriol: YAWEI yu seibum melabat, en shoum melabat yu laigim melabat olataim.

english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.
kriol: En wen aibin stil preipreibat det einjul gulum Geibriyal bin flaiflai langa mi. Imbin det seimwan weya aibin luk basdam langa det feswan drim. Imbin kaman langa mi langa det taim blanga gibit det sangodan sekrifais na.

english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
kriol: en deibin jandim sambala wekinmen blanga olabat en sambala wekinmen blanga det gabman bos neim Herod, en detlot wekinmen bin go langa Jisas, en deibin tok, “Titja, melabat sabi yu oldei tok det trubala wed streidat langa enibodi, en yu nomo teiknodis wanim enibodi jinggabat. Nomeda det men im jidan haibala. Bat stil yu oldei dalim im streidat blanga wanim God wandim im blanga dum.

english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.
kriol: En detlot serramonimen nomo bin askim, ‘Weya YAWEI?’ Detlot lowamen nomo bin sabi mi, najing. En detlot lida bin gibit mi bekboun du. Detlot speshalwan mesinja bin oldei toktokbat garram det neim blanga Beil, en olabat bin oldei weshipbat olkain nogudwan drimin sheip.”

english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
kriol: Yu si? Bifo imbin dai, Jisas bin tok, “Ai garra trastim God.” En afta imbin tok, “Iya na mi, en iya ola femili main weya God bin gibit langa mi.”

english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
kriol: Yumob bina album ola powan pipul en ola biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi, bat najing! Yumob bina gibit feyago langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enibodi blanga albumbat olabat, bat najing!

english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
kriol: YAWEI bin gudbinji blanga meigim yumob rili ritjwan en imbin meigim yumob abum loda biginini. Wal seimwei im garra gudbinji blanga binijimap yumob en im garra dum loda nogudwan ting langa yumob, en im garra jandimwei yumob brom det kantri weya im garra gibit langa yumob blanga jidan.

english: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
kriol: Jehosheba bin maindimbat det lilboi Jowesh deya insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis fo 6 yiya. Langa ol det taim na Eihalaiya bin jidan kwin langa Juda.

english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
kriol: Wal Judas Basabas en Sailas bin tok langa detlot bilibamob lilbit longtaim, dumaji dubala bin speshalwan mesinja blanga God, en dubala bin meigim olabat gudbinji en brabli strongbala,

english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
kriol: Afta na Joshuwa bin majurrumap det dubala klen gulum Rubin en Ged en haf det klen gulum Manesa,

english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
kriol: Bat ai dalim yumob. Nomeda yumob bin luk mi, bat stil yumob kaan bilib langa mi. En nomeda aibin dalim yumob lagijat bifo, bat stil yumob kaan bilib langa mi.

english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
kriol: en det wekinmen bin raidimdan ebrijing weya imbin luk. Wal dijan na det wed brom God, det trubala wed weya Jisas Krais bin shoum langa det wekinmen.

english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.
kriol: Imbin pudum det shet en longwan kout langa Eran, en det waitwan heinggitjif raidaran langa im binji. En imbin meigim im werrimon det speshalwan shet gulum Ifad en bin taiyimap garram belt.

english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
kriol: En Edaniram bin bos blanga ol pipul brom najalot kantri hubin jidan jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga King Deibid en im pipul olabat. En Jehosafet det san blanga Ahilad bin oldei maindimbat ola buk blanga Deibid.

english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Jerusalem garra abum twelbala geit. Thribala geit garra jidan langa ebrisaid blanga det taun wol. Detlot geit garra abum seimwan neim blanga detlot twelbala klen blanga Isreil na. Detlot geit gulum Rubin, Juda, en Libai garra jidan langa nowathsaid. Detlot geit gulum Josef, Benjamin en Den garra jidan langa sanraisaid. Detlot geit gulum Simiyan, Isaka en Sebyulan garra jidan langa sauthsaid. Detlot geit gulum Ged, Esha en Neftali garra jidan langa sangodansaid. Ebri said langa det taun wol garra jidan 2.5 kilomita longwei.

english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
kriol: Main enami olabat tokabat mi krulbalawei. Dei wandim mi blanga dai en fogedabat mi.

english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.
kriol: Afta na Ilaisha bin leidan ontop langa det lilboi bodi, imbin pudum im mawus langa det lilboi mawus, im ai langa det lilboi ai, en im bingga langa det lilboi bingga, en bambai det lilboi bodi bin go womwan.

english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
kriol: Dei garram oni abum lilbit daga blanga dagat en oni lilbit woda blanga dringgim. En olabat garra dai slobala, dumaji deibin dumbat brabli nogudbala ting.”

english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
kriol: “Ebribodi sabi ol detlot lilwan bard dei nomo bigwan ting. Dei nomo kos loda mani. Yumob gin baiyim faibala blanga lilwan prais. Bat God im stil jinggabat blanga detlot bard.

english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
kriol: En deya na im garra jidan seifwan brom det ded men rileishan hu wandi kilim im ded. Det men hu dei reken im gilti, nobodi kaan kilim im, dumaji dei garra kotim im basdam.

english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
kriol: Deibin meigim miselp nogud brom dumbat nogudbala ting, en dei nomo bin jidan trubala langa God.

english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
kriol: En if wi kipgon en nomo gibap, wal im garra meigim wi jidan bos garram im bambai. Bat if wi tok wi nomo sabi im, wal im garra tok im nomo sabi wi du.

english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
kriol: En im mobeda blanga jidan deya weya olabat kraikraibat wen sambodi bin dai den go langa detlot hu abumbat padi, dumaji ola laibala pipul garra oldei jinggabat dei garra ol dai bambai du.

english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
kriol: Yu si? Yumob sabi yumob lau dagat detkain daga. Bat maitbi det filing blanga yumob braja o sista im wikwan, en det filing blanga im dalim im, im nomo lau dagat detkain daga. En if im luk yumob dagat detkain daga deya langa det serramoni pleis, wal im garra dagat det daga du, en det daga garra meigim im nogud, dumaji im dum wanim im reken im nomo lau dum. En yumob na meigim im dum det nogudbala ting.

english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
kriol: God, pipul nomo enijing. Wotfo yu oldei jinggabat melabat? Wotfo yu oldei lukaftumbat melabat?

english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
kriol: o detlot enimul weya wokabat garram binji langa graun, o fish weya jidan langa woda. Yu kaan meigim eni drimin sheip lagijat.

english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

kriol: Nobodi kaan dum enijing if YAWEI nomo larram im.

english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
kriol: Wal det king bin jingat langa ola haibala serramonimen en ola lowamen, en wen deibin kaman langa im, imbin askim olabat, “Wujei det beibi yumob gulum Krais garra bon?”

english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin tok, “If yu kaan go garram melabat, wal yu nomo meigim melabat gowei brom dis pleis, dumaji if yu nomo go garram melabat, wal ebribodi garra tok yu nomo gudbinji langa mi en langa ola pipul blanga yu, en if yu nomo jidan garram melabat, wal melabat garra jidan seim laik ola najalot pipul.”

english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
kriol: Brom deya Pol en Banabas bin go langa det taun gulum Entiyak deya langa det kantri gulum Pasidiya, en wen imbin Sebathdei dubala bin go langa det Juwish Miting Pleis.

english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
kriol: Bat wanbala serramonimen deya neim Gameiliyal bin stapam olabat. Gameiliyal bin brom detlot serramonimen gulum Ferasi, en imbin oldei titjimbat ola lowamen, en ola pipul bin rispek im brabliwei. Wal imbin jandap deya langa detlot serramonimen, en imbin jandim detlot speshalwan mishanri atsaid brom det rum,

english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”
kriol: Aibin dalim yumob wanim blanga tok, en ai garra kipum yumob seifwan garram main pawa. Dumaji mi na bin spredimat det skai en meigim dijan wel. Wal mi tok na, ‘Ola pipul blanga Jerusalem, yumob jidan main ronwan pipul.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into Yahweh’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into Yahweh’s house,
kriol: Wal King Jowesh bin tok langa ola serramonimen en imbin dalim olabat blanga kipum ola mani weya ola pipul bin gibit blanga pei blanga detlot sekrifais ofring langa det Serramoni Pleis en ola ofring mani weya deibin gibit gudbinjiwei langa YAWEI.

english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
kriol: Wal det hedmen bin tok, “Nomo. If ai faindim det kap langa enibodi beig, oni im na garra jidan prisana en dumbat ola adwek blanga mi. Yumob najalot gin kipgon.”

english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
kriol: YAWEI bin meigim mi jidan wikwan wen mi stil yang. Imbin meigim main laif jidan shotwan.

english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
kriol: Imbin rabum main feis langa graun, en imbin bitsimap ol main tuth garram ston.

english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.
kriol: Dumaji yumob bin jidan detkainaba lida bifo, wal yumob garra wokwok lida langa ebribodi wen detlot enamimob garra deigidawei yumob prisana langa longweiwan kantri. En ola bigwan padi weya yumob bin oldei abumbat garra ol binij du.

english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
kriol: en ol detlot najalot kantri garra jidan nogudwan jis laiga deset kantri, dumaji God garra panishim ol detlot najalot pipul blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya deibin oldei dumbat.” Lagijat na aibin tok.

english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
kriol: Wal God bin tok gudbalawei blanga ol detlot pipul hubin bilib brabliwei. Bat im nomo bin gibit olabat wanim imbin pramis bifo deibin dai, dumaji imbin abum mobedawan plen blanga wi.

english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
kriol: Main laif go kwikbala jis laik det bout wen im go kwikbala, en jis laik det igulok flaiflaibat kwikbala wen im gajimbat daga.

english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
kriol: Mi na brabli sabibala, en mi sabi ebrijing. Ai garram brabli gudbala main en oldei gibit ebribodi feyago.

english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.
kriol: If yu abum blendi blanga dagat en dringgimbat, wal yu gudbinji, bat yu kaan abum dubala if yu nomo garram eni mani.

english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

english: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.
kriol: Wal detlot pipul bin agri brabliwei blanga kipum det brabli strongbala pramis blanga YAWEI, en afta deibin abum bigbala padi en jingat gudbinjiwei en pleipleibat myusik.

english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.
kriol: ai garra gajim detlot pipul brom Jerusalem en ai garra tjakam olabat langa det faiya. Lagijat na ai garra panishim olabat dumaji olabat bin bidim det feswan faiya bat dis sekanwan faiya garra barnimap olabat holot. En wen ai dum lagijat Isikiyel, yu garra sabi mi na YAWEI det trubala God.

english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,
kriol: Wal wen aibin irrim det wed, aibin krai. Aibin kraikraibat blanga sambala dei en ai nomo bin dagat daga blanga shoum aibin nogudbinji. En aibin prei langa God,

english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
kriol: “Ol detlot ritj pipul hu jinggabat olabat ronselp garra abum raftaim, dumaji deibin abum det isibala laif olredi.

english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.
kriol: Streidawei olabat bin bringimap detlot golwan kap en boul en deibin ol dringgimbat wain na,

english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
kriol: Wal yu nomo wandi tok seimwei laik olabat oldei tok, dumaji wi Dedi sabi olredi wanim yu wandim bifo yu askim im.

english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
kriol: En imbin jidan langa deset kantri, weya nomo eni woda bin jidan.

english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
kriol: en det gudnyus na im blanga Jisas Krais det San blanga God en det Bos blanga wi. Wal nomeda Jisas Krais bin God San, bat stil imbin kaman laik wi, en imbin kaman brom det femili lain blanga King Deibid,

english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
kriol: Yumob stil jinggabat ebrijing jis laiga biginini. Yumob garra lafta growap. Yumob silibala pipul. Yu garra lafta len mowa blanga andasten brabliwei.

english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.
kriol: Wal yumob garra meiksho det men yumob pikimat blanga king im na det seimwan YAWEI pikimat. Det men garra jidan blanga yumob kantrimen. Yumob nomo pikimat king brom najalot kantri.

english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.
kriol: “Wal ebri 3 yiya yumob garra gibit wanbala ebri tenbala wanim yumob bin growimap langa detlot Libai pipul en langa detlot pipul brom najawan kantri hu jidan garram yumob, en detlot biginini nomo garram mami o dedi, en detlot widogel du, wulijim langa dijan kantri ebribodi garra abum naf daga blanga dagat.

english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
kriol: “Wal yumob jinggabat det najawan wed weya detlot fama oldei tok, dumaji det wed im trubala. Dei oldei tok, ‘Wan men oldei plentimbat sid, en najawan men oldei gajimbat det kukwan daga.’

english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
kriol: Yu garra meigim det geit garram det gudwan matiriyal weya dei meigim garram bluwan, pepulwan en redwan wul, en yu garra pudum loda sheip langa det matiriyal du blanga meigim purdiwan. Det geit garra jidan 9 mita longwei garram fobala pol ontop langa fobala pleit.

english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
kriol: Bat Jisas im jidan laibala olagijawan, en nobodi kaan deigim pleis blanga im en dum det serramonimen wek blanga im.

english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
kriol: Wal Shedrek, Mishak en Ebadinago bin stil werrimon olabat klos wen detlot blijiman bin taiyimap en tjakam olabat langa det bigwan faiya.

english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
kriol: en streidawei det bos blanga ola solja bin deigim sambala solja garram im, en deibin go streit langa detlot pipul, en wen detlot pipul bin luk langa olabat, deibin stap beldimbat Pol,

english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
kriol: Yu garra meigim faibala pol brom det wadultri, en yu garra gaburrumap detlot pol garram gol, en yu garra pudum sambala golwan huk langa olabat blanga heingimap det ketin langa det dowawei, en yu garra meigim faibala kopawan pleit blanga holdimap detlot pol.”

english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.
kriol: Bambai na detlot men bin faindim wanbala lilboi brom Ijip, en deibin deigim im langa Deibid, en deibin gibit im sambala figtri daga en reisan daga en woda, dumaji im nomo bin abum eni daga en woda blanga 3 dei. Wal afta wen det lilboi bin binij dagat, imbin filim miselp strongbala,

english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
kriol: en enijing yumob tok en dum, yumob garra dum brabli trubalawei, dumaji yumob bulurrum Jisas Krais det Bos blanga wi, en thru im na yumob garra oldei gibit theingks langa God det Dedi blanga wi.

english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
kriol: En langa detlot pipul weya God garra seibum olabat, det gudnyus im jis laiga gudsmelwan medisin weya meigim olabat gudbala. Bat det gudnyus im jis laiga brabli nogudwan smel langa detlot najalot pipul, dumaji dei nomo bilib langa det gudnyus. En tharran na garra meigim olabat dai. Wal yumob dalim mi na. Hu garram det pawa blanga spredimat det gudnyus? Nobodi.

english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu oldei jidanbat langa olabat ronwei, olabat nomo main fren. Ai nomo heingaran garram detlot tufeis pipul.

english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.
kriol: God na, hu jidan bos olagijawan, garra irrim mi en im garra bidim olabat, dumaji olabat nomo wandi tjeinj, en dei nomo gibit im rispek, najing.

english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
kriol: Blanga main frenmob oldei mokimbat langa mi, bat ai garra jinginat langa God,

english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
kriol: Detlot enami olabat nogudbala, jis laik detlot pipul langa det dubala taun gulum Sadam en Gamora. Olabat jis laik greiptri weya abum jigiwan en poisinwan greip daga,

english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
kriol: “Wal yumob irrim mi na. Nobodi kaan gowin eniwei langa strongbala men haus en pulumat im enijing. Yu garra taiyimap det strongbala men basdam, en afta yu gin pulumat im enijing. En im lagijat du wen mi andimwei dibuldibul.

english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
kriol: “Blanga melabat grengrenfathamob bin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, bat deibin ol binij na. En wi abumbat detlot trabul en panishmen blanga detlot nogudbala ting na.

english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
kriol: en imbin dalim olabat, “Loda pipul ebriweya olabat redi blanga bulurrum God. Bat oni lilbit wekinmen blanga dalim olabat hau dei garra bulurrum im. “Wal yumob garra askimbat God blanga jandim wekinmen blanga dalimbat detlot pipul.

english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudwan ting kaan jidan gudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dum gudbala ting garra jidan gudwei en brabli strongbala.

english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
kriol: Wal det sambodi hubin jidan ontop langa det klaud bin swingim det krukidwan naif langa ola kantri, en wantaim imbin gajimbat ola gudwan pipul.

english: Then Yahweh appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.
kriol: YAWEI bin kamat langa im naitaim. Imbin tok langa im, “Aibin irrim yu preya en aibin pikimat dijan Serramoni Pleis weya ola pipul garra gibit sekrifais ofring langa mi.

english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
kriol: If aibin dum nogudbala ting langa im, o if aibin wandim dum lagijat,

english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
kriol: Bat if im merrit, wal im garra abum im ronwan waif, en ola wuman garra abum olabat ronwan hasbin du, dumaji olkain nogudbala ting garra temtimbat olabat.

english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
kriol: Afta na detlot gel bin gobek langa olabat dedi, en imbin askim olabat, “Wotfo yumob bin kambek kwikbala?”

english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
kriol: “Yu garra meigim det boks garram det wud brom det wadultri. Im garra jidan 1.1 mita longwei en 0.66 mita kroswei en 0.66 mita apendan,

english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”
kriol: Yumob go langa Ijip en baiyim daga blanga wi bambai wi dai.”
