english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
kriol: Wal minbala bin gobek langa det atsaidwan kotyad en minbala bin wokpas langa detlot fobala kona.

english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
kriol: Wal wen imbin naitaim, det bout garram ola wekinmen bin langa milwoda, en Jisas bin miselp langa det hil.

english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
kriol: Yu garra meigim pleit en kap en jag en dish blanga yusum langa det teibul blanga det ofring. Yu garra meigim ol detlot ting na garram gudwan gol,

english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
kriol: en det graun bin sheik nomo lilbit, en wan einjul blanga God bin kamdan brom hebin, en det einjul bin pushumwei det ston dowa brom det keib, en imbin jidan deya gin langa det ston weya imbin pushumwei.

english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
kriol: Detlot Moweb pipul meigim miselp nokap brom gogobat langa detlot teibul blanga ofring blanga weshipbat en preipreibat langa olabat drimin. Bat tharran nomo album olabat.

english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,
kriol: Wal detlot serramonimen kaan meigim nogud detlot seikridwan ofring.

english: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok holot dijan graun garra jidan brabli rabishwan, bat nomo ebrijing garra binijap.

english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Mi na YAWEI garra seibum yumob. Mi na det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul, en dijan na main pramis. Blanga seibum yumob na ai garra jandim ami langa Bebalon, en det ami garra deigimwei ola pipul brom Bebalon prisana, en olabat garra kraikraibat.

english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.
kriol: Wal bifo deibin abum det sebis deya langa det Serramoni Pleis langa Jerusalem deibin meigim ola serramonimen en detlot Libai pipul redi jis laik im tok langa det lowa weya Mosis bin raidimdan.

english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
kriol: Wal Pida bin dalim laiya igin. Bambai na detlot pipul deya bin dalim Pida, “Trubala yu wekinmen blanga Jisas, dumaji yu kaman brom Gelali.”

english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin kipgon tok, “Ol yumob Isreil pipul, mi na bin pikimat yumob blanga jidan main ronwan wekinmen olabat.

english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
kriol: Wal afta na ola lida blanga detlot Isreil pipul bin kaman langa Deibid deya langa det taun gulum Hebran, en deibin dalim im, “Melabat na yu ronwan kantrimen.

english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
kriol: Bat detlot pipul hu jidan deya, olabat brabli strongbala, en olabat taun garram brabli bigwan strongwan wol. En melabat bin luk detlot brabli longwan en strongbala men hu grengrenfathamob bin kaman brom detlot pipul dei gulum Einakait.

english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
kriol: God bin wandim ola ebrijing blanga jidan difrinwei, dumaji imbin sabi bambai im garra meigim ola ebrijing jidan fri brom det difrinwei weya bin meigim ebrijing go nogud, en ola ebrijing garra jidan fri langa det brabli shainiwan lait garram ol detlot biginini blanga God.

english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
kriol: “Yumob gin dagat ola fish weya im garram fin en skeil.

english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
kriol: Wanim bin hepin langa yu solwoda blanga meigim yu draiyap? En yu Jodan Riba, wotfo yubin stap randanbat?

english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.
kriol: Yumob jidan jis laik gel hu sabi hau blanga faindimbat detlot men. En det brabli nogudbala gel du, im gin stil len brom yumob na.

english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Wujan wekinmen langa dijan najawan stori im gudwan en klebabala? Yumob jinggabat na. Wen det bos blanga det haus gowei, im pikimat wanbala wekinmen blanga lukaftum ola najalot wekinmen en wekingel,

english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”
kriol: En imbin tok, “Isikiyel, yu reken dislot boun gin kambek en jidan laibala igin?” Wal aibin ensimbek im, “YAWEI, yu na det boswan God. Oni yu na sabi blanga tharran.”

english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.
kriol: Dei bin meigim dijan kantri jidan brabli nogudbala, en najalot pipul oldei rabishimbat dijan kantri. Ol detlot hu oldei gopas, dei gedim shok wanim olabat oldei lukinatbat. Olabat garra hatjamp nomo lilbit en sheikimbat olabat hed.

english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
kriol: Wal det gel bin kipgon bilimap det woda trof raidap detlot kemul bin ol bulap,

english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
kriol: Yumob sabi na? Detlot pipul hu oldei duwit langa olabat ronwan nogudbala filing kaan meigim God gudbinji.

english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
kriol: En im oldei libum biyain brabli shainiwan roud, en im meigim det solwoda go brabli waitwan.

english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
kriol: Im na bin gajim ola pipul brom ebri taun en deibin jidan prisana, en im nomo bin larram olabat go fri en gobek langa olabat kantri en hom. Im na bin meigim ola kantri jidan wulijim deset kantri.”

english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
kriol: Wal Maikaiya bin tok, “Ai gin luk detlot solja blanga Isreil jidan ebriweya deya langa det hil kantri, jis laik ola ship weya nomo garram eni stakmen. En YAWEI bin tok, ‘Dislot men nomo garram king. Larram olabat gobek langa olabat kemp gudbalawei.’”

english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
kriol: Bat if yubin silipsilip garram najawan men,

english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
kriol: Wal yu gidap na, en yu go en pikimap det lilboi en album im, dumaji God garra gibit im detmatj biginini, en dei garra jidan bigwan traib.”

english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
kriol: Sambala pipul jidan brabli gridibala en dumbat krulbala ting langa ola po pipul en langa detlot pipul hu nomo abum eniweya blanga silip.

english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
kriol: Wal yumob jis laik main ron femili. En blanga tharran na mi raidimbat dijan leda langa yumob, dumaji ai nomo wandim yumob blanga dumbat nogudbala ting. Bat if enibodi dumbat nogudbala ting, wal wi gin streitinimat det ting, dumaji wi garram sambodi deya hu jandap lida langa wi Dedi langa top, en im oldei tok langa im blanga wi. En det sambodi na im Jisas Krais hu nomo bin dum eni nogudbala ting.

english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,
kriol: “Yumob garra jinggabat det nogudbala ting weya wibin dum longtaim langa det hil gulum Piyowa, dumaji afta YAWEI bin gibit im ronwan pipul olabat det siknis blanga panishim wi, en wi stil abum trabul brom det siknis. Wal wi nomo wandim detkain ting garra hepin langa wi igin.

english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
kriol: Wal wen wi jidan strongbala wanwei lagijat, wi nomo jidan laiga lilwan biginini weya nomo sabi enijing. Ola lilwan biginini bilib langa enijing, en ola laiyinbala gin kaman en trikimbat olabat en meigim olabat bulurrum det nogudbalawei.

english: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok, “Main biginini olabat, yumob garra go en dalim yumob mami im dumbat olkain nogudbala ting. Nomeda im nomo main waif en mi nomo hasbin blanga im, bat stil yumob garra dalim im nomo blanga deigimat im klos en shoumbat miselp bodi en silipsilipbat garram eni men,

english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
kriol: Wal ai gibit theingks langa God, dumaji imbin meigim Taidas wandi album yumob brabliwei seimwei laik mi oldei wandi album yumob.

english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.
kriol: Wal King Hairam brom det kantri gulum Taya bin oldei jidan gudfren blanga Deibid, en wen imbin irrim Salaman bin jidan king afta im dedi Deibid, imbin jandim sambala boswan mesinja langa im.

english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
kriol: Yu na main God en ai garra gibit yu theingks, en ai garra kipgon tok blanga ebrijing yubin dum blanga meigim yu jidan mowa haibala.

english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
kriol: Wal detlot san blanga Bela bin Eda, Gira, Abaihad, Ebishuwa, Neiman, Ahowa, Gira, Shefufan en Huram.

english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),
kriol: Wal langa det namba 13 dei blanga det namba 12 manth gulum Edara, det dei na detlot pipul bin dum ebrijing brom det wed weya det king bin dalimbat olabat. Detlot enami blanga ola Juwish pipul bin reken dei gin binijimap olabat langa det dei, bat det nyuwan wed bin kamat brom det king blanga tjeinjim ebrijing. Ola Juwish pipul bin mowa strongbala langa det najalot pipul.

english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Wal ai go en meigim im gudbala.”

english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
kriol: God jidan langa im seikridwan tjeya. Im jidan bos blanga ola pipul langa ebri kantri.

english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
kriol: Afta na dijan kantri garra jidan brabli draiwan nomo garram eni daga fo sebenbala yiya. Ola pipul garra trai en jinggabat weya dijan kantri bin jidan garram bigmob daga bifo. Bat kaan du. Dijan kantri garra jidan brabli draiwan, en im garra meigim ola pipul fogedabat ola daga weya deibin abum bifo. Dijan kantri garra jidan brabli nogud.

english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
kriol: If enibodi silip garram yanggel hu nomo garram pramis, wal im garra peiyim det dediwan, en im garra merrit langa det yanggel.

english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
kriol: Blanga yumob lidamob, det win garra blowimwei olabat. Detlot solja brom najawan kantri hu oldei jidan gudfren blanga yumob, detlot enami bin deigimwei olabat prisana, en det taun blanga yumob garra jidan brabli sheimwan en brabli nogudwan du, dumaji yumob bin oldei dumbat brabli nogudbala ting.

english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
kriol: Wal Bilded brom Shuwa bin tok langa Job,

english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”
kriol: En ola boun blanga im garra leidan ebriweya langa graun jis laik minyuwa wulijim nobodi kaan sabi hu im.” Lagijat na Jeihu bin tok.

english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to Yahweh toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,
kriol: “Wen yu dalim ol yu pipul blanga go en fait langa olabat enami en dei prei langa yu, nomeda wujei dei jidan, en dei luk streit langa dijan taun weya yubin pikimat en dijan Serramoni Pleis weya aibin bildimap blanga yu,

english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
kriol: Jisas bin dalim olabat, “If enibodi nomo sabi det wei blanga God, wal im jidan blainwan insaidwei, en God kaan panishim im blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya im dumbat, dumaji God nomo panishim detlot pipul hu nomo sabi wanim dei dumbat. Bat God garra panishim yumob blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob dumbat, dumaji yumob reken yumob sabi det wei blanga im. Bat yumob nomo bulurrum det wei blanga im brabliwei.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
kriol: If yu kambek langa God en yu libum det nogudbalawei ebrijing garra jidan gudwei blanga yu.

english: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
kriol: Ebri ailibala ai sabi YAWEI im oldei album mi en kain langa mi.

english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
kriol: Wotfo yu nomo album melabat? Wotfo yu haidim miselp bingga?

english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
kriol: “Bat yu askim, ‘Wotfo im san nomo bin deigim det panishmen, dumaji im dedi bin dum detlot nogudbala ting?’ Wal det san bin dum brabli gudbala ting en imbin kipum main lowa en imbin bulurrum mi brabli gudbalawei, en blanga tharran na im garra jidan laibala. Tharran na det ensa.

english: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
kriol: Kwikbala na YAWEI, yu ensim main preya. Ai kaan dum enijing. Nomo libum mi iya miselp bambai mi dai en godan langa det pleis blanga ola dedbala pipul.

english: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
kriol: Oni langa yu na YAWEI, oni langa yu melabat garra preisimbat, dumaji yu kipgon laigimbat yu pipul olabat, en yu jidan brabli trubalawan langa olabat. Melabat kaan preisim miselp.

english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
kriol: Wal main Kristjan fren olabat, wi jidan jis laiga streinja langa dijan wel, dumaji wi nomo blanga dijan pleis. Wi blanga hebin. En ai dalim yumob. Nomeda wi jidan iya langa dijan wel, bat stil yumob kaan larram ol detlot nogudbala filing blanga yumob bodi deigidawei yumob, dumaji ol detlot nogudbala filing na oldei fait langa wi insaidwei.

english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
kriol: En dumaji yumob trastim en jinggabat God olataim, wal yumob garra wek blanga kain langa yumob Kristjan braja en sista olabat. En dumaji yumob kain langa yumob Kristjan braja en sista olabat, wal yumob garra laigim olabat brabliwei du.

english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
kriol: Wal yumob garra gibit wanbala boiwan gout blanga det nogudbalawei ofring, en lagijat na yumob gin jidan nomo garram enijing rong.

english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
kriol: Holot, yumob Isreil pipul en detlot najalot streinja pipul hu jidan garram yumob, YAWEI garra larramgo yumob fri, dumaji ebribodi bin dum nogudbala ting.

english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
kriol: Wal wanim mi oldei gedimbat blanga dumbat det wek? Nomo enijing, dumaji wen ai dalimbat enibodi det gudnyus, ai dalimbat det gudnyus friwan. Ai nomo meigim enibodi peiyim mi blanga dalimbat det gudnyus, dumaji ai nomo yusum det rait blanga meigim enibodi peiyim mi.

english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
kriol: Wal yu garra lisin langa mi na. Mi na YAWEI det brabli haibala boswan God, det God blanga ola Isreil pipul en ai garra dum brabli nogudbala ting langa olabat na. Ai garra gibit main pipul olabat nogudwan plent blanga dagadagat, en poisinwan blanga dringgimbat.

english: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into Yahweh’s house.
kriol: En langa det namba 14 dei langa det seimwan manth deibin kilim detlot lilwan boiwan ship blanga det Pasoba Serramoni. En detlot serramonimen en detlot Libaimen hu nomo bin jidan klinbala blanga serramoni, deibin brabli sheim, en deibin gibit miselp langa YAWEI, en afta olabat bin lau blanga gibit barnapwan ofring langa det Serramoni Pleis.

english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
kriol: Wen yumob gibit sekrifais blanga gibit theingks langa mi, yumob garra bulurrum detlot lowa gudwei, wulijim ai garra gudbinji langa yumob.

english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
kriol: Yumob garra jinggabat wen yumob bin jidan wekinmen en wekingel jis laiga prisana deya langa Ijip, en blanga tharran na aibin gibit yumob dijan lowa.”

english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
kriol: Bat yumob nomo trubala langa YAWEI. Yumob kaan jidan im pipul olabat. Yumob brabli nogudbala en laiyinbala pipul.

english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
kriol: Yu kaan tok, “Ai nomo sabi enijing blanga dijan.” God sabi wanim yu jinggabat langa yu main. Im oldei wotjimbat wi en im sabi wanim wi jinggabat en im garra peiyimbek wi blanga wanim wibin dumbat.

english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
kriol: En det boswan lida hu oldei jidan garram olabat im garra pudum im beig langa im bek en im garra go thru langa det hol weya sambodi bin grajim en im garra gowei wen im stil dakbala. Im garra gaburrumap im dubala ai wulijim im kaan luk wujei im garra go.

english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.
kriol: Modakai bin pudumdan det neim blanga King Seksis en det mak blanga det speshalwan ring langa det wed. En imbin jandim det wed langa ola mesinja hubin raidim ola faswan hosis blanga det king.

english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
kriol: “En langa det namba 3 dei yumob garra gibit dijan ofring, 11 yangwan boiwan buligi, dubala dediwan ship en 14 boiwan ship wan yiya ol, holot nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat bodi.

english: My defense to those who examine me is this:
kriol: Wal wen enibodi wandi testim mi blanga faindat if trubala mi jidan speshalwan mesinja, wal mi oldei tok lagijat.

english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
kriol: En nomeda yumob plentimbat yumob gadin, bat stil yumob kaan gedim eni kukwan daga brom detlot gadin. En nomeda yumob skwisimap ola olib daga, bat stil yumob kaan yusum det oil. En nomeda yumob meigimbat wain, bat stil yumob kaan dringgim det wain.

english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
kriol: If sambodi tok brabli nogudbalawei langa yu en detlot wed nomo trubala im kaan ardimbat yu. Detlot wed jis gowei, jis laik det bard wen im flaiwei.

english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
kriol: Wen yumob gugumbat det damba garram det nyuwan sid daga en meigim det feswan damba, yumob garra gibit det damba langa YAWEI. Det damba im brabli speshalwan ofring blanga YAWEI en yumob garra gibit seimwei laik det sid daga ofring yumob bin gibit langa YAWEI weya yumob bin grandimbat det sid daga.

english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin sabi wanim olabat bin toktok, en imbin dalim olabat, “Yumob nomo wandi toktokbat lagijat, dumaji main Dedi bin jandim mi,

english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
kriol: Langa detlot kantri weya pipul nomo bulurrum YAWEI, im nomo larram eni nogudbala plen hepin.

english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin kipgon, en imbin faindim naja dubala braja gija, det dubala san blanga Sebadi neim Jeims en Jon. Dubala bin deya insaid langa det bout meigimbat ola fishnet redibala blanga fishing.

english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
kriol: Im nomo larram mi gajimbek main win, en ai kipgon jidanbat garram pein.

english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
kriol: Sambodi hu oldei gitwail kwikbala meigimbat loda trabul, en im na dumbat loda nogudbala ting.

english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
kriol: en deibin titjim im ola klebabala ting langa det kantri, en imbin jidan haibala men, dumaji garram pawa imbin oldei tok en dum enijing.

english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
kriol: Kora bin abum thribala san neim Esiya, Elkana en Abaiyasaf. Brom detlot thribala boi ola femili lain blanga Kora bin kamat.

english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
kriol: en yumob garra oldei larram det wed blanga Jisas Krais jidan insaid langa yumob brabliwei, en yumob garra oldei titjimbat en lenimbat yumob Kristjan braja en sista olabat brabliwei, en yumob garra oldei sing ola song langa God gudbinjiwei,

english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
kriol: gudwan matiriyal, bluwan wul, pepulwan wul, redwan wul, matiriyal weya dei meigim garram nenigout heya,

english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.
kriol: Yubin kipum det pramis weya yubin meigim langa main dedi Deibid. En tudei na ebrijing weya yubin tok bin hepin na.

english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.
kriol: Ebribodi langa dijan kantri, nomeda im lobala o haibala, olabat trai blanga meigim mani trikibalawei, en ol detlot serramonimen en ol detlot speshalwan mesinja oldei trikimbat ola pipul du.

english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
kriol: Wal wantaim detlot jaiyant gulum Emait bin oldei jidan langa det taun gulum Eiya. Detlot pipul bin brabli longwan en brabli strongbala jis laik detlot jaiyant gulum Einakait.

english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu irrim en teiknodis en dum ola rait ting, wal dei garra jidan laibala, bat detlot hu nomo teiknodis en nomo onap blanga olabat rongwei, wal dei garra faindim miselp langa deinja.

english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
kriol: Bat detlot Juwish pipul kaan bilib langa det wed, dumaji dei wandi luk klebabala ting garra hepin. En detlot Jintail pipul kaan bilib langa det wed du, dumaji dei wandi irrim bigwan klebabala wed.

english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
kriol: Neksdei na deibin bringimap sambala enimul, en deibin kilim haf detlot enimul ded langa sekrifais serramoni, en deibin gibit haf detlot enimul blanga det ofring gulum feloship ofring, en afta deibin jidan blanga dagat det serramoni daga en dringgimbat, en deibin densdensbat du.

english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
kriol: Wal det gel bin tok, “Bos, if enibodi pudum bleim langa yu blanga det ting weya yu garra dum blanga mi, wal yu en yu femili olabat kaan abum det bleim. Det bleim garra kaman langa mi en main femili olabat.”

english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
kriol: Wal Elkana bin abum dubala san neim Amasai en Ahimath. Wal dijan na det femili lain weya bin kamat brom Ahimath. Olabat neim bin Elkana, Sofai, Neihath, Eliyab, Jeroham, en Elkana.

english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
kriol: Wal wen Jeikob en detlot stakmen bin stil toktok yet, Reitjul bin kamat deya garram ola ship blanga im dedi,

english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”
kriol: Wal King Sol bin tok, “Nomeda aibin dumbat nogudbala ting, bat stil ola pipul en ola boswan garra luk yu shoum rispek langa mi, dumaji mi bos blanga olabat, en yu garra kaman garram mi wulijim ai garra weship langa YAWEI det God blanga yu.”

english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
kriol: Nathanel det san blanga Suwara im det boswan blanga det Isaka klen,

english: Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin dum wanim imbin pramis blanga dum. Imbin binijimap wi en nomo kain langa wi, dumaji imbin dalim wi longtaim wen wi grengrenfathamob bin jidan laibala. Imbin meigim detlot enamimob bidim wi, en deibin gudbinji.

english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
kriol: Wal nomeda ai gin jidan eniwei, bat stil imbin brabli gud weya yumob bin album mi wen aibin abum adtaim,

english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.
kriol: Brom deya Esta det nambawan waif blanga det king, en det doda blanga Ebiheil, bin raidimdan leda garram Modakai blanga det dubala dei gulum Purim. Esta bin bekimap strongbalawei det fes leda weya Modakai bin jandim.

english: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa Mosis ontop langa det bigwan hil gulum Sainai,

english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, ai dalim yumob na. Yumob garra oldei wotjim miselp blanga detlot pipul hu meigim yumob kadimat miselp en stapam yumob brom bilib brabliwei. Detlot pipul hu meigim yumob dum lagijat nomo bulurrum det wed weya yumob bin len.

english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
kriol: En wen ol dislot ting garra hepin, yumob garra sabi det taim im gulijap na jis laik weya gel abum det feswan pein wen im garra abum beibi.

english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
kriol: Wal dislot na det femili lain weya bin kamat brom Eran. Olabat neim bin Eliyeisa, Finiyas, Ebishuwa, Bukai, Yusi, Serahiya, Meraiyoth, Amaraiya, Ahitab, Seidok en Ahimas.

english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
kriol: en imbin tok, “Wotfo yumob pipul langa Jerusalem nomo sabi wanim yumob bina dum tudei blanga jidan gudwei? Wotfo yumob kaan luk?

english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),
kriol: Wal ol dislot ebrijing bin hepin langa det taim wen King Seksis bin jidan bos blanga det bigwan kantri gulum Pesha. Imbin jidan bos blanga 127 kantri, brom det kantri gulum Ithiyopiya raidap langa det kantri gulum Indiya.

english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
kriol: En if det bos blanga det haus nomo agri langa yumob wen yumob tok det wed, wal God kaan album im jidan gudwei. Bat if im agri langa yumob, wal God garra album im,

english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
kriol: Wal aibin ensim olabat na, “YAWEI bin dalim mi, en imbin gibit dijan wed blanga yumob.

english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
kriol: Brom deya naitaim bin gowei, en wen imbin ailibala, imbin det namba 5 dei na.

english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
kriol: “Wal yumob garra selim ola enijing yumob garram, en yumob garra gibit ola mani langa ola po pipul, dumaji yumob garra gedim det prais langa hebin weya kaan go nogud. Yumob garra hipimapbat ola enijing blanga yumob langa hebin weya detlot enijing kaan binij. Detlot enijing deya kaan binij, dumaji nobodi kaan stilimbat enijing deya, en nomo enijing kaan dagat detlot ting du.

english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
kriol: Wal aibin dum loda gudbala ting en pipul ebriweya bin sabi. Aibin bildimap loda haus blanga main en aibin growimap loda greiptri.

english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
kriol: “Aibin binijimap brabliwei sambala pipul brom yumob, jis laik aibin binijimap detlot pipul brom det dubala nogudbala taun gulum Sadam en Gamora. En yumob pipul weya ai nomo bin binijimap, yumob na jis laik det wanbala stik weya sambodi bin pulumat bifo imbin barnap langa faiya. Bat stil yumob nomo bin kambek langa mi. Yumob nomo bin abum irriwol.

english: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
kriol: “Bambai na im garra fait blanga teikoba langa Ijip igin, bat im kaan win laik det fes taim.

english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
kriol: En wen yumob luk det win kaman brom sauthwei, yumob tok, ‘Im garra hot.’ En im go hot.

english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
kriol: YAWEI, yu gibit melabat detmatj filing blanga jidan gudbinjiwei na blanga ola yiya weya melabat bin jidan nogudbinjiwei.

english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
kriol: Wal Jisas bin ensim olabat, “Wal yumob jinggabat wanim im tok langa yumob ron lowa. Longtaim God bin gulum detlot Isreil bosmen ‘drimin’.

english: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
kriol: Ai garra dum gudbala ting langa enibodi hu oldei shoum rispek langa det seikridwan dei gulum Sebathdei en nomo wek, en langa ol detlot pipul hu nomo dum eni nogudbala ting.

english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
kriol: Wal det king bin laigim Esta mowa langa ol detlot najalot gel. Imbin brabli gudbinji garram im, en imbin pudum det speshalwan het langa im hed blanga meigim im nambawan waif blanga deigim pleis blanga Bashtai.

english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
kriol: “Yumob sabi? If yumob hendulum lilwan ting raitwei, wal yumob gin hendulum bigwan ting raitwei du. Bat if yumob hendulum det lilwan ting rongwei, wal yumob garra hendulum det bigwan ting rongwei du.

english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
kriol: Wal wen detlot wekinmen bin kamat langa det woda, Saiman Pida bin dalim olabat, “Ai garra go fishing.” En olabat bin tok, “Wal melabat garra kaman garram yu du.” En deibin ol gowin langa bout, en deibin fishingbat olnait. Bat dei nomo bin gajim eni fish.

english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.
kriol: Wal Josef bin meigim ola braja blanga im jidan langa det teibul brom det eldiswan raidap langa det yangiswan. En deibin ol lukinat Josef, en wen deibin luk hau imbin meigim olabat jidan, deibin ol hatjamp.

english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
kriol: Wen Meri bin irrim det wed, streidawei imbin gidap, en imbin go kwikbala blanga midim Jisas deya atsaid langa taun langa det pleis weya Matha bin tok langa im.

english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.
kriol: en aibin dalim olabat ebrijing wanim YAWEI bin shoumbat mi.

english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
kriol: en blanga det wek weya yumob oldei dumbat, dumaji yumob bilib langa im. En melabat oldei gibit im theingks dumaji yumob laigim im brabliwei en yumob oldei wek adbalawei. En melabat oldei gibit im theingks dumaji yumob sabi Jisas Krais en yumob oldei jandap strongbalawei blanga im.

english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
kriol: “Wal aibin jinggabat tharran en aibin reken im gud aidiya en aibin pikimat 12 men, wanbala men brom ebri klen.

english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Wen ai garra panishim ola pipul langa ebri kantri, ai garra shoum olabat main pawa en olabat garra luk garram olabat ronwan ai dumaji mi na garram detmatj pawa en mi na det brabli shainiwan lait.

english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
kriol: Wal detlot pipul bin tok, “Bos, melabat bin trikim yumob, dumaji melabat bin bradin blanga dai. Melabat bin irrim det stori blanga YAWEI det God blanga yumob, en melabat sabi imbin dalim det wekinmen neim Mosis blanga gibit yumob ola kantri en kilim ded ola pipul. En wen melabat bin irrim det stori, melabat bin bradin blanga yumob.

english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
kriol: Yu oldei gudbala langa detlot pipul hu jidan gudbala. Bat yu oldei nogudbala langa detlot pipul hu jidan nogudbala.

english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
kriol: Imbin tok, “Wantaim deibin abum wan boswan blanga det kot langa wan taun, en det boswan nomo bin bradin langa enibodi, en im nomo bin bradin langa God du.

english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
kriol: En sambala pipul bin tok, “Nomo. Im det Boswan gulum Masaiya.” En najalot pipul bin tok, “Nomo. Im nomo det Masaiya, dumaji det men bin kaman brom Gelali,

english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin pikimat dislot men na brom detlot klen. Blanga det Juda klen det lida bin neim Keilab, det san blanga Jefana. Blanga det Simiyan klen det lida bin neim Shelumiyel, det san blanga Amihad. Blanga det Benjamin klen det lida bin neim Elided, det san blanga Kislon. Blanga det Den klen det lida bin neim Bukai, det san blanga Joglai. Blanga det Manesa klen det lida bin neim Heniyel, det san blanga Ifad. Blanga det Ifreiyim klen det lida bin neim Kemyuwel, det san blanga Shiftan. Blanga det Sebyulan klen det lida bin neim Elisafan, det san blanga Panak. Blanga det Isaka klen det lida bin neim Paltiyel, det san blanga Esan. Blanga det Esha klen det lida bin neim Ahihad, det san blanga Shelomi. Blanga det Neftali klen det lida bin neim Pedahel, det san blanga Amihad.

english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
kriol: Wal neksdei na detlot Filastain pipul bin gobek blanga pulumatbat ola enijing brom detlot dedbala Isreil solja, en deibin faindim detlot bodi blanga king Sol en im thribala san deya ontop langa det hil Gilbowa,

english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
kriol: Nomeda det lowa bin tok ola serramonimen garra kaman brom det Libai klen, bat stil God bin meigim Jisas jidan serramonimen, dumaji Jisas garram det pawa blanga jidan laibala olagijawan.

english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.
kriol: Wal God bin tok langa det men hubin werrimon detlot gudwan klos. Imbin tok, “Yu go rait langa midul langa detlot wil, deya andanith langa detlot tjerabim en yu garra gajim bigismob hotwan eshis garram yu bingga. Yu garra tjakam en spredimat detlot hotwan eshis oloba langa dijan taun.” Aibin wotjim im go.

english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
kriol: Wen mi leidan, mi nomo silip, jis laik det bard weya im jidan miselp ontop langa haus.

english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
kriol: Ai nomo tok yumob dumbat rong ting wen yumob oldei gibit sekrifais ofring langa mi, en wen yumob oldei bringimap ola ofring langa mi en barnim olabat,

english: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”
kriol: Yu mait reken olabat brabli strongbala blanga fait, bat God garra larram detlot enamimob bidim yu, nomeda yu fait brabli adbalawei. Im na meigim yu win det fait o im na larram detlot enamimob bidim yu.”

english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu jidan langa olabat kantri en nomo teiknodis langa det lowa blanga God garra abum loda trabul, bat detlot pipul hu kipgon det lowa blanga God im tok garra jidan hepiwan.

english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.
kriol: Wal mi na, YAWEI, ai gibit woning langa olabat. Ai garra jandim brabli nogudbala ting langa olabat, en olabat kaan ranawei. En wen olabat garra jingat langa mi blanga album olabat, ai kaan irrim olabat.

english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;
kriol: “Wal wen im sabi im gilti, wal im garra lafta onap blanga det nogudbalawei.

english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
kriol: Olabat grajimbat det graun naitaim langa det deset kantri blanga dagadagatbat detlot rutpat blanga detlot plent, dumaji deibin jidanbat hanggriwan.

english: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.
kriol: en Deibid bin gajim wanbala ston brom im beig, en imbin pudum det ston langa det shangai, en imbin swingim det shangai, en det ston bin go streit langa Galaiyath, en det ston bin kilim im rait langa midul langa im forid, en det ston bin breigimap det hed bounpat insaid, en Galaiyath bin buldan feisdan langa graun.

english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
kriol: en imbin stat tjakambat ston langa Deibid en im boswan wekinmen olabat. Nomeda ola solja blanga Deibid bin raidaran langa im, bat stil det men bin tjakambat ston langa im,

english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.
kriol: “Bebalon, yu brabli praudbala. Wal mi na YAWEI det brabli boswan God, en ai nomo laigim yu na. Det taim bin kaman na wen ai garra panishim yu.

english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
kriol: Imbin jidan nambawan blanga Detlot 30 Solja, en imbin lida blanga olabat. Bat dei nomo bin meigim im jidan mowa haibala langa detlot solja dei gulum Detlot Thribala Solja, dumaji olabat bin brabli boswan.

english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
kriol: King Jehowesh bin gedim ola silba en gol en ebrijing imbin faindim, en ola ebrijing deibin yusum langa det Serramoni Pleis en ola brabli gudwan ebrijing brom det bigwan haus blanga det king en imbin deigim detlot ebrijing langa Sameriya en imbin deigimbek sambala prisana garram im du.

english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
kriol: Yumob sabi na? Im jis laik weya det speshalwan mesinja neim Aisaiya bin tok langa detlot Isreil pipul. Imbin tok, “Nomeda detlot Isreil pipul jidan detmatj wulijim ola sengraun wansaid langa solwoda, bat stil God garra seibum oni lilbit brom detlot pipul, dumaji wen det rait taim garra kaman, streidawei God garra jadjim detlot pipul en peiyimbek olabat brabliwei.”

english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
kriol: Bat det wed nomo gowin insaid langa olabat, en dei nomo lisin langa det wed fo longtaim, en wen enikain trabul kaman langa olabat, wal dei tenawei brom det wed na.

english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
kriol: Wal tudei yumob sabi God. O maitbi ai tok, God im sabi yumob. En dumaji yumob sabi im, wal wotfo yumob oldei wandi gobek langa ol detlot ting weya kaan album yumob en gibit yumob enijing? Wotfo yumob wandi jidan wekinmen blanga detlot ting weya dei gulum drimin igin?

english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”
kriol: En deya na Ilaija bin tok langa Ilaisha, “Yu garra dalim mi wanim ai garra dum blanga yu bifo YAWEI deigidawei mi.” Wal Ilaisha bin tok, “Yu garra larram mi abum det seimwan pawa weya yu garram blanga deigim yu pleis.”

english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
kriol: Wal yu garra pikimat detkain men na, dumaji loda Kristjan pipul deya langa det kantri nomo duwit langa enibodi. Loda Kristjan pipul tok eniwei, en dei trai en meigim najalot pipul bilib langa olabat wei, en dei nomo lisin langa enibodi. En loda Kristjan pipul brom detlot Juwish pipul jidan lagijat du.

english: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
kriol: Sing nyuwan song langa YAWEI det trubala God. Ola pipul langa dijan wel sing song langa YAWEI.

english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
kriol: Bat Jisas bin holdim det lilboi langa im bingga, en imbin lidimap im, en imbin meigim im jandap.

english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
kriol: Wal det taim detlot wekinmen blanga Jisas nomo bin sabi det ting weya bin hepin langa Jisas brabliwei. Bat afta wen imbin gidap laibala brom dedbala, det taim na deibin jinggabat wanim det oltestaman bin tok en wanim deibin dum blanga Jisas, en deibin sabi na.

english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
kriol: Brom deya det bos blanga ola solja bin jingat langa dubala boswan solja, en imbin dalim dubala, “Yunbala meigim redi 200 solja en 70 hosmen en 200 spiyamen blanga go langa det taun gulum Sesariya, en yumob garra gowei tunait na.

english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
kriol: Wal aibin luk det geit weya imbin go insaidwei langa det kotyad blanga det Serramoni Pleis en aibin luk imbin mowa haibala langa det dubala atsaidwan geit weya bin go langa det kotyad. Wal det men bin meshurum det longweiwan roud brom det atsaidwan geit langa det insaidwan geit en imbin 50 mita.

english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
kriol: Wal wi garra dum ebrijing weya God bin dalim wi blanga dum. En wen wi dum, tharran na shoum wi trubala wi sabi God.

english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
kriol: “Yumob jinggabat detlot Bebalon pipul. Detlot Asiriya pipul nomo bin binijimap Taya, bat detlot Bebalon pipul bin dum tharran. Det taun gulum Taya im jis rabishwan en ola wailwan enimul jidan langa det pleis na.

english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.
kriol: “Detlot speshalwan mesinja bin lidimbat main pipul olabat rongwei wen deibin oldei toktokbat, ‘Ebrijing im orait’. Bat ebrijing nomo orait. Detlot speshalwan mesinja oldei trikimbat langa ola pipul jis laik sambodi hu oldei hipimap ola ston blanga meigim wol en gaburrumap garram waitwan klei, en tok, ‘Dijan im brabli strongwan wol,’ bat najing.

english: Then the Philistines said, “Who has done this?” They said, “Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion.” The Philistines came up, and burned her and her father with fire.
kriol: Wal ol detlot Filastain pipul bin askimbat miselp hubin barnimap olabat fam, en deibin faindat Semsan bin dum, dumaji im lambarra bin gibit im waif langa najawan men deya langa det taun gulum Timna. Afta na detlot pipul bin go langa det taun, en deibin barnimap det gel en im dedi haus.

english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat yumob bodi na. Wi garram olkain difrinwan pat langa wi bodi, en detlot difrinwan pat dumbat difrinwan wek.

english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
kriol: Wal langa det rait taim pipul garra dum ebrijing, bat pipul oldei abumbat loda trabul en adtaim.

english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
kriol: Yu meigim main enami olabat sabi yu na seibumbat mi.

english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
kriol: Wal det mesinja bin go langa King Deibid, en imbin dalim im wanim Jowab bin dalim im blanga tok,

english: Huram continued, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.
kriol: Preisimbat YAWEI det God blanga Isreil. Im na bin meigim skai en graun. Imbin gibit King Deibid brabli klebawan san hu sabi ebrijing wanim im garra dum. Im na garra bildimap serramoni pleis blanga YAWEI en haus blanga im ronselp.

english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.
kriol: Wal detlot boutmen bin brabli bradin blanga YAWEI na, en deibin meigim det sekrifais serramoni blanga im, en deibin meigim olkain pramis langa im.

english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
kriol: Lagijat na Pida bin tok, dumaji deibin ol brabli bradin, en im nomo bin sabi wanim im garra tok.

english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.
kriol: En yu garra pudum oliboil en pudum det gudsmelwan medisin ontop.

english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
kriol: Bat afta wen detlot boswan en det nekswan jinareishan bin ol dai, ola biginini blanga detlot nyuwan jinareishan nomo bin jinggabat wanim YAWEI bin dumbat blanga olabat longtaim.

english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
kriol: Wal det taim na King Herod bin jidan bos langa Jerusalem, en imbin stat gibitbat ola bilibamob adtaim,

english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
kriol: Yumob bin fogedabat yumob ronwan God. Im jis laiga bigwan ston weya bin seibum yumob. Im det God na hubin gibit yumob laif.

english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
kriol: Trubala, longtaim im garra jidan king! Larram detlot pipul brom Shiba gibit im gol. Larram ola pipul prei blanga im olataim. Larram God jidan gudbala langa im olataim.

english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
kriol: Yu larram Lesaras go en gibit woning langa olabat wulijim dei kaan kaman iya langa dijan pleis weya ebribodi oldei ardimbat.’

english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”
kriol: Wal Deibid bin tok, “Wotabat Ebsalom det san main? Im rait?” Wal det mesinja bin tok, “Bos, im mobeda ola enami blanga yu en ol detlot pipul hubin gibit yu bekboun bina dai seimwei laik imbin dai.”

english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
kriol: Nomo silipsilipbat garram naja men waif. Tharran meigim yu nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
kriol: Yumob nomo bradin, dumaji ebriyiya yumob irrimbat olkain stori blanga detlot boswan weya fait gija blanga teikoba en jidan bos. Bat yumob kaan bradin en gibap.

english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
kriol: Det wekinmen hu wek gudwei garra jidan bos blanga det boswan san, dumaji im nogudwan, en wen det bosmen garra dai im garra libum sambala ting langa det wekinmen dumaji im jis laik im ronwan san.

english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.
kriol: Wal Ebsalom bin duwit langa det wed weya Hushai bin gibit im, en imbin stat majurrumap ola Isreil men brom ebriweya langa det kantri. Wal wen Ahithafel bin luk Ebsalom nomo bin duwit langa det wed weya imbin gibit im, imbin brabli nogudbinji, en imbin gajim im dongki, en imbin gowei brom Jerusalem, en imbin gobek langa im ronwan taun, en deya na imbin meigim ebrijing rait langa im femili, en afta imbin go en heingim miselp, en deibin berrim im bodi deya gin langa im femili greibyad.

english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.
kriol: Wal det men bin jandap wansaid langa mi na en aibin irrim YAWEI bin toktokbat insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis,

english: Afterward,” says Yahweh, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’
kriol: Bat blanga yu, en yu wekinmenmob, en ola pipul hu stil jidan laibala afta det fait, en afta det taim wen yumob nomo bin abum daga, en afta wen pipul bin daidaibat brom det nogudwan siknis, wal ai garra larram King Nebakanesa en ol yumob enami hubin oldei wandim blanga kilim yumob, garra gajim ol yumob. King Nebakanesa garra kilim yumob ded. Im kaan fil sori o kain langa yumob en im kaan larram yumob jidan laibala.” Wal lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
kriol: Dislot najamob bin boswan blanga detlot femili hubin kaman brom det femili lain blanga Libai. Jedeiya bin det boswan blanga det femili lain blanga Shebuwel en Emrem.

english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
kriol: Wal brom det taim na detlot pipul langa det nowathwan kantri gulum Isreil, bin oldei faitfaitbat langa det femili lain blanga King Deibid deya langa det sauthwan kantri gulum Juda.

english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
kriol: Wal det gel bin heidim Jon brabliwei, en imbin wandi kilim im. Bat Herod nomo bin larram im kilim im, dumaji imbin bradin langa Jon.

english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
kriol: Wal Salaman bin jidan king blanga ola pleis langa Isreil,

english: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.
kriol: en dei garra gowin langa yu haus en langa ola haus blanga ola boswan wekinmen blanga yu en langa ola haus blanga ol yu pipul olabat, en detlot grashopa garra bilimap ol detlot haus. Yumob nomo bin abum detmatj grashopa iya langa dijan kantri bifo, en yumob grengrenfatha nomo bin luk detmatj grashopa du.” Lagijat na Mosis en Eran bin tok, en wen dubala bin binij tok, dubala bin gowei brom det king.

english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;
kriol: En jinggabat im bifo det san en det mun en detlot sta garra jidan dimwan blanga yu, en bifo detlot rein klaud garra kambek.

english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’
kriol: Yu kaan ranawei eniweya. Dei garra gajim yu en hendimoba yu langa det king. Yu garra luk im feis en yu garra tok garram im, en afta yu garra go garram im langa Bebalon.

english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
kriol: En blanga tharran na ola gel garra werrimon det het blanga shoum rispek langa olabat hasbin weya olabat jidan bos blanga olabat, dumaji nomo oni men garra luk detlot gel deya langa det sebis. Ola einjul lukinat langa olabat du.

english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
kriol: Bat ola klebabalamen blanga det king bin dum det seimkain klebabala ting garram olabat ron pawa du, en deibin meigim loda frog kamat brom ola woda du.

english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
kriol: Ol main enami garram gudwan bodi en dei jidan strongbala. Sambala pipul nomo laigim mi, en dei nomo garram eni risan.

english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
kriol: en imbin wandi dai blanga wi, en blanga tharran na imbin lafta meigim miselp brabli seim laik wi, dumaji imbin wandi meigim miselp serramonimen blanga wi. En imbin wandi jidan brabli trubala en kainbala blanga wi wen imbin dum det boswan haibala serramonimen wek blanga God, en imbin meigim ola pipul fri brom olabat nogudbalawei wen imbin dum det wek.

english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
kriol: Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Detlot nogudbala pipul oldei kaman en laflafbat langa mi, en olabat oldei meigimbat fan langa mi.

english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
kriol: Wal aibin binij dalimbat detlot pipul ebrijing wanim YAWEI det trubala God blanga olabat bin jandim mi blanga dalimbat olabat.

english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
kriol: en wan gel bin deya hubin abum nogudbala spirit, en det spirit bin meigim det gel sikwan. Det gel bin abum nogudwan bekboun, en im kaan jandap streitbala. Fo 18 yiya imbin lagijat.

english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,
kriol: En Salaman bin abum 80,000 wekinmen blanga kadimbat ola ston langa det hil kantri, en 70,000 wekinmen blanga garrimap detlot hebiwan ston,

english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin gowei brom det pleis, en wen imbin wokwok, imbin luk wan men bin jidanbat langa det haus weya imbin oldei gajimbat ola teks mani blanga gabman. Det men bin neim Methyu, en Jisas bin dalim im, “Yu bulurrum mi.” En Methyu bin gidap, en imbin bulurrum Jisas.

english: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.
kriol: Det king bin gibit oda langa im wekinmen olabat blanga meigim dubala sheip garram wing brom aiyan en gaburrumap dubala garram gol. Deibin pudum dubala langa det Brabli Seikridwan Rum.

english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
kriol: Bat tudei na God jidan langa hebin en im garra tok mi nomo gilti en im garra oldei maindimbat langa mi.

english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
kriol: Neksdei melabat bin go langa Jeims, en ola tjetj lidamob bin deya du.

english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
kriol: Dumaji ai laigim main femili olabat en ol main fren olabat, ai askim God blanga larram olabat jidan gudbinjiwei.

english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, ai wandim yumob garra sabi det plen blanga God weya imbin holdimbek en nomo oldei shoum langa enibodi. Bat imbin shoum wi det plen na, en yumob garra sabi det plen wulijim yumob kaan reken miselp haibala. Wal iya na det plen blanga God. Imbin meigim detlot Isreil pipul jidan admen. Bat im kaan meigim olabat jidan lagijat olagijawan. Dei garra jidan admen raidap ol detlot Jintail pipul hu garra bilib langa Jisas Krais bin kaman langa im.

english: Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
kriol: Ai garra singim song langa YAWEI. Ai garra preisim YAWEI. Im na bin seibum ola pipul hubin abum adtaim brom det pawa blanga ola nogudbala pipul.

english: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
kriol: Detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanbat deya garra oldei singsingbat song blanga preisimbat, en olabat garra jingatbat gudbinjiwei. Garram main pawa ai garra meigim olabat jidan bigismob, en najalot pipul garra rispek langa olabat gudbalawei.

english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
kriol: “Wal wantaim sebenbala braja bin jidan, en det bigiswan bin merrit, en wen imbin dai, im nomo bin abum eni biginini.

english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
kriol: En ola pipul blanga Jerusalem bin tok na, “Melabat bin irrim det wed. Melabat garram wikwan bingga, en melabat ardimbat nomo lilbit en abumbat loda pein, jis laik det wuman weya im redi blanga abum beibi.

english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.
kriol: en deibin ol mub, detlot wil bin ol mub garram olabat du. Wen deibin oldei spredimat olabat wing blanga flaiwei, detlot wil bin go garram olabat du. Detlot tjerabim bin oldei mub garram detlot wil du.

english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
kriol: Yumob gulum mi Titja, en yumob gulum mi Bos. En yumob garra gulum mi Titja en Bos. En im rait lagijat, dumaji mi na Titja en Bos blanga yumob.

english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.
kriol: “Wal dijan na det mesij blanga detlot enimul weya oldei jidan langa det deset kantri langa sauthsaid. ‘Ol yumob mesinja hu oldei meigimbat ola dongki en kemul garrimapbat ola gol en silba blanga Ijip, yumob go thru det nogudbala deset kantri weya im garram detmatj laiyan en brabli poisinwan sneik.

english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
kriol: Brom deya najawan sain bin kamat langa hebin. Brabli bigwan dregan bin jandap deya. Det dregan bin redwan, en imbin abum 7 hed garram 10 hon, en langa im hed imbin werrimon 7 speshalwan het. Wal det dregan im na det boswan dibuldibul neim Seitin hubin meigim miselp sneik longtaim blanga trikimbat ola pipul langa dijan kantri en meigim olabat go nogudbalawei.

english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
kriol: Yunbala dedi bin tok, ‘Ai gibit yu ola spadidwan enimul blanga peiyim yu.’ En afta ola enimul bin abum spadidwan beibi, en wen imbin hepin lagijat, yunbala dedi bin tok, ‘Ai gibit yu ola straipiwan beibi blanga peiyim yu.’ En ola enimul bin abum straipiwan beibi.

english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
kriol: Wal im kaan tatjim det dedwan bodi blanga det femilimob blanga im waif en meigim miselp nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
kriol: Mi jis laik defwan en kaan irrim enijing, en jis laik ai nomo garram mawus en kaan tok langa enibodi.

english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
kriol: Bat wi garra ol dai en ola wem garra gaburrumap wi.

english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
kriol: En det san blanga Shaul bin Shalum, en im grensan bin neim Mibsam en det san blanga im bin neim Mishma.

english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
kriol: Wal yu garra jinggabat ol dislot ting weya mi dalimbat yu, dumaji Jisas Krais det Bos blanga yunmi garra meigim yu sabi brabliwei wanim mi toktok.

english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
kriol: en jis laik detlot wekinmen hu oldei gajimbat det rabishwan aiyan brom det silba langa hotwan faiya, wal ai garra jandim hotwan faiya blanga meltimap olabat, dumaji mi brabli wail.

english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
kriol: Wal yu go hanting garram yu bo en erro en kilim bif blanga mi, dumaji mi oldei laigim dagat detkain bif. En yu bringimbek det bif en gugum blanga mi, en afta wen ai binij dagadagat det bif, wal ai garra gibit langa yu main laswan wed, en ai garra hendimoba ola ebrijing blanga mi langa yu bifo mi dai.”

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa Mosis,

english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
kriol: en Jisas bin go deya dumaji God bin tok im garra hepin lagijat. Longtaim det speshalwan mesinja blanga God neim Aisaiya bin tok langa oltestaman blanga dijan ting,

english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
kriol: Det einjul bin dalim mi dijan wed brom YAWEI det trubala God blanga Serababal. Imbin tok, “Langa yu ronselp yu nomo brabli strongwan men blanga bildimap dis bigwan Serramoni Pleis. Yu nomo garram loda pawa, bat main spirit im brabli strongwan en im garra meigim yu brabli strongbala blanga binij bildimap det Serramoni Pleis.

english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
kriol: Wal detlot wekinmen bin tok, “Sambala pipul reken yu Jon Beptis, en sambala pipul reken yu det speshalwan mesinja blanga God hubin jidan longtaim neim Ilaija o maitbi Jeramaiya, en sambala pipul reken yu najawan speshalwan mesinja.”

english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok, “Ebritaim wen aibin wandi album main pipul olabat deya langa Isreil, aibin oldei luk ola nogudbala ting weya deibin oldei dumbat. Ebritaim wen aibin wandi meigim olabat gudbala, aibin luk det nogudbalawei weya deibin oldei bulurrumbat. Dei oldei dalimbat miselp laiya, en dei oldei gowin langa enibodi haus en stilimbat ola enijing, en wen dei midim enibodi langa roudwei, dei oldei pulumat im ola enijing.

english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Ol yumob pipul brom Jerusalem, yumob kraikraibat en kadimof yumob heya en tjakidawei. En yumob sing det fyunral song ontop langa detlot hil, dumaji mi na YAWEI, en mi brabli wail na, en aibin gibit bekboun langa main pipul olabat.

english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
kriol: “En langa det namba 7 dei yumob garra gibit dijan ofring, 7 yangwan boiwan buligi, dubala dediwan ship en 14 wan yiya ol boiwan ship, holot nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat.

english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
kriol: “Ai dalim yumob. If dubala pipul agri gija wen dei prei blanga enijing, main Dedi langa hebin garra ensim det preya blanga dubala. Dumaji wen dubala o thribala majurrap blanga prei garram main neim, mi oldei deya garram olabat.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
kriol: en weya imbin oldei lukaftumbat ola ship. Imbin meigim im jidan king blanga ola Isreil pipul. Imbin det stakmen blanga ola pipul blanga God,

english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
kriol: Job, yu nomo sabi enijing. Maitbi if yu jidan wailwan o jelaswan, tharran na garra kilim yu ded.

english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
kriol: Aibin meigim ola pipul laik mi, en blanga tharran na if wan men kilim najawan men ded, wal najawan men garra kilim im ded du blanga det ting.

english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
kriol: Wal wen Jethro bin irrim ola gud ting weya YAWEI bin dum blanga detlot Isreil pipul, imbin gudbinji,

english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
kriol: En imbin bin dalim im, “Ran langa det yangbala men garram det string blanga meshurum en dalim im dijan wed brom YAWEI det trubala God. YAWEI bin tok ‘Dumaji detmatj pipul en buligi garra jidan langa Jerusalem, im garra jidan brabli bigwan en im kaan abum eni wol.

english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.
kriol: en wen imbin lidimap det spiya, ol detlot solja hubin blandim miselp biyain langa det taun bin kamat streidawei, en deibin go streidin langa det taun, en streidawei deibin stat barnimap det taun.

english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.
kriol: Wal Neiham bin tok dijan wed blanga ol detlot pipul deya langa det taun gulum Ninaba. Imbin tok, “Wan men bin kamat brom yumob garram olkain nogudbala plen, en imbin wandi fait langa YAWEI.”

english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
kriol: Ai garra binijimap ol detlot Asiriya pipul hu oldei jidan langa main kantri, en ai garra bitsimap detlot pipul hu oldei gogobat langa main bigwan hil. En ai garra meigim main pipul jidan fri, en detlot Asiriya pipul kaan gibit adtaim langa main pipul olabat enimo.

english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
kriol: En detlot fama oldei kadimdan ol detlot tri weya nomo growimap gudwan daga, en dei oldei tjakam detlot tri langa faiya.

english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
kriol: en aibin blandim, dumaji aibin bradin langa yu. Ai sabi yu admen en yu meigim najalot pipul dum ola wek en yu gajim ola mani. En blanga tharran na aibin bradin langa yu.’

english: Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
kriol: Wal YAWEI main God bin dalim mi, Sekaraiya, “Detlot ship deya garra dai. Yu go langa ola boswan blanga detlot ship en dalim olabat yu garra jidan stakmen blanga detlot ship.

english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
kriol: If yu nomo laigim len blanga ola gudwan ting wal yu garra ardim yu ronselp, bat if yu teiknodis langa ola gudbala wed wal yu garra jidan sabibala.

english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
kriol: en wen imbin faindat wotaim deibin luk det sta, imbin dalim olabat laiya. Imbin tok, “Yumob go lida langa Bethlahem, en yumob lukabat det lilboi, en wen yumob faindim im, yumob garra kambek en dalim mi, dumaji ai garra go langa im en weship im du.” Lagijat na det king bin tok laiyawei.

english: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
kriol: Yumob garra shoum rispek en teiknodis langa YAWEI. Yumob garra bradin langa im, en jidan brabli gudbinjiwei garram im.

english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
kriol: en aibin dum ol detlot ting weya imbin pikimat mi blanga dum, en blanga tharran na deibin pudum mi langa dijan jeil. english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
kriol: en ai wandim yumob garra sabi det brabli strongwan pawa blanga im weya im wek langa ol detlot pipul hu bilib langa im.

english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
kriol: en det fladwoda bina binijimap wi na.”

english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
kriol: Langa oltestaman God bin tok, ‘Ai garra jandim main mesinja lida langa det boswan blanga meigim det roud redibala blanga im.’ En wen im tok lagijat langa oltestaman, im tok blanga Jon Beptis.

english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
kriol: Yumob sabi?
