Im garra shain langa yumob jis laiga moningsta weya im shain.

english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
kriol: Brom deya Jisas bin go nomo longwei brom detlot thribala wekinmen, en deya na imbin baudan garram im feis langa graun, en imbin prei langa God blanga deigidawei det trabul brom im.

english: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
kriol: “En ol yumob Juda pipul deya langa det taun gulum Maresha, God garra jandim sambodi langa yumob blanga bidim yumob en teikoba det taun blanga yumob. En ola haibala Isreil pipul garra go en blandim miselp langa ola keib deya langa det taun gulum Edulam.

english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
kriol: Detlot enamimob garra bitsimap ol detlot taun langa Isreil en ol detlot drimin sheip, en ol detlot teibul blanga ofring, en detlot teibul weya deibin oldei barnimbat det gudsmelwan medisin, en ol detlot ebrijing garra ol binij.

english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
kriol: Det yiya na im garra jidan brabli seikridwan blanga yumob. Yumob gin oni dagat det daga weya im gro miselp langa pedik.

english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
kriol: en langa det teibul blanga ofring weya yu garra pudum det damba ofring en langa det lemp en langa det najawan teibul weya yu garra barnim ola gudsmelwan medisin,

english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
kriol: “Wal yumob jinggabat det grengrenfatha blanga yumob neim Jeikob. Wen im en im braja Isau bin stil insaid langa dubala mami binji bifo dubala bin bon, imbin fait garram im braja, en afta wen Jeikob bin growap, imbin fait langa God.

english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
kriol: Yu ensim langa mi, if yu wandim tok enijing.

english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
kriol: en det men bin tok, “Dijan na! Brom main ronwan boun en brom main ronwan bif. Wal dei garra gulum im wuman, dumaji God bin meigim im brom main ron riboun.”

english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
kriol: En wen yumob abum olkain trabul, yumob kaan jinggabat det trabul. Yumob garra hendimoba det trabul langa God, dumaji im na lukaftumbat yumob.

english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
kriol: Imbin kilim ded ola boi hubin bon fes blanga ola femili langa Ijip.

english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
kriol: Olredi aibin tok tumatj en ai kaan tok enimo na.” Lagijat na Job bin tok.

english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
kriol: Det namba blanga ola men hubin dagadagat det daga bin 4,000, en loda wuman en biginini olabat bin dagadagat det daga du.

english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
kriol: en wen detlot thribala men bin kamat langa im, Aisik bin askim olabat, “Yumob bin bedfren langa mi bifo, en yumob bin andimwei mi brom yumob kantri. Wal wotfo yumob bin kaman iya langa mi tudei?”

english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
kriol: En dubala bin tok langa detlot pipul, “Det kantri wibin lukaran im brabli gudbala kantri.

english: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
kriol: Wen YAWEI tok im shoum im pawa. Im shoum im na det brabli haibalawan.

english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
kriol: Det nogudbalawei blanga ola nogudbala pipul jidan raitdan dip insaid langa olabat hat. Dei oni jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting. Olabat nomo bradin en abum eni rispek blanga God.

english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
kriol: YAWEI, yu na det brabli strongwan God, en yu na bin dum detmatj ting garram yu pawa. Ai garra tokabat blanga yu dumaji yu trubala. Oni yu na ai garra preisim.

english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
kriol: Bambai na wan manth afta det king blanga det kantri gulum Eman bin wandi fait langa detlot Isreil pipul hubin jidan langa det taun gulum Jeibesh deya langa det kantri gulum Giliyad. Det king bin neim Neihesh, en imbin go garram im solja olabat langa det taun, en deibin majurrumap ola pipul insaid langa det taun. Wal ola men brom det taun bin dalim det king, “If yu meigim pramis langa melabat en nomo kilim melabat ded, wal melabat garra larram yu jidan bos blanga melabat, en melabat garra jidan wekinmen blanga yu.”

english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
kriol: Nomeda mi gilti, o nomo gilti bat yu stil panishim mi en mi sheim miselp na, dumaji aibin abum loda trabul.

english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
kriol: En God kaan album detkain men weya jinggabat eniwei. Im kaan album det men hu nomo jinggabat wanwei.

english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
kriol: Detlot gudbala pipul oldei lukaftumbat olabat enimulmob gudwei, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei dumbat krulbala ting langa olabat enimulmob.

english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
kriol: Meigim olabat blainwan, en meigim olabat garrimap hebiwan loud olagijawan.

english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.
kriol: Detlot Bebalon soljamob bin stap faitfait en olabat bin jidanbat deya igin langa olabat strongwan taun. Olabat nomo garram strongwan pawa blanga fait. Olabat wikwan jis laik ola wuman. Detlot geit blanga det taun im breikinwan en detlot haus blanga olabat barnbarn garram faiya.

english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
kriol: “Wal tudei ai dalim yumob. If enibodi luk langa najawan gel en wandim im, wal im jis laik imbin silip garram im olredi, en im gilti.

english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
kriol: If enibodi wandim baiyimbek detlot sid daga o frut daga, wal im garra pei det raitwan mani en lilbit mowa.

english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
kriol: Larram ola buligi blanga melabat abum detmatj gabigabi gudwei en nomo lujimbat. Nomo larram enibodi jidan soribala en kraikrai langa ola roud blanga melabat.

english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.
kriol: Wal langa det namba 9 manth langa det namba 5 yiya wen Jehoiyakim bin jidan king langa det kantri gulum Juda, detlot pipul nomo bin dagadagat daga blanga meigim YAWEI tridim olabat gudwei. Detlot pipul hubin dum tharran bin jidan langa Jerusalem en langa detlot taun blanga Juda.

english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
kriol: Wal det olgamen bin irrim det nyus blanga Jisas,

english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
kriol: Wal yu irrim mi na. Nobodi kaan gibit laif langa enijing. Oni God gin gibit laif. En wen Jisas Krais bin jandap lida langa det gabman bos neim Panshas Pailat, imbin tok gudbalawei blanga det trubalawan wed. Wal God en Jisas Krais dubala na jidan witnis blanga yunmi weya mi dalimbat yu.

english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
kriol: Brom deya detlot pipul bin go langa Heiseroth weya olabat bin meigim kemp.

english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
kriol: Gobek langa yumob kemp na en dagat gudwan daga en dringgim switwan dringk. En gibit daga en wain langa detlot najalot pipul hu nomo garram eni daga redi, dumaji tudei im seikridwan blanga YAWEI. Wen yu dum wanim YAWEI wandim yu, tharran na garra meigim yu strongbala.”

english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
kriol: Imbin tok, “Wen yumob garra trebul langa roud, ai garra jandim einjul lida langa yumob blanga lukaftumbat yumob, en det einjul garra deigim yumob langa det kantri weya aibin meigim redi blanga yumob.

english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.
kriol: en afta wen dei pikimat detlot enimul, dei garra deigidawei olabat brom ola najalot enimul, en dei garra lukaftumbat olabat brabliwei fobala dei, en afta dei garra kilim detlot enimul wen im sangodantaim,

english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
kriol: “Eibrahem! God dalim yu, ‘Aibin meigim pramis garram main ronwan neim, en ai garra meigim yu brabli gudbinji, dumaji yu nomo bin holdimbek yu ronwan san brom mi.

english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
kriol: Wal dijan stori im blanga det drim weya YAWEI det boswan God bin gibit langa det speshalwan mesinja blanga im neim Obadaiya. Langa det drim God bin dalim im wanim garra hepin langa detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Idam. Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin jandim im mesinja langa ola pipul blanga im, en ebribodi bin irrim det wed, en det wed bin tok, “Wi garra meigim miselp redi, dumaji wi garra go en fait langa detlot pipul langa det kantri gulum Idam.”

english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
kriol: Wotfo yu oldei dumbat adwek blanga dijan laif? Wanim laif gibit yu? Ai nomo sabi. Im nomo album yu olagijawan.

english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.
kriol: Wal langa det namba 12 dei blanga det feswan manth melabat bin gowei brom det lilwan krik gulum Eiheba blanga go langa Jerusalem. God bin jidan garram melabat en imbin lukaftum melabat brom ola enami en brom detlot stilinbala enami hu oldei blandim miselp blanga stilim enijing en kilim enibodi wen deibin trebul.

english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
kriol: Detlot trabulmeika oldei stadimap trabul, jis laik lilwan faiya stadimap bigwan faiya.

english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
kriol: Yumob jinggabat blanga stilimbat en kilimbat en blanga silip garram naja men waif en blanga dalimbat laiya en spredimatbat yan.

english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
kriol: Oni God imselp sabi det wei,

english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
kriol: Afta na yumob garra meigimbat fan langa det king blanga Bebalon wen yumob singsingbat dijan song. ‘Det king, det brabli krulbala enimul, im binij na! Im kaan kilim melabat enimo.

english: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”
kriol: “Bat YAWEI bin meigim dijan pramis, ‘Nomo enibodi hu dum nogudbala ting garra jidan gudbinjiwei.’”

english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
kriol: Mi meigim miselp jidan seikridwan wulijim olabat du garra meigim miselp jidan brabli seikridwan du.”

english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
kriol: Wal ebribodi jidan lebul na. Nomeda yumob Juwish o Jintail o wekinmen o bosmen o gel o boi, bat stil yumob ol jidan wanbala garram Jisas Krais.

english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
kriol: Afta na wen Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin krosim det bigwan woda, deibin kamat langa det kantri gulum Gerasa najasaid brom Gelali,

english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
kriol: en detkain nogudbala main meigim olabat jidan enami blanga God. Wal detkain pipul garram nogudbala main nomo wandim duwit langa God lowa. En dei kaan duwit dumaji dei nomo garram pawa blanga duwit.

english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. kriol: Detlot najalot san blanga Manesa bin neim Abaiyesa, Helek, Esriyel, Shekam, Hefa en Shemida. Loda femili bin kamat brom olabat, en ol detlot femili bin gedim sambala kantri sangodansaid brom det Jodan Riba.

english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
kriol: Brom deya det wuman bin lukinat det tri na. Det tri bin brabli purdiwan, en det daga langa im bin luk gudwan blanga dagat. En det wuman bin jinggabat blanga meigim miselp klebabala na. english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
kriol: Det silibala men nomo garram det streitbala main, en wanim im tok, tharran na nomo album enibodi.

english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
kriol: King Eihes bin dai en deibin berrim im bodi langa Jerusalem, bat nomo langa det greibyad blanga ola king. Im san Hesakaiya bin jidan det nyuwan king.

english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
kriol: Ifta, Eshna, Nesib,

english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
kriol: “Bat detlot pipul bin gibit mi bekboun du. Deibin breigim main lowa en dei nomo bin kipum main wed, en deibin rabishim det Sebathdei. If dei bina bulurrum main lowa dei bina jidan gudbalawei. Aibin gulijap binijimap olabat deya langa det deset kantri, dumaji aibin brabli wail.

english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.
kriol: Dijan ola neim blanga detlot Libai femili hubin kambek brom det kantri weya deibin jidan prisana. english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
kriol: En yu garra meigim faiya garram det draiwan guna, en gugum det damba langa det faiya na, en dagat wulijim ebribodi gin luk langa yu.

english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
kriol: Heshban bin det bigiswan taun blanga Saihan det king blanga detlot Emarait pipul hubin fait en bidim langa det najawan king blanga Moweb, en Saihan, bin gajim ol det kantri raidap langa det Anan Riba.

english: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
kriol: Wal im nomo gudwan lagijat blanga peiyimbek YAWEI. Yumob brabli medwan pipul. Im na yumob dedi en imbin meigim yumob.

english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
kriol: Afta na wanwiktaim Nowa bin larramgo det pijin brom det bout igin,

english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
kriol: Im bekboun jis laik loda shild weya jidan mijamet, en im brabli adwan wulijim ston. Ola bekboun blanga det enimul joinap brabli gulijap gija, en nomo enijing gin breigim.”

english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
kriol: Bat yumob titjimbat ola pipul nomo blanga bulurrum det wed blanga God. Yumob dalim olabat wen dei abum enijing, dei gin tok langa olabat mami en dedi, ‘Dijan im seikridwan. Im blanga God. Ai kaan gibit yunbala.’

english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
kriol: Brom deya olabat bin go langa Ilim, en deya na deibin kemp langa det pleis weya bin abum 12 spring en 70 pamtri.

english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
kriol: “Brom deya yu garra luk langa det madwan brik weya yubin drowim det pitja blanga Jerusalem en gitwail en sheikim yu bingga langa det brik en yu garra tok, ‘YAWEI im brabli wail langa detlot Jerusalem pipul en im garra binijimap olabat.’

english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
kriol: Wotfo ola pipul brom najalot kantri askim melabat, “Wujei yumob God?”

english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
kriol: Wal det tjetj weya God bin pikimat iya langa dijan pleis gulum Bebalon weya mi jidan im jidan jis laiga sista blanga det tjetj blanga yumob, en ola pipul iya langa dijan tjetj tok gudei langa yumob, en det men neim Mak hu jidan jis laiga san blanga mi im tok gudei langa yumob du.

english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
kriol: Aibin luk langa detlot bigwan hil. Detlot hil bin sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit, en detlot hil bin mubabat ebriweya.

english: But Yahweh is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.
kriol: Bat yu, YAWEI, yu na det brabli trubalawan God. Yu na det brabli laibalawan God, en yu na det olagijawan king. Wen yu wail brabliwei yu meigim dijan wel sheiksheik nomo lilbit, en ola pipul hu jidan langa dijan wel oldei bradin wen yu wail.

english: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
kriol: Det boswan men neim Eshpanes bin gibit olabat nyuwan neim na. Wal Denyul imbin gulum Beltashesa, Henanaiya imbin gulum Shedrek, Misheiyel imbin gulum Mishak en Asaraiya imbin gulum Ebadinago.

english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.
kriol: Wal yu meigim yu tent mowa bigwan. Meigim detlot peig jidan ebriwei, en taitinimap olabat brabliwei wulijim dei kaan kamat en buldan.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: “Aibin dalim yu Mosis blanga gibit Eran en im femilimob en ol detlot Isreil pipul ol dislot lowa blanga bulurrumbat na. Wen eni Isreil pipul o enibodi brom najalot kantri hu jidan langa yumob Isreil pipul gibitbat barnapwan ofring, nomeda olabat bin pramis blanga dumbat, o gibitbat mi presen, det enimul kaan abum enijing rong langa im.

english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.
kriol: Wal ai kaan neba larram detlot pipul brom det Libai klen jidan serramonimen blanga mi o kaman gulijap langa det Brabli Seikridwan Rum blanga main. Olabat garra jidan brabli sheimwan en nomo abum eni rispek, dumaji olabat bin dum brabli nogudbala ting.

english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Yahweh’s word.
kriol: Ol detlot pipul brom Sameriya bin ran langa det kemp blanga detlot Siriya ami en deibin gajimbat ebrijing blanga olabat. Dijan ting bin hepin jis laik Ilaisha bin dalim det king wanim YAWEI bin tok. Ola pipul bin baiyim faib kilogrem gudbala sid daga gulum wit o 10 kilogrem sid daga gulum bali garram lilbit silbawan mani.

english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
kriol: en afta wen Jisas bin dai, God bin meigim im gidap laibala brom dedbala. En wi sabi trubala im det San blanga God, dumaji imbin gidap laibala brom dedbala, en det Holi Spirit bin shoum wi trubala im det San blanga God garram pawa.

english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
kriol: en sambala pipul deya bin oldei go en gajim detlot reig weya imbin oldei yusum, en deibin oldei go en pudum detlot reig langa ola sikbala pipul, en God bin oldei meigim olabat gudbala, en imbin oldei andimwei ola nogudbala spirit brom insaid langa enibodi wen deibin yusum det reig.

english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”
kriol: Ai garra panishim yunbala dumaji yunbala bin silipsilipbat garram eni men, en yunbala bin weshipbat detlot drimin sheip. En yunbala garra sabi mi na YAWEI det boswan God.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
kriol: Wal Herod bin brabli nogudbinji na. Bat imbin lafta duwit langa det gel, dumaji imbin meigim det pramis langa det gel wen ol detlot pipul bin deya.

english: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
kriol: Yu garra dalimbat olabat wen det rait taim blanga dislot serramoni.”

english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat na. Det bodi blanga wi garram loda difrinwan pat. En nomeda im garram loda difrinwan pat, bat stil im oni wanbala bodi.

english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
kriol: Afta na Jonathan bin gibit det bo en erro langa det yangboi, en imbin dalim im blanga deigimbek det bo en erro langa haus,

english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
kriol: Jehosafet bin 35 yiya ol wen deibin meigim im jidan det nyuwan king blanga Juda. Imbin jidan king blanga 25 yiya, en det taim na imbin oldei jidan langa Jerusalem. Im mami bin Esuba, det doda blanga Shili.

english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.
kriol: Wal Joshuwa en im solja olabat bin go ebriweya langa det hil kantri en langa det plein kantri sangodanwei en langa det plein kantri sanraiswei en langa det deset kantri sauthwei, en deibin bidim ebribodi langa detlot kantri, en dei nomo bin larram enibodi jidan laibala. Deibin kilim ebribodi langa detlot kantri ded, dumaji YAWEI bin dalim olabat blanga kilim olabat ded.

english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.
kriol: en imbin dalim im hau King Sol bin kilimbat ded ol detlot serramonimen blanga YAWEI.

english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
kriol: Wal deibin jingat langa det gel, en wen imbin kaman, dubala bin askim im, “Yu wandi go garram dijan olmen?” En det gel bin tok, “Yuwai.”

english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
kriol: “Yumob sabi na? Nomeda yumob nogudbala, bat stil yumob sabi blanga gibit yumob biginini olabat gudbala ting. En yumob sabi yumob Dedi langa hebin im gudbala, en im oldei gibit brabli gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hu askim im. En if yumob askim im, wal im garra gibit yumob det Holi Spirit blanga im.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.

english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
kriol: En nomeda wanim hepin tudei o enitaim, wal imbin olredi hepin bifo. God garra meigim det seimwan ting hepin igin.

english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
kriol: Ailibala neksdei na detlot haibala serramonimen bin majurrumap ola lowamen en ola kaunsala, en deibin meigim plen blanga kilim Jisas, en deibin taiyimap im, en deibin deigim im en hendimoba im langa det gabman bos neim Pailat.

english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
kriol: Siklag, Medmana, Sensana,

english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”
kriol: Wal imbin brabli drai langa det kantri weya Jeikob bin jidan, en wen olabat bin ranat blanga daga, Jeikob bin gedim wed weya deibin abum daga langa det kantri gulum Ijip. Wal Jeikob bin dalim im san olabat, “Wotrong garram yumob?

english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
kriol: “Main biginini, yu lisin langa mi na en yu kipum ol detlot wed weya ai oldei dalimbat yu, wulijim yu garra jidan laibala longtaim.

english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
kriol: Wal wen mi oldei jinggabat ol det trabul mi abumbat, en hau mi nomo garram kemp blanga jidan, im jis laik sambodi bin poisinim mi.

english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
kriol: en imbin pudum shild en spiya deya du. Imbin jidan king blanga Juda en Benjamin na.

english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
kriol: Bat wen aibin go langa yu Serramoni Pleis, deya na aibin sabi wanim garra hepin langa ol detlot brabli nogudbala pipul.

english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
kriol: Wal sambala brom det Ged klen bin boswan blanga 1,000 men, en najalot bin boswan blanga 100 men.

english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
kriol: Wal Maika bin abum im ronwan serramoni pleis, en imbin meigim sambala drimin sheip, en imbin meigim klos jis laik det speshalwan shet gulum ifad weya det haibala serramonimen blanga YAWEI bin oldei yusumbat, en imbin meigim wanbala san blanga im jidan serramonimen.

english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
kriol: “Wal kwikbala na yumob gobek langa main dedi, en yumob gibit im dijan wed main. Yumob dalim im God bin meigim mi sekanbos blanga dijan kantri.

english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
kriol: “Wal bifo ai garra kambek, det trabul garra binij, en det san garra go dakbala, en det mun kaan gibit lait du, en ola sta garra buldan brom skai, en ol detlot strongbala ting weya jidan langa skai garra gowei brom olabat pleis.

english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
kriol: “Ol yumob pipul langa det kantri gulum Tashish garra lukaran ebriweya blanga wek. Nobodi kaan stapam yumob en yumob garra lafta wek langa yumob fam jis laik detlot Ijip pipul.

english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.
kriol: King Asa bin pudum langa det Serramoni Pleis ola gol en silbawan ting weya imbin meigim imselp, en ol detlot enijing weya im dedi bin gibit langa YAWEI bifo.

english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
kriol: Bat Josef nomo bin sabi tharran deya. Imbin reken det yanggel bin go langa najawan men, en blanga tharran na imbin jidan femiliwei. Wal Josef bin gudbala men, en imbin jinggabat blanga libum det yanggel kwaitbalawei, dumaji im nomo bin wandi meigim im sheim.

english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
kriol: Imbin gibit det lowa langa detlot Isreil pipul wen imbin deigimwei olabat brom Ijip. Aibin irrim sambodi tok bat ai nomo bin sabi hu. Imbin tok,

english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
kriol: en imbin tok langa im brabliwei, “Main lilgel im brabli sik, en im garra dai. Wal yu kaman en pudum yu bingga langa im en meigim im gudbala wulijim im kaan dai.”

english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”
kriol: If ola pipul iya bina meigim mi bos, wal ai bina andimwei Abimalek, en ai bina dalim im blanga majurrumap im solja olabat en kaman en fait langa mi.” Lagijat na Geil bin tok.

english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”
kriol: garram ola gol en silba en garram kopa en aiyan. Wal yu garra stadimap det wek, en YAWEI garra jidan garram yu.” Wal lagijat na King Deibid bin tok.

english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.
kriol: en dei mait tok, ‘Yumob nomo sabi YAWEI, dumaji YAWEI bin pikimat det Jodan Riba blanga meigim bandri blanga im pipul olabat, en yumob jidan najasaid langa det bandri. Wal yumob kaan joinin langa melabat blanga weship langa YAWEI.’ En if dei tok lagijat, wal dei kaan larram melabat biginini olabat weship YAWEI.

english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
kriol: Ol detlot pipul hu garra kaman biyain langa wi garra wek blanga YAWEI, en olabat garra dalim olabat biginini olabat blanga im.

english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”
kriol: Wal jis laik wen detlot jag bin smeshap ai garra bitsimap detlot pipul lagijat na, ola olwan en yangwan du. Ai kaan fil sori blanga enibodi. Nomo enijing kaan stapam mi brom kilimbat olabat.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
kriol: Mosis en Eran bin dalim detlot pipul blanga go lida langa det rok, en Mosis bin tok, “Yumob jigibala, yumob irrim mi na. Wotfo wi garra gajim woda brom dijan rok blanga yumob?”

english: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,
kriol: Hoshaiya bin wok biyain langa detlot singamob en haf detlot lidamob blanga Juda bin bulurrum im,

english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
kriol: En imbin gibit mi det rait, dumaji im wandim ebribodi garra rispek langa mi seimwei laik dei rispek langa im. En enibodi hu nomo rispek langa mi, wal im nomo rispek langa main Dedi hubin jandim mi.

english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
kriol: Wal aibin gedim detlot boswan men brom ebri klen weya dei klebabala en weya dei sabi ebrijing en aibin dalim olabat blanga lukaftum yumob. Sambala boswan bin jidan bos blanga 1,000 pipul, en sambala blanga 100 pipul, en sambala blanga 50 pipul en sambala blanga 10 pipul. En aibin pikimat najalot boswan brom ola difrinwan klen blanga jidan bos langa olabat.

english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”
kriol: en yu garra dalim olabat dei garra gobek langa midul langa det riba, en dei garra gajim twelbala ston brom deya gin weya detlot serramonimen bin jandap, en dei garra garrimap detlot ston en meigim olabat jandap weya yumob garra kemp tunait.” Lagijat na God bin tok langa Joshuwa.

english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
kriol: en detlot Ijip pipul bin hipimapbat detlot frog ebriweya, en deibin smel brabli nogud.

english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
kriol: Blanga tharran na mi oldei adwek nomo lilbit, en mi oldei yusumbat det brabli strongwan pawa blanga Jisas Krais weya imbin gibit langa mi.

english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
kriol: Wal yu sabi ol detlot pipul hu jidan gulijap langa det taun gulum Efasas bin tenawei brom mi, en yu sabi det dubala men neim Fijalas en Hemajanis bin tenawei garram olabat du.

english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
kriol: Yumob garra duwit langa ola lowa brom YAWEI, en im garra dum ol dislot brabli gudbala ting blanga yumob.

english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
kriol: Wal yumob jinggabat det gudbala men neim Lot na. Imbin jidan garram detlot nogudbala pipul brom det dubala taun gulum Sadam en Gamora, en ebridei imbin oldei brabli nogudbinji, dumaji imbin oldei luk ol detlot nogudbala ting weya deibin dumbat, en imbin oldei brabli nogudbinji wen imbin oldei irrim ol detlot nogudbala wed weya deibin oldei tok. Wal God bin deigidawei Lot bifo imbin barnimap det dubala taun en binijimap detlot pipul.

english: and commanded Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.
kriol: En imbin dalimbat ebribodi langa Juda blanga weshipbat YAWEI jis laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin dum, en bulurrum en duwit langa ol im lowa en ola ting imbin titjimbat.

english: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
kriol: Brom deya YAWEI bin tok langa det sneik, “Ai garra panishim yu blanga det ting. Oni yu na ai garra panishim. Ai kaan panishim ol detlot najalot enimul. Oni yu na. Wal yu garra oldei wok garram yu binji langa graun, en yu garra dagadagat graun olawei raidap yu dai.

english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
kriol: Yumob wed ardimbat mi, en yumob nomo kain langa mi. Maitbi seimwei yumob garra go en ardimbat detlot biginini hu nomo garram mami o dedi, o ardimbat yumob ronwan kantrimen. Maitbi yumob garra selim olabat blanga mani.

english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
kriol: Wal Herod bin tok, “Aibin kilim Jon Beptis ded, dumaji aibin kadimof im hed. Bat hu dijan men? Aibin irrim im oldei dumbat olkain klebabala ting.” Lagijat na Herod bin tok. En imbin oldei wandi trai blanga luk Jisas.

english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
kriol: Wal deibin abum oni wanbala langgus basdam. Garram seimwan wed ola pipul bin oldei tok.

english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
kriol: Afta, det einjul bin jingat langa mi, “Detlot hosis weya bin go nowathwei langa Bebalon bin shoum olabat YAWEI na garra jidan bos blanga olabat bambai.”

english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin askim det lowamen na, “Wujan men brom detlot thribala men bin laigim det hafdedwan men?”

english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
kriol: If tharran na im buldan langa matiriyal o langa letha, wal dei garra lafta washim, en tharran nomo klinbala blanga serramoni raidap sangodan.

english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin askim im, “Enibodi brom Sol femili stil jidan laibala? Dumaji ai wandi kain langa im jis laik God bin kain langa mi.” Wal det wekinmen bin tok, “Det san blanga Jonathan neim Mefibosheth stil jidan laibala. Bat im kripulwan.”

english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
kriol: Aibin jingat langa yu YAWEI. Aibin jingat brabliwei langa yu blanga album mi.

english: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
kriol: “Wal wibin luk garram wi ron ai ola gadin blanga wi bin binij. Wal wanim garra hepin wen wi go langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI det trubala God blanga wi? Wi garra gudbinji deya?

english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
kriol: Maitbi main bodi en main garra jidan wikwan, bat yu na God meigim mi jidan strongbala, en oni yu na mi wandim olagijawan.

english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’
kriol: Dalim detlot Isreil pipul aibin meigim pramis garram olabat wen aibin shoum miselp langa olabat deya langa Ijip en aibin dalim olabat mi na YAWEI.

english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det boswan God bin dalim detlot pipul brom Jerusalem, “Yumob nomo lisin langa detlot mesinja. Olabat oldei bilimap yumob laif garram laiyawan wed. Olabat oldei dalimbat yumob wanim olabat oldei jinggabat, en nomo wanim aibin dalimbat olabat.

english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok, “Ebriyiya yumob garra pudum wansaid blanga YAWEI ola fesbon boiwan buligi en ship en yumob nomo lau blanga meigim det buligi wek en yumob nomo kadimbat det wul blanga det ship.

english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
kriol: Ai garra oldei trastim langa yu blanga ebrijing. Ai garra kipgon preisimbat yu.

english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
kriol: Bat sambala biliba hubin bulurrum detlot serramonimen gulum Ferasi bin tok, “If detlot Jintail pipul wandi bulurrum God, wal dei garra sekamsais, en dei garra duwit langa ola lowa blanga Mosis.”

english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
kriol: en deibin pudum det dubala ston langa det dubala strep blanga det speshalwan shet gulum ifad jis laik weya YAWEI bin dalim Mosis blanga dum. Det dubala ston bin jidan blanga meigim ola Isreil pipul oldei jinggabat detlot san blanga det olmen, dumaji ola klen blanga Isreil bin kamat brom olabat na.

english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
kriol: If yumob bin jidan detkain wekinmen o wekingel hu jidan jis laiga prisana bifo God bin jingat langa yumob, wal yumob kaan wori blanga tharran. Yumob garra kipgon jidan detkain wekinmen o wekingel. Bat if yumob bos wandi larramgo yumob fri, wal yumob garra jidan fri.

english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
kriol: Yu bradin jis laik sambodi hu jidanbat langa brabli dakbala pleis en yu jis laik sambodi hu gulijap draun langa fladwoda.”

english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
kriol: Imbin binijimap detmatj pipul brom najalot kantri, en ola brabli strongbala king,

english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
kriol: Yu stadimap det faiya en meigim det woda boilap wulijim detlot enami blanga yu garra sabi hu yu, en ola pipul langa ebri kantri garra sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit, dumaji olabat garra sabi yu kaminap gulijap na.

english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
kriol: “If yu jingat langa mi, ai garra ensim yu. Ai garra dalim yu brabli gudbala ting yu nomo bin sabi bifo.

english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”
kriol: Wal King Sol bin irrim nyus weya Deibid bin jidan,

english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
kriol: Wal yumob nomo haibala langa yumob titja, en if pipul tridim yumob seimwei laik dei tridim yumob titja, wal yumob garra gudbinji. Wi ol wan femili, en if dei gulum mi det dibuldibul neim Belsibul, wal dei garra gulum yumob mowa nogudbala neim.

english: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;
kriol: En wen dubala bin jidanbat langa det teibul det wed blanga YAWEI bin kaman langa det olbala speshalwan mesinja.

english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
kriol: Wal Nowa bin duwit langa God, en imbin dum ebrijing weya God bin dalim im blanga dum.

english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”
kriol: Imbin dum lagijat dumaji imbin wandi streitinimap dis trabul. Wal bos, yu sabi ebrijing jis laiga einjul brom God. Yu sabi ebrijing weya im hepin langa dijan kantri.” Lagijat na det gel bin tok langa King Deibid, en afta det gel bin gowei.

english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
kriol: Afta na wen olabat bin abum dina sambala pipul gulum Ishmeil pipul bin kaminap langa det roud brom det kantri gulum Giliyad. Detlot Ishmeil pipul bin brom det traib gulum Midiyan, en deibin kaminap garram kemul olabat, en deibin abum olkain medisin blanga selim langa det kantri gulum Ijip.

english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
kriol: “Wen ai bringimbek main pipul olabat, ai garra kipgon lukaftumbat olabat, en ai garra meigim olabat gro jis laiga gadin, en ai garra meigim olabat abum bigismob biginini jis laik det greiptri weya im abum bigismob daga, en pipul brom ebriweya garra laigim olabat jis laik dei laigim det wain weya dei meigim langa Lebanan.

english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
kriol: Wal wanim yumob reken? Yu gin wori en meigim miselp jidan laibala longtaim? Najing. Yu kaan wori en meigim miselp jidan laibala longtaim.

english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
kriol: Yumob luk gudwei langa det skai. En yumob luk langa det graun gudwei du. Det skai garra binijap jis laik det smok, en dijan wel garra binijap jis laik detlot olwan klos weya binijap. Ebribodi langa dijan wel garra dai jis laik detlot flai. Bat wanim ai dum kaan neba binij. Im garra kipgon jidan lagijat olagijawan.

english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
kriol: Wal Timathi, yu garra lukaftumbat det trubalawan wed weya aibin gibit langa yu, en yu nomo wandi joinin langa detlot pipul hu oldei toktok nogudbalawei, en yu nomo wandi joinin langa detlot pipul hu oldei agamin gija blanga olkain wed en reken dei toktok blanga det trubalawan wed. Detlot wed weya dei toktok, im nomo det trubalawan wed. Bat sambala pipul bin bilib langa detlot wed, en detlot wed bin meigim olabat tenawei brom det trubalawan wed blanga Jisas Krais. Wal Timathi, ai wandim God garra kain langa ol yumob Kristjan pipul deya. Binij na.

english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
kriol: Yu andimwei olabat en yu binijimap olabat.” Lagijat na det speshalwan mesinja bin tok.

english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.
kriol: Bambai na tuyiya bin gon na, en King Fero bin abum drim. En langa det drim imbin jandap wansaid langa det bigwan riba gulum Nail Riba deya gin langa im kantri,

english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
kriol: YAWEI det trubala God im brabli haibalawan, en pipul garra preisim im brabliwei langa det bigwan taun blanga wi God langa im seikridwan hil.

english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
kriol: en wen Jeikob bin luk Reitjul garram ola ship blanga im anggul Leiban, imbin go en rolimwei det ston na streidawei, en imbin wodarim detlot ship.

english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.
kriol: Wal langa det feswan dei langa det Pasoba Serramoni det boswan garra bringimap buligi blanga sekrifais blanga im nogudbalawei en blanga detlot nogudbalawei blanga ola pipul.

english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
kriol: “If sambodi dai gulijap langa wan Nesarait, wal im garra weidabat blanga 7 dei en langa det namba 7 dei im garra lafta sheibum im heya, en lagijat na im garra jidan raitwei igin blanga mi.

english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
kriol: en wen deibin bridabat lida langa detlot straipiwan stik, bambai na detlot nenigout en ship bin abum straipiwan en spadidwan beibi.

english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
kriol: Langa det deset kantri imbin gibit yumob det daga gulum mena blanga dagat weya wi grengrenfathamob nomo bin dagat bifo. Imbin jandim trabul langa yumob blanga luk hau yumob garra jandap blanga im en blanga meigim yumob jidan lobala. En imbin dum lagijat blanga yumob dumaji imbin wandi gibit yumob olkain gudbala ting.

english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
kriol: Wal detlot san blanga Jeroham bin Shamsherai, Sheharaiya, Ethalaiya, Jareshaiya, Ilaija en Sikri.

english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”
kriol: Wal im dedi en mami bin askim im, “Wotfo yu wandi go en gajim waif brom detlot nogudbala Filastain pipul? Wotfo yu kaan gajim waif brom ola Isreil pipul? Yu garra gajim waif brom yu ronwan kantrimen.” Wal Semsan bin dalim im dedi, “Nomo. Ai wandim yu garra gajim det Filastain gel na, dumaji ai laigim im.”

english: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
kriol: Wen imbin 22 yiya ol deibin meigim im king en imbin jidan king fo 1 yiya deya langa Jerusalem. Im mami bin Ethalaiya det doda blanga King Eiheb, en grendoda blanga King Omri brom Isreil en imbin dalim im blanga dum ola nogudbala ting, jis laik King Eiheb femili bin dum.

english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.
kriol: Dei nomo bin raidimdan detlot neim blanga det Libai klen,

english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
kriol: “Ai dalim yumob. Wen det taim garra kaman, if dubala silip, wal God garra deigidawei wanbala en libum det najawan biyain.

english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.
kriol: Ebribodi bin lafta abum namba blanga baiyimbat enijing en blanga selimbat enijing, en det namba bin jis laiga bren blanga det feswan enimul neim.

english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
kriol: Brom deya det namba 5 einjul bin blowim im longwan wisul na, en aibin luk wanbala sta bin buldan brom top raidap langa dijan kantri. Sambodi bin gibit det sta det ki blanga det brabli dipwan hol,

english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
kriol: Maitbi ai garra beldim im brabliwei garram shotbala wip en larramgo im.” Lagijat na Pailat bin tok.

english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
kriol: En dubala bin tok, “Dumaji bos wandim.”

english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
kriol: Det laswan solja brom Det Thribala Solja bin neim Shama. Imbin det san blanga Eigi brom det taun gulum Herara. Wantaim ola Filastain solja bin majurrumap miselp langa det pleis gulum Leihi weya deibin abum gadin weya deibin growimap loda daga gulum bin, en wen detlot Isreil solja bin fait langa detlot Filastain solja, detlot Isreil solja bin ranawei.

english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
kriol: Wal aibin tok, “Ai garra dalim yumob blanga YAWEI en hau im kipgon laigimbat wi, en ai garra preisim im blanga ol detlot gudbala ting weya YAWEI bin dumbat blanga wi. Ai garra jidan gudbinjiwei langa im dumaji YAWEI bin shoum imbin kipgon laigimbat wi, en imbin jidan brabli kainbala en brabli gudbala langa wi, ola Isreil pipul.

english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin stil toktok langa im wekinmen olabat, det najawan wekinmen blanga im neim Judas bin kamat deya langa olabat garram loda pipul. En detlot pipul bin garrimapbat longbala naif en stik, dumaji detlot serramonimen en lowamen en najalot boswan bin jandim olabat blanga grebum Jisas.

english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
kriol: En dubala bin jidan langa brabli purdiwan tjeya en lida langa dubala deibin abum teibul garram loda gudbala ting, ol detlot gudsmelwan medisin en det oliboil weya aibin gibit langa dubala.

english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
kriol: Ol dislot bin detlot femili lain weya bin kamat brom Esha. Deibin jidan bos blanga ola femili en deibin strongbala solja, en brabli gudwan lida. Wal det namba blanga ol detlot men hu gin fait langa ami brom det Esha klen bin 26,000.

english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
kriol: En Aisik bin tok, “Orait, main boi. Yu bringimap det daga weya ai garra dagat, en afta ai garra gibit langa yu det laswan wed bifo mi dai.” Wal Jeikob bin gibit det daga en sambala wain langa det olmen na,

english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin dalim Tamas, “Yu pudum yu bingga iya langa main bingga en yu luk gudwei. En yu pudum yu bingga langa main said du. En yu stap askimbat oldei. Yu garra bilib langa mi weya aibin gidap laibala brom dedbala.”

english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.
kriol: Aibin stapam ola rein weya yumob bin wandim blanga meigim ola daga langa yumob pedik gro. Aibin jandim rein langa wanbala taun en najing langa najawan taun. Rein bin buldan langa wanbala pedik en najawan pedik bin jidan draiwan.

english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
kriol: King Eiheb bin meigim det drimin sheip gulum Eshara du blanga weshipbat. Imbin dumbat ola brabli nogudbala ting blanga meigim YAWEI det God blanga ola Isreil pipul brabli wail langa im. Imbin dum mowa nogudbala ting den ola najalot king hubin jidan bifo langa im.

english: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
kriol: Libum ol yumob trabul langa YAWEI, en im garra maindimbat yumob. Im kaan larram enijing bidim detlot pipul hu jidan langa im raitwei.

english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
kriol: Bat wi garra stapam dijan stori blanga Jisas brom spredatbat. Wal wi lafta gibit woning langa dijan dubala men nomo blanga yusum det neim blanga Jisas wen dubala tok langa enibodi.”

english: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
kriol: dumaji YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat rong ting, bat im jidan fren langa detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubalawei.

english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
kriol: Wal sambala pipul hubin jandap deya gulijap langa det kros bin irrim im jingat lagijat, en deibin tok, “Im jingat blanga det speshalwan mesinja neim Ilaija hubin wokaran iya longtaim.”

english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
kriol: Wal im lagijat gin blanga ol yumob Kristjan hasbin. Yumob garra oldei jinggabat yumob waif, dumaji olabat nomo strongbala wulijim men, en yumob garra rispek langa olabat en tridim olabat gudbalawei, dumaji olabat du garra gedim det brabli gudbalawan laif weya God garra gibit langa detlot pipul hu bilib langa im san. Dei garra gedim det laif mijamet garram yumob, en if yumob jidan garram olabat brabliwei, wal God garra teiknodis langa yumob wen yumob prei langa im, en nomo enijing kaan stapam det preya.

english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
kriol: en im na det haibala serramonimen hubin dalim ola kaunsala im mobeda wanbala men dai blanga ola pipul.

english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
kriol: Ai nomo bin dum det nogudbala ting. Mi rili bradin dumaji God mait panishim mi.

english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
kriol: Det feswan riba bin neim Paishan, en imbin go raidaran langa det kantri gulum Habila. Langa det kantri na ola brabliwan gol bin jidan,

english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
kriol: Wal bambai na det mesinja bin kaman. Imbin neim Jon, en imbin go en jidan langa bush kantri, en imbin werrimon detlot klos weya deibin oldei meigim garram kemul heya, en imbin werrimbat lethawan belt, en imbin oldei dagadagat grashopa en shugabeig. Wal bigmob pipul brom Judiya en brom Jerusalem bin ol go langa Jon, en Jon bin toktok langa olabat. Imbin dalimbat olabat lagijat, “Yumob garra libum ol yumob nogudbalawei, en yumob garra beptais wulijim God garra larramgo yumob fri brom detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin oldei dumbat.” Lagijat na Jon bin oldei tok. Wal detlot pipul bin onap, en deibin dalimbat Jon blanga olabat nogudbalawei, en imbin beptaisimbat olabat langa det Jodan Riba,

english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
kriol: wal wi garra ol dai en wi ol garra gobek langa graun.

english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
kriol: “Bambai pipul brom difrindifrinwan kantri garra kaman langa Jerusalem.

english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin tok langa Kora, “Tumorro yu en detlot 250 wekinmenmob blanga yu garra kaman langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI, en Eran garra kaman deya du.

english: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
kriol: Det rein im binij na,

english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
kriol: Wal God bin panishim Bebalon, dumaji imbin faindim det blad blanga ola Kristjan pipul en blanga ola speshalwan mesinja blanga im deya na. Bebalon na bin weistimbat olabat blad, nomeda langa wujan kantri deibin dai.

english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
kriol: Wal ai garra lafta prei blanga yu, wulijim yu garra ardimbat detmatj, dumaji yu tok jis laik detlot nogudbala pipul.

english: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”
kriol: en afta imbin sing dijan song. “Garram jauboun aibin kilim 1,000 men ded. Garram jauboun aibin meigim olabat leidan ebriweya.”

english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”
kriol: Ai askimbat lagijat dumaji wanbala men bin pei mani blanga kilim en binijimap mi en ola Juwish pipul olabat. If dei bina selim melabat blanga jidan wekinmen en wekingel en melabat nomo bina wek blanga mani, wal ai bina jidan kwaitbala, dumaji det trabul im nomo brabli bigwan, bat im wandim kilim wi ded holot. Blanga tharran na mi kaman en askim yu.”

english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.
kriol: Wal det taim garra kaman na wen ai garra binijap detlot drimin sheip blanga Bebalon. Ola pipul deya garra sheim miselp brabliwei, en olabat garra ol gitkil.

english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
kriol: Wal wen det Holi Spirit im jidan insaid langa wi, im gibit wi pawa blanga shoum wi trubala im deya. Bat im nomo gibit wi det pawa blanga wi miselp. Nomo. Im gibit wi det pawa blanga album ebribodi.

english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
kriol: Im pudum ola klaud ebriweya langa skai. Im meigim rein buldan langa dijan kantri, en im meigim gras gro ebriweya langa ola hil.

english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
kriol: en tharran na garra meigim mi binijap, en ol main gadin garra ol barnbarn.

english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
kriol: Ai garra gibit yu theingks garram sekrifais ofring, en ai garra prei langa yu.

english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.
kriol: YAWEI garra jidan brabli kainbala langa yumob laik imbin pramisim. Wal yumob garra lendim mani langa detlot pipul brom najawan kantri. Bat yumob nomo askim najalot blanga mani dumaji yumob garram ebrijing. Yumob garra jidan bos langa ebri traib langa ebri kantri en olabat kaan jidan bos langa yumob.

english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”
kriol: En najalot pipul garra tok, ‘Dumaji olabat nomo bin kipum det strongwan pramis weya deibin meigim garram God blanga olabat, en olabat bin oldei weshipbat en bulurrumbat olkain drimin.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?
kriol: En wen deibin kaman, det king bin tok langa det thribala men, “Im trubala yu nomo wandim weship main drimin sheip, en yumob nomo bin pudumdan yumob feis langa graun en weship langa dijan golwan drimin sheip weya aibin meigim, indit?

english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
kriol: Yu dalim mi blanga main nogudbalawei wulijim ai garra sabi.

english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
kriol: Wal det brabli silibalawan im jis laik det gel weya jinginatbat adbala, dumaji im nomo sheim. Im nomo sabi enijing.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
kriol: En ola san blanga King Deibid bin jidan serramonimen du. En det men neim Benaiya bin bos blanga ola blijiman hubin oldei lukaftumbat King Deibid. En im dedi bin neim Jehoiyada.

english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.
kriol: Bat ai garra binijimap detlot nogudbala pipul weya nomo laigim mi en hubin gibit bekboun langa mi.

english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
kriol: “Wal ol detlot Isreil pipul reken dei dum gudbala ting. Bat najing. Dei oni weistimbat taim, dumaji dei oldei dalimbat laiya en trikimbat olabat ronwan kantrimen en kilimbat olabat du, en dei oldei go en meigim pramis langa detlot pipul hu jidan longwei brom olabat deya langa det kantri Asiriya, en dei oldei selimbat ola daga en enijing langa detlot najalot pipul langa Ijip.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
kriol: Dei garra tok gudei langa yu, en dei garra gibit yu dubala damba, en yu garra gajim det dubala damba brom olabat.

english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.
kriol: Wal streidawei det spirit blanga YAWEI bin meigim Semsan strong, en imbin go langa det taun gulum Eshkalan, en imbin kilim 30 Filastain men ded, en imbin pulumat olabat klos, en imbin gibit detlot klos langa detlot 30 men hubin deya langa det weding padi. Wal Semsan bin brabli wail, en imbin gobek langa im dedi haus,

english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
kriol: en aibin kamdan blanga gajim olabat brom detlot pipul en deigidawei olabat brom det kantri. Ai garra deigim olabat langa gudbala opin kantri weya dei garra faindim loda daga en enijing. Ai garra deigim olabat langa det kantri weya detlot siksbala traib gulum Keinanait, Hitait, Emarait, Perasait, Hibait en Jebusait jidanbat.

english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
kriol: Dubala bin tok, “Wotfo yumob wandi dum det ting? Minbala nomo drimin! Minbala men seim laik yumob! Minbala bin kaman iya blanga dalimbat yumob det gudnyus en blanga meigim yumob libum diskain nogudbala ting en go langa det laibalawan God. Im na bin meigim skai en graun en solwoda en ebrijing weya jidan langa dijan wel.

english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
kriol: Yumob sabi aibin lafta kaman deya dumaji aibin sik, en wen aibin deya, aibin dalimbat yumob det gudnyus,

english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
kriol: Det serramonimen garra deigim sambala daga blanga gibit ofring langa mi, en im garra barnim langa det teibul blanga ofring. En det smel blanga det sid daga ofring garra meigim mi brabli gudbinji.

english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
kriol: Wi nomo bin abum filing blanga sing en plei gita, en wibin heingimap olabat langa gulijapwan tri.

english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,
kriol: Wal yumob iya tudei blanga meigim det brabli strongbala pramis garram YAWEI, en yumob garra kipum det strongbala pramis,

english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
kriol: Wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, “Eibrahem bin bilib langa God, en blanga tharran na God bin meigim im jidan raitwei langa im.”

english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
kriol: En YAWEI im garra meigim yu klebabalawan, dumaji yu na garra jidan boswan blanga detlot Isreil pipul, en yu garra kipum det lowa blanga im.

english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
kriol: Yu reken yu garram brabli strongbala am wulijim mi? Yu reken yu gin jinginat adbala laik det thanda wulijim mi?

english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’
kriol: Blanga ol im gudwan solja dei garra gitkil langa det wo, en detlot pipul hu garra stil jidan laibala garra spredat ebriweya wulijim olabat garra sabi mi na YAWEI bin tok.”

english: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
kriol: Wal det fama hu sabi det raitwan win, im sabi wen im rait taim blanga plentimbat det sid. En det fama hu sabi detlot klaud, im sabi det rait taim blanga gajimbat det sid daga.

english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
kriol: bat olabat garra ol jidan langa det rabishwan taun nomo garram eni pipul.

english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
kriol: en aibin jinggabat det pramis weya aibin meigim garram olabat grengrenfatha olabat, en ai garra deigimat olabat brom det kantri weya dei abumbat adtaim, en ai garra deigim olabat langa gudbala kantri weya dei garra faindim loda daga. Yu dalim olabat ai garra deigim olabat langa det kantri weya detlot siksbala traib gulum Keinanait, Hitait, Emarait, Perasait, Hibait en Jebusait jidanbat.

english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahweh.
kriol: Wal King Salaman en ola pipul bin gibit ola sekrifais langa YAWEI.

english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
kriol: YAWEI, yu na God, en nobodi haibala seimwei laik yu, en melabat bin irrim tharran brom longtaim.

english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
kriol: Wen det laiyan go hanting, im jidan hanggri wen im nomo faindim eni daga, bat wen wi duwit langa YAWEI, im kaan libum wi nomo garram eni gud ting.

english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
kriol: Brom deya Jona bin go en imbin jidan sanraisaid brom det taun. Deya na imbin meigim lilwan sheid, en imbin jidan insaid langa det sheid. En brom deya na imbin lukinat det taun, dumaji imbin wandi luk wanim God garra du langa det taun.

english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
kriol: en im toktok blanga ol detlot ting weya imbin luk en irrim. Bat nobodi nomo oldei bilib langa im wed.

english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
kriol: Brom deya aibin luk detmatj einjul olabat. Milyans en milyans bin jandap raidaran langa det speshal boswan tjeya, en deibin jandap raidaran langa detlot fobala najakain enimul en langa detlot olmen.

english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
kriol: Brom det geit imbin gowin langa det longwan rum weya bin abum thribala rum langa det dubala said. Detlot rum bin weya detlot solja bin oldei lukinatbat. Ol detlot rum weya imbin meshurum, deibin seim laik detlot rum langa det sanrais geit. Wal det geit langa nowath imbin 25 mita longwei en imbin 12.5 mita kroswei,

english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.
kriol: Jehoiyada bin gibit detlot boswan solja ola spiya en shild weya bin jidan blanga King Deibid longtaim weya deibin kipumbat deya langa det Serramoni Pleis.

english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
kriol: Wen ai kaan dum enijing mowa, oni yu na sabi det wei blanga mi. Langa det roud weya mi wok, main enamimob bin pudumdan trep blanga mi.

english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
kriol: En wotabat det taim wen aibin breigim detlot sebenbala daga blanga detlot 4,000 pipul? Yumob bin bilimap loda baskit garram ola leftobawan daga, indit?

english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
kriol: YAWEI oldei lukaftumbat detlot pipul hu oldei gibit daga langa ola po pipul.

english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
kriol: en mi gudbinji blanga dubala, dumaji dubala nomo bin oldei jinggabat dubala ron laif wen deibin albumbat mi. En ola Jintail Kristjan pipul gudbinji blanga dubala du.

english: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
kriol: Main biginini olabat, yumob garra abum rispek blanga YAWEI en det king brabliwei, en yumob kaan meigim fren garram detlot pipul hu gibit bekboun langa YAWEI en det king.

english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
kriol: En yumob kaan garrimap mani o beig o but, en yumob kaan stap en tok langa enibodi langa roud.

english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
kriol: Wal langa najawan drim aibin luk wanbala men garram string langa im bingga blanga meshurumbat.

english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
kriol: Langa det taim na aibin jidan brabli strongbala jis laik det tri weya im rut go raitdan langa bigismob woda,

english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
kriol: Wal aibin tok na, “Wandei det hil weya det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI det trubala God jidan garra jandap brabli haibala langa ola najalot hil, en detmatj pipul brom ebri kantri garra kaman langa det hil,

english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
kriol: En ol detlot pipul hu jidan langa sanraisaid langa det kantri, en ol detlot pipul hu jidan langa solwodasaid, garra preisim YAWEI det trubala God blanga ola Isreil pipul.

english: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
kriol: Bat ola biginini blanga olabat bin abum loda biginini, en deibin gulum miselp Isreil pipul, dumaji deibin ol femili blanga Jeikob, en God bin gibit im det neim Isreil. Wal detlot Isreil pipul bin abum mowa en mowa biginini olabat, en deibin jidan brabli strongbala pipul, en deibin spredat ebriweya langa det kantri Ijip.

english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
kriol: Yubin luk thru langa ol dislot tent main. Yubin faindim enijing blanga yu iya? Kaman na! Yu bringimap detlot ting iya atsaid weya ola wekinmen blanga yunmi gin luk detlot ting. Ol detlot wekinmen blanga yunmi garra jidan witnis blanga wujan rait langa yunmi.

english: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
kriol: Wal Deibid bin tok, “Ebna, yu det boswan solja, indit? Yu gulum miselp bigbala men brom ola najalot men, indit? Wal wotfo yu nomo lukaftumbat det king? Im na bos blanga yu, indit? Wal sambodi bin deya tudei langa yumob kemp blanga kilim det king,

english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
kriol: en deya na det wanbala streinja bin jingat langa olabat, “Ranawei! Ranawei! Nomo lukbek! Yumob garra kipgon olawei langa det hil kantri. Yumob kaan stap hafwei, wulijim yumob kaan dai du.”

english: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
kriol: Bat mi jingat langa YAWEI det trubala God blanga album mi, en im garra seibum mi.

english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
kriol: Wen det dongki bin luk det einjul, imbin mub wansaid langa det wol en bin ardimbat Beilam leig nomo lilbit deya langa det wol. Beilam bin beldim det dongki igin.

english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
kriol: Wal Reiyabowam bin 41 yiya ol wen imbin jidan king en imbin king fo 17 yiya langa Jerusalem, det taun weya YAWEI bin pikimat brom ola kantri langa Isreil blanga weshipbat im. Det mami blanga King Reiyabowam bin neim Neima en imbin brom det kantri gulum Eman.

english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.
kriol: Wal wen det speshalwan mesinja tok, ‘YAWEI na bin dalim mi samting garra hepin,’ en det ting nomo hepin, wal yumob garra sabi det wed nomo blanga YAWEI. Det speshalwan mesinja na oni bin tok im ronselp, en yumob kaan bradin langa im.”

english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;
kriol: En garram im brabli gudwan en strongbala pawa imbin bringimat olabat brom Ijip. Im strongwan pawa bin wek ebriweya wen imbin meigim olkain nogudwan ting hepin langa detlot Ijip pipul, en deibin bradin nomo lilbit.

english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:
kriol: Wal aibin tok langa det king na, “Ai garram nyus blanga yu brom YAWEI det boswan God.

english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
