english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.
kriol: Pipul langa Juda bin jidan tufeiswan du, en dei nomo bin sheim wen deibin oldei silipsilipbat garram naja gel hasbin, najing. Deibin dum dijan wen deibin oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip weya deibin meigim brom rok en wud. En dei nomo bin wori deibin meigim det kantri jidan nogudwan.

english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.
kriol: en detlot windo langa det rum weya olabat oldei kaman en det pitja blanga detlot pamtri bin jidan seim langa sanrais geit. Det rum weya olabat oldei kaman bin feising langa det kotyad langa det Serramoni Pleis en bin abum sebenbala step.

english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
kriol: Detlot pipul hubin abum klebabala main bin jidan bos blanga ol detlot kantri du. Nomo najalot pipul bin titjimbat olabat.

english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
kriol: en deya na deibin luk Jisas, en wen deibin luk im, nomeda sambala bin oni hafbilib, bat stil deibin ol nildan en weship langa im.

english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
kriol: “Wal ai dalim yumob. If enibodi tok gudbalawei blanga mi langa ola pipul, wal ai garra tok gudbalawei blanga im langa ola einjul wen God garra jadjim ebribodi.

english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
kriol: Hu yu reken meigim det rein weya oldei tjeinjim det draiwan kantri en meigim det gras gro brabli longwan en jidan brabli grinwan?

english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.
kriol: Wal Joshuwa bin lafta sekamsais olabat dumaji nobodi bin sekamsais olabat. Basdam wen deibin ol gowei brom Ijip, ola men bin sekamsais.

english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
kriol: Olabat garra dalimbat blanga detlot gudbala ting blanga yu, en olabat garra sing song blanga det kainbalawei blanga yu.

english: By David. Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
kriol: YAWEI yu dum det seim ting langa detlot hu dum nogud ting langa mi. Yu fait langa olabat weya dei fait langa mi.

english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
kriol: En yumob garra oldei dumbat gudbala ting en album yumob Kristjan braja en sista olabat, dumaji wen yumob dum lagijat, tharran na najawan ofring weya meigim God gudbinji.

english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
kriol: En nomo eni Isreil pipul lau blanga dagat eni fet o eni blad. En dijan na tharran lowa weya ola Isreil pipul garra kipum olataim nomeda weya dei jidan.”

english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to Yahweh; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because Yahweh has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”
kriol: Wal det gel bin tok, “If yubin meigim pramis langa YAWEI, wal yu garra dum wanim yubin dalim im, dumaji imbin binijimap ola enami blanga yu.”

english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
kriol: If det singul gel bin meigim trubala pramis o pramis samting im nomo jinggabat wen imbin meigim det pramis, en afta na imbin git merrit.

english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
kriol: en afta dei garra ol sabi mi brabliwei. Nomo oni detlot haibala serramonimen. Ebribodi garra sabi mi brabliwei. Dei garra ol sabi mi insaidwei, en wen dei garra jidan lagijat, dei kaan go en dalimbat enibodi blanga sabi mi, dumaji olabat sabi mi olredi,

english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’
kriol: “Wen yu dai, nomo enibodi garra krai blanga yu o tok, ‘Dijan ting bin hepin. Im brabli nogudwan!’ Nomo enibodi kaan fil sori blanga yu, o jingat yu, ‘Main bos! Main king!’

english: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
kriol: “Wal sambala nogudbala mesinja oldei meigim main pipul olabat go nogudbalawei, dumaji dei nomo gibit trubala wed langa enibodi. Dei oldei gibit gudbala wed langa detlot pipul hu oldei peiyim olabat, en dei oldei meigim trabul blanga detlot pipul hu kaan peiyim olabat.

english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
kriol: “Wal yumob bin trai blanga meigim mi gudbinji, bat yumob bin gibit langa mi rabishwan wed, nomo garram eni mining, en yumob bin dalim mi laiya.” Lagijat na Job bin tok.

english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
kriol: Ebribodi luk! Detlot nogudbala pipul leidanbat dedbala, en olabat kaan neba gidap igin.

english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
kriol: Jerusalem im brabli purdiwan, bat im garra jidan brabli rabishwan na.

english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
kriol: Wal wi sabi wen yu yusum det lowa raitwei, det lowa im gudwan.

english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
kriol: If det wekinmen tok, “Ai laigim main bos en main waif en main biginini olabat, en ai nomo wandim main bos garra larramgo mi fri,” wal yu garra deigim im langa det Serramoni Pleis, en deya na yu garra meigim im jandap wansaid langa dowa, en yu garra makam im irriwol, en im garra jidan wekinmen blanga yu olagijawan.

english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
kriol: Wal det men bin gowei brom det Serramoni Pleis, en imbin go langa detlot serramonimen, en imbin dalim olabat, “Jisas na bin meigim mi gudbala.”

english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
kriol: “Wal yumob jinggabat na. Wen enibodi andimwei nogudwan spirit brom insaid langa sambodi, det nogudwan spirit garra go ebriweya lukabat pleis blanga jidan. En if det nogudwan spirit kaan faindim pleis blanga jidan, im dalim miselp.

english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
kriol: Wal Pol bin jidan prisana fo 2 yiya langa im ron haus, en imbin oldei gudbinji langa enibodi hubin oldei kaman deya.

english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
kriol: Imbin meigim ola kopawan dish blanga gajim ola eshis weya dei barnim det fet brom det bif, en imbin meigim ola kopawan shabul en pleit blanga klinim det faiyapleis, en imbin meigim ola kopawan huk en dish blanga det bif en blad,

english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
kriol: Yu reken yu gin kaundimap ola klaud o meigim ola rein buldan

english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
kriol: en wen deibin oldei selim enijing, deibin oldei sherimat det mani blanga album detlot bilibamob hu nomo bin abum enijing.

english: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
kriol: Detlot raida blanga detlot najalot hosis bin dalim det najawan einjul, det einjul blanga YAWEI, hubin jandap deya insaid langa detlot metiltri. Deibin tok, “Melabat bin go ebriweya langa dijan wel en melabat bin luk ebrijing jidan gudwei en kwaitbala.”

english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
kriol: Ebribodi oldei dalimbat laiya, en detlot pipul hu oldei gibit bekboun langa det nogudbala ting, olabat abum brabli adtaim na.” Lagijat na detlot pipul bin tok. Wal wen YAWEI bin sabi det trubalawei bin gowei, imbin brabli nogudbinji.

english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.
kriol: Aibin lidimap main bingga en aibin tok, “God, mi brabli sheim. Ai kaan lidimap main hed langa yu. Melabat kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting en dei jidan na detmatj.

english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
kriol: Main gudfren olabat, wi garra laigim gija, dumaji God na meigim wi laigim gija. En detlot pipul hu laigim olabat braja en sista olabat jidan biginini blanga God, en dei sabi God.

english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
kriol: Yu oldei album detlot pipul hu oldei dum wanim yu wandim olabat blanga dum, bat yu oldei gitwail kwikbala wen olabat dumbat ola nogudbala ting. Longtaim na melabat bin kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting. Oni yu na gin album en seibum melabat.

english: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
kriol: Bifo imbin dai deibin kadimat det rokwan greib blanga im deya langa det hil langa det taun blanga Deibid. Wal deibin berrim im bodi deya en deibin bilimap det pleis garram gudsmelwan oil en switwan smelwan ebrijing. Afta na, ola pipul bin meigim bigwan faiya blanga shoum rispek langa im.

english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
kriol: Wal wen Sol bin irrim det stori, streidawei det spirit blanga God bin teikoba langa im, en imbin gitwail nomo lilbit,

english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
kriol: YAWEI, ai sabi nomo enibodi jidan bos blanga wanim garra hepin langa im ronselp, en nomo enibodi im bos blanga im ronwan laif.

english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
kriol: Wal yumob garra larram detlot Kristjan braja en sista olasbat hu nomo bilib strongbalawei jidan gudfren blanga yumob. En yumob kaan tok nogudbalawei langa olabat blanga hau dei oldei jinggabat blanga dum enijing, dumaji detlot pipul hu bilib strongbalawei sabi dei gin dagat enikain daga.

english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
kriol: Wen sambodi preisim det siliwan men, tharran nomo rait. Im jis laik bigis rein weya kaman langa draisisantaim, o sno weya buldan langa hotwethataim.

english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
kriol: en dubala bin agri blanga kipum haf mani en gibit haf langa detlot speshalwan mishanri, en dubala bin agri blanga dalim olabat dubala garra gibit holbit. Wal det men bin go langa Pida, en imbin gibit im det mani,

english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
kriol: Afta na wen Jisas bin beptais, imbin stat dumbat det speshalwan wek blanga im. Imbin 30 yiya ol wen imbin stat dumbat det wek, en deibin reken imbin san blanga Josef. Wal Josef bin san blanga Hilai,

english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
kriol: Wal King Shishak bin kaman langa Jerusalem en imbin deigimwei ola brabli gudwan ebrijing brom det Serramoni Pleis en brom det bigwan haus blanga det king. Imbin deigimwei ebrijing en ola golwan shild weya King Salaman bin meigim du.

english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.
kriol: Wal afta wen imbin bidim detlot Midiyan pipul, Gidiyan bin gobek langa im ronwan taun, en imbin jidanbat deya.

english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
kriol: Det thribala klen bin libum ol detlot najalot Isreil klen deya langa det taun gulum Shailo deya langa det kantri gulum Keinan, en deibin gobek langa olabat ronwan kantri gulum Giliyad. Mosis bin gibit olabat det kantri dumaji longtaim YAWEI bin dalim im blanga gibit olabat.

english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.
kriol: Sambala streinja pipul bin ranawei brom Bebalon en olabat bin go langa Jerusalem. Deya na deibin oldei toktokbat hau YAWEI bin panishim detlot Bebalon pipul dumaji detlot pipul bin bitsimap im Serramoni Pleis langa Jerusalem.

english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
kriol: Yu si? Yumob det bodi blanga Jisas Krais, dumaji yumob na det tjetj. En ebribodi jidan jis laiga difrinwan pat blanga im bodi. Yu si? God bin pikimat wujan pipul garra jidan speshalwan mishanri basdam. En imbin pikimat wujan garra jidan speshalwan mesinja, en imbin pikimat wujan garra jidan titja. En imbin pikimat wujan garra dumbat klebabala ting, en wujan garra abum det pawa blanga meigim sikbala pipul gudbala, en wujan garra abum det pawa blanga albumbat pipul, en wujan garra abum det pawa blanga lidimbat pipul, en wujan garra abum det pawa blanga toktok garram difrinkain langgus.

english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
kriol: Orait, God bin oldei tok langa wi grengrenfatha olabat. Lodataim imbin tok langa olabat, en imbin yusum olkainwei blanga gibit im wed thru ol detlot speshalwan mesinja blanga im.

english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
kriol: Main bedfren olabat bin tjeisimbat mi en deibin gajim mi. Deibin pudum mi langa dakwan jeil, en mi jidanbat jis laik detlot pipul hubin dai longtaim.

english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
kriol: Wal Eran garra gibit det boiwan buligi blanga sekrifais blanga deigidawei det nogudbalawei blanga im en im femilimob.

english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.
kriol: en King Nebakanesa bin kaman garram ol im ami en olabat bin fait langa Jerusalem. Olabat bin kaman langa det namba 10 dei, langa det namba 10 manth, langa det namba 9 yiya wen King Sedakaiya bin jidan king. Olabat bin majurrumap miselp raidaran langa det taun en pudumap olabat kemp deya du, en olabat bin hipimap ola graun blanga meigim haiwan hil raidap langa top langa det wol blanga teikoba det taun.

english: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!
kriol: Jerusalem, yu gidap brom det graun. Yu kaan jidan prisana enimo. Deigimat det roup brom yu nek.

english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”
kriol: Bat afta aibin dalim olabat, “Yumob, wi garram loda trabul iya langa Jerusalem. Dijan taun im ol breikinwan en detlot solja bin breigimap ola geit. Wal wi garra bildimap ola wol blanga dijan taun, en wi kaan sheim mowa na.”

english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin dalim det gel, “God bin seibum yu, dumaji yu bilib langa main wed. Wal yu go na, dumaji yu fri.”

english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
kriol: Wal hau enibodi garra sabi if pipul spirit gowap langa hebin, en det enimul spirit godan langa graun?

english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’
kriol: Wen det boswan blanga det fyunral brom det ded men femili deigimat det bodi brom det haus im garra jingat langa det men hu oldei album langa fyunral. Im garra tok, ‘Enibodi mowa deya garram yu?’ “Det men garra tok, ‘Najing.’ “En det ded men femili garra tok, ‘Jidan kwait! Wi kaan gulum det neim blanga YAWEI.’

english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
kriol: Wal det boks bin jidan langa det haus blanga wan men neim Abinadeb. Det haus blanga im bin ontop langa wan hil deya, en King Deibid en detlot solja bin gajim det boks brom im, en deibin pudum det boks ontop langa nyuwan wegan, en det dubala san blanga Abinadeb neim Yusa en Ahiyo bin lukaftumbat det wegan.

english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
kriol: Dijan sekanwan enimul bin ofsaida blanga det feswan enimul, en imbin gedim pawa brom det feswan enimul, en imbin meigim ebribodi langa ola kantri weship langa det feswan enimul. Det feswan enimul bin jandap wansaid langa im, en ola pipul bin baudan en weship langa det feswan enimul.

english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
kriol: Yu garra dalim detlot hil kantri langa Isreil blanga irrim main wed. Mi na YAWEI det boswan God, en mi tok langa ola haiwan hil, en langa ola beli. Ai garra binijimap detlot pleis weya detlot pipul oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip.

english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
kriol: En ola femili blanga det men neim Geshan bin gedim 13 taun brom detlot kantri blanga detlot fobala klen gulum Isaka, Esha, Neftali en Manesa.

english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.
kriol: en YAWEI bin kamat langa dubala deya. Imbin jandap deya jis laiga longwan klaud wansaid langa det dowa blanga det Seikridwan Tent.

english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
kriol: Wal bigmob pipul bin bulurrum Jisas biyain, en sambala olgamen bin deya du, en deibin kraikrai detmatj blanga Jisas, dumaji deibin nogudbinji blanga im.

english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
kriol: Ola brabli nogudbala pipul meigim trep blanga mi, bat mi oldei teiknodis langa detlot lowa blanga yu.

english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
kriol: Wal King Deibid bin tok, “Nomo. Yu kaan gibit mi dislot ting blanga najing. Mi garra baiyim brom yu, dumaji mi kaan gibit enijing langa YAWEI if ai nomo bin pei.”

english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
kriol: Meigim mi strongbala jis laik yubin pramisim mi, en ai garra jidan laibala. Nomo larram mi jidan nogudbinji wen mi weidabat blanga yu blanga seibum mi.

english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
kriol: Wal wen Rubin bin irrim det wed, imbin wandi album Josef, en imbin tok, “Wi nomo wandi kilim im ded.

english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
kriol: wanim yu reken garra hepin langa wi? Wi oldei dumbat brabli nogudbala ting, en wi oldei lukabat blanga mowa nogudbala ting.

english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.
kriol: Wotfo yumob weistimbat mani langa detlot rabishwan enijing weya nomo meigim yumob sedisfaid? Wotfo yumob dumbat brabli adbala wek blanga najing? Detlot ting kaan meigim yumob sedisfaid. Najing. Wal yumob irrim mi na brabli gudwei, en yumob garra brabli gudbinji blanga det brabli gudbala daga.

english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
kriol: Ai reken yu gin dum tharran, dumaji yubin olredi bon langa det taim wen aibin meigim ebrijing, indit?

english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
kriol: En blanga tharran na wi nomo oldei jinggabat detlot trabul. Wi oldei jinggabat detlot ting weya God garra gibit wi. Nomeda wi kaan luk detlot ting garram wi ai dubala, bat stil wi oldei jinggabat detlot ting, dumaji wi sabi detlot ting weya wi luk garram wi ai dubala kaan jidan longtaim. Bat detlot ting weya wi kaan luk garram wi ai dubala garra jidan olagijawan.

english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob jinggabat detlot speshalwan mesinja hubin oldei tok blanga Jisas Krais det Boswan. Nomeda deibin abum loda trabul, bat stil deibin weidabat en nomo slekbek,

english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
kriol: YAWEI bin jandim wan men lida langa olabat langa Ijip blanga seibum im pipul olabat. Det men bin Josef, en im braja olabat bin selim im blanga jidan wekinmen.

english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
kriol: Wal nomeda detlot jigibala bos bin meigim detlot Isreil pipul adwek, bat stil detlot Isreil pipul bin kipgon abumbat mowa biginini olabat, en deibin kipgon spredatbat ebriweya langa det kantri, en detlot pipul langa det kantri bin bradin blanga detlot Isreil pipul na.

english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
kriol: Bambai na wen imbin dinataim, det san bin go dakbala, en det kantri bin jidan dakbala raidap aftanun kabaditaim,

english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
kriol: YAWEI, yu brabli kainbala, en yu nomo tjeinjim yu main. Yu brabli haibala YAWEI, en ai askim yu blanga larramgo olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei, laik yubin oldei larramgo olabat fri wen olabat bin gowei brom Ijip.” Lagijat na Mosis bin prei.

english: I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
kriol: “Oni mi na YAWEI det trubala God. Nomo eni drimin o enibodi jidan haibala laik mi. Aibin meigim yu jidan brabli strongbala, nomeda yu nomo bin sabi langa mi.

english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
kriol: Wal yu garra jidan kainbalawei langa melabat igin, en yu garra bastimap ol detlot nogudbala ting weya melabat bin dumbat, en yu garra tjakidawei ol detlot nogudbala ting longwei rait insaid langa solwoda.

english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”
kriol: Aibin oldei jandimbat main speshalwan mesinja hubin oldei dalimbat yumob nomo blanga dum dislot nogudbala ting weya ai nomo laigim.

english: But you, Yahweh, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
kriol: Bat YAWEI, oni yu na sabi wotkain mi. Yu oldei luk langa mi wanim aibin dum, en hau ai laigim yu brabliwei. Yu garra deigimwei ol dislot nogudwan men brom iya, jis laik det ship weya dei redi blanga kilim im en kadimap im. Yu kipum olabat raidap olabat garra gitkil.

english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
kriol: Bat wen enibodi dagat det brabliwan daga weya bin kamdan brom hebin, im garra jidan laibala olagijawan.

english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.
kriol: Yunmi garra gidap ailibala gin, en luk if purdiflawa bin kamat langa detlot greiptri. Yunmi garra go luk if deibin gro gudwei en abum purdiflawa, en if det najalot frut tri gulum pamagrenit tri abumbat purdiflawa du. Deya na ai garra jidan garram yu en yunmi garra silipsilipbat.

english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Det lait kaan jidan garram yumob longtaim. En yumob garra wok wen yumob stil garram det lait bifo det dakbala gajimap yumob, dumaji detlot pipul hu wok langa dakbala nomo sabi weya olabat go.

english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.
kriol: Yumob nomo teiknodis langa wanim aibin dalim yumob, en yumob titjim main lowa langa sambala pipul brabliwei en yumob titjim najalot rongwei wulijim dei gin gudbinji langa yumob. Wal ai garra meiksho detlot pipul sabi wotkain serramonimen yumob wulijim dei kaan abum eni rispek blanga yumob en yumob garra sheim miselp.” Lagijat na YAWEI det haibala bos bin tok.

english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
kriol: Wal wen imbin sangodan, det dubala einjul hubin abum dina langa Eibrahem kemp bin kamat langa det taun gulum Sadam. Wal det olmen neim Lot bin deya langa det geit blanga det taun, en wen imbin luk det dubala streinja kaminap, imbin gidap, en imbin tok gudei langa dubala,

english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
kriol: “Aibin askim YAWEI na, ‘Haulong dijan ting garra jidan lagijat?’ “Wal YAWEI bin tok langa mi, ‘Raidap olabat haus garra buldan en olabat taun garra bitsap en raidap olabat fam garra jidan nomo garram enijing,

english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Nomo. Ai kaan rabumat yu neim brom det buk main. Ai garra rabumat ola neim blanga detlot pipul hubin dum nogudbala ting langa mi.

english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
kriol: Dumaji det mami en dedi blanga Mosis bin bilib, wal afta wen imbin bon, dubala bin luk imbin purdiwan beibi, en dubala bin blandim im fo 3 mants, dumaji dubala nomo bin bradin blanga det king.

english: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.
kriol: Det spiya bin brabli thikwan, en det bleidpat bin aiyanwan. Det bleidpat bin brabli hebiwan du 7 kilogrem. En wanbala solja bin oldei garrimap det shild blanga Galaiyath lida langa im.

english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
kriol: Wal Pida bin tok langa Jisas na, “Bos, yu dalimbat dijan stori oni blanga melabat yu wekinmen o yu dalimbat blanga enibodi?”

english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
kriol: Bat ebritaim wen yumob oldei abum det Pasoba Serramoni, mi oldei larramgo fri wanbala prisana. Wal yumob dalim mi na. Yumob wandim mi blanga larramgo fri det king blanga yumob Juwish pipul?”

english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
kriol: Wal lagijat igin yu garra dalim ola yangboi blanga lukaftum miselp en jinggabat streitbalawei.

english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
kriol: Ai gibit woning na. Nomo larram detlot laiyawan mesinja en najalot pipul hu oldei jidan garram yumob oldei trikimbat yumob wen olabat oldei tok dei sabi wanim garra hepin bambai. Nomo teiknodis langa olabat drim.

english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok, “YAWEI bin dalim yumob nomo blanga dagat enijing weya im nomo klinwan blanga serramoni.

english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
kriol: Im lukaftumbat en gibit feyago langa detlot biginini hu nomo garram mami o dedi, en detlot widogel weya dei nomo garram enibodi blanga lukaftumbat olabat. Im laigim detlot najalot pipul weya dei nomo blanga yumob kantrimen en hu jidan iya langa yumob. Im gibit olabat ola klos en daga.

english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
kriol: Ai garra panishim yumob biginini olabat en ai garra meigim yumob sheim. Wen yumob kadimap detlot enimul blanga sekrifais ofring, yumob oldei deigim detlot binjipat langa rabish pleis. Wal ai garra gajim det binjipat en ai garra rabum langa yumob feis en dei gin deigidawei yumob en detlot binjipat langa det rabish pleis.

english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
kriol: en imbin jidan langa im ronwan tjeya deya wansaid langa det rum. Det boswan solja neim Ebna bin jidan wansaid langa King Sol, en Jonathan bin jidan najasaid langa det rum, en nobodi bin jidan langa det tjeya blanga Deibid.

english: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
kriol: Nogudbala pipul jidan ebriweya, en ebribodi tok gudwei blanga ola brabli nogudbalawei. YAWEI, kipum melabat seifwan, en andimwei detkain nogudbala pipul brom melabat.

english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
kriol: wal im garra pudum im bingga ontop langa det enimul hed en kilim im deya lida langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga main. Detlot serramonimen garra tjakambat det blad langa det fobala said blanga det teibul blanga ofring,

english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
kriol: Wal Mosis bin kipgon tok,

english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
kriol: YAWEI, mi garram loda enami. Dalim mi blanga detlot raitwan ting ai garra dum, en lidim mi langa det streitwei blanga go.

english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
kriol: Wal trubala mi jidan langa dijan wel. Bat mi nomo bulurrum det wei blanga dijan wel en fait seimwei laik ola pipul langa dijan wel oldei fait.

english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
kriol: Bambai na wen det taim bin kaman blanga King Sol doda blanga merrit langa Deibid, King Sol nomo bin gibit im langa Deibid. Imbin gibit im langa wan men neim Eidriyal brom det taun gulum Mehola.

english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
kriol: Deibin meigim dubala golwan ring, en deibin pudum det dubala ring andanith langa det dubala bodamwan kona blanga det nekleis,

english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
kriol: en imbin deigim detlot boun langa det hil weya detlot dubala san en faibala grensan blanga Sol bin heinginap, en imbin gajim olabat boun,

english: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.
kriol: Det faiya garra barnbarn oldei en olnait. En Idam garra jidan jis laik det deset kantri, en nomo enibodi garra trebul thru langa det kantri igin.

english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
kriol: Wal Elifas bin kipgon tok, “Job, yu jingat langa sambodi hu gin album yu. Maitbi sambala einjul garra kaman.

english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
kriol: en dei garra meigim sambala raunwan sheip jis laik det frut daga gulum pamagrenit. Dei garra meigim detlot sheip garram bluwan, pepulwan en redwan wul, en dei garra meigim sambala golwan bel, en dei garra pudum detlot sheip en detlot bel langa bodam langa det kout.

english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
kriol: “Wen yu gibit enijing langa enibodi, God garra gibitbek langa yu. En if yu gibit olabat detmatj, wal God garra gibitbek yu mowa, en pipul garra gibit yu detmatj du.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok langa im wekinmen olabat.

english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’
kriol: “Bat yumob na, yumob tok, ‘Det teibul blanga ofring blanga sekrifais, im nomo gudwan.’ En yumob pudum daga ontop langa det teibul weya yumob sabi im nogudwan. Wal yumob rabishim mi lagijat.

english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.
kriol: Wal afta detlot ting bin hepin, King Seksis bin pikimat wanbala boswan gulum Heiman, det san blanga Heimadetha, brom det femili lain blanga Eigeg. Imbin meigim im det sekanwan bos blanga ol detlot kantri.

english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
kriol: En dijan kantri gulum Keinan weya yu jidan streinja, wal ai garra gibit dijan kantri langa yu en langa yu biginini olabat olagija. En mi na garra jidan God blanga olabat.

english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
kriol: en det dubala sheip garram wing bin jidan ontop langa det boks weya det lait blanga God bin oldei shain, en deya na langa midul langa det dubala sheip det haibala serramonimen bin oldei spilim det blad blanga deigidawei detlot nogudbalawei brom ola pipul. Wal ai nomo garram taim blanga dalimbat yumob ebrijing blanga det Serramoni Pleis.

english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
kriol: en wen deibin fait langa im, imbin trai ranawei. Bat deibin ranimap im, en wen deibin gajimap im, deibin kadimof im dubala bigwan bingga en dubala bigwan tou.

english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God nomo laigim enibodi hu tjidimbat pipul, en im nomo laigim enibodi hu oldei yusumbat laiyawan skeil, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei yusumbat skeil gudwei.

english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
kriol: Wal Eibrahem bin baudan langa graun igin, en imbin laf, en imbin tok miselp, “Mi 100 yiya ol na, en im reken ai garra abum main ronwan lilboi. En main waif Sera im brabli olgamen 90 yiya ol na, en im reken Sera garra abum beibi. Minbala kaan abum biginini.”

english: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
kriol: Kaman langa mi, main olmen. Ran kwikbala laik det diya. Kaman iya langa det hil kantri weya ola gudsmelwan medisin oldei gro. Binij na.

english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
kriol: Im mobeda yu jidan powan en toktokbat trubalawei den jidan silibala en dalimbat laiya.

english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
kriol: Wal Tamas bin tok, “Yu na main Bos en main God!”

english: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”
kriol: Ai garra bringimap olabat langa main seikridwan hil, en deya na olabat garra preisimbat mi langa main haus weya olabat oldei weshipbat langa mi. Wen olabat garra gibit mi sekrifais en ofring langa main teibul blanga ofring, ai garra jidan brabli gudbinji. En olabat garra sabi det Serramoni Pleis blanga main garra jidan blanga ola pipul brom ebri kantri blanga prei langa mi.

english: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.
kriol: ‘Ai garra pikimap olabat en tjakam olabat longwei brom mi. Ai garra dum tharran langa olabat pipul en langa olabat taun du, det taun Jerusalem, weya aibin gibit olabat en olabat grengrenfathamob.

english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
kriol: Jonathan bin det dedi blanga Meribeil en imbin det dedi blanga Maika.

english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
kriol: Wal Jona bin lisin langa God, en imbin go langa det taun. Det taun bin brabli bigwan pleis, en imbin deigim im 3 dei blanga wok rait thru langa det taun.

english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
kriol: Wen yu gibitbat enijing langa ola po pipul yu kaan jidan powan, bat if yu jadimap yu ai dubala en nomo gibit enijing langa detlot po pipul, loda pipul garra tok nogudbalawei blanga yu.

english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
kriol: Imbin gibit olabat ola kantri nowathwei brom det taun gulum Mahanaiyim. Imbin gibit olabat detlot kantri gulum Beishan weya det king neim Og bin jidan bos bifo, en imbin gibit olabat detlot 60 lilwan taun deya langa det kantri gulum Jaiyiya,

english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
kriol: en detlot pipul bin ol majurrumap miselp deya langa det taun, en wen ol detlot Filastain pipul bin irrim det nyus, detlot faibala Filastain king bin go garram ola solja blanga olabat blanga fait langa detlot Isreil pipul. Wal wen detlot Isreil pipul bin irrim detlot Filastain solja bin kaminap, deibin brabli bradin,

english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
kriol: Wen yu dringgim loda wain im meigim yu mokimbat enibodi en grog meigim yu faitfait. Enibodi hu laigim jidan drangginwan kaan sabi enijing.

english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
kriol: Bat detlot pipul brom Ijip kaan album yumob. Blanga tharran na aibin gibit Ijip najawan neim gulum Wikwan Kantri.’”

english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.
kriol: Wal det dubala men bin tok, “Minbala garra kipum det pramis weya minbala bin meigim garram yu.

english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”
kriol: Yu nomo kipgon spredimatbat det wed langa dijan taun Bethel, dumaji dijan pleis im det meinwan speshalwan pleis weya det king en ola pipul oldei weship.” Lagijat na Amasaiya bin tok.

english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
kriol: Brom deya Jisas en im wekinmen olabat bin go langa det pleis gulum Gesimani, en deya na Jisas bin dalim olabat, “Yumob jidan iya, dumaji ai garra go tharrei lilbit longwei blanga prei.”

english: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
kriol: Ola ritjmen en ola powan, YAWEI det trubala God na bin meigim olabat holot.

english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
kriol: If enibodi sheim langa mi en nomo dalimbat det gudnyus langa ol detlot pipul hubin tenawei brom God, wal ai garra sheim langa olabat du wen ai garra kambek garram det brabli shainiwan lait main, garram ola einjul en garram detmatj pawa brom main Dedi.”

english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
kriol: En im seimwei du garram ola pipul en enimul olabat. God bin gibit difrinkain bodi langa pipul en difrinkain bodi langa enimul en difrinkain bodi langa bard en difrinkain bodi langa fish du.

english: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
kriol: en ola Isreil solja bin jingat gudbinjiwei, en deibin aftumbat olabat blanga kilim olabat, en deibin ranimap olabat raidap langa det taun gulum Geth olawei langa det taun gulum Ekran. Detmatj dedwan Filastain solja bin leidan ebriweya langa det roud langa det taun gulum Sharaiyim olawei raidap langa det dubala taun gulum Geth en Ekran.

english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
kriol: Bat dubala nomo bin faindim im, en ailibala neksdei dubala bin lafta gobek raitbek langa Jerusalem en lukabat im deya.

english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
kriol: Afta dijan, Jonanan en detlot lidamob blanga detlot solja hu nomo bin gibit miselp langa Bebalon pipul bin kaman langa Gedalaiya langa Mispa.

english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
kriol: Olabat garra dai, dumaji olabat nomo bin sabi hau blanga jidan gudbalawei. Olabat nogudbalawei garra deigim olabat langa greib.”

english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
kriol: Bat if olabat nomo teiknodis en olabat nomo laigim lagijat, wal olabat garra ol dai brabli nogudbinjiwei.”

english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
kriol: YAWEI, Boswan God, yu na main bos en main God. Ola lilwan bard meigim olabat kemp deya langa yu haus, en olabat growimap olabat beibi gulijap langa ol yu teibul blanga ofring.

english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
kriol: Imbin blandim det wed brom ebribodi basdam. Bat tudei imbin shoum im pipul olabat det brabliwan plen blanga im weya imbin abum brom longtaim. Yumob sabi? Bifo nobodi bin sabi Jisas Krais garra jidan insaid langa wi. Bat tudei wi sabi, dumaji God bin pikimat det rait taim blanga shoum wi wanim im wandim garra hepin langa ebribodi. Jisas Krais jidan insaid langa wi, en blanga tharran na wi sabi wi garra jidan langa det brabli shainiwan lait blanga God.

english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
kriol: “Ai kaan gibit yu eni kantri langa yu o yu rileishanmob. Ol yumob Libai pipul kaan gajim eni kantri dumaji yumob garram mi en ai garra oldei lukaftumbat langa yumob.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
kriol: Imbin meigim mi godan langa dakbala pleis.

english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”
kriol: Wal imbin ensim im na, “Ai gin oni tok wanim YAWEI wandim mi blanga tok.”

english: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”
kriol: Wal yumob, main serramonimen, yumob nomo weistimbat taim na. Yumob na YAWEI bin pikimat blanga barnimbat det gudsmelwan medisin blanga im, en yumob garra lidim detlot pipul blanga weshipbat im.” Lagijat na King Hesakaiya bin tok.

english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
kriol: Det brabli sabibalawan im jis laik det wuman hu oldei jinginatbat langa ebri roud langa det taun en langa detlot pleis weya pipul oldei go blanga baiyim enijing.

english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
kriol: Ebridei blanga det 7 dei, yumob garra bringimap ofring. En langa det namba 8 dei, yumob garra majurrumap miselp igin blanga weship mi en bringimap ofring, dumaji det dei na blanga weship, en yumob kaan dum eni wek.

english: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
kriol: Im jidan jis laik det bush langa det deset kantri, weya im gro langa det draiwan rabishwan kantri langa soltiwan graun weya nomo enijing gro. Nomo enijing gudwan oldei hepin langa im.

english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
kriol: Wal Pailat bin jingat langa detlot haibala serramonimen en kaunsala en detlot najalot pipul, en imbin majurrumap olabat,

english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
kriol: Bat detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, olabat blanga det boswan dibuldibul, dumaji det boswan dibuldibul bin dumbat nogudbala ting brom longtaim wen God bin meigim ebrijing. En det San blanga God bin kaman blanga binijimap ol detlot nogudbala ting weya det boswan dibuldibul bin dum.

english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
kriol: En yumob nomo foget det brabli strongwan pramis weya imbin meigim garram yumob olagijawan.

english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
kriol: Afta na detlot bos bin jandim sambala men langa Shailo blanga gajim det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI det Boswan God, en imbin oldei jidan deya ontop langa det Seikridwan Boks langa midul langa det dubala sheip garram wing. Wal Hofni en Finiyas det dubala san blanga det serramonimen neim Ilai bin kambek du garram det Seikridwan Boks weya detlot men bin bringimbek langa olabat kemp,

english: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”
kriol: Wal Emnon bin go en leidan langa im bed, en imbin geman meigim miselp sik, en wen King Deibid bin kaman blanga luk im, Emnon bin dalim im, “Ai wandim Teima garra kaman en gugum main daga iya gin weya ai gin luk langa im, en ai wandim im garra gibit mi det daga miselp.”

english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”
kriol: Det brabliwan mami blanga det beibi hubin laigim im beibi brabliwei bin tok langa det King, “Nomo main Haibala King! Nomo kilim det beibi! Gibit im langa det gel!” Bat det najawan gel bin tok, “Nomo gibit langa minbala. Yu kadim det beibi hafenhaf na.”

english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
kriol: en det men neim Saiman bin bilib langa Jisas Krais du, en afta wen Filip bin beptaisim im, imbin oldei go garram Filip olataim, en imbin oldei hatjamp wen imbin luk ola speshalwan ting weya Filip bin oldei dumbat.

english: “This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”
kriol: “Wal tharran na det drim aibin abum. Wal Beltashesa, yu dalim mi wanim det drim im min. Detlot klebabala en doktabala men main kaan dalim mi, bat yu gin dalim mi, dumaji det spirit blanga yu God im jidan garram yu. Lagijat na aibin tok langa Beltashesa.”

english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
kriol: en King Sol bin dalim olabat blanga gobek en tok langa Deibid lagijat, “Det king nomo wandim bigmob enijing brom yu blanga merrit langa im doda. Oni wan ting im wandim. Im wandim det skinpat brom 100 dedwan Filastain solja, dumaji olabat na det enami blanga im, en im wandi peiyimbek olabat.” Lagijat na King Sol bin wandim Deibid garra dum, dumaji imbin wandim Deibid garra dai brom detlot Filastain solja.

english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
kriol: Wal yu dalim olabat na, ‘Mi na YAWEI det boswan God pramis blanga opinimap detlot greib en larramgo yumob fri. En ai gin bringimbek yumob langa Isreil.

english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
kriol: Det king oldei gudbinji langa detlot wekinmen hu sabi ebrijing, bat im oldei panishim detlot wekinmen hu nomo dumbat olabat wek raitwei.

english: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.
kriol: Nomeda aibin spredimatbat olabat ebriweya langa detlot kantri blanga najalot pipul, bat dei garra kipgon jinggabat mi, en olabat garra stil jidan laibala en olabat biginini du. En afta dei garra kambek langa olabat ronwan kantri mijamet.

english: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.
kriol: Bat im nomo bin binijimap detlot pleis weya ola pipul bin oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip. En detlot pipul nomo bin weship det God blanga olabat grengrenfathamob holbit.

english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
kriol: Mosis bin merrit langa wan gel brom Kush, en blanga tharran na Miriyam en Eran bin mokimbat langa Mosis.

english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”
kriol: En Jerusalem garra askim na, ‘Mi na det mamiwan blanga olabat, indit? Hau aibin gibit olabat laif wen aibin stil kraikraibat langa streinjawan kantri? Hubin growimap dislot biginini? Brom weya olabat bin kaman?’”

english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
kriol: Wal det Ferasi serramonimen neim Nikadimas hubin go langa Jisas basdam bin deya du, en imbin sabi detlot serramonimen bin wandi kilim Jisas ded. Bat im nomo bin wandim olabat blanga kilim im, en imbin dalim olabat,

kriol: Esta bin tok langa im, “Yu dalim Modakai dijan wed.

english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
kriol: Wal wen Deibid bin binij toktok, King Sol bin askim im, “Lambarra, yu na tharran?” En imbin stat blanga krai na,

english: “‘therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
kriol: “‘Wal mi na YAWEI det boswan God. Yu reken yu jis laik mi en yu jidan brabli klebawan,

english: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.
kriol: en im garra gibit yunbala hasbin igin en meigim yunbala jidan femiliwei.” Lagijat na det olgamen bin tok. Brom deya det olgamen bin holdim dubala, en imbin kis langa dubala blanga sei gudbai langa dubala. Wal dubala bin stat kraikrai na,

english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
kriol: Bat ai kaan gobek langa det lowa, dumaji mi jidan jis laiga dedbala langa det lowa wulijim ai garra jidan laibala blanga God. En det lowa na bin meigim mi dai.

english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
kriol: en if olabat nomo dum wanim ai dalim olabat,

english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
kriol: Aibin kraikraibat oldei. Ai kaan luk na. Mi wik na dumaji mi oldei wori blanga main enami olabat.

english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
kriol: Wal Juda bin tok, “Nomeda. Larram det gel kipum det nekleis en wokinstik main. If yunmi kipgon lukabat det gel, bambai ola pipul garra laflaf langa yunmi. Aibin trai blanga peiyim im. Bat yu nomo bin faindim im. Wal libum na.”

english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
kriol: en imbin gajim dish, en imbin bilimap det dish garram woda, en imbin stat washimbat ola fut blanga im wekinmen olabat, en imbin draiyim olabat fut garram det tawul weya imbin taiyimap langa im weist.

english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.
kriol: Afta na ol detlot Isreil solja bin godan langa det kemp kwaitbalawei, en wen imbin midulnait, Gidiyan en im 100 solja olabat bin kamat gulijap deya langa det kemp, en wen detlot Midiyan solja bin tjeinjimbat miselp blanga hu garra wotjimbat kantri, Gidiyan en im solja olabat bin blowim olabat hon, en deibin breigim detlot jag,

english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
kriol: Wal im mami bin tok, “Main boi, yu larram det trabul kaman langa mi. Yu irrim mi na. Yu jis go en gajim det dubala nenigout.”

english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.
kriol: Dumaji Eihesaiya bin jidan femili blanga King Eiheb, imbin tenawei brom YAWEI en kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting, seimwei laik Eiheb femilimob bin oldei dumbat.

english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?
kriol: Nobodi kaan breigim det brabli strongwan aiyan brom nowathsaid weya deibin oldei miksap garram kopa.”

english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.
kriol: Wen detlot pipul langa Juda irrim det nois blanga ol detlot hosis, en detlot men hu yusumbat detlot bo en erro, ebribodi garra lafta ranawei kwikbala. Sambala garra lafta ran langa det bush kantri, en najalot garra trai blanga galimap insaid langa detlot rok. Ebri taun na garra jidan brabli emtiwan. Nomo enibodi kaan jidan deya enimo.

english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.
kriol: King Nebakanesa bin deigimwei ebrijing brom det Serramoni Pleis. Imbin deigimwei ola gudwan ting brom ola stowa rum blanga det king en ol im boswan wekinmen. En imbin deigimbek ebrijing langa Bebalon.

english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.
kriol: Wal Heiman bin luk na hau Modakai nomo bin pudumdan hed langa im, en im nomo bin shoum rispek brabliwei, en Heiman imbin brabli wail detmatj.

english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”
kriol: En det haus weya im jidan langa det geit langa sauthsaid im blanga detlot pipul hu oldei go blanga wek langa det teibul blanga ofring. Oni detlot brom det femili lain blanga Seidok brom det Libai klen gin jidan serramonimen blanga YAWEI.

english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
kriol: Wal deibin larramgo wi braja Timathi fri brom det jeil, en if im kaman langa mi dregli, wal minbala garra kaman en luk yumob.

english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
kriol: Wal Deibid bin tok, “Bos, wanim aibin dum rong? Yu nomo bin faindim enijing rong langa mi brom det taim weya aibin jidan garram yu raidap tudei. Wal wotfo ai kaan kaman en album yu fait? Yu na main king en bos, indit?”

english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
kriol: “Olabat hosis brabli kwikbala, laiga detlot big bujiget, en olabat brabli jigiwan jis laik detlot wailwan dog weya lukabat daga. Detlot soljamob hu raidimbat hosis garra kaman brom longwei kantri. Olabat hosis garra grajim det graun. Dei kaman kwikbala jis laik igulok weya kaman brom skai, gajimbat daga.

english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
kriol: en imbin dum lagijat langa wi blanga shoum ebribodi tudei en bambai det brabliwan filing weya im garram blanga ebribodi, en imbin shoum det filing blanga im wen imbin brabli kainbala langa wi wen imbin joinimap wi garram Jisas Krais.

english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God tok, “Yumob jidan kwait en irrim mi, ol yumob pipul brom ola longweiwan kantri! Yumob garra meigim miselp redi blanga abum kot. Yumob garra abum taim blanga tok. Wi garra ol majurrumap miselp en faindat hu langa rait.

english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
kriol: “Wal wen Mosis bin 40 yiya ol, imbin jinggabat blanga luk hau im ron pipul bin oldei wek,

english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.
kriol: Det boswan blanga ola Libaimen hubin jidan langa Jerusalem bin Yusi, det san blanga Bani en grensan blanga Hashabaiya. Dubala grengrenfatha blanga im brom longtaim bin Metanaiya en Mika brom det femili lain blanga Eisaf. Ola men brom dis femili lain bin lida blanga ola myusik langa sebis blanga det Serramoni Pleis,

english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
kriol: Wal yu garra tok gudei langa det dubala neim Prisila en Akwila, en yu garra tok gudei langa ola femili blanga det men neim Onesafras du.

english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
kriol: Ai garra jandim detmatj enami blanga binijim ola greip fam blanga main pipul olabat, bat detlot enami kaan kadimdan ola greiptri. Ai garra dalim detlot enami blanga breigimap ola bushis blanga detlot greiptri, dumaji detlot bushis nomo blanga main.

english: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
kriol: Wal detlot pipul hu oldei jidan gudbalawei, YAWEI det trubala God kaan larram olabat jidan hanggriwan. En im kaan larram detlot nogudwan pipul abum wanim olabat wandim.

english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
kriol: Aibin dalim det dubala men, “Nobodi kaan opinim detlot geit blanga Jerusalem raidap det san im go hot, en oni detlot solja garra opinim. En dei garra jadimap detlot geit, en dei garra lokimap garram ba bifo dei binij wek sangodantaim. Yunbala garra pikimat men brom detlot pipul hu jidan langa Jerusalem blanga wotjimbat dijan taun. Sambala garra wotjimbat detlot pleis gulijap langa olabat kemp en sambala garra wotjimbat detlot najalot pleis blanga dijan taun.” Lagijat na aibin tok.

english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
kriol: Im garra jadjim ola pipul langa ebri kantri, en im garra gaburrumap det faiting pleis garram ola ded bodi. Im garra bidim ola king oloba langa dijan wel.

english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
kriol: “Wotfo nogudbala pipul jidan laibala blanga longtaim en olabat oldei abum detmatj pawa?

english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
kriol: Yubin larram melabat abum loda trabul jis laik melabat bin buldan insaid langa trep, en jis laik yubin meigim melabat garrimap hebiwan loud langa bekboun.

english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat, wan blijiman hubin deya bin hitim im garram im bingga, en imbin tok, “Yu kaan tok lagijat langa det boswan haibala serramonimen.”

english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,
kriol: en Aminadeb bin dedi blanga Neishan, en Neishan bin dedi blanga Selman,

english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
kriol: Ai garra binij iya langa dijan kantri en ai kaan go najasaid langa det riba, bat oni yumob garra go najasaid en teikoba det gudwan kantri.

english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
kriol: Brom deya melabat bin kipgon langa det taun gulum Patalameiyas. Deya na melabat bin midim sambala bilibamob, en melabat bin jidan garram olabat oni wan dei.

english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
kriol: Aibin luk sambala pipul hu nomo bin sabi enijing. Deibin gedim ola ebrijing blanga lilwail, bat God bin jandim nogudwan ting en binijimap olabat, jis laik det tri wen sambodi pulumat im garram im rut.

english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
kriol: “Wal det serramonimen garra gibit ol dislot ebrijing na langa mi, en im garra gibit det nogudbalawei ofring, en det barnapwan ofring du.

english: “You shall not commit adultery.
kriol: “Yumob nomo lau blanga silipsilip garram enibodi. Oni yumob waif o yumob hasbin.

english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
kriol: En if det eks blanga yu im blandwan en yu nomo meigim im shapwan, wal wen yu yusum det eks yu garra wek brabli adbala. Bat sambodi jidan klebabala im jis laik shapwan eks. Im oldei binijim det wek.

english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
kriol: Yu na bin andimwei ola najalot pipul brom det kantri, en yubin meigim yu ronwan pipul jidan deya na.

english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
kriol: Wal wanbala boswan brom ebri femili en wan yangbala braja bin tjakambat det dubala speshalwan ston blanga faindat wanim wek olabat garra dum, jis laik olabat rileishanmob hubin detlot serramonimen brom det femili lain blanga Eran bin dumbat. Wal ol dislot bin luk tharran, King Deibid, Seidok, Ahimalek, en detlot boswan blanga detlot femili brom detlot serramonimen, en detlot Libai pipul.

english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
kriol: Wal yubin luk det kantri brom yu kemp. Bat yu garra go na en wokabat ebriweya langa det kantri, dumaji ai garra gibit det kantri langa yu.” Lagijat na God bin tok.

english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
kriol: God, ol detlot traib weya nomo weship yu bin luk wanim yubin dum langa melabat, en olabat mokimbat en laflaf langa melabat.

english: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
kriol: Olabat bin gobek en dumbat nogudbala ting jis laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin oldei dumbat. Olabat nomo bin duwit wanim aibin dalim olabat. Olabat bin oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip. Detlot Isreil en Juda pipul bin breigim det strongwan pramis weya aibin meigim garram olabat grengrenfathamob.

english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
kriol: “Wen yu prei, yu garra tok lagijat. ‘Dedi langa hebin, yu neim im brabli haibala, en melabat nomo wandim enibodi garra yusum yu neim nogudbalawei.

english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
kriol: Dei kaan wek nogudwei wen olabat bos nomo deya. Dei garra wek gudwei olataim. Bat dei kaan wek gudwei blanga meigim olabat bos gudbinji blanga olabat. Dei garra wek gudwei blanga meigim God gudbinji, dumaji dei dumbat det wek blanga det Bos Jisas Krais,

english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
kriol: “‘Detlot men brom Saidan en Abad bin pedulumbat det bout, en yu ronwan wekinmen hu sabi hau blanga lukaftum det bout, bin jidan bos langa det bout.

english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
kriol: Det wei blanga yu main God im holiwan. Nomo eni drimin brabli haibalawan wulijim yu.

english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
kriol: YAWEI laigim im pipul olabat, en im oldei maindimbat ola pipul blanga im. Olabat weship im, en olabat oldei dum wanim imbin tok.

english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
kriol: YAWEI, yu na det brabli gudwan stakmen. Yu oldei maindimbat mi, en ai garram ebrijing brom yu. Ai kaan wandim mowa.

english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.
kriol: Wal det king bin gibit det oda langa Eriyak, det boswan blanga detlot soljamob hubin oldei maindimbat det king. Wal wen Denyul bin irrim det nyus imbin go langa Eriyak en imbin jinggabat adbala wanim blanga tok.

english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.
kriol: Det king brom Siriya hubin fait en teikoba garra dum enijing im wandim langa olabat en nobodi garra fait langa im. Im garra teikoba Isreil en im garra jidan brabli bos garram pawa blanga binijimap det kantri.

english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”
kriol: “Wal mi na YAWEI det boswan God garra majurrumap yumob brom ola kantri weya aibin jandim yumob, en ai garra gibitbek det Isreil kantri langa yumob.

english: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
kriol: “Wal ol yumob drangginbala garra gidap na en kraikrai. Ol yumob pipul hu laigim det wain, yumob garra sori miselp, dumaji detlot grashopa bin binijimap ol detlot greiptri daga weya yumob oldei meigimbat det wain.

english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
kriol: Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wal main san, yu garra dum wanim yu dedi oldei dalimbat yu, en yu nomo fogedabat wanim yu mami oldei titjimbat yu.

english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
kriol: “Wal yumob sabi det stori weya ola braja blanga Josef bin jelas langa im. Deibin selim im langa detlot pipul hubin deigim im langa Ijip. Bat God bin deya garram im,

english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
kriol: YAWEI garra meigim ola beibi en ola biginini jidan bos blanga yumob.

english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
kriol: En wen olabat dai, ebribodi tok gudwei blanga olabat.

english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
kriol: Wal imbin kilim det enimul blanga im ronwan barnapwan ofring. En im sanmob bin bringimap det blad en imbin tjakam langa fobala said langa det teibul blanga ofring.

english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
kriol: If wi teiknodis en duwit trubalawei langa ebrijing weya YAWEI bin dalim wi blanga dum, wal im garra jidan gudbinji brabliwei garram wi.’ Lagijat na yumob garra tok langa yumob biginini.”

english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
kriol: en afta wen detlot Roman bos bin kotim mi, deibin wandi larramgo mi fri, dumaji deibin faindat ai nomo bin dum enijing rong blanga dai.

english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
kriol: Wal ai dalim yumob. Nomeda yumob dagat o dringgim o dumbat enijing, bat stil yumob garra dum ebrijing blanga shoum rispek langa God, dumaji yumob nomo wandi dum enijing weya garra stapam Juwish pipul o Jintail pipul o Kristjan pipul blanga bilib langa Jisas Krais.

english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.
kriol: “‘Wal wen det purdiflawa bin binij en bifo det greip daga bin kukwan, God garra kadim det greiptri weya im stat blanga gro igin, en kadimap detlot wadi pat du.

english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
kriol: Im oldei gidap ailibala en meigim daga redibala blanga im femili en im oldei dalim ola wekingel wanim dei garra dumbat.

english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
kriol: Wal yumob lisin langa dijan plen weya aibin meigim blanga detlot pipul brom Idam, en blanga detlot pipul langa det taun gulum Teman. Detlot enami garra deigidawei olabat bigininimob, en ebribodi garra bradin nomo lilbit.

english: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
kriol: Wal King Jehosafet brom Juda bin kambek seifwan en jidan langa im ronwan bigwan haus deya langa Jerusalem.

english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
kriol: Brom deya Isau bin tok, “Detlot wekinmen garram ola enimul weya aibin midim basdam, ai nomo sabi wotfo yubin jandim olabat lagijat.” En Jeikob bin tok, “Aibin jandim olabat lagijat blanga meigim yu gudbinji langa mi.”

english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
kriol: Wal ol detlot speshalwan mishanri langa Jerusalem en ola bilibamob langa Judiya bin irrim det stori weya detlot Jintail pipul bin irrim en bilib langa det wed blanga God,

english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
kriol: Afta wen imbin tok lagijat, streidawei imbin gidap, en imbin galimap langa im dongki, en imbin gajim detlot faibala wekingel blanga im, en deibin ol go garram detlot wekinmen blanga Deibid, en wen deibin kamat langa Deibid, Ebigeil bin merrit langa im.

english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”
kriol: Ilaisha bin tok langa Gehasi, “Askim im wanim ai garra dum blanga album im weya imbin kainbala langa mi en weya imbin bildimapbat dijan lilwan rum blanga yunmi en imbin gibit yunmi ebrijing. Wal yu askim im. Maitbi im wandim mi blanga go langa det king, o det boswan solja en dalim olabat weya imbin jidan kainbala langa mi.” Det ritjwan gel bin tok, “Im rait. Main ronwan femili dei jidan iya ebriweya gulijap langa mi.”

english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
kriol: en wen imbin jinggabat det pramis weya God bin gibit im, im nomo bin gibap. Najing. Imbin kipgon bilib, en God bin meigim im strongbala,

english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
kriol: En yu sabi enibodi hu jidan lida blanga God kaan agamin garram enibodi. Im garra kain langa ebribodi, en im garra titjimbat olabat gudbalawei, en im kaan abum eni ad filing langa enibodi,

english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
kriol: “Wen yumob faitfaitbat langa yumob kantri blanga lukaftumbat miselp brom ol yumob enamimob hu wandi kilim yumob, dubala garra blowimbat det dubala longwan wisul blanga dalim yumob blanga det fait. Mi na YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob, en ai garra albumbat yumob en seibum yumob brom ol yumob enamimob.

english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.
kriol: Neksdei na Joshuwa bin gidap ailibala, en ol detlot serramonimen en solja bin wok raidaran langa det taun seimwei igin. Sambala solja bin go lida langa detlot serramonimen garram detlot nenigout hon, en detlot serramonimen garram det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI bin kaman biyain langa olabat, en ola najalot solja bin kaman biyain langa det Seikridwan Boks, en olawei weya deibin wokaran langa det taun, detlot serramonimen bin oldei blowim detlot hon.

english: Then he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;
kriol: en imbin prei, “YAWEI, trubala God blanga Isreil. Nomo eni God langa top o langa dijan wel laik yu. Yu kipum yu brabli strongbala pramis garram yu pipul en yu shoum olabat yu laigim olabat detmatj wen dei bulurrum yu en teiknodis langa yu wed holbit.

english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
kriol: If enibodi boiwan buligi kilim najawan men buligi ded, wal det dubala men garra selim det laibwan buligi en kadimat miselp det mani, en dubala garra kadimat miselp det bif brom det dedwan buligi du.

english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
kriol: “Aibin pikimat yu bifo aibin gibit yu laif, en bifo yubin bon aibin pikimat yu, dumaji ai wandim yu garra jidan speshalwan mesinja blanga ola kantri.”

english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.
kriol: “‘Yumob kantri garra jidan emtiwan nomo garram enijing, en detlot taun garra jidan brabli rabishwan.

english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
kriol: Wal dislot na ola brabli gudwan wed blanga Salaman hubin det san blanga Deibid, en hubin det king blanga Isreil.
