english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh. The people did according to this promise.
kriol: En aibin sheikimat main klos weya aibin werrimon en aibin tok, “Wal lagijat na God garra dum langa ebribodi if yumob breigim yumob pramis. If yumob nomo dumbat raitwei wal yumob kaan abum ebrijing du.” En deibin tok, “Yuwai! Preisim YAWEI det trubala God!” En ola boswan bin kipumbat det pramis lagijat na.

english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
kriol: God bin dalim langa wi, ‘If yu rispek langa mi, wal yu garra sabi main trubalawei en yu garra libum det nogudbalawei.’”

english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
kriol: Joktan bin abum 13 san neim Elmodad, Shelaf, Heisameibeth, Jera,

english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
kriol: “Job haulong yu garra toktokbat lagijat? Yu garra larram melabat tok na.

english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
kriol: Yumob sabi det wed weya imbin gibit langa ola Isreil pipul. Imbin dalim olabat det gudnyus blanga Jisas Krais weya im garra meigim olabat jidan raitwei langa God, en Jisas Krais im na Bos blanga ebribodi.

english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
kriol: En yumob garra gibit ol detlot najalot ofring seim laik weya yumob bin gibit langa det feswan dei.

english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.
kriol: Wal det einjul bin lidimap im dubala bingga langa skai en imbin meigim strongwan pramis langa det neim blanga det olagijawan God, en aibin irrim im tok, “Im garra jidan thri en haf yiya. Basdam bigiswan trabul garra kaman langa detlot pipul blanga God en wen im binij wal ol dislot ting garra binij du.”

english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
kriol: Dijan bin stapam det nogudwan siknis en imbin jandap deya rait langa midul langa detlot pipul hubin binij en sambala hubin stil laibalawan.

english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
kriol: Ai nomo bin jadimap main hat langa yumob. Bat yumob na bin jadimap yumob hat langa mi.

english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
kriol: Deibin deigimwei ola shabul en ola dish blanga eshis weya deibin oldei yusum blanga klinimbat det teibul blanga ofring, en detlot tul blanga klinimbat ola lemp, en ola boul weya detlot blad bin buldan wen deibin oldei kilim det enimul sekrifais, en detlot dish weya deibin yusum blanga barnimap ola gudsmelwan medisin, en ola najalot kopawan ting weya deibin yusum blanga weshipbat insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis.

english: Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?
kriol: Wal aibin tok na, “Nobodi bin bilib wanim melabat bin dalim olabat. En nobodi bin bilib wanim YAWEI det trubala God bin dum garram im pawa.

english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
kriol: Wal Beilam bin tok langa Beilak, “Yu jandap iya wansaid langa yu barnapwan ofring, en ai garra go en tok langa God na.”

english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
kriol: Im nogud lagijat blanga yumob weya yumob garra barnap yumob pipul weya meigim ad blanga najalot pipul en yumob nomo bulurrum det raitwei, en yumob hu oldei tjeinjim det gudbalawei en dumbat nogudbalawei.

english: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin tok, “Yu irrim mi na! Ai garra kaman dregli. En ai garra bringimap ola gudbala ting en ola nogudbala ting blanga ola pipul. Ai garra gibit ola nogudbala ting langa detlot pipul hubin dumbat nogudbala ting, en ai garra gibit ola gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hubin dumbat gudbala ting. Olawei lagijat na ai garra gibitatbat.

english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
kriol: Wal wanmo ting. Yu garra meigim wanbala rum redi blanga mi, dumaji God garra lisin langa yumob wen yumob tok langa im blanga mi, en im garra album mi blanga kamat brom dijan jeil, en afta ai garra kaman deya langa yumob.

english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.
kriol: En deibin ol go mijamet en wen deibin kamat deya langa det Jodan Riba deibin stat wekwekbat.

english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
kriol: En imbin kipgon askimbat Jisas nomo blanga andimwei detlot nogudbala spirit brom det pleis.

english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”
kriol: En ai sabi dijan win garra tjakam dijan bout garram wi langa wan ailin.” Lagijat na Pol bin tok langa detlot boutmen langa det namba 14 dei.

english: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
kriol: YAWEI im wokwokbat wulijim wailwan solja. Im brabli strongwan. Im jinginatbat adbala, en im garra fait langa im enamimob en bidim olabat.

english: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
kriol: Bat detlot gudbala pipul hubin duwit langa God, wen dei dai, dei garra jidan gudbalawei.

english: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house.
kriol: Wal detlot men olabat bin majurrumap ola najalot Libaimen, en deibin meigim miselp klinbala blanga serramoni. En afta tharran deibin dum wanim det king bin dalim olabat blanga dum en deibin meigim det Serramoni Pleis klin blanga serramoni. Dumaji lagijat na det lowa blanga YAWEI bin tok.

english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
kriol: en deibin sing blanga det yangwan ship, det song weya Mosis det wekinmen blanga God bin lenim olabat blanga sing, “God, yu brabli haibala. Yu na det Brabli Bos. Ebrijing weya yu dumbat, yu dumbat brabli gudwan. Yu oldei jidan trubalawei. Yu nomo laiyawan. En yu oldei gibit feyago langa ebribodi. Yu na king blanga olkain pipul.

english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.
kriol: Det speshalwan het garra jidan langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga mi, en wen pipul garra luk im deya dei garra jinggabat detlot men neim, Heldai, Tobija, Jedaiya en Josaiya, det san blanga Sefanaiya.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
kriol: Wal Elifas bin kipgon tok, “Job, yu gibit yu laif langa God wulijim yu garra jidan gudbalawei en brabli hepiwan.

english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.
kriol: If yumob go lukaran sangodanwei raidap langa det ailin gulum Saipras, en if yumob garra jandim sambodi sanraiswei raidap langa det kantri gulum Keda, yumob kaan faindim enijing bin hepin lagijat bifo.

english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
kriol: en wen det gudfren blanga King Deibid neim Hushai bin luk Ebsalom, imbin jingat laiyawei, “Dis king garra jidan longtaim! Melabat wandim Ebsalom garra jidan king longtaim!”

english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
kriol: Wal det king bin jingat langa Mosis en Eran, “Distaim aibin dum brabli nogudbala ting. YAWEI det God blanga yumob im rait, en mi en main pipul olabat melabat rong.

english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.
kriol: Wal Eran en im sanmob bin dum ebrijing wanim YAWEI bin dalim Mosis olabat garra dum.

english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
kriol: Imbin kilim ded ola strongbala boswan. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.

english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
kriol: Wal detlot femili lain weya bin kamat brom Manesa bin teikoba detlot taun gulum Bethshan, Tanak, Magido en Nafodowa en ol detlot lilwan taun deya gulijap du. En detlot femili lain weya bin kamat brom Josef det san blanga Jeikob bin jidan langa dislot taun na.

english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
kriol: Bambai na wan bosmen blanga det taun bin meigim detlot pipul jidan kwait, en imbin tok, “Main kantrimen olabat, ebribodi sabi wi oldei lukaftumbat det serramoni pleis blanga Atemis det haibala drimin. Ebribodi sabi wi oldei lukaftumbat det sheip blanga im weya imbin kamdan brom top.

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.
kriol: En jis laik im dedi, King Jehoiyakin bin tenawei brom YAWEI en kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting.

english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
kriol: Nomeda God bin gibit yumob det lowa blanga im garram ola einjul, bat stil yumob nomo oldei duwit langa im.” Lagijat na Stibin bin tok.

english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
kriol: If ai tok miselp, “Ai garra blandim miselp langa dakbala. If nomo lait deya maitbi YAWEI kaan luk langa mi.”

english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
kriol: En holot det wol garra jidan 10 kilomita. Det taun garra abum nyuwan neim gulum YAWEI Im Jidan Iya.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok. Binij na.

english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
kriol: en loda pipul bin go langa det taun blanga meigim Matha en Meri gudbinji, dumaji dubala braja bin dai.

english: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
kriol: Trubala, im nomo lilwan ting weya yu dum, YAWEI. Detlot ting weya yu jinggabat, olabat brabli adwan blanga pipul blanga sabi.

english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, mi askimbat yumob blanga lisin brabliwei langa dijan wed weya aibin raidimdan blanga meigim yumob jidan strongbala, dumaji dijan leda im nomo longwan.

english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
kriol: Wal yu dalim olabat, ‘Mi na YAWEI det boswan God, en trubala ai dalim yumob. Ai nomo wandim detlot wikitwan pipul garra dai. Ai wandim olabat blanga libum olabat nogudbalawei en jidan laibala. If detlot Isreil pipul wandim jidan laibala dei garra stap dumbat detlot nogudbala ting en dei garra kambek langa mi.

english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,
kriol: Olabat garra irrimbat detlot hosis galapgalapbat, en detlot wil blanga detlot bagi garra meigimbat nois. Ola dediwan kaan gobek blanga gajim olabat biginini olabat, dumaji olabat bradin en jidan wikwan.

english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
kriol: Wal dubala bin luk, en afta det einjul bin dalim dubala, “Yunbala gobek kwikbala na en dalim ola wekinmen blanga im. Yunbala dalim olabat Jisas bin kambek laibala brom dedbala, en imbin gidap brom det greibyad. Yunbala dalim olabat im garra go lida langa Gelali. Deya na olabat garra luk im. Lagijat na yunbala garra dalim olabat.”

english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
kriol: “Detlot wikitwan pipul gin go langa silip brabli ritjwan, bat wen olabat garra gidap olabat garra jidan brabli powan.

english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
kriol: Bambai na wen King Seksis nomo bin wail langa Bashtai, imbin kipgon jinggabat wanim Bashtai bin dum en det lowa weya imbin raidimdan blanga im.

english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
kriol: En yumob oldei dum dislot ting ai heidim. En afta yumob kaman en jandap lida langa mi langa main ronwan Serramoni Pleis en yumob tok, ‘Wal melabat orait.’

english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
kriol: Mi oldei adwek blanga meigim yumob jidan strongbala en blanga meigim yumob wandi kipgon bulurrumbat det trubala wed. En mi oldei adwek blanga joinimap yumob en meigim yumob laigim gija en jidan wanbala. En mi oldei adwek blanga meigim yumob sabi brabliwei det plen blanga God weya nobodi bin sabi bifo. Det plen na im Jisas Krais. En wen yumob sabi det plen brabliwei, wal yumob garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwei,

english: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
kriol: Detlot lif bin brabli purdiwan, en imbin abum bigismob frut daga, naf blanga ebribodi langa ola kantri blanga dagat. Ola wailwan enimul bin silip andanith langa det sheid, en ola bard bin meigim nes langa det tri en ola pipul en olkain enimul du bin dagat det frut langa det tri.

english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
kriol: En ol detlot pipul hubin bulurrum mi, en deibin tenawei brom mi, en dei nomo kaman en prei langa mi, wal ai garra binijimap detlot pipul holot.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
kriol: Thritaim det ting bin hepin lagijat, en afta det kaliko bin gobek langa top,

english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
kriol: Sheiksheik graun! YAWEI im kaminap. Sheik lida langa YAWEI det God blanga Jeikob.

english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
kriol: YAWEI, mi brabli nogudbinji en im jis laik mi jidanabat langa dakwan pleis. Mi jinginatbat langa yu blanga album mi.

english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
kriol: Wal detlot Siriya soljamob hubin ranawei bin jinggabat weya detlot Isreil soljamob bin bidimbat olabat, en deibin majurrumap miselp igin, en det king blanga olabat brom Soba neim Heidadesa bin jandim wed langa detlot najalot Siriya soljamob hubin jidan sanraisaid langa det Yufreitis Riba. Wal det bos blanga ola Siriya solja blanga King Heidadesa bin neim Shobak.

english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
kriol: Yu si? Langa oltestaman im tok, “Wen yumob bedfren jidan hanggriwan, yumob garra gibit im daga, en wen im jidan thestiwan, yumob garra gibit im woda, dumaji wen yumob dum lagijat langa im, yumob garra meigim im sheim.”

english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
kriol: bat ai nomo bin laigim Isau en im biginini olabat. En ol detlot hil kantri blanga im gulum Idam, aibin meigim nogudwan en oni ola wail enimul jidan deya na.”

english: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
kriol: “Ai wandim yumob enami solja blanga kilim ded ola Moweb pipul, en if eni solja larram enibodi ranawei, ai garra tok nogudwan wed langa im.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
kriol: Ai garra tjakidawei det adwan hat blanga yumob, en ai garra gibit yumob nyuwan hat en ai garra meigim yumob jidan brabli trubala. Yumob garra oldei jinggabat blanga ola brabli gudwan ting,

english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
kriol: Wal aibin tok langa King Hesakaiya na, “Weya dislot mesinja bin kaman brom? Wanim olabat wandim?” En King Hesakaiya bin tok, “Olabat bin kaman olawei brom Bebalon.”

english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
kriol: Wal Seidok en Abaiyatha bin duwit langa King Deibid, en deibin deigimbek det Seikridwan Boks langa Jerusalem, en deibin jidanbat deya na.

english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
kriol: Wal wen det men bin tok lagijat, Jisas bin tok, “Wotfo yumob kaan bilib brabliwei? Haulong ai garra stap iya garram yumob? Haulong ai garra kipgon shoumbat yumob?” En langa det men Jisas bin tok, “Yu bringimap yu san iya.”

english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.
kriol: Detlot kopawan ting weya King Salaman bin meigim blanga det Serramoni Pleis, det dubala pol, detlot bagi, en det bigwan teingk, en det twelbala buligi weya oldei jidan deya blanga holdimap, detlot bin brabli hebiwan, en olabat nomo bin weiyimbat.

english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
kriol: Wal Lot bin lilbit bradin blanga jidan langa det taun gulum Sowa, en imbin gajim im dubala doda, en deibin go langa det hil kantri, en deya na imbin meigim kemp langa wan keib.

english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Wen Eran binij meigimbat klinbala det Brabli Seikridwan Rum, en det najawan pat langa det Seikridwan Tent weya mi oldei jidan, en det teibul blanga ofring, wal im garra gibit det laibwan boiwan nenigout langa Esasel blanga mi.

english: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”
kriol: Wal aibin tok langa ola pipul langa det kantri gulum Idam, “Ai garram wed blanga yumob brom YAWEI. Imbin jandim mesinja blanga dalim ola najalot pipul blanga majurrumap olabat amimob mijamet en olabat garra gitredi blanga go en fait langa yumob.

english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;
kriol: en detlot lida blanga ola Isreil pipul bin bringimap olkain purdibala ston blanga pudum langa det speshalwan klos blanga det haibala serramonimen,

english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
kriol: Im nomo deya langa top, en yumob kaan askim, ‘Wal hu garra gowap deya en bringimdan blanga melabat, wulijim melabat gin irrim en duwit?’

english: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
kriol: “Detlot pipul hu bulurrum yu God garra jidan laibala, en olabat bodi garra gidap laibala igin. Detlot dedbala pipul langa greibyad garra gidap en sing gudbinjiwei. YAWEI yu na det lait weya gibit laif, wulijim det dyu weya im wetim det graun ailibala. Yu gibit laif langa ola dedbala pipul.”

english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
kriol: Wal dijan mesij blanga im, im jis laiga leda weya deibin jadimap garram det bushgam. Sambala pipul garra tok, ‘Melabat kaan ridim dijan, dumaji im nomo opinwan.’

english: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
kriol: Yumob garra pikimat enijing weya yumob wandi gibit langa YAWEI. Dislot enijing na yumob garra bringimap blanga ofring, gol, silba, kopa,

english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Hu main mami en hu main braja?”

english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
kriol: Ola pipul en enimul en bard oldei lukaranbat blanga im, bat dei kaan faindim im, najing.

english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
kriol: Wen enibodi hu dalim laiya blanga im fren, tharran im laik yu ardim im garram bigwan wadi o yu kadim im garram bigwan naif o shudum im garram erro.

english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
kriol: Imbin meigim wi win langa ola pipul. Imbin meigim wi jidan bos blanga ola kantri.

english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
kriol: Wal det seim dei Debra en Barak det san blanga Abinowam bin sing dijan song,

english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.
kriol: Brom deya aibin dalim detlot blijiman blanga jadimap ola geit sangodantaim ebri Fraidei en detlot geit garra jidan lagijat raidap det sangodantaim neksdei dumaji im det Sebathdei. En aibin pudum sambala wekinmen main blanga wotjim detlot geit blanga stapam pipul bringimapbat louding langa det Sebathdei.

english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him said, “Nothing has been done for him.”
kriol: Det king bin tok, “Wibin dum enijing blanga shoum Modakai rispek brabliwei weya imbin jandim wed langa mi?” Im wekinmen olabat bin tok, “Wi nomo bin dum enijing langa im.”

english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
kriol: en imbin dalim olabat, ‘Yumob go en wek langa main gadin, en ai garra peiyim yumob det raitwan mani.’

english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.
kriol: En King Neko bin meigim det san blanga King Josaiya neim Eliyakim det nyuwan king blanga Juda en tjeinjim im neim brom Eliyakim langa Jehoiyakim. Brom deya King Neko bin deigim King Jowahes langa Ijip en deya na imbin dai.

english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
kriol: Afta na im waif bin album im kamat thru langa windo, en imbin gidawei brom detlot men hubin wotjimbat det haus,

english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”
kriol: Wal wen detlot wekinmen bin gowei brom det haus weya det dubala boi bin blandim miselp, dubala bin kamat brom det wel, en dubala bin go langa King Deibid, en dubala bin dalim im ebrijing weya bin hepin, en dubala bin dalim im det wed weya Ahithafel bin gibit langa Ebsalom, en dubala bin tok, “Kwikbala na! Yumob krosim det riba.”

english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
kriol: God im oldei kipum wi seif, en im na meigim wi brabli strongbala. Im oldei album wi wen wi oldei abum olkain trabul.

english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
kriol: Nomo jidan longwei brom mi God. Det trabul im gulijap en nobodi iya blanga album mi.

english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.
kriol: Detlot garra dalim yumob wanim rait en yumob garra dum wanim detlot dalim yumob blanga dum.

english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
kriol: Aibin reken yumob na main gudfren hu garra albumbat langa mi, bat najing. Yumob nomo eni gudbala. Yumob jis laik det lilwan krik weya nomo garram eni woda. Wen im stat rein im abum loda woda,

english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
kriol: Wal maitbi sambodi garra tok, “Wen God garra meigim ola dedbala pipul gidap laibala, wotkain bodi dei garra abum?”

english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
kriol: Dei meigim plen blanga ardimbat ola gudbala pipul, en kilimbat ded ola pipul hu nomo bin dum enijing rong.

english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
kriol: Wal brom oloba langa det kantri gulum Isreil, ola serramonimen en ol detlot Libaimen bin kaman sauthwei langa Juda blanga albumbat King Reiyabowam.

english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
kriol: Bat deibin faindim im wokwok ontop langa det woda, en deibin jingat adbala, en deibin bradin brabliwei, dumaji deibin reken im dibuldibul. Wal Jisas bin jingat langa olabat, “Mi dijan. Yumob nomo bradin.”

english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
kriol: Detlot lowa blanga yu garra jidan olagijawan garram mi, jis laik mi kipumbat main ronwan ebrijing, en dei oldei meigim mi jidan brabli gudbinji.

english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
kriol: en deibin grebum det kwin, en dei deigidawei im, en ola wekingel blanga im kilimbat miselp en kraikrai jis laiga lilwan bard.

english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of Yahweh.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”
kriol: en aibin jinggabat na detlot Filastain solja garra kaman en fait langa mi iya langa Gilgel, en ai nomo bin dum enijing blanga meigim YAWEI gudbinji langa mi, en aibin lafta jinggabat blanga dum det sekrifais serramoni miselp.”

english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
kriol: Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa mi, “Isikiyel, yu garra gajim madwan brik en yu garra pudum lida langa yu en yu garra drowim pitja blanga Jerusalem langa det brik. En yu garra jinggabat det brik im jis laik det taun.

english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
kriol: en imbin dum wanim imbin wandi dum, en imbin shoum wi det plen blanga im weya imbin jinggabat blanga dum garram Jisas Krais. Nobodi nomo bin sabi det plen bifo. Bat wi sabi na.

english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.
kriol: Wal det dubala Midiyan king bin go langa det taun gulum Kakowa. Basdam dubala bin abum 135,000 solja brom detlot deset kantri. Bat 120,000 solja bin dai langa det fait, en oni 15,000 solja bin deya garram dubala.

english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
kriol: Mi oldei jinggabat hau yubin wori blanga mi, en im meigim mi wandi kaman en luk yu en meigim miselp gudbinji brabliwei.

english: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
kriol: Wen YAWEI albumbat yu im meigimbat yu jidan gudwei garram olkain gudwan ting. Ola adwan wek kaan meigim yu jidan mowa gudwan.

english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
kriol: Tharran na mi laigim.” Wal Jeikob bin tok langa im anggul na, “Orait. Ai wandim Reitjul det doda blanga yu. Blanga im na ai garra wek blanga yu 7 yiya.”

english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
kriol: Wal det spirit blanga God bin lidimap mi en imbin deigim mi langa det sanrais geit blanga det Serramoni Pleis. En deya na rait langa det dowawei langa det geit aibin luk 25 men bin deya garram Jasanaiya det san blanga Esura, en Pelataiya det san blanga Benaiya. Dubala bin lida blanga detlot Jerusalem pipul.

english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
kriol: Im brabli nogud blanga det nogudwan bos hu nomo lukaftumbat im pipul olabat, en im jis libum olabat. Ola solja garra kaman en beldim im, en libum im wikwan garram breikinwan am. Im garra jidan blain langa im raidensaid ai, en im kaan sabi wanim blanga dum mowa na.”

english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
kriol: Wal wen Oholiba bin luk langa olabat, imbin wandim silipsilipbat garram olabat, en imbin jandim mesinja langa Bebalon blanga go en bringimbek sambala men langa im.

english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
kriol: Wal wen sambala serramonimen gulum Ferasi bin irrim det wed weya Jisas bin tok, deibin laf langa im, dumaji dei laigim mani.

english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai nomo laigim detlot serramoni weya yumob oldei abumbat. Trubala ai nomo laigim olabat.

english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.
kriol: En imbin gibit im det wed weya det mesinja bin dalim ol detlot pipul langa det taun gulum Susa. Tharran na bin det nyubala lowa blanga binijimap ola Juwish pipul. Modakai bin gibit det peipa langa Hethak blanga shoum langa Esta, en imbin tok, “Dalim Esta im garra go langa det king en kipgon askimbat im blanga gibit melabat feyago.”

english: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.
kriol: en ai garra kipum main pramis weya ai garra meigim garram im wen im garra jidan main waif.

english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
kriol: King Deibid bin tok, “Detlot pipul weya God bin larramgo olabat fri brom ola nogudbala ting weya deibin oldei dumbat garra gudbinji.

english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
kriol: Langa det namba 7 dei, yumob garra washim yumob klos, en lagijat na yumob garra jidan brabli klinbala en yumob gin gobek langa det kemp.” Lagijat na Eliyeisa bin tok.

english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
kriol: Bat if yumob nomo bin teiknodis en nomo dum enijing, en nomo kilim im ded,

english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
kriol: Main bos, meigim mi jidan gudbinji dumaji mi blanga yu wekinmen. Mi oldei jingat langa yu.

english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
kriol: “Jinggabat ol detlot wed weya main wekinmen Mosis bin titjimbat. Teiknodis langa ebrijing aibin titjim im en ola lowa weya aibin gibit langa im deya langa det hil gulum Sainai. Aibin gibit im det wed blanga ol main Isreil pipul.

english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
kriol: En YAWEI bin kamdan insaid garram det klaud en jandap lida langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent, en jingat adbala, “Eran! Miriyam!” Wal dubala bin jandap lida,

english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
kriol: Wal lagijat na ai reken God garra dum langa olabat, dumaji olabat nomo bin laigim im, en olabat nomo prei langa im du.

english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
kriol: Brom deya det wekinmen blanga Jisas neim Judas Askeriyat bin go, en imbin tok langa detlot haibala serramonimen blanga hendimoba Jisas langa olabat.

english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
kriol: YAWEI bin meigim pramis basdam garram yumob blanga meigim yumob im ronwan pipul olabat, en tudei na imbin kipum det pramis langa yumob. En imbin dalim yumob blanga duwit langa ol detlot lowa blanga im.

english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
kriol: Wal mi na det men. Bat ai nomo bin wandi gulum main neim, dumaji ai nomo bin wandi tok praudbalawei blanga main ronselp en reken miselp mi strongbala. Bat ai gin tok praudbalawei lagijat weya mi jidan wikwan.

english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.
kriol: Jerabowam bin jidan king blanga Isreil blanga 20 yiya, en langa det namba 20 yiya na deibin meigim Asa det nyuwan king blanga Juda, en imbin jidan king blanga 41 yiya langa Jerusalem. Asa bin det grensan blanga Meiyaka, det doda blanga Ebsalom.

english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
kriol: Wal wantaim Jisas bin andimwei dibuldibul brom insaid langa wan men. Det dibuldibul nomo bin oldei larram det men tok. Bat wen Jisas bin andimwei det dibuldibul, det men bin tok na, en ola pipul bin hatjamp.

english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
kriol: Wal dubala bin tok, “Yu jingat langa det gel en faindat wanim im wandi du.”

english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
kriol: Wi sabi tharran, dumaji langa oltestaman im tok, “God, pipul nomo enijing. Wal wotfo yu oldei jinggabat olabat? En wotfo yu oldei lukaftumbat olabat?

english: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
kriol: Wal Jowab bin tok, “Bos, YAWEI det trubala God garra meigim ola Isreil pipul jidan detmatj, mowa en mowa. En olabat wekinmen blanga yu. Wal wotfo yu wandim kaundimap olabat tudei en meigim olabat jidan gilti blanga dumbat nogudbala ting?”

english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.
kriol: Wal det bos blanga ola solja blanga YAWEI bin dalim im, “Yu deigimat yu but, dumaji dijan graun weya yu jandap im seikridwan.” En Joshuwa bin dum wanim det solja bin dalim im.

english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
kriol: Afta na det wekinmen blanga Eibrahem bin deigim 10 kemul en imbin loudimap detlot purdiwan enijing, en imbin go langa det kantri gulum Mesapoteimiya, en imbin go raidap langa det taun weya det braja blanga Eibrahem neim Neihowa bin jidan.

english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
kriol: En yumob garra go en dalimbat olabat du. “Wal ai garra jandim yumob langa deinjawan pleis. Im jis laik weya lilwan kidikidi go langa det pleis weya ola wailwan dog jidanbat.

english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
kriol: en det gudnyus garra spredat ebriweya langa ola kantri bifo det taim blanga God garra kaman.

english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
kriol: Wal det tjetj weya God bin pikimat iya langa dijan pleis im jidan jis laiga sista blanga det tjetj blanga yumob, en ola pipul iya langa dijan tjetj tok gudei langa yumob. Binij na.

english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
kriol: Dumaji main enami olabat kaan winoba langa mi, ai garra sabi yu gudbinji langa mi.

english: Then Job answered Yahweh:
kriol: Wal Job bin tok langa YAWEI,

english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.
kriol: Bambai na Jethro det serramonimen brom det kantri gulum Midiyan bin irrim ebrijing weya God bin dum blanga im lambarra Mosis, en imbin irrim ebrijing weya God bin dum blanga detlot Isreil pipul wen imbin deigidawei olabat brom Ijip.

english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
kriol: en Liya bin tok, “God bin gibit mi gudwan presen. Main hasbin garra lukbek langa mi olataim, dumaji aibin abum siksbala lilboi blanga im.” En imbin gulum neim blanga det lilboi Sebyulan.

english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.
kriol: Henanaiya bin det san blanga Shelemaiya, en Henun, det namba 6 san blanga Seilaf, en deibin bildimbek najawan pat du. Dijan bin olabat sekanwan pat deibin bildimbek. Meshalam bin det san blanga Berakaiya, en imbin bildimbek det najawan pat weya bin lida langa im haus.

english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
kriol: Wen yumob bin askim mi blanga gibit yumob king, nomeda aibin wail langa yumob, bat stil aibin gibit yumob detlot king, en tudei na mi stil wail langa yumob, en blanga tharran na ai garra deigidawei yumob king.

english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
kriol: Nomo enibodi bin wandim dum enijing langa yu. Nobodi nomo bin fil sori blanga yu. Deibin jis tjakidawei yu langa opinwan kantri.

english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.
kriol: Wal wen King Jehosafet dedi Asa bin jidan laibala im nomo bin andimwei ol detlot nogudwan men en gel hubin oldei wek deya langa detlot pleis weya ola pipul bin oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip. Wal King Jehosafet na bin andimwei ol detlot nogudwan men en gel hubin oldei wek en hubin oldei silipsilip garram enibodi deya langa detlot pleis du.

english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
kriol: En if det men jidan langa sedul o tjeya wen im garram det nogudwan sowa detlot ting im nomo klinbala blanga serramoni.

english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
kriol: Deya na ontop langa det fletwan ruf, samting bin deya. Imbin luk jis laik det speshalwan tjeya blanga det king. Imbin brabli shainiwan garram brabli purdiwan ston. En ontop langa det speshalwan tjeya wanbala sheip bin jidanbat deya. Imbin luk jis laik wanbala men.

english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,
kriol: “Bambai ai garra meigim nyuwan pramis langa ol detlot Isreil pipul, en langa ol detlot pipul brom Juda.

english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
kriol: If yu wonim olabat en dei kipgon dumbat detlot nogudbala ting, wal olabat garra dai, dumaji olabat nomo bin teiknodis langa yu en deibin kipgon dumbat detlot nogudbala ting, en yu kaan jidan giltiwan.”

english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom
kriol: Wal basdam wen King Deibid bin teikoba Idam, Joweb det boswan wekinmen blanga im soljamob bin go langa Idam en deibin jidan deya 6 manth. En langa det taim na imbin kilim ola solja brom Idam en imbin berrim ola Isreil solja hubin gitkil deya du.

english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.
kriol: wulijim nobodi brom detlot Isreil pipul lau abum eni Isreil wekinmen o wekingel hu jidan laiga prisana wek blanga olabat.

english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Maitbi yumob nomo bin ridim det stori langa oltestaman blanga King Deibid weya im en im wekinmen olabat bin hanggri en dei nomo bin abum eni daga blanga dagat?

english: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
kriol: “Mi na YAWEI det boswan God. Tharran na main neim. Mi na det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul en mi na garra seibum olabat.

english: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
kriol: Det meinwan rum bin abum sidatri wud langa ola wol en deibin gaburrumap garram gudwan gol. Deibin abum pitja blanga pamtri en tjein oloba.

english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”
kriol: Afta na deibin jandim wed langa ola pipul langa det taun gulum Kiriyajerim. Deibin tok, “Detlot Filastain pipul bin jandimbek det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI. Wal yumob lafta kaman en gajim det boks en deigimbek garram yumob.”

english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
kriol: Wen det klaud bin oldei jidan deya langa det Tent, detlot Isreil pipul bin oldei jidan deya du, en wen det klaud bin oldei gowei brom det Tent, ola Isreil pipul bin oldei shifdim olabat kemp.

english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, yumob jinggabat na. Yumob kaan tok streidawei.

english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
kriol: Wal detlot bosmen bin tok gija blanga tharran, “Wanim wi garra tok? If wi dalim im Jon bin gedim det rait brom God, wal im garra askim wi wotfo wi nomo bin duwit langa det wed blanga im.

english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
kriol: en det serramonimen garra luk, en pudumwei fo 7 dei.

english: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
kriol: Dei ran langa det taun, en dei galimap ontop langa det wol, en dei gowin langa ola haus thru langa ola windo jis laik ola stilinbala gowin.

english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
kriol: dumaji olabat jinggabat olabat ronselp en dei tok praudbalawei.

english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
kriol: Wal detlot speshalwan mishanri bin luk Jisas bin gowap ontop langa hebin brom det hil gulum Olib. Det hil nomo bin longwei brom det taun Jerusalem. Imbin oni wan kilomita, en afta wen Jisas bin gowap, detlot mishanri bin gobek langa det taun,

english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
kriol: En wanbala nogudbala spirit oldei grebum im, en im meigim im jingat en deigim fit, en im meigim spit kamat brom im mawus. Det nogudbala spirit oldei ardimbat im, en im kaan gowei brom im.

english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
kriol: Bambai na wandei wen Jisas bin preiprei miselp, im wekinmen olabat bin go langa im, en imbin askim olabat, “Hu ola pipul reken mi?”

english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
kriol: en imbin go en gajim det bodi garram Nikadimas det men hubin go en tok langa Jisas wan nait. Nikadimas bin deigim loda gudsmelwan medisin gulum mera en elos. Gulijap 30 kilogrem imbin deigim,

english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
kriol: “Wal if sambala pipul oldei dumbat gudbala ting en maitbi olabat garra libum det gudbalawei en dumbat nogudbala ting, wal ai garra testimbat olabat if dei nomo duwit langa mi. Bat if yu nomo dalim olabat, wal dei garra dai dumaji deibin dumbat rong ting. Ai kaan jinggabat detlot gudbala ting weya deibin dum basdam, najing. Isikiyel, ai garra bleim yu if detlot pipul garra ol dai.

english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.
kriol: Wal wen King Josaiya bin irrim wanim im tok langa det buk garram God lowa, imbin breigimap im klos en jidan soribalawei.

english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Ebribodi iya langa dijan kantri dei merrit.

english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
kriol: En dei oldei jidan brabli gudbinji, nomo garram enijing rong langa olabat raidap langa det dei wen olabat redi blanga dai.”

english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.
kriol: Wal det pleis nomo bin gudwan blanga jidan deya kolwethataim, en ola boutmen bin wandi kipgon blanga kamat langa det najawan pleis gulum Finiks deya sauthsaid langa det seimwan ailin, dumaji imbin gudwan pleis blanga jidan kolwethataim.

english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
kriol: Wal detlot boswan bin meigim granggibala men jidan haibala, en deibin meigim detlot haibala men en ritjmen jidan wekinmen.

english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.
kriol: Afta na det dubala men bin kamdan brom det hil kantri, en dubala bin krosim det riba, en dubala bin gobek langa det kemp blanga ola Isreil pipul, en deya na dubala bin dalim Joshuwa ebrijing weya bin hepin langa det taun,

english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
kriol: en wen imbin irrim det nyus weya Jisas bin kambek brom Judiya, imbin go langa Jisas, en imbin askim im blanga go garram im en meigim im san gudbala, dumaji im san bin gulijap dai.

english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
kriol: Bat yumob Kenait pipul garra gitkil wen detlot Asiriya solja garra deigimwei yumob prisana.”

english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt
kriol: Olabat bin bradin blanga detlot Bebalon pipul, dumaji Ishmeil bin kilim Gedalaiya hubin jidan bos langa det kantri, dumaji det king brom Bebalon bin meigim im bos. Wal olabat bin go langa Ijip na, dumaji olabat bin trai blanga gowei brom detlot Bebalon pipul. Olabat bin stap hafwei langa det pleis gulum Kimam gulijap langa Bethlahem.

english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok langa det tri na, “Nobodi kaan dagat eni daga brom yu, dumaji yu kaan abum eni daga.” En detlot wekinmen blanga im bin irrim im tok lagijat langa det tri.

english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
kriol: Bambai na det waif blanga Potafa bin stat tjeisimbat Josef, en imbin askim im blanga silip garram im, dumaji Josef bin abum gud bodi, en imbin brabli purdibala.

english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.
kriol: En wen imbin tok lagijat, detlot solja bin kadim detlot roup blanga det dinggi, en deibin larramgo det dinggi bifo detlot boutmen bin gowin.

english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
kriol: Wal det gel bin tok, “Ai sabi det Boswan gulum Masaiya garra kaman, en wen im kaman, im garra dalim wi ebrijing.”

english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
kriol: Wal detlot Isreil pipul bin dum wanim Mosis bin dalim olabat. Bat sambala pipul bin gajim blendibala daga, en sambala pipul bin gajim lilbit daga,

english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
kriol: en wen yumob bin irrim det gudnyus, yumob bin sabi hau God bin brabli kainbala langa wi, en brom det taim na raidap tudei det gudnyus bin wek langa yumob laif brabliwei, en det gudnyus kipgon spredatbat ebriweya langa ebri kantri.

english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin tok dijan, “Pipul brom Jerusalem, yumob garra go langa Lebanan, en yumob garra jinginat. Yumob garra go deya langa det kantri gulum Beshan en yumob garra jinginat, en jingat du brom det bigwan hil langa Moweb, dumaji detlot solja brom det najawan kantri hu oldei jidan gudfren blanga yumob, dei nomo bin win, najing.

english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
kriol: Yumob garra meigim yumob mami en dedi gudbinji blanga yumob en yumob mami garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwei.

english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
kriol: Wal yumob irrim mi na. Mi na, Pol, mi dalim yumob. If yumob bulurrum det lowa blanga sekamsais, wal Jisas Krais kaan album yumob, dumaji yumob trastim det lowa blanga meigim yumob jidan raitwei langa God. Yumob nomo trastim Jisas Krais blanga meigim yumob jidan raitwei langa im.

english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
kriol: dumaji blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting detlot Juda en Jerusalem pipul bin oldei dumbat. Olabat kingmob, en lidamob, en detlot serramonimen en speshalwan mesinjamob holot bin dumbat nogudbala ting.

english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
kriol: Yumob agamin gija en deigim miselp langa odinri pipul blanga jadjim yumob, en tharran na shoum wi yumob nomo brabli Kristjan. Yu si? Yumob oldei dum nogudbala ting langa yumob Kristjan braja o sista olabat, en yumob oldei pulumat olabat enijing. Bat ai dalim yumob. Yumob nomo wandi dum nogudbala ting langa yumob Kristjan braja o sista olabat. Im mobeda yumob larram olabat dum nogudbala ting langa yumob. Nomeda olabat pulumat yumob enijing, bat stil yumob nomo wandi dum nogudbala ting langa olabat.

english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
kriol: Main boi, yu garra teiknodis langa mi brabliwei en yu wotjim wanim mi oldei dumbat.

english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
kriol: God, yu oldei dum wanim rait. Yu sabi wanim melabat jinggabat en wanim melabat filim. Yu stapam detlot nogudbala pipul brom dumbat krulbala ting langa najalot pipul. Yu gibit ola gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei.

english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
kriol: Pipul brom Jerusalem en brom ola taun oloba Juda en Isreil bin kaman. Dei nomo bin abum det Pasoba Serramoni lagijat brom det taim wen Semyul bin jidan speshalwan mesinja. Dei nomo bin abum eni Pasoba Serramoni lagijat bifo langa Isreil.

english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
kriol: Wal det gel bin kipgon kraikrai raidap det laswan dei blanga det weding padi, en langa det laswan dei Semsan bin dalim im wanim det stori min, dumaji det gel bin kipgon askimbat im, en det gel bin go en dalim detlot Filastain men.

english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
kriol: en God bin meigim ebrijing garram det Wed. Im nomo bin meigim enijing nomo garram det Wed,

english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
kriol: Hesakaiya bin dedi blanga Manesa, en Manesa bin dedi blanga Eman, en Eman bin dedi blanga Josaiya.

english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
kriol: En detlot Juwish pipul bin majurrumap miselp igin langa Susa langa det namba 14 dei blanga det manth gulum Edara, en deibin kilim 300 men mowa langa Susa, bat dei nomo bin deigidawei enijing brom olabat.

english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.
kriol: Wal King Hesakaiya bin fait en bidim detlot Filastain pipul en imbin gajimbat ola ebrijing brom ol detlot bigwan en lilwan taun en brom det taun gulum Gasa en langa detlot taun gulijap deya du.

english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”
kriol: En ai garra askim yu wanmo ting na, en nomo nokambek mi.” “Wanim tharran?” Bethsheba bin tok.

english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
kriol: Afta tharran na, Sedakaiya det san blanga Josaiya bin jidan king langa Juda. Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin dalim mi,

english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
kriol: Wotfo yu meigim mi lukinatbat dislot nogudbala ting, en wotfo yu larram diskain ting hepin weya olabat faitfait gija en olabat agamin gija, en olabat breigimap ebrijing du en dumbat krulbala ting? Pipul ebriweya dumbat lagijat.

english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
kriol: Wal wandei, wen ola Isreil pipul bin abumbat fyunral, deibin luk ola Moweb pipul kaminap en deibin tjakam det ded bodi langa det seim greib weya deibin berrim det bodi blanga Ilaisha en deibin ol ranawei brom deya. Bat wen det dedwan bodi bin tatjim detlot boun blanga Ilaisha det dedwan men bin gidap laibala igin en imbin jandap.

english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
kriol: “Yumob jidan praudbalawei dumaji yumob bin meigim prisana ola pipul langa det taun gulum Lodaba. En praudbalawei yumob oldei tok, ‘Melabat bin brabli strongbala naf blanga teikoba det najawan taun gulum Kanaiyim.’

english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”
kriol: Yu garra gajim det mani en yusum blanga lukaftumbat det Seikridwan Tent weya ai garra jidan, en det mani garra pei blanga olabat laif, en ai garra oldei jinggabat langa olabat en lukaftumbat olabat.”

english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?
kriol: “Wal yumob garra stap en jinggabat dijan. Yumob reken men gin abum beibi? Wotfo ai oldei luk ebri men oldei holdimbat im ronwan binji, jis laik det gel wen im garra abum im beibi? Wotfo ebribodi sheiksheik nomo lilbit?

english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:
kriol: Afta na aibin gowei brom Tofeth weya YAWEI bin jandim mi blanga dalimbat olabat det mesij. Aibin gowin en jandap lida insaid langa det rum langa det Serramoni Pleis, en aibin dalim ola pipul wanim

english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
kriol: Wal loda pipul bin kaman langa Jerusalem blanga det Pasoba Serramoni, en det neksdei wen deibin irrim Jisas bin kaminap langa Jerusalem, deibin gajim bushis brom ola pamtri,

english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
kriol: Wen det rait taim garra kaman, ai garra dum ebrijing weya aibin dalim Ilai. Brom stat raidap langa binij ai garra dum ebrijing langa im femili olabat.

english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.
kriol: Wal aibin kipgon lukabat brabli adbala blanga detlot ensa, bat ai nomo bin faindim, najing! Wal pipul oldei tok, “Aibin faindim oni wanbala gudwan men brom bigismob men, bat ai nomo bin faindim wanbala gel.”

english: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
kriol: Detlot pipul hu peiyimbek mi nogudwei blanga gudbala ting mi dum, olabat main enami.

english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
kriol: En seimwei du God im Bos blanga det gel weya merrit langa Kristjan men. God im Bos blanga det dubala merrit pipul, en blanga tharran na dubala biginini olabat jidan blanga God du. Bat if God nomo bina jidan Bos blanga det dubala merrit pipul, wal detlot biginini blanga dubala bina jidan jis laik ola odinri pipul weya nomo bilib langa Jisas Krais.

english: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
kriol: raidap ai meigim haus blanga YAWEI, det haibalawan God blanga Jeikob.”

english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
kriol: en bigmob pipul bin go langa det kemp blanga im. Detmatj pipul bin hipap deya, en deibin jadimap det kemp, en nomo eni rum bin deya langa det dowa blanga gowin insaid. Wal Jisas bin insaid langa det haus dalimbat detlot pipul det gudnyus,

english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
kriol: Wal wen Pol bin deya langa Mailitas, imbin jandim wed langa detlot tjetj lidamob langa Efasas, en imbin dalim olabat blanga kaman langa im deya langa Mailitas,

english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
kriol: En oni God na gin meigim blainwan detlot boswan hu oldei kotimbat ola pipul. If God nomo bin dum, wal hubin dum? En hubin larram ol detlot nogudbala pipul teikoba dijan wel?”

english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
kriol: Wal main braja en sista olabat, melabat sabi yumob oldei album yumob braja en sista olabat jidan strongbalawei en meigim olabat gudbinji, en yumob garra ol kipgon albumbat gija lagijat.

english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
kriol: o kripulwan bekboun, o hu garram nogudwan ai, o skin siknis, o nogudwan boiwan pat, o shotwan men hu nomo bin gro gudwei, im nomo lau blanga gibitbat det sid daga ofring langa mi.

english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
kriol: Brom deya det gabman bos blanga Gelali neim King Herod bin irrim det nyus blanga Jisas,

english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
kriol: Detlot hubin dai basdam langa det wo, deibin mowa lakiwan. Dijan najamob hubin dai afta, dei jidanbat hanggriwan en dai slobala, dumaji olabat nomo bin abum eni daga.

english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
kriol: Yu kaan bradin wen yu silip en olabat garra rispek langa yu.

english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Aibin libum detlot Isreil pipul. Aibin tjakidawei main ronwan pipul. Aibin gibit main pipul hu aibin laigim langa detlot enamimob.

english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
kriol: Detlot pipul deya langa det taun nomo bin bulurrum YAWEI. Deibin oldei bulurrumbat olabat ronwei, en deibin brabli nogudwan pipul.

english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
kriol: Wal yumob sabi ol detlot boswan haibala serramonimen bin oldei lafta gibit ofring en abum det sekrifais serramoni blanga God, en det brabli Boswan haibala serramonimen blanga wi bin lafta gibit ofring du.

english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.
kriol: Main olmen bin pudum im bingga langa det dowa, en aibin brabli gudbinji imbin gulijap.

english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
kriol: en deibin jingat langa detlot speshalwan mishanri, en deibin dalim detlot blijiman blanga beldim olabat garram wip. En afta wen deibin beldim olabat, detlot serramonimen bin dalim olabat nomo blanga yusum det neim blanga Jisas en titjimbat enibodi blanga im. En deibin larramgo olabat.

english: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to Yahweh, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
kriol: en imbin tok, “Bos, wotfo yubin kaman iya?” Wal King Deibid bin dalim im, “Aibin kaman iya blanga baiyim dis pleis brom yu wulijim ai garra bildimap teibul blanga ofring blanga weship langa YAWEI blanga stapam dis siknis.”

english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”
kriol: Bat na ai garra hendimoba det kap langa detlot krulbala enami, hubin oldei tridimbat yumob brabli nogudbalawei. Deibin tridimbat yumob rafwei, jis laik deibin wokwokbat ontop langa yumob.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
kriol: Wal Jisas bin tok, “Wotfo yumob lukabat mi? Yumob nomo sabi brabliwei det klebabala ting weya aibin dum. Trubala ai dalim yumob. Yumob lukabat mi dumaji yumob bin dagadagat det daga en meigim miselp bulap binji.

english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.
kriol: Lodataim aibin oldei panishim detkain pipul langa ola Juwish Miting Pleis, en aibin oldei trai en meigim olabat libum det stori blanga Jisas. Aibin oldei go longwei langa najalot taun blanga panishimbat olabat, dumaji aibin brabli wail langa det stori.

english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.
kriol: “En ola Isreil men weya dei jidan langa yumob kantri garra kaman en weship langa YAWEI 3 taim ebriyiya langa det wanbala pleis blanga weship. Dei garra midap langa det serramoni gulum Pasoba, det serramoni gulum Kukwan Daga, en det serramoni gulum Hampi. Ola men garra bringimap presen. If YAWEI bin gibit yumob oni lilbit wal yumob oni garra gibitbek lilbit en if imbin gibit yumob bigismob wal yumob garra gibitbek im bigismob.”

english: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Jeramaiya, yu garra dalim detlot pipul langa Isreil ebri jag garra jidan fulwan garram wain. En olabat garra tok dei sabi ebri jag garra jidan fulwan garram wain.

english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.
kriol: Yumob dalim det king, YAWEI bin tok langa im, ‘Yu kaan go gudbala. Yu garra dai.’” Lagijat na Ilaija bin tok, dumaji imbin teiknodis langa YAWEI.

english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
kriol: dumaji imbin wandim im pipul olabat blanga teiknodis langa ol im lowa en dum ebrijing im dalim olabat blanga dum. Aleiluya! Preisim YAWEI det trubala God!

english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
kriol: Ola najalot pipul hu nomo bilib langa God garra binijimap dijan taun Jerusalem. Dei garra kilimbat sambala pipul garram naif, en dei garra deigidawei sambala pipul langa najalot kantri en meigim olabat jidan prisana. Dei garra pudumbut langa dijan taun ebriweya raidap olabat taim garra binij.

english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
kriol: YAWEI, yu gibit melabat ebrijing igin, jis laik rein wen im bilimap woda langa ola draiwan riba.

english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
kriol: Imbin dai en deibin berrim im deya langa Jerusalem, en im san Reiyabowam bin jidan det nyuwan king.

english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
kriol: “Bambai na wen yu kamat langa det kantri yu garra kadimat ola kantri blanga ola klen. Yu garra gibit lilbit kantri langa lilwan klen, en loda kantri langa bigwan klen.

english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
kriol: “Wal ebrijing main Dedi garram, olabat blanga mi du. En blanga tharran na aibin dalim yumob det Holi Spirit garra meigim yumob sabi ebrijing weya mi dalim im.

english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
kriol: Shimiyai bin abum 16 san en siksbala doda, bat im brajamob nomo bin abum bigmob biginini, wulijim det klen blanga Simiyan nomo bin go bigwan laik det klen blanga Juda.

english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
kriol: en wen dubala merrit, dubala jidan wanbala na,

english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
kriol: Wal aibin faindat diskain ting na oldei hepin langa mi. Wen ai wandim dum gudbala ting, ai kaan dum det gudbala ting miselp. Oni nogudbala ting ai gin dum miselp.

english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
kriol: Wal King Deibid en ol detlot boswan blanga ola Isreil pipul en ola solja bin go langa det haus blanga Obedidam, deibin go en gajim det Seikridwan Boks en deibin brabli gudbinji.

english: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
kriol: Preisim im neim tudei en olagijawan.

english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
kriol: Wal Eibrahem bin tok, “God garra gibit yunmi samting blanga tharran ofring.” En dubala bin kipgon wok.

english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.
kriol: Langa 7 dei yumob kaan dagat eni damba garram raising, en yumob kaan abum eni damba garram raising langa yumob haus, en yumob kaan abum eni raising eniweya langa yumob haus du.

english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
kriol: Wal ol yumob Kristjan pipul hubin bon Jintail, yumob garra jinggabat hau yumob bin oldei jidan bifo. Ola Juwish pipul bin oldei tok rabishwei langa yumob, dumaji deibin ol sekamsais en yumob nomo bin sekamsais.

english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
kriol: If det men hu garram det nogudwan sowa tatjim sambodi bifo imbin washim im bingga, wal det sambodi garra lafta washim im klos en abum bogi en im garra lafta jidan nomo klinbala blanga serramoni raidap sangodan.

english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
kriol: Dei kilim ded ola widogel en detlot biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi. En dei medrim pipul hubin kaman brom najawan kantri blanga jidan langa wi kantri.

english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”
kriol: Bat imbin dalim mi ai garra abum lilboi, en mi nomo lau dringgim eni grog o dagat eni daga weya yu nomo lau dagat, dumaji det lilboi garra jidan jis laik detkain speshalwan men blanga God gulum Nesarait brom beibitaim raidap im garra dai.”

english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
kriol: Wal wanim yumob reken?” Wal deibin ol tok, “Wibin faindim folt langa im, en im garra dai.”

english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”
kriol: Bat detlot pipul bin ol jidan kwaitbala, dumaji King Hesakaiya bin dalim olabat nomo blanga tok langa det Asiriya solja.

english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
kriol: Imbin ardim loda gudbala men en imbin meigim bigismob men dai du.

english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
kriol: Afta na detlot boswan blanga detlot solja bin go langa Mosis

english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
kriol: If yu binijimap olabat, detlot pipul brom Ijip garra tok, “YAWEI nomo garram det pawa blanga deigim olabat langa det kantri weya imbin pramis olabat. Imbin deigim im ronwan pipul olabat langa deset kantri blanga binijimap olabat, dumaji im nomo laigim olabat.”

english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
kriol: Olabat binij kwikbala, jis laik det shedopat. Ebrijing weya pipul dum im jis najing. Olabat gin jidan ritjwan garram ebrijing tudei bat olabat nomo sabi hu garra gajim ol detlot ebrijing bambai.

english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”
kriol: Wal King Salaman bin tok, “If im rispek mi, wal nomo enijing garra ardim im, bat if im nomo rispek langa mi, wal im garra dai.”

english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
kriol: Wal wen det beibi bin wan wik ol, imbin taim blanga sekamsais im en gibit im neim, en detlot pipul bin wandi gibit det lilboi im dedi neim Sekaraiya.

english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
kriol: Wi garra kaman langa im en tok theingkyu, en preisim im garram ola hepiwan song.

english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
kriol: Wal Jehoiyakin bin 18 yiya ol wen imbin jidan det nyuwan king blanga Juda. Imbin jidan king langa Jerusalem blanga Juda 3 mants. Im mami bin neim Niyashta det doda blanga Elnathan hubin jidan langa Jerusalem.

english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
kriol: Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok langa Mosis,

english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”
kriol: Dijan brabli nogudwan ting bin kaman langa yumob dumaji yumob bin oldei gibitbat sekrifais ofring langa ola drimin, en yumob bin dum nogudbala ting langa YAWEI wen yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa im wed.” Lagijat na aibin tok.

english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
kriol: en det Holi Spirit bin kamdan langa im jis laiga bard, en God bin tok brom hebin, “Yu na main ronwan san. Mi laigim yu, en mi brabli gudbinji blanga yu.” Wal Jon bin oldei dalimbat ola pipul blanga libum detlot nogudbalawei blanga olabat, en imbin dalimof det gabman bos neim Herod du. Imbin dalimof im streidat, dumaji Herod bin merrit langa Herodiyas det waif blanga im ronwan braja Filip, en imbin oldei dumbat olkain nogudbala ting du. En wen Jon bin dalimof im, Herod bin dum brabli nogudbala ting. Imbin pudum Jon langa jeil.

english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?
kriol: Ebribodi bin sabi det taun weya bin oldei jidan brabli hepiwan, bat nomo enibodi jidan deya na, najing.

english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
kriol: Det san blanga Eran neim Eliyeisa bin merrit langa det doda blanga Putiyel, en imbin abum wan san neim Finiyas. Wal ol detlot femili bin ol kamat brom det wan men neim Libai.

english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
kriol: Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Wal wotfo God bin wandim pipul blanga jidan laibala langa dijan kantri garram loda trabul?

english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
kriol: En deya na deibin meigim dubala jandap lida langa detlot Roman bos, en deibin tok, “Dijan dubala men iya, dubala Juwish, en dubala meigimbat trabul iya langa wi taun.

english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
kriol: Bat God sabi detlot hu laigim im brabliwei.

english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
kriol: Afta na Jisas bin jingat langa detlot najalot pipul blanga kaman langa im en im wekinmen olabat, en wen deibin kaman langa im, imbin dalim olabat, “If enibodi wandi kaman langa mi, wal im kaan jinggabat im ronselp. Ebridei im garra jidan redi blanga dai blanga mi, en im garra bulurrum mi.

english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
kriol: Dens blanga preisim im neim. Plei ola dram en ola gita blanga preisim im.

english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
kriol: Wal wen Jisas bin kamat langa detlot wekinmen blanga im deya langa det haus, det wekinmen neim Tamas Didamas nomo bin deya garram olabat,

english: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
